ngos 'dzin pa tsam 'grig kyang / ga yig sgra 'jug drag par mngon sum du grub bzhin du ma ning du bskyal ba dang / na ra la rnams las nga 'a ma rnams kyi 'jug pa sgra zhan par rtogs sla ba yin yang de dag gi dbye ba 'khrugs pa dang / gzhan yang nor ba mang zhing rgyu mtshan de rnams kyis dang 1 nang gses ston byed kyi gzhung log par bkral ba'i dbang gis nang gses kyi sgra 'jug rnams la'ang 'khrul ba'i phyir ro//gnyis pa rtags de rnams kyi 'jug pa rgyas par 'chad pa la mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yang byed pa bzhi byed de/ /gang la 'jug byed gang gis byed/ /ji ltar 'jug byed ci phyir byed//ces pas bstan/ de'ang rjes 'jug pho mo ma ning gsum re re la'ang byed pa bzhi bzhi'i sgo nas 'jug tshul shes par bya ste/ 'jug yul yi ge gang la 'jug par byed pa dang / 'jug pa po gang gis 'jug par byed pa dang /tshul ji ltar 'jug par byed pa dang / dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug par byed pa rnams kyis so/ /gnyis pa de dag rgyas par bshad pa la/ rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po gang la 'jug pa ni/ gang la yi ge thams cad la/ /zhes pas bstan te/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po de dag 'jug yul yi ge gang dang gang la 'jug na ming gzhi'i yi ge thams cad la bye brag med par 'jug go /zhes so/ /dper na/ bkag bkang / bkad/ bkan/ bkab/ bkun// bka'/ bkar/bkal/ bkas lha bu ka yig gi mthar rjes 'jug thams cad 'jug pa sogs ba 6༵ bsgro bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir rjes 'jug gi 'jug yul gyi yi ge yin

na 'dir bstan chub pa gzhi'i yi ge yin pas khyab bam zhe na ma khyab ste/ sa yig rjes 'jug ga nga ba ma rnams kyi mthar yang 'jug cing / da yig na ra la rnams la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gang gis 'jug pa ni/ gang gis bcu po de dag gis/ /zhes pas bstad te/ yi ge thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa po yi ge gang dang gang zhig gis 'jug par byed ce na sngar bshad pa'i rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po de dag gis 'jug go /zhes so/ /'dir 'grel byed kha cig gis gzhan gyis ni ma yin par rjes 'jug nyid kho nas dus gsum dang blang dor gyi gnad thams cad ston byed du 'jug go /zhes zer yang bab col du smras par zad de/ sngon 'jug sogs gzhan gang la'ang ma ltos par rjes 'jug kho nas rang dbang gis dzad 'dod pa'i rjes 'jug rang rang gi bstan bya thams cad ston pa'i phyir 'jug pa med pa'i phyir te/ gong du smos pa bzhin sngon 'jug la ma stos par sa da gnyis kyi 'jug pas 'das pa dang skul tshig ston pa dang / 'a yig gis ma 'ongs pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig ston pa tsam mthong yang de rnams ming gzhi la mi ltos pa ni mi srid pas rang stobs dang gzhan dbang gnyis kas yin la de rnams kyis de dag las gzhan pa mi ston cing rjes 'jug lhag ma rnams kyis ni rang stobs gtso bor gyur pas gang yang bstan pa ma mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ji ltar 'jug pa 'chad pa la mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ ji ltar rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /sgra yi 'jug tshul don gyi tshul/ /zhes pas bstan te rjes 'jug rnams tshul ji ltar 'jug pa'ang rdo~X pa

gnyis kyi sgo nas shes par bya ste/ rjes 'jug zhugs tshul gyis sgra drag zhan du 'gyur ba sgra'i 'jug tshul dang / de lhar zhugs pas don ci zhig ston pa don gyi 'jug tshul lo/ /zhes so/ 'dir yang kha cig rjod byed sgra dang brjod bya don zhes gsal btod pa yod mod/ sgra'i 'jug pa rnams rjod byed yin du chug kyang / skabs 'di'i don gyi 'jug tshul gyi don yin na brjod bya yin pas ma khyab ste/ rtags mtshungs dang sgra mthud 'dren tshul gyi skabs su don 'dren bya dang 'dren byed yi ge mthun mi mthun ston pa yin pas de skabs kyi don gyi 'jug pa de sgra'am yi ge'i 'jug pa yin gyi/ ming tshig de dag gis don gang zhig brjod par 'gyur ba'i brjod bya ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la sgra'i 'jug tshul dang don gyi 'jug tshul gnyis/ dang po la drag zhan spyir 'jug tshul/ nang gses zhib tu 'jug tshul/ thun mong du de dag gi dper brjod bstan pa'o/ dang po ni/ pho gsum mo gnyis ma ning gsum/ /drag zhan bar ma gsum du 'jug /ces pa ste/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu las pho skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum dang / mo mo tsam dang shin tu mo gnyis/ ma ning 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis mtshan med gsum ste 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba de rnams rim pa bzhin du pho gsum ming gzhi'i yi ge gang la zhugs kyang brjod pa'i sgra gdangs drag par 'gyur bas drag par 'jug pa dang / de bzhin du mo gnyis zhan par 'jug pa dang / ma ning gsum bar ma ste ran par 'jug pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar drag zhan bar ma gsum du 'jus pa'i rgyu mtshan des/ spyir btang rjes 'jug la pho mo ma ning gsum du rnam par bzhag pa'ang yin no zhes zhar las bstan par grub 154

bo//gnyis pa nang gses kyi 'jug tshul ni/ drag pa gsum nyid nang phrad dam/ /gal te zhan pa nang phrad na/ /de la'ang nang gi cha shas kyis/ /de yang drag zhan gnyis su dbye/ /ma ning gsum du gang gtogs pa/ /drag dang phrad na drag par 'gyur/ /zhan dang phrad na zhan par 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dag dang phrad gyur na/ /de ni gnyis ka can du 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dag dang ma phrad na/ /gang du yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /des na 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis dang / /mtshan med dag dang gsum du 'dod/ /de ni sgra yi 'jug tshul lo/ /zhes blo ka gsum dang rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan te/ de la gnyis/ gzhung don ji lha ba bshad pa dang / de'i 'thad pa sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtags ngos 'dzin gong du song ba ltar rjes 'jug la nang gses kyis rtags brgyad du dbye ba ni sgra'i 'jug tshul gyi dbang gis yin pas de rnams la sgra'i 'jug tshul tha dad pa brgyad du ji ltar dbye zhe da/ drag pa gsum ste pho yig skyes bu rab 'jing tha gsum ni rjes 'jug nyid nang phrad du gyur pa la ltos nas dbye ste/ ming gzhi gang gi mthar yang rung rjes 'jug gi pho yig rnams yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pas sgra drag pa gzhir bzhas pa'i nang gses drag 'bring gang rung du 'gyur ba'i cha nas skyes bu rab 'bring gnyis su 'byed cing / yang 'jug med pa zhugs pas sgra drag pa'i zhan par 'gyur ba'i cha nas skyes bu tha mar 'byed pa'i phyir/ 'dir dam zhes pa sdud pa'i tshig phrad de gsham du dbye zhes gsungs pa dang sbol ba'i slad du'o/ /de bzhin du gal te zhan pa ste mo yig rnams rjes 'jug nang phrad kyis ming gzhir nugs pa yod na der ltos 1༵༵/

de dag la nang gi cha shas sgra 'jug drag zhan gyi dbang gis spyir zhan pa de la'ang nang gses drag zhan gnyis su dbye ste/ yang 'jug dang bcas pa'i mo yig zhugs pa mo tsam dang / yang 'jug med na shin tu mor 'byed pa'i phyir/de bzhin du 'gyur ba sogs ma ning gsum du gang zhig gtogs par gyur pa'i rjes 'jug gi yi ge de rnams ni ming gzhir 'jug tshul dang rjes 'jug nang phrad gnyis ka la ltos nas dbye ste/ de rnams ming gzhi'i yi ge drag pa dang phrad na yang 'jug yod med ji lhar rung sgra drag par 'gyur zhing / zhan pa dang phrad na yang 'jug med pa'i tshe zhan par 'gyur ba dang / ming gzhi zhan cing yang 'jug drag pa'i bar du chud pas drag zhan gnyi ga dang phrad par gyur na/ ma ning de rnams sgra drag zhan gnyis ka can du 'gyur ba dang /ming gzhi drag zhan gnyis ka dang ma phrad pa ste bar ma ma ning gi yi ge rnams la zhugs pa'i tshe yang 'jug yod med ji ltar rung sgra drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur bar bar ma nyid du gnas pa ste/ de lhar gsum du 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rim pa bzhin du/ 'gyur ba ma ning / mtshan gnyis ma ning /mtshan med ma ning gsum du 'byed par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon gyi 'grel byed phal mo ches/ skabs 'dir drag pa gsum nang phrad pa ni/ sngon 'jug ming gzhi rjes 'jug gsum gyi pho yig 'dus pa dang / zhan pa nang phrad kyang de gsum gyi mo yig 'dus pa la 'dod mod/ de ni nges par khas blang du rung ba ma yin te/ de 'chad pa'i skabs ma yin pa dang / bshad pa mi 'thad pa dang / skabs don chad pa'i skyon gsum ba 5༵'i phyir ro/ /de la skyon dang po yod de/ 'di skabs spyir rjes 'jug gi

'jug pa 'chad pa'i skabs dang / khyad par sgra'i 'jug pa 'chad pa'i skabs dang / de las kyang nang gses 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas 'dir bla rdol du sngon rjes ming gsum ga'i thun mong gi sgra 'jug 'chad pa mi 'brel ba'i phyir ro/ /skyon gnyis pa'ang yod de/ khyed dag gi 'grel tshul gyi dbang du byas nas gzhung don la brtags pa'i tshe/ drag pa gsum dang zhan pa gsum nang phrad pa gzhir bzhag nas de dag la nang gses drag zhan gnyis su dbye ba tsam zhig las ma bstan pas/ dngos bstan de ltar du 'dod na ni sngon rjes ming gsum 'dus pa'i sgra 'jug spyir bstan pa'ang skabs 'dir dgos pa med na/ nyi tshe ba de dag bstan pa lhag par yang dgos med du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / sngon rjes ming gsum drag zhan bar ma sna tshogs phrad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ drag pa'i drag zhan 'breng gsum sogs dbye ba mang po byed pa ni rang bzo nyid du zad pas rang 'dod kyi gzhung don 'grel tshul dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir te drag zhan bar ma sna tshogs 'dus pa dbye gzhir bzung bas nang phrad ces pa'i tshig gi nus pa dang 'gal zhing / rnam pa mang por byes pas gnyis su dbye zhes pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /skyon med de snga ma shugs bstan gyi dbang du byas shing / phyi ma sngon rjes drag la ming gzhi zhan pa sogs mang por bye na'ang drag zhan so sor drag zhan gnyis gnyis su phye bas bsdus pa'i phyir/ snyam na'ang rim pa bzhin mi 'thad de gzhung du nang phrad ces nges gzung mdzad pa la nang mi mthun shugs bstan du 'byung ba 'gal ba'i phyir dang / sngon rjes mi gsum so sor pho mo ma ning gsum gsum du rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas gsungs pa la bgol nas de dag gi mo dang ma ning 167

dag sgra zhan par phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas drag zhan gnyis gnyis su dbye ba de skabs 'dir ma 'grig pas rang bzo mi byed ka med gyur pa las rgyu mtshad gang yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /skyon gsum pa'ang yod de/ gzhung 'di'i gong du rjes 'jug gi rtags gsum spyir dbye ba'i sgra 'jug bshad cing /mjug tu nang gses ma ning la gsum du dbye ba'i sgra 'jug gsungs pa'i bar du/ pho mo gnyis kyi nang gses kyi sgra 'jug nges par ston rigs pa la de ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /skyon med de pho gsum mo gnyis kyi yi ge de rnams nyid sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi la sbyor bas sgra gdangs 'byung tshul nyid 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /snyam na'ang mi 'thad de gnyis su dbye zhes nges gzung mdzad pa las brgal ba'i skyon dang thun mong gi 'jug pa bstan pa'i skyon gnyis sel bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /de lhar gzhan gyi 'dod pa la dpyad pas rang lugs 'thad par grub ste skabs don yin pa dang / bshad pa gzhung don dang mthun pa dang / gzhung gi bstan bya rdzogs par grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa thun mong du de dag gi dper brjod bstan pa ni/ rtags gsum spyir 'jug tshul gyi dper brjod zhar la rtogs pa'i dbang du byas nas 'dir nang gses brgyad kyi 'jug tshul gyi dper brjod phyogs tsam 'god pa la skyes bu rab ni/ skyogs/ dkrigs/ dkrogs/ dkrugs/ bklags/bkyigs/ 'a gas/ 'a gas/ grags/ grogs/ sgrogs/ bsgrags/ 'gags/ngogs/ bsngags/ lcags/ bcags/ 'chags/ 'jags/ 'jigs/gnyags/ stogs/ bsnyegs/ snyigs/ rtags/ rtogs/ brtags/ gtogs/bdu sa/ btags/ stegs/ thogs/ thegs/ thugs/ dogs/ 'dogs/

'degs/ gdags/ nags/ brdogs/ pags/ lhags/ spags/ sgyugs/phyags/ 'phyugs/ bags/ bogs/ blugs/ blags/ dbugs/ sbags/bregs/ dbags/ sprags/ zugs/ dmigs/ dmyugs/ rmugs/ gcigs/ btsugs/ btsags/ brtsigs/ brtsegs/ tshogs/ tshags/ tshegs/ 'dzugs/rdzogs/zhags/ zhugs/ gzhogs/ bzhugs/ gzugs/ gzigs/ gzags/bzugs/ g.yogs/ g.yigs/ rigs/ rlugs/ legs/ lags/ shags/gshegs/ gshags/ bshags/ sogs/ bsegs/ hrags/ zhes so/ /༈skyes bu 'bring ni/ skabs/ klubs/ bkrabs/ skyabs/ bskyabs/ skobs/ 'khobs/bsgrubs/ spubs/ brdubs/ bcabs/ bcibs/ chabs/ chibs/ 'jabs/'jibs/ bsnyabs/ snyobs/ stabs/ stobs/ gtibs/ bstabs/ thabs/'thibs/ drubs/ ldebs/ bsdebs/ snabs/ bsdubs/ snabs/ mnabs/spabs/ phebs/ byabs/ brabs/ brubs/ spubs/ gtsubs/ rtsibs/ rtsabs/tshabs/ 'tshabs/ zhabs/ gzhibs/ gzhabs/ gzabs/ g.yabs/ rabs/brlabs/ rlobs/ shubs/ gshibs/ srubs/ bslabs/ bsabs/ 'a sogs pa rnams so/ /1skyes bu tha ma ni/ skas/ skad/ bkag bkab/ mkhas/'khrid/ khrag khrab/ 'gas/ bgrad/ sgrog grub/ sngas/ nged/ ngag rngab/ la sogs pa'o/ /༈mo tsam ni/ bskangs/ bskums/ ba sa/ khams/ gangs/bgoms/ dngangs/ brngams/ la sogs pa'o/ /1shin tu mo ni/ bskang /kong / skom/ bka'/ khong / kham/ mkha'/ gang / sgrom/ 'ga'/ ngang /dngom/ snga' la sogs pa'o/ /1'gyur ba ma ning ni/ bstand/ rkun/bskord/ bstar/ stsald/ btsal/ 'gran/ 'gor/ 'gul/ la sogs pa'o/ /169

1mtshan gnyis pa ni/ 'dzind/ brgyand/ gyurd/ 'byord/ rold/bsald/ la sogs pa'o/ /1mtshan med ni/ phyind/ mthun/ thard/ 'thor/'phruld/ 'khrul la sogs pa rnams te de dag gis mtshon nas rgya cher shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa don gyi 'jug tshul la/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/dang po ni/ don ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /snga ma gang ltar gyur pa dang / /phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes pas bstan te/ rjes 'jug rnams don gang dang gang la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i tshul ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ snga ma rjes 'jug nyid gang la zhugs shing gnas pa'i ming de'i don gang ltar te ji lta bu zhig tu 'gyur ba dang / phyi ma rjes 'jug gam mtha' des ming mtha' la sogs pa 'dren tshul gyis don gang ltar 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa de rgyas par 'chad pa la gnyis las/ dang po snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba 'chad pa la/ gzhung don dper brjod dang bcas dgod pa dang /gzhan gyi 'dod pa nor bar bstan pa gnyis so/ dang po ni/ snga ma sngon 'jug lnga bzhin sbyar/ /zhes pas bstan te/ rjes 'jug rnams gang la zhugs pa'i ming de nyid ming mtha' sogs la ltos nas snga mar grub pas des bdag gzhan sogs don ci zhig ston pa ni ming de'i sngon du gnas pa sngon 'jug lnga las gang zhig yin pa de'i don dang ji lha ba bzhin du sbyar nas rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /des na gtso bor sngon 'jug gi nus pa dang sbyar nas rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang ci rigs par bdag gzhan dang dus gsum gyi don rnams de dang mtshungs par ston par 'gyur ba yin gyi skabs 'ga' zhig 1ma

tu ma gtogs par rjes 'jug gi nus pa gtso che bas ni ma yin no/ /zhes pa ni 'dir shes par bya ba'i gnad dam pa'o/ /'dir kha cig sngon 'jug la mi ltos par/ byas/ zos/ grags/ chad/ thard/ thond/ phog dag phab/ lha bu pho yig gis 'das pa ston pa dang / gyis/ byos/ khos/ nond/ rold/chod/ rgyob/ shog lta bu pho yig gis skul tshig ston pa dang / sngon 'jug la ltos kyang rjes 'jug gi nus pa gtso ba/ bskangs/ bsgrubs/ bsams/bsags/ bsad/ bcad/ bstand/ bskyard/ bsald/ lha bu pho yig gis 'das pa spub pa sogs mang du yod pas 'dir rjes 'jug gi nus pa gtso bor mi 'chad pa mi legs so snyam pa dag yod par mngon yang / dogs pa mi dgos te/skul tshig gi 'jug tshul ni gzhung 'dir dngos shugs gang du'ang ma bstan pa der bas/ sngon 'jug la ma stos par rjes 'jug rnams nyid bdag gzhan dang dus gsum sogs bya byed dang 'brel ba'i ming tshig thams cad la 'jug pa yod kyang sngon 'jug can la ltos na shas chung bas zhar la go ba'i dbang du mdzad cing / sngon 'jug las rjes 'jug gi nus pa gtso ba 'das pa sgrub pa'i sa yig gi 'jug yang 'jug gnyis ka dang da yig gi yang 'jug kho na tsam la yod kyi gzhan rnams sngon 'jug gi nus pa gtso ba kho na yin pa'i phyir sngon 'jug gi 'jug pas bdag gzhan sogs ston pa khyab che bas gtso bor gyur pa la dgongs nas 'dir sngon 'jug lnga bzhin spyar zhes nges gzung gis gsungs pa lhar kho bos legs par bshad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sngon 'jug med par rjes 'jug gi don bstan pa ches mang ste ming rkyang phal cher de 'dra yin pa'i phyir snyam na/ de 'dra'i ming rkyang rnams rjes 'jug gis 161

ming du grub pa yin kyang des bdag gzhan dang dus gsum sogs bstan pa med pas/ spyir rtags 'jug gi gzhung 'di'i bstan bya'i gtso bo ma yin la/khyad par sngon 'jug lnga bzhin spyar/ /zhes pa'i sbyar bya ma yin par nges pas skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ /des na skabs 'di'i dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas pa'i dper brjod ni sngon 'jug gi skabs su rgyas par bstan pa nyid las logs su mi dgos na'ang phyogs mtshon pa'i phyir rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi go rim dang mthun par cung zad bkod pas go bde ba la bsams nas dper brjod na/ skyes bu'i rtags rab 'bring tha gsum ci rigs par dus 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ brtags/ btags/ bcags/ bsags/ bsgrubs/ bskyabs/bstabs/ bkag bltas/ brgyab/ bcad/ lta bu dang/ de rnams byed pa bdag la 'jug pa ni/ 'dogs byed/ 'degs byed/ 'dzugs byed/ 'gugs byed/ gzhibs byed/ gshibs byed/ bsnub byed/ 'jog byed/ 'gas byed/'grub byed/ gcod byed/ lha bu dang / de rnams bya ba gzhan la 'jug pa ni/gdags bya/ bsdigs bya/ bsdogs bya/ gtubs bya/ dgag bya/ brtas bya/gzab bya/ bsgrub bya/ bstab bya/ bskyab bya/ bskyed bya/ lta bu dang / de rnams bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas ma bsdus pa'i da lta dang ma 'ongs pa ci rigs par 'jug pa ni/ 'degs bzhin pa/ 'dogs bzhin pa/ gtubs bzhin pa/'gog bzhin pa/ gcod bzhin pa/ rang bzhin gyis gshegs par 'gyur/rang bzhin gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ 'chad par 'gyur/ 'thas par 'gyur/lha bu rnams so/ /de bzhin du mo rtags gnyis 'das pa 'a 'jug pa/brdo~Xs/ brkyangs/ bskums/ bkang / bkram/ lha bu dang / 1bdag la

'jug pa/ 'doms byed/ 'gengs byed/ mchongs byed/ 'dong byed/ 'a sgo byed/ gsol byed/ lta du dang / 1gzhan la 'jug pa/ gdams bya/ 'khums bya/ bskang bya/dgang bya/ gtams bya/ bza' bya/ lta bu dang / 1da lta dang ma 'ongs par 'jug pa/ 'doms bzhin pa/ 'gengs bzhin pa/ 'dod bzhin pa/ gso' bzhin pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'doms par 'grur/ 'gro bar 'gyur/ 'gong bar 'gyur/ 'dam par 'gyur/ lta bu'o/ /1ma ning gsum 'das pa la/ bstand/ bkand/ bkard/ bstard/ bcald/ mnand/bgard/ bsald/ mab da/ mtshard/ 'jild/ lha bu dang/ 1bdag la/brtsand byed/ brtson byed/ gnon byed/ gtor byed/ gsor byed/ bkold byed/ 'grol byed/ 'dund byed/ 'dzerd byed/gsold byed/ mthard byed/'khor byed/ 'phend byed/ mthun byed/ 'thul byed/ lta bu dang / 1gzhan la/ bsten bya/ bskur bya/ dgar bya/ bskol bya/ bskyal bya/ mkhyen bya/ 'tshir bya/ 'khol bya/ lha bu dang / da lha dang ma 'ongs par/ bstund bzhin pa/gnon bzhin pa/ gtor bzhin pa/ 'dzind bzhin pa/ gsold bzhin pa/'greld bzhin pa/ 'thord bzhin pa/ mkhyend bzhin pa/ rang bzhin gyis/dkond par 'gyur/ 'dund par 'gyur/ mthun par 'gyur/ gsal bar 'gyur/ 'khul bar 'byur/ lta bu rgya cher shes par bya'o/ /de ltar sngon 'jug la ltos pa gtso bor gsungs pa'i zhar las sngon 'jug med pa'i ming don rnams la ji lhar 'jug pa'ang shes par bya ste/ dper na/ skyes pa'i rtags 'das pa la 'jug pa/ grags/ thogs zhugs/ byabs/ byas/ gas/ bros/phos/ nos/ spras/ zos/ phog nog thub/ grub/ sprad/ chad/ khod/1no /

co gas dang / 1bdag la/ sgrogs byed/ stogs byed/ stobs byed/ klubs byed/ lcibs byed/ sgrub byed/ sgrod byed/ sdod byed/ rjed byed/ snyeg byed/deg byed/ ltos byed/ sogs dang / 1gzhan la/ rtogs bya/ grabs bya/ shes bya/ skug bya/ glod bya sogs dang / ༈de dag las gzhan da lha dang ma 'ongs par 'jug pa/ rtogs bzhin pa/ shes bzhin pa/ sdod bzhin pa sogs dang /rtogs par 'gyur/ skug par 'gyur/ shes par 'gyur/ zhes sogs kyis mtshon par bya'o/ /de bzhin du mo gnyis 'das pa la 'jug pa/ spangs/khengs/ thengs/ goms/ khrems/ gang / song / pham/ gum/ chom/ them sogs dang / 1bdag la/ stongs byed/ rengs byed/ stems byed/ nyams byed/ myong byed/ snang byed/ blo byed/ sra' byed/ rgyu' byed/ 1gzhan la/ spung bya/ spang bya/ spring bya/ blang bya/ rlom bya/ smra' bya/ sogs dang / 1da lha dang ma 'ongs par/ rengs bzhid pa/ stems bzhin pa/ myong bzhin pa/ zlo' bzhin pa/ ngang gis stongs par 'gyur/ nyams par 'gyur/ gang bar 'gyur/dam par 'gyur/ sra' bar 'gyur/ sogs so/ /1ma ning gsum 'das par 'jug pa/ tshild/ rold/ dul/ shar/ bor/ sprand/ brand/ zind/smind/ byind/ phyind/ thard/ tshard/ tshor/ thal sogs dang / ༈bdag la/ stond/ stend/ rtend/ sbyin/ spun/ sgron/ skurd/ spruld/ sgyur/ spel/lend/ smond/ seld/ nyand/ khur/ phan byed sogs dang / gzhan la/spar bya/ spel bya/ sbar bya/ sbyin bya/ myul bya/ smon bya/ rgal bya sogs dang /༈da lha dang ma 'ongs par yang / stond bzhin pa/ stend bzhin pa/ sgyur bsdi~X pa/ sgrol bzhin pa/ myul bzhin pa/ grol bar 'gyur/ sman par 'gyur/

phyind par 'gyur/ thar bar 'gyur/ sogs te 'di dag gis 'di rigs thams cad la mtshon par bya'o/ /de ltar dper brjod pa de rnams las sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo bdag gzhan sogs thams cad la mnyam par 'jug par gsungs pa bzhin du sngon 'jug la ltos par/ mthun mkhyen sogs mang po dang / sngon 'jug med par yang / rtogs/ spungs/ snang / stegs/ rengasaspruld sogs mang po bdag gzhan dus gsum kun la gzugs tha dad med par 'jug pas 'jug yul bdag gzhan sogs gang yin tshig grogs las shes par bya dgos pa rnams kyang blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang gzhung 'dir dmigs bsal du ma bstan kyang rjes 'jug sa yig gi 'jug yang 'jug gnyi ga dang / da yig gi yang 'jug gis dus 'das pa ston pa shin tu mang zhing / 'a yig 'das pa la mi 'jug pa'i khyad par tsam di gsal bar mthong ba sngon rjes kyi dper brjod bkod pa rnams su gsal zhing / grags che ba der zad/ rjes 'jug rnams skul tshig la 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ gzhung 'di'i dngos shugs gnyi gar ma bstan pas bshad byar ma gyur mod/ 'on kyang de'i rnam gzhag zhar las rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dper brjod na/ sa da gnyis dang khyad par sa yig skul tshig la 'jug pa mang bar mthong ste/ snyoms shig klogs shig sgrogs shig rtogs shig rtsigs shig zhugs shig sregs shig tshugs shig zlogs shig rlobs shig slobs shig sgrubs shig rtsis shig gyis shigabyos shig rgyus shig rngos shig sngos shig ltos shig nos shigaskos shig rkus shig khos shig chos shig drongs shig srongs 166

shig chings shig sungs shig dengs shig skyongs shigasdoms shig snyoms shig soms shig rtsoms shig stond cigathond cig nond cig sold cig nyond cig stend cigasnyend cig rold cig rtsold cig phrold cig sgrold cigaskurd cig sbord cig stord cig chod cig sod cig khod cig sdod cig slod cig ces pa la sogs pa dang / rjes 'jug gzhan der 'jug pa na/ shog cig khog cig zlog cig phob cigathob cig rgyob cig sgong zhig zung zhig song zhig ma smra' zhig ma lta' zhig ma zlo' zhig snun zhig skrun zhig phyor zhigasbyor zhig tshol zhig skol zhig lha bu ste 'di rnams kyis mtshon nas rgya cher shes par bya'o/ /des na skul tshig phal cher la sngon 'jug med pa mang zhing sngon 'jug spyar dkos pa'ang yod de/ bkros shig bstod cigabartson zhig bsnos shig gtord cig gdungs shig gsongs shigadakrugs shig dgongs shig dpyod cig mchod cig mchong zhig mdzod cig 'goms shig ma 'gro' zhig ma 'tshe' zhigaces pa lta bu rnams so/ /gnyis pa gzhan gyi 'dod pa nor bar bstan pa ni/ skabs 'dir 'grel byed snga ma phal cher gyis/ snga ma sngon 'jug lnga bzhin sbyar/ /zhes pa'i don sngon 'jug ltar rjes 'jug gi pho yig dmas 'das pa dang / gzhan sgrub la 'jug pa sogs rtags kyi bye brag gis 'jug yul so sor sbyar rgyur 'dod mtsho/ de ltar sbyor ba skabs re gnyis la 'grig pa ltar snang yang phal mo

cher nges pa med pa'i sbyor tshul du 'gyur bas mi 'thad pa'i tshul gong du rtags ngos 'dzin gyi skabs su bshad zin cing / gzhan yang de ltar 'dod pa la skyon mang du yod de/ gzhung gi spyi'i sa bcad dang mi 'grig pa dang / bye brag mdor bstan dang 'gal ba dang / zhen don gyi dper brjod mi 'thad pa'i skyon rnams yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ snga ma sngon 'jug sogs kyi gzhung 'di/ spyi'i sa bcad ji lhar 'jug byed 'chad pa'i skabs dang / de las kyang don gyi ji ltar 'jug byed 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa la/ de dang— mi 'grig pa'i ci phyir 'jug byed bshad pa'i phyir te/ rjes 'jug rnams sngon 'jug gi ci phyir 'jug par bshad pa lhar/ rtags kyi khyad par gyis bdag gzhan dang dus gsum gyi khyad par nges par ston pa'i slad du 'jug par bshad pa'i phyir/ snga ma ma grub ste/ ji lhar 'jug pa dang ci phyir 'jug pa gnyis ka dang mthun par bshad du yod pa'i phyir/ snyam na'ang ma yin te/ ci phyir 'jug pa ni don de ston byed du nges par 'jug pa zhig dgos la/ ji ltar 'jug pa ni/ sgra don de dang der 'jug pa tsam du zad pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang ji lhar dang ci phyir gyi 'jug pa gnyis skabs 'dir mthun par bshad na/ gsham du ci phyir 'jug pa gsungs pa zlos pa'am dbye ba 'khrugs pa'i skyon du 'gyur zhing / gal te/ pho ni 'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir/ /sogs sngon 'jug gi skabs ci phyir 'jug 'chad byed yin yang 'dir min no zer na'ang / sa bcad ma 'grig pas ci bya gtol med kyis byung rgyal du smras par zad de/ rgyu mtshan med par ma zad don ci'i phyir 'jug pa 'chad bzhin pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa grub ste/ bye brag snyi~X gyi

'jug tshul la gnyis su dbye ba'i snga ma gang lhar 'gyur ba zhes mdor bstan pa 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa gang zhig de la khyed kyis rjes 'jug rnams rang dbang gis don ston byed du 'jug par bshad pa 'gal ba'i phyir te/'gyur ba zhes pa'i don rjes 'jug rnams rang dbang mi btsan par sngon 'jug la sogs pa'i don bzhin du 'gyur 'gro ba la 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/de ma grub snyam na/ de ltar 'chad rigs te snga ma rjes 'jug gi don gtso bor sngon 'jug gi rjes su 'gro zhing phyi ma ming mtha' dang rnam dbye sogs kyi don rjes 'jug dang tshig phyi ma dag gi rjes su 'gro ba gzhung du gang lhar 'gyur ba zhes pa'i sgras mtshungs par bstan pa'i phyir te/ de lhar ma bshad pas sngar smos pa'i skyon de rnams kyang spong mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa grub ste/khyed rnams kyis skabs 'dir da ba sa gsum gyis 'das pa ston pa'i dper bkod pa/ bcad/ bkab/ bkas/ zhes pa rnams las phyi ma sa yig gis 'das pa bstan du chug kyang / snga ma gnyis 'das tshig tu grub pa rjes 'jug gi nus pas ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis/ gcad/ gcod/ dgab/ 'geb/zhes bya byed kyi tshig la sbyar ba'i tshe na'ang rjes 'jug de kho na las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ sngon 'jug gi nus pa kho nas bya byed kyi tshig tu grub pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dper brjod de tsam la'ang yid brtan pher ba ma byung na/ rang nyid kyis bshad pa dang mthun pa'i dper brjod gzhan rnams 'god par lta ga la nus pas 'god ma nus pa der zad do/ /gzhan yang /lugs de khas len pa'i phyis byung zhig gis skabs 'dir dper brjod cung zad mang bar 'god pa'i khul du byas te/ bya ba byas/ char pa phob/ me tog 168

phog na tsha chad ces sogs 'das pa la 'jug pa dang / sras po/ srab/srog /srid lha bu dngos po gzhan dang / gdams par bya/ pe par bya/bklag par bya/ brjod par bya lta bu bya tshig dang dngos su 'brel ba dang /rgyas par byas/ sa bon btab/ lam 'gog snod 'dzed lha bu dngos su ma 'brel yang bya ba pe pa la 'jug pa dang / nam mkha' lta bu gzhan dang /yod pa'i gda' sogs da ltar ba ston pa dang / 'gyur/ 'jal/ 'byung /'dren/ 'gram/ blo gsar/ chu skor/ bgrang phreng / mdun/ mtshal sogs bdag dang ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /zhes bris mod/ de rnams zer rgyus phongs pa'am blo rnal du mi gnas pa'i skyon nyid kyis byung rgyal du smras pa ste 'das pa'i dper skul tshig bris pa dang / gzhan gyi dper ming rkyang dang 'das tshig dang byed tshig bkod pa dang / bdag dang ma 'ongs pa'i dper ming rkyang bkod pa sogs phal cher 'gal ba kho nar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /khyad par ming rkyang rnams 'di'i dper brjod du bkod pa ni shin tu mtshang che ste/ming rkyang tsam de 'dir bstan gyi bdag gzhan dang dus gsum gyis ma bsdus pa sngod 'jug gi skabs su bshad pa lha bu'i phyir dang / ming rkyang rnams la rjes 'jug thams cad ste brag med par 'jug pa yin pas rtags kyi 'jug don gyi dbang gis tha dad du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci'ang med pa'i phyir ro/ /stes dbang gis dper brjod 'grig pa de rnams kyang gong smos bzhin rang gi zhen don gyi sgrub byed du mi 'gro ste/ 'a yig 'das pa la mi 'jug pa dang /sa da gnyis 'das pa la 'jug pa mang ba tsam las gzhan bye zag cher med par rjes 'jug rnams bdag gzhan dang dus gsum thams cad la ka~X 9

pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/ mkhas rlob phal cher ri bong cal rjes stogs/ /smig rgyu'i chur sred brag ca'i glu dbyangs len/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang de 'dra'i 'bab stegs la/ /gzhol zhing ngal ba ci yang bsten pa mthong / /'di dang 'di 'dra'i tshul la brtags pa'i tshe/ /nam yang gzhan dring kho nar mi bsten cing/ /gzhan zer kho na'i lad mo'ang mi slo bas/ /kho bo'i blo gros skal ba bzang snyam bgyid/ /mkhas pa'i bstan bcos rang bzhin dag pa'i dngos/ /gsal byed mkhas pa nyid la rag las te/ /'dod sbyin dbyig mchog nor bu bzud/ /ded dpon mkhas pas yongs su sbyangs la ltos/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba 'chad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi ma dag gi 'dren tshul ni/ /zhes pa ste/ phyi ma ming mtha' dang rnam dbye sogs kyi thob thang gi don ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur ba'i tshul ni snga ma'i rjes 'jug dang phyi ma'i brjod bya dag la ci rigs par ltos pa'i sgo nas 'dren pa'i phyir de'i tshul smos pa ni/ zhes mdor bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la ming mtha' 'dren tshul dang / rnam dbye sogs 'dren tshul 'chad pa ste gnyis so/ dang po ni/ pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drang //mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drang / /ma ning gis ni ma ning ngo / /zhes pas bstan te/ ming snga ma'i mtha'i rjes 'jug pho yig gis/ de nyid kyi ming mtha' gzhan gyi ming gzhi'i pho yig drang bar bya zhing / de bzhin du mo yig gis mo'i ming mtha' drang ba dang / ma ning gis ma ding gi ming mtha' drang bar bya'o/ /170

zhes so/ /des na ming snga ma'i mtha'i rjes 'jug rnams kyang ming mtha' yin mod kyi 'dir bstan gyi ming mtha' zhes pa ni rjes 'jug gis ming du grub pa'i ming snga ma de nyid kyi cha shas ming de'i mthar sbyar rgyu zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos so/ /de dag gi dper brjod pa ni/ phos pho'i ming mtha' drangs pa/dpyid ka stond ka thad ka stod kor/ klad kor/ berd ka bstod pa/ ba pa/ bcad pa/ phand pa/ phyind pa/ stend pa/ sdod pa/ rtsod pa/ nod pa/ glod pa/ khyab pa/ chub pa/ grub pa/ sgrub pa/ skyod pa/ gdab pa/thob pa/ 'grub pa/ thub pa/ sos ka gnyis ka byas pa/ bsgrubs pa/brtags pa/ dgongs pa/ gtams pa/ dngos po/ dgos pa/ goms pa/bzlas pa/ dmigs pa/ chags pa/ mchis pa/ pags pa/ skyes pa/ rtag pa/'phrag pa/ zag pa/ ltag pa/ dag pa/ reg pa/ lag pa/ bdug pa/ gdug pa/gcig pu/ cig car/ bdag cag la sogs shin tu mang ngo / /mos mo'i ming mtha' drangs pa ni/ gang ba/ byung ba/ mthong ba/ gsung ba/ 'byung ba/'drong ba/ gtong ba/ bskang ba/ dgang ba/ bzang ba/ snying ga mthong gamathing ga lngang ga spang ma/ dang ma/ gdung ma/ gsing ma/ 'dung ma/'dem ga gsum ga tham ga zla ba/ 'dra ba/ dpa' ba/ sra ba/ dga' ba/ 'cha' ba/ bde ba/ re ba/ mdza' ba/ bkra ba/ gda' ba/ nyi ma/ dga' ma/ gta' ma/ 'da' ga ya ga nya ga 'di ga gro ga khyi gu/ lu gu/sogs so/ /ma ning gis ma ning drangs pa di/ ston kha/ dgun kha/ mon kha/dbyar kha/ ser kha/ gtar kha/ shar kha/ myur kha/ ral kha/ thal kha/ mtshal kha/rgyal kha/ gsal kha/ dpal kha/ sogs so/ /de ltar ming mtha' rtags mtshungs 171

kho na 'dren pa lta bur gsungs pa ni pho mo'i rtags phal cher gyis de ltar 'dred pas gtso che ba tsam la dgongs pa ste/ 'chad 'byur ltar/ de nyid rang gi sgra mthun pa'i/ /zhes gsungs pa dang sbyar na 'dren tshul gzhan yang yod par grub cing / mngon sum gyis kyang 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ma ning gi rtags rnams kyis rtags mtshungs 'dren pa dper brjod bkod pa 'di 'dra thor khu las/ phal cher brjod bde bas sgra mthun pa mo rtags nyid drangs pa mthong ste/ mngon ba/ mthun ba/ bstar ba/ shar ba/ dar ba/ 'thul ba/gsal ba/ rgyal ba/ zhes pa lta bu dang / mo rtags ma yig gis kyang brjod bde rang sde'i skyes pa'i rtags drangs pa/ dam pa/ bsam pa/ rngam pa/ skam pa/ ram pa/ rim pa/ lcam pa/ rnam pa/ bum pa/ lha bu mang du snang bas bye brag so sor ma 'dzings par rtogs par bya'o/ /gzhan du rkang pa/ khang pa/stong pa/ sogs nga yig gis pho drangs pa 'ga' zhig snang ba/ kha cig gis/bdag po'i sgra yin par 'dod kyang mi 'thad pa rtogs sla bas de dag dang /gzhan yang / lhas ma/ btsas ma/ ltad mo/ stag ma/ sogs phos mo drangs pa lha bu dmigs bsal de 'dra thar thor la nges pa med de/ ka lnga par/ lhag ma 'jig rten pa'i nyer spyod las 'dzin pa grub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'jig rten pa'i grags pa dang bstun dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir kha cigakhyod kyis rtags mtshungs 'dren pa'i dper bkod pa 'di rnams la khyod nyid kyis khas blangs pa dang 'gal ba yod de/ sngar yang 'jug dang bcas pa'i na ra la rnams ma ning dang / nga ma yang 'jug can rnams mo rtags su khas blangs pa gang zhig 'dir de rnams kyis pho yig drangs pa/ phos po'i ming 172

mtha' drangs pa'i dper brjod du bkod pa'i phyir/ snyam na skyon med de/sngar sgra gdangs drag zhan gyi 'jug tshul gyi dbang gis bshad cing / 'dir yang 'jug med na ming mtha'i rjes 'jug de nyid dang yod na yang 'jug nyid kyi rtags gang yin pa dang sbyar nas ming mtha' phyi ma 'dren tshul tsam 'chad pa yin gyi/ snga ma ltar 'jug yang 'jug gnyi ga bsdebs pa'i sgra gdangs de'i nus pa 'chad pa'i skabs ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs 'dir 'grel byed snga ma rnams kyis ming gzhi phyi mas ming mtha' snga ma 'dren par 'dod kyang / shin tu mi 'thad de/ skabs 'di'i 'dren tshul ni ngag gi brjod pa dang sbyar nas rtogs dgos pa'i phyir 'dren byed sngon du ma brjod par de la ltos pa'i 'dren bya'i brjod pa 'byung ba mi srid de/ dper na/ rtag lha bu'i ngag sngon du yod na de'i ming mtha' ga la ltos pa'i ming mtha' phyi ma pa yig 'dren par 'gyur ba lha bu kho na yin pa'i phyir te/ khyed rnams lhar na ltos sa ma byung ba'i sngon du ltos chos grub zin pa dang / 'dren byed ma byung ba'i sngon du der ltos pa'i 'dren bya grub zin pa sogs phyin ci log mang po khas len dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ 'dren byed rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sogs su byas shing/ 'dren bya ming snga ma'i mthar 'dod pa de las/ ming mtha' de dag nyid kyis kyang / /sogs kyi gzhung 'chad pa'i tshe dngos 'gal du'ang spru dgos par byung snang ba'i phyir ro/ /spyir yang ming mtha' snga mas phyi ma 'dren/ ming mtha' snga phyi gnyi gas rnam dbye sogs 'dren pa 'di'i rgyu mtshan la nges pa ma rnyed pas/ 'dren bya'i ming mtha' ngos ma zin pa dang /'dren tshul go zlog dang rnal ma gnyis thon pa 'di lags so/ /gzhan yang 173

skad gnyis spru ba 'ga' zhig gis/ dkond cog rind cen/ thabs cigalhand cig yungs kar la sogs pa rnams/ de dag gi skad dod legs spyar la dkon pa'i mchog dang rin thang chen po dang grangs kyi gcig dang kha dog dkar po sogs kyi don med pas de dang de'i don du mi 'jil ba'i phyir phos pho'i ming mtha' drangs par bzhed pa mkhas pa'i gsung yin yang zhib mor dpyad na go ba mi bzang ste/ spyir sngar bod du ma grags pa'i brda gsung rab sgyur ba na dgos par byung nas legs sbyar gyi skad dang sbyar te gsar du btags pa rnams la legs sbyar gyi byings sogs dang bstun nas dpyad pas snang la ma nges pa'i dogs pa sel zhing brjod don ji bzhin du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin mod/ 'on kyang thams cad la des ma khyab ste/ lpa don dang sbyar nas btags pa ma yin par mtshon don gyi sgo nas ming gsar du dzin ba dag kyang yod cing de 'dra la skad dod yod med dang khams dang rkyen gyi nus pas 'grub mi 'grub dpyad du med pa'i phyir te/ ka ri ka/ zhes pa tshig le'ur byas par bsgyur na der tshig dang le'u gnyi ga'i skad dod med pa dang/brdzi ka/ dka' 'grel du bsgyur na der dka' ba dang 'grel ba gnyi ga'i skad dod med pa sogs shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du bod nyid la sngar nas grags pa'i brda 'dod rgyal dang rjes spub gang yin yang rung / de 'dra'i sdeb sbyor la legs sbyar gyis zhus dag bgyid mi gtub ste/ de 'dra de legs sbyar nas bsgyur ba yin yang skad gnyis po'i 'jug yul mtshungs phyin/ sgra don gyi zur yan chad gcig shos la gang yod gcig shos la yod pa'i bar bkab ci~X mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ ra sna zhes pa dkon cog tu bsgyur ba

ni/ bod du dam chos ma dar gong du dkon cog gi brda med pa la lo tsā bas rin cen du bsgyur na dbyig gi mchog dang thun mong du 'gyur ba'i phyir thun mong min pa'i don mtshon par 'dod nas lung dang sbyar te dkon pa dang sgra don dang phyag nas mchog ces bsdebs nas ming gcig tu mdzad pa yin no/ /de lha na dkon cog 'don par rung ngam zhe na/ de ltar shin tu rung ste dkon cog ces ming gcig tu byed pa'i tshe mchog gi sgra ming mthar 'gyur bas phos pho'i ming mtha' drang ba'i phyir sngon 'jug mo yig phyis nas ming gzhi'i ma ning rang sde'i pho yig tu bsgyur bar zad kyi don bsgyur ba ma yin pa'i phyir/legs sprul la tri ti sro du bsgyur ba bzhin no/ /des na dkon pa dang mchog gi sgra don lung la brten nas bshad du yod pa'i phyir dkon mchog ces 'don pa 'thad kyi dkon cog ces mi rung ngo zer ba'ang gnad 'di ma rtogs pa'i cal col tsam mo/ /ra sna'i sgra mchog la mi 'jug pa'ang ma yin te/ rang rigs kyi mchog la 'jug pa'i phyir te/ ra sna rang rigs gtso bo la/ /zhes 'byur ba'i phyir rat+na'i sgra la mchog gi skad dod dngos su med zer ba dang /tsan+d+ra pa'i nu ṇa sogs su ra sna ni gang mchog tu gyur pa de'o/ /zhes 'byung ba lung 'dren pa'ang 'gal ba yin te/ ra sna'i sgra mchog gi skad dod dngos su 'gyur bar lung de nyid kyis grub pa'i phyir/ dkon cog ces pa bod kyi 'dod rgyal yin zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ de bod du thog ma nas ma grags shing mkhas pa dag gis don dang bstun nas rgyu mtshan dang bcas par gsar du btags pa'i ming yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du rin po che'i sgra bsdus pas rin cen zhes pa ni bod brda rnying pa yin zhing rin thang che ba'i don yang yin 176

mod/ de'i skad dod kyang rat+na yin pas de la rin che ba'i sgra bshad byed du med kyang de dag gi 'jug yul rang rigs kyi gtso bo yin par mtshungs pas rin cen du bsgyur ba mi 'gal zhing rin thang che ba'i don nyid mi gtong bar phos pho'i ming mtha' drang ba'i dgos pas rind cen du grub pa'ang yin no/ /bod skad rin thang che ba tsam rang rigs kyi mchog la mi 'jug pa'ang ma yin te/ dper na/ skyes bu 'gang chen bud med 'gang chen nor 'gang chen zhes grong pa la grags pa'ang rin thang che ba'i tshig tsam yin pa bzhin no/ /thabs cig gam/ lhand cig gi sgra'ang / de'i skad dod la grangs gcig gi don med rung/ bod brda rnying pa phyogs gcig gam chab gcig gam tshom gcig gi don can yin pas grangs kyi sgrar nges pa dang / yungs kar zhes pa'ang yungs dkar nag gi zlas bye ba'i yungs ni dkar po yin pas dkar zhes pa kha dog nyid du gor ma chag pas de dag gi gcig dang dkar la 'phul byed dor ba'ang ming mtha' 'dren tshul nyid do/ /rgyu mtshan 'dis/ skad dod dang bod skad gnyis ka mthun pa'i sgo nas grangs su nges pa land cig lta bu la'ang ga 'phul mi 'byung ba'i gnad ka dang / skad cig gi da yig 'byid mi dgos pa sogs kyang shes par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rgya gar zhes pa rgya las logs su gar ba'i don yin zhes 'chad cing rgya dkar po'i don du 'dod pa rnams la gti thug lung med du rtsi bar mdzad kyang / legs par brtags na cir 'gyur mi shes te/ rgya nag po zhes pa yul de'i mi rnams zhwa gos sogs nag po shas che ba las grags shing cig shos de las bzlog pa'i phyir/ rgya nag gi zlas ka~X pa'i rgya dkar po zhes bod du grags par zad mod/ 'on kyang ming

mtha' 'dren tshul gyis sngon 'jug ma ning da yig phyis/ ming gzhi rang sde'i mo yig tu bsgyur bas rgya gar zhes grub par 'khums pas so/ /de bzhin du/klad kor dang / stod kor dang / pad kor sogs kyang skor ba'i don la/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi dbang las sa mgo mo yig yin pas phyis pa ste skor ba'i skad dod yod med rtsad gcod mi dgos shing tho skor nye skor sogs la sa mgo nges par sbyar dgos pa lha bu'ang go bar bya'o/ /des na 'di 'dra'i rigs ming mtha' rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul sngon gyi brda rnying la shin tu mang ba zhig yod pa 'dra'ang gsar bcad kyi zhus dag mangs pas da lha phal cher nub par gdod mi za bas dper brjod kyang cher mi snang la/ 'dis thams cad la rigs 'gre sbyar chog pa'ang min par mngon te/ 'di rigs ming mtha' 'dren tshul rtags mtshungs brjod bde mi bde sogs dang bstun pa'i tshig sdud las byung ba'i dmigs bsal gyi yi ge'i rnam 'gyur zhig tu mngon pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ pad ces pa'i da yig pho yin pas sa mgo mi 'thob ce na'ang mi 'thad de/ spub skor dang bshad spub dang mdzad spyod sogs mtha' yas pa zhig la sa mgo mi thob par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ba'ang snying pos dben par rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dam dbye sogs 'dren tshul la/ spyir 'dren tshul dang / nang gses 'jug tshul bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ ming mtha' de dag nyid kyis ni/ /de nyid rang gi sgra mthun pa'i/ /chos dngos las dang byed pa dang / /sbyin dang 'byung khungs 'brel ba dang / /gnas dang bod pa'i sgra yang drang / /gzhan yang slar bsdu lhag bcas dang / /'byed sdud bsnan dang bdag po 177

dang / /dgag sgrub rgyan dang dus la'ang 'jug /de dag snga shugs 'dren pas 'byung / /zhes pas bstan te/ bshad ma thag pa'i ming mtha' snga phyi de dag nyid kyis/ ming mtha' de dag nyid rang gi rtags mtshungs pa'am brjod pa bde bas sgra mthun par gyur pa'i rnam dbye dang po chos dngos te ngo bo tsam brjod pa dang / gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / gsum pa byed pa po'am byed pa tsam dang / bzhi pa sbyin pa'i yul gyis mtshon nas ched du bya ba dang / lnga pa 'byung khungs dang / drug pa 'brel ba dang / bdun pa gnas gzhi dang /brgyad pa bod pa'i sgra rnams kyang drang bar bya zhing / de bzhin du gzhan yang rnam dbye'i yan lag tu gyur pa'am ma gyur pa'i tshig phrad/ slar bsdu dang /lhag bcas dang / 'byed sdud dang / bsnan pa dang / bdag po dang / dgag pa dang / sgrub pa dang / tshig rgyan dang / dus te tshe skabs la 'jug pa'i sgra la sogs pa de dag rnams kyang snga ma ming mtha'i shugs kyis 'dren par byed pa na sbyor tshul legs par 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes so/ /de rnams kyi dper brjod pa ni sum cu pa'i skabs su rgyas par smos zin pa dang gsham du'ang phyogs tsam 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir mi spro zhing / skabs 'dir sgra mthun zhes pa'i don rtags mtshungs kho na la phal cher gyis bzhed kyang rnam dbye dang phrad sogs rtags mtshungs kho nas 'dren par ma nges shing gtso bor brjod bde ba'i sgra mthun 'dren pa shas che bar snang ba dang / sum cu par/dang po gnyis la dang po mthun/ /gsum lnga bcu la kya dang sbyar/ /bdun pa nyid 'a bdun pa ste/ /lhag ma rnams la gya sbyar ba/ /de dag i sbyar 'brel ba'i sa/ /zhes sgra mthun tshul gsal bar gsungs pa'ang / da ba sa nga rnams 178

kyi mthar rtags mtshungs 'dren pa 'grig kyang gzhan rnams brjod bde ba tsam la dgongs par snang bas/ rgyu mtshan 'di rnams dang sbyar na kho bo'i 'grel tshul 'di nyid legs bshad du rtogs par 'byur ro/ /gnyis pa nang gses kyi 'jug tshul 'chad pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de dag nang gses gang 'jug pa/ /mthar sbyar 'og ma'i ming don las/ /zhes pa ste/ de lhar rnam dbye dang tshig phrad de dag gi nang gses gang dang gang zhig 'jug pa ni gtso bor rnam dbye'am phrad dang bcas pa'i ming tshig de'i mthar sbyar rgyu'i ming don 'og ma las shes par bya'o/ /zhes spyir bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gzhung don dang / 'phros don no/ /dang po la/rnam dbye'i nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa dang phrad kyi nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyi 'jug yod dam byed pa yod/ /de bzhin ched byed rten byed dang / /las bya blang bya bsgrub par bya/ /sngon du 'os pa gnas pa'am/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de la dam dbye'i nang gses gang dang gang 'jug pa ni rnam dbye sbyar sa'i ming bdud rtsi lha bu la de'i rjes su spyi la 'jug pa'i sgra gang zhig lha bu yod na ming snga ma la rnam dbye dang po 'jug pa yin yang bod skad la ming rkyang dang rnam dbye dang po so sor mtshon mi nus pas ming rkyang de gar gnas pa bdud rtsi gang zhig lha bur 'gyur ba dang /ming de'i mthar 'tsho bar byed rto bu byed pa'i sgra yod na rnam dbye gsum pa 'jug pas bdud rtsis 'tsho bar byed/ ces par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du spyar te ming de'i mthar ched du byed pa'i sgra mos pa lta bu yod na dam da~X 9

bzhi pa 'jug pas bdud rtsi la mos pa zhes su 'gyur ba dang / brten rto bu rten byed kyi sgra yod na bdun pa 'jug pas bdud rtsi la brten ces dang /bsgyur lha bu las su bya ba'i sgra yod na gnyis pa thob pas bdud rtsir bsgyur ces dang / blang bar bya lha bu blang bya'i sgra yod na lnga pa 'jug pas bdud rtsi las blang bar bya zhes dang / bsgrub bya rgya mtsho lta bu'i sgra yod na drug pa 'jug pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes dang / sngon du 'bod par 'os pa'i ming bdud rtsi ma lta bu yod la de la'ang las bcol rgyu lha bu 'bod par 'os pa'i don yod na'ang rnam dbye dang po 'jug cing bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra'ang sbyar bar bya ste/ bdud rtsi ma kye bdag la 'chi med sprul/ /zhes par 'gyur ba sogs shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /'am zhes pa ni phyi ma dang sbrel ba'i phyir sdud pa'i tshig phrad do/ /de dag la dper brjod gzhan yang / ming mtha' tsam gyis nom dbye drangs pa dang / ming mthas ming mtha' gzhan drangs/des rnam dbye drangs pa'i dbye bas so sor gnyis gnyis te/ lha gang / rtag pa gang / lhas srung / dkond cog gis skyob/ 'tshol du 'gro /slong ba la sbyin/ shing la gnas/ brtan pa la gnas/ chur 'chu/ gsal bar byed/las las 'bras bu 'byung / bde ba las dga' ba skye gser gyi bum pa/ rtag pa'i go 'phang / zhes sogs rgya cher sbyar bar bya'o/ /de lhar 'dir gnyis pa bzhi pa drug pa brgyad pa rnams kyi 'jug don ma gtogs pa'i spyi 'jug dang byed pa sogs gsungs pa ni rnam dbye de rnams kyi 'jug don phyogs re'i cha nas dper brjod pa'i ched du gsungs pa yin gyi mtha' dag pa ni ma yin te de ༵rdo tu mi gtogs pa'i 'jug don gzhan yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dper

na/ bdud rtsi zhes pa'i ming mtha' nges gzung sogs kyi sgra yod na'ang snga mar dang po 'jug pas ming rkyang nyid du gnas pa/ bdud rtsi de/ bdud rtsi 'di lha bu dang / ming snga ma des tre par bya ba'i ming don 'og tu gnas pa la snga mar byed pa po dang mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi gsum pa 'jug pa/ brjid pas nyi ma dang mtshungs/ du ba'i rtags kyis me yod par grub/ lta bu dang ming mthar de las byung ba'i sgra'am/ dgar bya'i sgra'am/ bsgrub bya'i sgra yod na 'byung khungs sogs kyi lnga pa 'jug pa/ sa gzhi las myu gu 'khrungs/rgya mtsho das rin po che 'byung /tshangs pa las sangs rgyas khyad par 'phags/nag pa las srid sgrub 'phong skyed/ mi rtag pa las dngos por grub/ lta bu dang / ming mthar rten byed kyi sgra dngos ma yin yang rten byed ltar snang ba'i bya ba'i tshig la sogs pa yod pa 'ga' zhig la'ang bdun pa 'jug pa/ mdzub rtser glang chen mthong / mtshon khar bsad/ lha bu ste 'dis mtshon das 'jug don dang sbyor tshul gzhan yang rgyas par rtogs par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir yang kha cig gis/ spyi 'jug gang lta bur ngos bzung nas des rnam dbye 'dren pa dang/ drug pa ma gtogs pa'i byed pa la sogs pa'i sgra rnam dbyer ngos bzung nas des phyi tshig 'dren par 'dod pa ni shin tu mi rigs te gzhung don dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir te/ mthar sbyar rgyu'i 'og ma'i ming don spyi 'jug nas ba bya'i bar gang yang rung ba yin par de las ming snga ma'i mthar rnam dbye dang po nas drug pa'i bar gang yang rung ba 'jug par dkyus gcig tu gsal bar bstan pa las phyin ci log tu smras pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang de lhar 'dod na/ de dag nang gses gang 'jug pa/ /zhes ji1 dang 'gal te/181

spyi 'jug gis rnam dbye 'dren zer ba tsam dang / byed pa sogs rnam dbyes rang rang dang 'brel ba'i phyi tshig 'dren zer ba tsam las rnam dbye'i nang gses gang 'jug phyogs tsam yang ma bstan par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang khyed ltar na/ gzhung 'dir byed pa'i sgras bstan pa'i byed las de byed pa po dang / ched du byed pa'i las de ched du bya ba dang / rten par byed pa de brten bya dang / las kyi bya ba de las bya rgyu dang / blang bya de gang las blang ba'i gnas su khas blangs par song bas/ gzhung 'di dang 'gal ba lha ci smos tha snyad kyi gtsug lag phyogs tsam yang ma rtogs pa'i rdzob thams cad bstan par zad do/ /gzhan yang sngon du bod pa gnas pa'am/ zhes par/ bod pa'i sgra kye sogs sngon du gnas pas 'bod rgyu'i ming 'dren par 'bru gnyer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ spyir sum cu par 'bod pa'i sgra ming gi sngon du sbyar ba shas che bar gsungs kyang / 'dir dmigs bsal du ming gi mthar sbyar tshul gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ grub ste 'dir ming mtha'i rjes 'jug gis rnam dbye brgyad ka 'dren tshul 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa gang zhig sngon du 'os pa zhes pa'ang gang la 'bod par 'os pa'i ming sngon du gnas pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ rnam dbye gzhan rnams mthar sbyar rgyu'i ming don la ltos dgos kyang bod pa'i sgra de rnams dang mi mtshungs pa'i dmigs bsal bstan pa'i phyir de ltar gsungs par nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa phrad kyi nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa ni/ gzhan yang tshig don 'og ma las/ /bsdu rgyu yod dam med pa dang / /gong ma las kyang de bsdo~X te/ /rnam grangs dag kyang bkod pa las/ /bskyar ba yod dam med pa

dang / /pho sgra dang ni mo sgra dag /ming gi mtha' na yod med dang / /rgyan du gyur pa rnams la yang / /don la bsnyegs pa yod med dang / /bstan bya lhag ma yod med dang / /tshig don rdzogs dang ma rdzogs kyis/ /de dag nang gses rnam par dbye/ /zhes pas bstan te/ gzhan yang ming mthas tshig phrad kyi bye brag gang zhig 'dren par 'gyur ba ni phal cher ming mthar sbyar rgyu'i tshig don 'og ma las shes dgos shing phyi tshig la ltos ma dgos par brjod 'dod tsam gyis 'grub pa'ang yod pa/ dper na/ tshig don 'og ma gang yin de nyid dang mtshungs pa las snga ma bsdu rgyu yod pa yin na/ ming snga ma snga ma'i mthar snga ma sdud pa'i tshig phrad sbyar bar bya ste/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rang ste/ lta bu dang / de bzhin du tshig don snga ma de nyid dang mtshungs pa las phyi ma bsdu rgyu yod pa yin na phyi ma bsdu ba'i tshig phrad 'jug ste/ lhas kyang btud na mis lta ci smos/ lha'ang 'jigs na bgegs lta ci smos/ de dag kyang bdag dang lhan cig dga'o/ /lta bu dang /mjug tu bya tshig lha bur lhan cig tu trel ba'i phyir tshig don lnga ma la phyi ma bsnan dgos pa yod na'ang sdud pa'i bye brag bsnan pa'i phrad sbyar te/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mthar ma zad/ phyi rol ba'ang shes par bya/ gser dngul zangs lcags gsha' tshe'ang sbyar/ lha du dang / phyi mar ming tshig gi rnam grangs gcig gam gnyis sam mang po bkod pa las/ de dag kyang gal te bskyar ba yin na snga mar rnam grangs kyis 'byed pa'am sdud pa'i phrad spyar bar bya ste/don bskyar ba la/ nyi 'od ni gsal ba'am/ snang ba'o/ /'chi med dam/ rnam sad dam/ mig mi 'dzum ni lha'o/ /'gro ba dang / 'dong ba dang / /mchi ba 183

zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa lta du dang / tshig don gnyi ga bskyar ba la/ skor zhing skor zhing sgar yang de ru 'bab/ gtubs shing gtubs shing drag tu gsol bar byed/ lta bu dang / ming gi mthar pho sgra ste pu lid+ma'i sgra gsar du sbyar ba yod na ming mtha' de nyid bdag po'i sgrar 'gyur ba/ rta pa/ gser pa/ rtag pa pa/yod pa pa/ byed pa po/ sgrub pa po1 lha bu dang / bdag po'am dgag pa'i don du gsar du spyar ba ma yin pa'i ming mtha' nyid pu lika' ma/ snyu likar gnas pa ni ngo bo'am bya ba gang yin de de nyid du spub pa'i sgrar 'gyur ba/rtag pa/ dam pa/ bstod pa/ mdzes pa/ yag ma/gsar ma/ bla ma/ gong ma/lta bu dang / ming gi mthar dgag don du sbyar ba'i mo sgra ste sdi lid+ma'i sgrar gtogs pa yod na ngo bo'am bya ba gang yin de nyid dgag pa'i sgrar 'gyur ba/'jigs med/ 'chi med/ yod min/ med min/ gzugs med/ sgra med/ lha bu dang / tshig don snga ma dang chos mthun pa'i phyi tshig gzhi gcig tu bsdu rgyu yod na/ snga ma la mthun pa'i rgyan du gyur pa'i phrad sbyar te/ mjos kyang mdzes la 'od kyang 'tsher/ lta bu dang / snga phyi chos mi mthun pa gzhi gcig tu bsdu na/ snga mar mi mthun pa'i rgyan 'jug ste/ lha nyid yin yang bdud kyi bdud/ /khro ba spangs kyang dgra 'joms pa/ /lta du ste rgyan du gyur pa'i tshig phrad de dag kyang nges par don la snyeg pa yod na mi sbyar du mi rung zhing tshig mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan tsam kho na yin na sbyor ram mi sbyor ji lhar 'dod pa rung ba dang / tshig don snga ma'i 'phros de ma thag tu bstan bya lhag ma yod na snga ma la lhag bcas kyi phrad 'jug ste/ rtag ste 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ rgyas btab ste bzhag lta bu dang / tshig gi don de nyid kyi 'phros de ma thag tu 184

bstan bya med pas rdzogs pa yin na slar bsdu'i phrad sbyar te/ rtag go/ rdzogs so/ /bstan to/ /bya'o/ /'grub bo/ /lta bu rnam dbye dang phrad de dag gi nang gces gang dang gang zhig 'jug cing don ci 'dra zhig ston pa rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /zhes so/ /skabs 'dir yang 'grel byed snga ma rnams kyis ma brtags pa yod de/ spyir 'di skabs ming mthas phrad dang rnam dbye sogs 'dren tshul 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa la/ pa ri/ saṃ/ u pa sogs kyi nyer sgyur dang sdi lid+ma'i sgra dag ming gi sngon du spyar nas tshig rgyan dang/ dgag sgra'i dper brjod pa dang / ming gi dam grangs bkod pa la tshig don bskyar ba yod med kyi khyad par gyis phrad kyi spyor tshul shes par bya dgos pa la phrad sbyor tshul sogs kyi don 'di yin med pa'i/ legs so legs so dang / a la la chos a la la chos/ sogs kyi dper brjod bkod pa dang / de dag nang gses gang 'jug pa/ /zhes pa'i de dag gi sgras/ bshad ma thag pa'i chos dngos las dang sogs nas/ dus la 'jug ces pa'i bar bstan cing /mthar sbyar 'og ma'i ming dod las/ /zhes pa'i ming don de/ spyi 'jug yod dam sogs nas/ ma rdzogs kyig zhes pa'i bar gyi bstan bya yin pas 'og ma shas che ba'i ming don gang yod kyi rgyu mtshan las ming mthar rnam dbye dang phrad gang 'thob lta dgos pa gsal bor gzhung gis zin pa la/ de 'dra'i rnam gzhag gang yang med pa'i 'brel med kyi lung 'dren dang bshad pa mang du byas pa sogs so/ /gnyis pa 'phros don di/ skabs 'dir spyir dam dbye dang phrad kyi don shes pa gal che bar snang bas cung zad bshad na/ dam dbye zhes pa ni legs 186

spyar gyi skad la ming gi mthar sbyar bas tshig tu 'grub par byed pa'i rkyen si sogs bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig po rnams te/ don thob kyi dbang gis don rjod par byed pa'i skad rigs thams cad la rnam dbye de rnams med pa mi srid pas mkhan po 'dis bod kyi skad la'ang legs sbyar dang brdun nas rnam dbye de rnams kyi 'jug pa gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de'ang legs sbyar la tshe gnyis rje gsum/ lha sra gnyis/ o sra gnyis rnams sbyor yul don thob kyis dbye ba kas rkyen gyi ngo bo gnyis su med pas rkyen gyi ngo bo bcu drug tu nges pa yin yang bod skad la de dang mi mtshungs pas/ la don/ 'brel ba/byed pa ste rnam dbye'i rkyen gyi ngo bo gsum du nges shing gnyis tshig dang mang tshig mtshon pa'i sgra dag kyang rnam dbye'i yan lag tu 'jug pa'i phrad tsam mo/ /la na tu du la sogs pa rkyen de rnams kyi nang gses ni ming mtha' phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam las rkyen gyi ngo bo so so ba ma yin te/ legs sbyar la dha sra i su su bsgyur ba dang / ji smin dang nge spe dang nga ldan rnams yi lha sra lnga lnga lha po du bsgyur ba sogs dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam dbye de rnams kyang don la sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na legs sbyar dang mthun par rigs bdun dang re re'ang gcig tshig gnyis tshig mang tshig gis bsgyur bas nyi shu rtsa gcig nyid du 'gyur ro/ /de'ang mi zad pa ma gtogs pa'i legs sbyar gyi ming thams cad la rtags kyi dbye ba yod pas de'i ched du rnam dbye dang po sbyin pa yin yang 'dir de med pas ming don tsam la rnam dbye dang po/ las kyi don la gnyis pa/ byed pa po'i don la gsum pa/ ched du bya ba'i don la bzhi pa/'byung khungs sam gang las 'bral ba'i don la lnga pa/ 'brel ba'i don la drug 186

pa/ gnas gzhi'i don la bdun pa shams 'jug cing /brgyad pa bod pa zhes zer yang bod pa'i yul la rnam dbye dang po nyid 'jug cing kye dang kwa sogs ni bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra yin gyi rnam dbye ma yin pas logs su dbyer med do/ /de la dam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig gis ming don gyi ngo bo tsam zhig ston pa ni/ bum pa/ rtag pa/ bstand pa/ byas pa/ bsgrubs/ ba/ sgrub/ lta bu ste/ bod skad la rnam dbye'i rjes logs pa med pas ming tsam de nyid yin zhing ming la ni bdag gzhan dang dus gsum gyi dbye ba can rnams dang ming rkyang yang rung ste khyad par med do/ /dper na legs sbyar gyi skad du/krita/ ka ra ṇa/ da/ lta bu dus gsum dang bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba yod pa'i sgra rnams kyang ming tsam nyid du mtshungs pa la rnam dbyes tshig tu ka dgos pa bzhin no/ /dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig dag gis ni ldog pa cung zad dang bcas pa'i ming don gyi ngo bo tsam ston te/ lha dag lha rnams/bum pa dag bum pa rnams/ bsgrub pa dag bsgrub pa rnams/ sgrub byed dag spub byed rnams/ lha bu'o/ /'dir dag dang dmas zhes pa'i sgra'ang tshig phrad tsam las rnam dbye'i rkyen dngos ma yin te/ da dung de dag gi mthal la rdam dbye gzhan 'jug pa'i phyir/ des na phrad 'di dag ming gang gi mthar sbyar yang rung rnam dbye dang po'i gnyis tshig gam mang tshig mtshon nus shing rnam dbye'i rkyen gzhan rnams kyang 'di dag gi mjug tu sbyar bas so so'i gnyis tshig gam mang tshig tu 'gyur ro/ / dag ces pa'i sgra'ang spyir gnyis tshig kho na la 'jug pa'i nges pa med de phal cher mang tshig la sbyor ba shas che zhing / gnyis kho na la 'jug pa'i phrad bod skad la med pas ba8 ka

du gcig la mi 'jug cing gnyis yan chad la 'jug pa'i sgra lo tsā ba rnams kyis spyi'i sgra bye brag la sbyar nas gnyis tshig tu mdzad pa yin no/ /des na dag gi sgra mang tshig la sbyor ba mi 'thad ces smra ba ni legs sbyar gyi lad mo thal ches pa'i gsung du snang ngo / /'ga' zhig gis thams cad dang kun dang mtha' dag sogs kyang rnam dbye'i mang tshig tu 'dod kyang ming dang rnam dbye ma byed par zad do/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa la sogs pas ni don gyi ldog pa kho na ston gyi ngo bo ni nam yang mi ston te/ dper na/ bum pa la/ zhes pas de'i bya ba'am ched don nam rdzas gzhan ldan pa'i don dang / bum pa'i zhes pas de dang 'brel ba'i don dang / bum pas zhes pas de'i byed pa'i don ston pas tshig de dag gis bum pa rang gi ngo bo tsam ma yin par de'i ldog pa ston pa lta bu'o/ /de la la don rnams rnam dbye gnyis pa las la 'jug pa'i tshul ni/dper na/ lha la phyag 'tshal/ gzugs la lha/ shar du 'gro/ lta bu'i lha/gzugs/ shar rnams ni phyag 'tshal ba dang / lha ba dang 'gro ba rnams kyi bya ba 'jug pa'i yul yid pas de dag la las kyi rnam dbye 'jug pa yin no/ /zhib mor dpyad na/ gzugs la lta bar byed lha bu/ gzugs la las kyi don dang / lta ba la bya ba'i don du ste gnyi ga la rnam dbye gnyis pa 'jug cing phyi ma la gzhung 'dir de nyid kyi sgras gsungs so/ /de bzhin du bum par chu blugs zhes pa lta bu bum pa la bya ba blugs pa'i yul yin pas gnyis pa'am chu brten pa'i cha nas gnas gzhi ste rnam dbye gnyis gang rung 'jug cing / chu ni blug par bya rgyu'i las nyid yin pas/ de nyid kyi don la gnyis pa kho na 'jug mod/ phyi ma 'di rigs kyi rnam dbye bod skad la med pa mang ngo / /rnam 188

dbye gsum pa byed pa po la 'jug pa ni/ lhas bstan/ rdo rjes phug khyod kyis skyong / bdag gis brjod lha bu ste/ bstan/ phug skyong / brjod rnams bya ba yin pas de byed mkhad gyi don du rim par/ lha/ rdo rje/ khyod/ bdag rnams la nom dbye gsum pa byed pa po'i tshig 'jug pa yin no/ /de'ang zhib mor dpyad na/ bdag gis rig sngags kyis tshe spub lta bur bdag dang rig sngags gnyi ga spyir byed pa po yin pas gnyis ka la rnam dbye gsum pa 'jug kyang / bdag byed po gtso bo dang rigs sngags byed po phal pa yin pa'i dbye ba yod cing / yang na bdag byed pa po dang rig sngags ni byed pa tsam yin pa'i bye brag shes par bya dgos so/ /rgyu mtshan gyi don la gsum pa 'jug pa'ang rgyu mtshan des de lhar 'grub par byed pas byed pa po dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam dbye bzhi pa ched du bya ba'i don la 'jug pa ni/ lo tog la chu 'dren/ nor 'tshong du 'gro /slong mo pa la zan sbyin/ lta bu/ chu 'dren pa dang / 'gro ba dang / zan sbyin pa rnams bya ba yin zhing / de gang gi don nam ched du bya ba'i yul/ lo tog nor 'tshong / slong mo pa rnams la bzhi pa dgos ched kyi rnam dbye 'jug pa yin no/ /des na bya ba gang zhig bya ba'i don gyi yul de la phan gdags pa'i ched du 'jug pa'i la don drug po rnams ni rnam dbye bzhi pa zhes bya ba yin la/ dper na/ sha'i ched du phyugs gsod par byed/ lta bu la mtshon na/ gsod pa bya ba/ phyugs ni las/ sha ni bya ba'i don gyi yul yin pas gsod pa'i bya bas sha thob pa la phan 'dogs par byed pa dang / slong mo par zan sbyin zer ba la/ sbyin pa ni bya ba/ zan ni las/slong mo pa bya ba'i don gyi yul yin pa'i phyir sbyin pas slong mo par phan 189

'dogs pa sogs go dgos shing / bar du las kyi tshig med kyang sha'i ched du gsod/ slong mo par sbyin sogs kyang bzhi pa'i don de nyid las mi 'da'o/ /'o na legs sbyar la bya ba'i don gyi yul der phan 'dogs pa ma yin par yang bzhi pa 'jug pa mang du mthong ba ci snyam na/ legs stan la'ang spyir btang gi 'jug yul 'di dang mthun kyang dmigs bsal mi mthun pa ni/ mgo bor dbyug pas bsnun pa'i don la/ ma sta ka ya 'a da dā ti/ mgo bor dbyug pa sbyin zhes dang / bum par chu blugs pa'i don la/ gha ṭā ya dza lo da dā ti/ bum par chu sbyin/ zhes pa lta bu yod pa ni sbyin pa'i yul la bzhi pa 'jug pa spyir btang bas 'dir bsnun pa dang / blugs pa la sbyin pa'i sgras bstan pa'i tshig tsam gtso bor byas nas de'i yul la bzhi pa sbyar ba yin gyi skabs de'i sbyin pa sbyin pa dngos ma yin pa bzhin du de'i yul gyi rnam dbye bzhi pa'ang bzhi pa dngos ma yin te/ snga ma gnyis pa dang phyi ma bdun par don gyis 'thob pa la bzhi pa sbyar ba tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du na mas sogs kyi yul la bzhi pa 'jug pa'ang don thob kyi bzhi pa'i 'jug yul dngos ma yin yang /'jig rten pa'i nyer sbyod las de bzhin du 'jug pa ste skabs 'dir ma zad rnam dbye gzhan dang gzhan la'ang 'di 'dra'i rigs mang du 'byung ba rnams nom dbye de dngos kyi don du mi 'gyur bas tsam po pa zhes bya'o/ /bod 'dir ni dmigs bsal de 'dra dbye ba la dgos pa med pas don 'thob nyid kyi dbang du byed dgos pa yin no/ /yang gsod pa'i phyir du mtshon bsnun/ zhes pa lta bur mtshon bsnun pas gsad bya la phan gdags zer ba'i don ma yin gyi/ mtshon bsnun pa'i bya bas bya ba'i don gyi yul gsod pa la phan 'dogs 190

par byed pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir 'ga' zhig gis dod dang ched dang phyir zhes pa'i sgra dmas rnam dbye bzhi par byas pa mi 'thad de/ de rnams rnam dbye 'jug yul gyi ming tsam yin pa'i phyir te de dag la rnam dbye zhugs pas/don du/ don gyi/ don gyis/ lha bur 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na/ legs sbyar la de'i ched du zhes par/ ta dka ya/ zhes 'byung ba'i ma ze'i sgra de rnam dbye ma yin pa bzhin no/ /rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs la 'jug pa di/ sangs rgyas las chos/ gser kha nas gser/ rgya mtsho las chu bo 'byung / brag ri nas rbab lhung / mdzod nas nor blangs/ lta bu ste/ chos/ gser/ chu bo/ rbab/nor rnams kyi 'byung khungs rim pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas/ gser kha/ rgya mtsho/brag ri/ dkor mdzod rnams yin pas de dag la rnam dbye lnga pa 'jug pa yin zhing / rta las lhung / 'dzeg skas las babs/ shar phyogs nas 'od byung /lta bu lhung ba dang / babs pa dang 'od rnams kyi 'byung khungs dngos rta dang /skas dang shar rnams ma yin yang 'phral du de dang de dag las 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rnam dbye lnga pa spyar ba dang / du ba'i rtags las me yod par rjes su dpag go /lta bu rgyu mtshan gyi don la'ang rtags de las rjes su dpag pa'i tshad ma skye bas 'byung khungs lhar snang ba'i phyir lnga pa sbyar ba dang / bud med rnams las sngo bsangs mdzes/ lha bu yon tan sogs kyi sgo nas logs su bkar ba ste bud med rnams kyi nang nas blos khyad par bye nas phyung ba yin pa'i phyir 'byung khungs dang 'dra ba'i don gyis lnga pa sbyar ba sogs shes par bya'o/ /legs sbyar la ni gang las 'bral ba'i don la lnga pa bshad cing don des lnga pa'i 'jug yul thams cad la khyab par yang bshad pa mthong bas 191

bod skad la'ang zhib mor brtags na 'chad tshul de 'byor bar sems so/ /rnam dbye drug pa 'brel ba'i don la 'jug pa ni/ phyug po'i nor/ khrim gyi lha/chos kyi sku/ bdag gi don/ shing gi yal ga lha bu/ nor/ lha/ sku/ don/ la ga rnams rim pa bzhin/ phyug po/ khyim/ chos/ bdag shing dmas dang 'brel ba yin pa'i phyir/ de dag la rnam dbye drug pa 'jug cing 'dir gong du bsgrub bya zhes gsungs pas zhim mor brtags na drug sgra/ 'i/ sga kyi rnams bsgrub bya nor dang / lha dang / sku dmas/ bdag po phyug po dang /rten gnas khyim dang / zhi ba'i chos rnams dang 'brel ba'i sgrub byed du 'gro ba lta bur go dgos so/ /'brel ba'ang bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba brjod pa/ chos kyi sku/ rgya mtsho'i chu/ gser gyi bum pa lha bu dang / phyug po'i nor lta bu/ bdag po dang yul gyi 'brel ba/ khyim gyi lha lta bu rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba/ shing gi yal ga lta bu yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel ba sogs du mar 'gyur ba ste rtogs par bla'o/ /la don drug po rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi la 'jug pa ni/ shing la bya/ khyim du mi/ bum par chu/gdan la 'dug sa la nyal/ rgyab tu ri yod/ lta bu/ bya/ mi/ chu/ 'duganyal/ ri rnams kyi rten gnas sam gnas pa'i gzhi ni/ shing/ khyim/ bum pa/gdan/ sa/ rgyab phyogs rnams yin pas de dag la rnam dbye bdun pa 'jug pa yin zhing / de bzhin du chu la zhugs/ khung du 'dzul/ g.yul du go bgos/g.yul du bsad/ lta bu rnams kyang zhugs pa dang 'dzul ba dang go bgos pa dang bsad pa rnams kyi bya ba de dag gi rten rim bzhin du chu la sogs pa de dka 9༵na pas la don gyi rnam dbye de rnams bdun pa'i don du 'gyur ba yin

gyi rnam dbye gnyis pa las kyi don ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /yang skyes bu zhig gis skyes bu gzhan zhig la mdzub mo'i brdas bstan nas mdzub mo'i rtse 'di na glang po che brgya yod do zer ba lha bu la mdzub mo'i rtse der glang po che de rnams brten pa ma yin kyang mdzub mo'i rtse des mtshon pa'i yul phyogs der glang po che mthong ba'i mig shes skye ba'i rkyen byed pa'i cha nas rten dang 'dra ba'i phyir bdun pa 'jug pa dang / sdig pa la 'jigs/ seng ge la skrag sogs gang las 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i gnas de la rnam dbye lnga pa 'jug pa legs sbyar gyi lugs yin yang / bod skad la 'jigs pa skye ba'i yul lam rten du gyur pa'i cha nas bdun pa nyid sbyor ba dang / snag la rkun ma 'byung /nyi ma shar ba na gnyid sad/ lta bu gnas skabs de dang der brten nas de 'dra 'byung bas dngos su ma brjod kyang don thob kyis dus brjod pa la bdun pa sbyar ba dang / tshes gsum la lha mchod/ dpyid la khu byug grags/ston dus su btsas ma brnga lta bu/ dus dngos su brjod pa la bdun pa spyar ba ste 'di dag gis mchod nas 'jug yul gyi bye brag thams cad zhib mor rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar rnam dbye'i 'jug tshul phyogs tsam bstan nas tshig gi phrad ces bya ba ni spyir ming tsam gnyis sam du ma stel ba'i tshe bar du mtshams sbyor ba'am don gas ba la phan 'dogs par byed cing 'ga' zhis de 'dra'i thog mtha' gnyis dang ming rkyang tsam la'ang don gsal ba'am brjod bde ba la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i sgra'i rnam pa zhig ste de'ang /ming ngam tshig gzhan la ma sbyar na de nyid rkyang pa brjod pas don gsal bar mi mtshon pa'i phrad ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i rnam dbye'i rkyen/ sha na/ tu/ du/193

su/ ru/ kyi/ gyi/ gi/ 'i/ sogs dang rnam dbye la mi gtogs pa'i/ la/ na/kyi/ gyi/ gi /yi/ nas rnams dang / go /ngo / do/ no/ bo/ mo/ 'o/ ro/ lo/so/ to/ pa/ po/ bo/ ma/ mi/ can/ ni/ phyir/ kye/ kwa/ cing / zhing / shing /ces/ zhes/ shes/ cig zhig shig ce'o/ /zhe'o/ /she'o/ /ce na/ zhe na/she na/ gu/ kyang / 'ang / yang / gam/ ngam/ dam/ nam/ bam/ mam/ 'am/ram/ lam/ sam/ dag rnams/ te/ ste/ de/ lta/ lhar/ bzhin/ snyed/ dang / lo/ la sogs pa rnams yin mod kyi rnam dbye rnams logs su bshad pas lhag ma rnams gzung bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyang ming tshig la ji ltar sbyor na/ dag la gsal na legs mod kyi/ /bstan gyi 'jug gi 'chad bya yi/ /mkhas par byas nas tshul brtag go /bya ba bzang ngo legs bkod do/ /'byon no 'grub bo don bsam mo/ /bya'o phyar ro lha rgyal lo/ /bltas so bstan to lha chos pa/ /sgrub po dga' bo gsar ma pa/ /ma rnyog mi ltung dge ba can/ /da ni ci phyir kye kye du/ /kwa ye grogs dag bgrod cing mchis/ /bde zhing dgyes shing yod ces thos/ /gas zhes mjos shes zhad cig gda'/ sa mthar shes zhes sbyor ba 'di bzhin 'thad kyang 'khrul gzhi 'byung bar gzigs nas mkhas pa phyi rnams kyis ma mdzad pa bzhin da lha'i lag rgyun la mi byed do/ /nam zhig gros shig gdab ce'o/ /su yod ce na gang zhe na/ /ma byas she na byos shig gu/ /'khod kyang 'gro ba'ang dran na yang / /rgyug gam 'dong ngam sdod dam ci/ /mdun nam rgyab bam legs bsam mam/ /bya'am 'char ram cang thal lam/ /rgyas sam de dag dpal 'byor rnams/ /mkhas te 'chad de kun chub ste/ /de lta de lhar de bzhin skad//ji ༵dī bde dang ldan no lo/ /lha bu dang / yang sbyar yul la mi ltos par

yang rang nyid kyi brjod don gsal bar mtshon pa can gyi phrad ni/ gang / ci/de/ 'di/ su/ yang / nam/ slar/ 'o na/ la la/ ji/ zhes pa lta bu phrad rkyang pa rnams dang / phrad gnyis gsum sogs 'dus pa/ gang dag de dgagang noms/ de rnams/ ji snyed/ de snyed/ gang lhar/ ji lhar/ gal te na/gal te/ ci zhig su zhig ci phyir/ gang phyir/ de slad/ de lta na/ 'on kyang / ci'ang / ci nas kyang / yang yang / slar yang / ci zhig na de/ nam zhig su'ang / ci zhe na/ zhes pa lta bu rnams dang / 'o na zhes pa bsdus pas 'on dang / ci'ang zhes pa bsdus pas cang dang / gang la la zhes pa bsdus pas ga la dang / gang la zhes pa bsdus pas gal zhes pa lta bu rnams so/ /des na tshig phrad kyi rigs 'di 'dra shin tu mang bas 'dir phyogs tsam mtshon pa'i phyir cung zad bkod kyi zhib mor yi ger 'brir ma langs so /'dir 'ga' zhig gis legs sbyar gyi skad di pā ta bsgyur ba tshig phrad yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bod skad mi tshig phrad gang yin pa rnams kyang lebs sbyar gyi ni pā ta rnams dang bsgrig rung ba zhig dgos so snyam du bsams nas smra sgo rtsa 'grel la dgag pa brjod pa'i zhar du gnung 'di la'ang zur za ba dang /bye zad rtogs byed chen mo la'ang skyon gdags par byed mod/ dgongs pa can zhig yin na ma gtogs mkhas pa'i gsung du ma mthong ste/ spyir lo tsā ba rnams kyis ni pā ta zhes pa tshig phrad du bsgyur mod kyi legs sbyar gyi ni pā ta yin tshad bod skad kyi tshig phrad yin dgos pa dang / bod skad kyi phrad yin tshad ni pā ta yin dgos pa'i khyab pa su zhig gis khas blangs/ khyed nyid kyis khas blangs pas ni gzhan la gnod byed du mi 'gyur te/ da dung dam bca' 196

de bsgrub dgos shing bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir na sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis ni pā ta tshig phrad du sgyur ba'i dgongs pa ni/ legs sbyar byi/ tsa/ pā/ ye ba la sogs pa di pā ta rnams phal cher tshig gi phrad la 'byung ba shas che bas yin gyi bod skad kyi tshig phrad dang ni pā ta gnyis yin khyab mnyam du dgongs pas de bzhin du bsgyur ba ma yin pa'i phyir te/ legs spyar gyi ni pā ta la yod pa'i/ swa dra/ shī hūṃ/ ba/ ka rta bye/ su ste/ mi phywa/lha sra/ lha bu rnams rim bzhin bsgyur ba'i/ mtho ris/ mgyogs pa/ myur po/bya ba/ bde legs/ brdzun/ mthon po lta bu rnams bod skad kyi tshig phrad ma yin pa dang / bod kyi skad la tshig phrad du'ang bgrang chog pa'i dam dbye'i rkyen kyi gye la na lha bu yod kyang / legs sbyar la de'i dod/ su/ lnga su/ lnga po/lha bu rnams rnam dbye'i rkyen gyi rjes tsam las di pā ta ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir yang ni pā ta zhes pa sgra thad klog tu bsgyur na nges tshig ces bya zhing nges pa'i don yang ni pā ta yin pa rnams la rtags gsum gyi dbye ba med pa dang /rnam dbye'i rnam 'gyur phal cher med pas sgra'i gzugs nges pa'i don yin zhing de dag la ming gi rnam grangs gzhan mi zad pa zhes kyang bya la/ bod kyi tshig phrad ces btags pa ni tshig gi bar bar du mtshangs sbyor ba'i 'am dab 'byung ba shas che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de skad ces bya bas ming don gyi rgyu mtshan yang mtshungs pa ma yin no/ /des na bye rtogs su bod brda nyid kyi dbang du byas nas skabs skabs nas tshig gi phrad du 'byung ba zhes mdor bstan nas phrad du 'byung ba rnams bkod pa la ni pā ta ma yin pa 'ga' zhig mthong ba la skyon du spru ba ni ya cha'o/ /de bzhin du smra sgo rtsa 'grel du gang la zhes pa 196

bsdus pas gal dang ci zhig na zhes pa ste nar bsgyur nas sbyar bas gal te na zhes grub par bshad pa sun 'byin pa'ang legs bshad yin min brtag dgos te/ gal te zhes pa de'i skad dod ya di dang nges par sbyar dgos na/ya di zhes pa la tu la dus brjod pa'i don du rnam dbye bdun pa'i di byin nas tshig phrad kyi lugs su bsgrubs shing tshig phrad du kyur pa ta di dang ta lha lta bu yin pas bod skad gang la zhe'am gang tshe zhes par 'gyur bas smra sgo'i 'chad tshul de phyogs gcig nas 'grig pa ma yin nam/ de bas ya di'i mtha' de sgyub tshul ci yin ma mkhyen pa'i tshul bstan pa de ga mtshang che bar dogs so/ /yang legs sbyar la rnam dbye'i rkyen dang ni pā ta mi mtshungs pa thugs mad kyang bod skad gzhir gzhag gi rnam dbye'i rkyen la tshig phrad du brjod pa mi 'gal te rkyen de dag tshig phan tshun mtshangs sbyor ba'i phrad kyi don las mi 'da' ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam dbye rkyen tsam dang tshig phrad ming ngam tshig yin pas khyad che'o snyam pa srid kyang gang smos sbyor yul gzhan med par rang nyid gcig pu brjod na don mi gsal ba'i phrad rkyang de noms kyang rkyen tsam yin gyi ming tshig gang yang ma yin no/ /'o na legs sbyar gyi tsa dang tse tu bsgyur ba'i dang dang na lta bu'ang rkyen du 'dod dgos pas ha cang thal lo snyam na gong smos ltar skad gnyis don thog tu dbab dus mtshungs phyin rkyen dang ming sogs yin mnyam dgos par bsams pa ni de bas kyang thal ches te/ dper na/ tsā rā ya ṇa/ zhes par na ra sred med dang / u ya na ṇa gyi rkyen don bur bsgyur ba na bod skad bu zhes pa ming yin gyi rkyen ma yin pa dang / sa ji ya zhes par sab kun dang zhi ya'i don phan par bsgyur ba na phan pa rkyen sna9 ༵na

pa sogs mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro/ /legs sbyar gyi lugs la'ang ba dang ta bya dang skyo mun la sogs pa rkyen yin mod kyi de'i mtha' ni pā ta'ang yin pas rkyen dang di pā ta rnam pa kun tu 'gal bar bsams na'ang mi rung ngo / /yang skad dod la nom dbye dbyi bar mi nges pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gang ci de sogs tshig phrad min zhes gsungs pa'ang bye brag ma zud pa'i gsungs te de dag gi skad dod ya tu ta tu ke sogs rgyu mtshan sogs kyi don la 'jug pa'i tshe/ ni pā ta yin pa 'chi med mdzod sogs su gsal zhing sarba tsā ma'i skabs su ni pā ta ma yin pa'ang sgra gzhung rnams su gsal bas de dag ma phyed par spom yor gyis gzhan la rgol bar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'chi med mdzod sogs gzigs pa'i zhal rbad kyang de tsam du bas so/ /yang don dam par dbyer med na zhes pa lta bu'i na de la don 'chad pa'i nus pa med par bshad 'dug pa/ phyi tshig mi mthun par ston pa'i nus pa na'i sgra de la med na don dam du dbyer med ces tshig snga ma dang kun rdzob tu dbyer yod ces tshig phyi ma dag so so'i ngo bo brjod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir de gnyis la mi mthun par ston pa'i nus pa de bas kyang med do/ /gzhan yang mi 'thad pa du ma zhig snang yang dgag pa'i spros pa ma byas la/ smra sgo rtsa 'grel dang smra ba kun la 'jug pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos rtsa 'grel 'ji noms la'ang mi 'thad pa shin tu mang zhing mkhas pa gzhan gyis gnod byed brjod pa gnad du song ba'ang mang bar snang bas 'phags yul mkhas pa'i legs bshad ni min par nges mod/ 'on kyang sum cu pa'i skabs su 'ga' zhig drangs pa sogs gzhung 'di'i don dang skabs 'gar mthun pa'i legs bshad mang dag kyang 'dug pas rnam pa kun 198

tu 'dor bya ni ma yin no/ /de ltar gal che ba'i 'phros don cung zad bshad das/ bzhi pa rjes 'jug gi yi ge rnams dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa 'chad pa la/ rjes 'jug gi dgos pa dngos bshad pa dang / zhar byung yi ge'i 'jug pa spyi'i dgos pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ /yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung ste/ /ming gi khongs nas tshig phyung nas/ /tshig gis don rnams ston par byed/ /ces pas bstan te/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po de rnams dgos pa ci'i phyir du 'jug par byed ce na/ sngon 'jug yod med gang yang rung ba'i ming gzhi'i yi ge gcig gam gnyis sam du ma 'dus pa yin yang rung rjes 'jug yi ge gang rung zhig ma zhugs par dod gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming du grub pa mi srid pas yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir dang / ming gcig gam gnyis sam du ma sprul du zin kyang mtshams sbyor bar byed pa'am don gsal bar byed pa'i rnam dbye dang phrad sogs phal cher rjes 'jug las byung zhing rjes 'jug la ltos pa de rnams ma zhugs na don gyi khyad par brjod pa'i tshig tu 'grub pa mi srid pas ming gi khongs nas tshig dbyung ba'i phyir 'jug ste/ de lta bu'i tshig gis 'jig rten du don rnams rjod par byed pa'i phyir don mtshon pa'i brngod pa ji snyed pa'ang rjes 'jug gi yi ge rnams 'jug pa'i dgos par grub bo zhes so/ /skabs 'dir ming tshig brjod pa gsum po ji ltar dbye ba'i tshul ni/ byu ka ra ṇa'i lugs la rnam dbye'i mtha' can ni tshig go /rnam dbye med pa ni ming ngo / /zhes 'byung yang /bod skad la rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig ming tsam las logs su dbyer 199

med cing / dag dang rnams kyi phrad kyis gnyis tshig dang mang tshig mtshon yang da dung de dag gi mthar rnam dbye gzhan 'jug pa sogs kyis rnam gzhag de lta bu spyar du mi rung ba dang / chos mngon pa'i lugs kyi yi ge du ma 'dus pa las ming / ming du ma 'dus pa las tshig ces gsungs pa'ang spyir btang rags pa tsam yin pas 'dir phra ba'i dbang du byas na mi 'byor bas skabs 'dir ni bod skad gzhir gzhag gis gang zhig yi ge gnyis sam mang po 'dus pa'ang rung don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra ni ming yin zhing / ming de nyid nom dbye'am phrad gang rung dang ldan pas don gyi khyad par ston par byed pa rnams ni tshig dang / tshig mang po sgrol nas don dang ldan pa'i ngag gi phreng bar grub pa ni brjod pa zhes bya'o/ /de'ang bstan bcos 'di yi lugs kyis dbyangs yig srog zhugs mi bzhed pas de lha bu yi ge gcig yin yang bshad ma thag pa ltar rjes 'jug dngos su med kyang don gyis thob pas da' zhes yi ge gnyis su 'gyur ba de lta bu ni yi ge gnyis tshogs pa'i ming gi mtshan gzhi dang / de bzhin du/ dpal/ dga' ba/ sgrub pa/ bsod nams lta bu rim bzhin yi ge gsum bzhi lnga drug 'dus pa'i ming du shes par bya zhing yi ge de las mang ba 'dus pa'i ming rnams kyang mtshon par bya'o/ /yang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang / sred med bu/ lta bu rnams ni tshig gnyis sam mang po bsdus nas ming gcig tu byas ste/ don gyi khyad par de dag dang ldan pa'i ming can de'i ngo bo tsam brjod pa'i phyir ming las mi 'da'o/ /'di 'dra phal cher la bar gyi rnam dbye dang phrad rnams bsdus pa mang yang ma ba~X pa'ang / de bzhid gshegs pa/ kun tu bzang po/ 'khor lo'i dbang

phyug lha bu ci rigs par 'byung bas de 'dra dmas la phrad dang rnam dbye yod pas tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya ste spyi ldog nas ming can de'i don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pas ming nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dper da/ legs sbyar la/ ke sha zhes pa mgor nyal te ming de'i nang na don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig mngon gyur du yod kyang spyi ldog nas sgra'i ngo bo tsam zhig las mi ston pa'i phyir ming yin pa lta bu'o/ /yang lha mo dang sbyin skyes lha bu ni legs sbyar la ming gcig nyid la mo rtags dang bu rgyud kyi rkyen sogs kyis bsgyur ba yod kyang bod skad la de 'dra'i rkyen med pas ming gnyis bsdus pa yin zhing / bde ba can lta bu phrad kyi mtha' yin yang zhing khams kyi ming du byed pa'i tshe don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i cha nas ming yin zhing / bde ba dang ldan pa tsam brjod rgyu yin na don gyi khyad par ston byed yin pas tshig tu 'gyur te skabs thob kyis shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du phrad rnams la'ang / gang / de/ 'di/ lta bu rnams la ming tsam dang / gang dag gang phyir/ de lta bu/ 'on kyang / de lta na/ lta bu dmas tshig dang/ na/ la/ ste/ lta bu rnams ming tshig gang yang ma yin par go dgos shing/ rnam dbye gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar dang / gnyis dang mang po'i tshig phrad dang / bod pa'i sgra sogs sbyar ba rnams ni tshig kho na yin no/ /des na phrad tsam gyis tshig tu grub pa rnams kyi mthar ni slar yang phrad dang rnam dbye ci rigs par 'jug pa yod la rnam dbyes tshig tu grub pa rnams kyi mthar ni slar rnam dbye 'jug pa ma yin zhing phrad 'ga' zhig 'jug pa yod de/ dper na/ de yis kyang / khyod kyi ni lta bu rnams so/ /tshig bsdus nas ming du gyur pa de noms kyi mthar yang phrad dam rnam dbye spyar bas don gyi 201

khyad par ston par byed na tshig tu 'byur ba sogs zhib mo'i blos dpyad par bya ste khyad par mtha' dag ni 'dir 'bri bar ma langs so/ /yang brjod pa zhes bya ba'ang spyir ming tshig yi ge gang yang rung ngag gis brjod pas thams cad la sbyar du rung yang / snyan ngag gi gzhung du brjod pa dang gtam gnyis rigs gcig par bshad pa bzhin ming tshig brjod pa gsum du dbye ba'i brjod pa ni tshig du ma 'dus pa'i ngag gi phreng ba nyid yin zhing / de la ming gzhan gtam jes kyang bya ste/ pad+ma dkar po lhar rdam par mdzes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa rnams ni 'jig rten gyi rgyan du gyur pa yin no/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /'di thad kyi zha lu'i 'grel par gnas brgyad chen mo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i/ sgra dang skad/ ming dang mtshan ma/ brda dang tha snyad/ tshig dang don te yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad kyi bshad pa zhig 'byung ba phal cher legs bshad du yod kyang / bod skad zur chag tu mdzad pa cung mi legs te/ skad rigs bzhi ni 'phags yul gyi dbang du byas nas bzhag la/snyan ngag me long du/ bstan bcos rnams la legs sbyar las/ /gzhan pa zur chag nyid du brjod/ /ces 'byung ba'ang 'phags yul gyi dbang du byas pa'i phyir/ go ṭa la sogs pa yul 'khor chen po la brten pa'i rang bzhin gyi skad rnams ni/ twa ma la tu mi dang / a ho 'a ha mi dang / sna khru sha 'a sa ri ṣa dang /a sna la a gin dang / ra rgyu la ra tan lha bu legs spyar gyi zur nyams pa kho na yin pa dang / rgya bar mtha' 'khob kyi ba lang rdzi la sogs pa'i ska da dmas ni rang bzhin gyi ska da de rnams nyid las zur nyams par 'don pa tsam yin pa ba 0/2sha za'i skad ces pa'ang zlos gar gyi bstan bcos su 'byung ste/ lnga ka pu

tra zhes par/ mtho ut+ta dang / ya bye baṃ zhes par/ dza yi e rnyi dang / ku 'a pra ho zhes par/ kul bla hu kho zhes pa lta du legs sbyar gyi zur shin tu nyams pa tsam yin pas skad rigs de dag thams cad legs sbyar las zur chag pa nyid du mtshungs pa'i phyir legs spyar las gzhan pa'i skad thams cad zur chag tu gsungs pa yid gyi/ bod dang rgya dag lha bu'i skad rnams ni legs sbyar gyi zur chag pa ma yin pa'i phyir zur chag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci'ang med do/ /'on kyang bod dang rgya nag sogs kyi yul dbus pa'i skad bstan bcos su grags pa rnams la ltos nas so so'i mtha' 'khob pa'i skad sogs de las ma dag par 'don pa dmas yul de dang de'i zur chag gi skad yin no zhes smra na ni 'os pa tsam mo/ /des na bod skad rgya gar gyi skad rigs bzhi'i khongs su mi chud pas skad rigs de bzhi las 'di yin zhes ngos gzung mi dgos kyang rung mthun sbyo ra na rang bzhin gyi skad yin byas pas chog ste pā kṛ ta zhes pa phal ba 'a 'jug pas/ rgya gar gyi yu' 'khor chen por grags pa'i phal skad bzhin du/ bod yul gyi phal skad dam rang bzhin gyi skad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang ming gi skabs su bad sprod pa'i lugs kyi nom dbye'i mtha' can zhes byung yang yig nor du gor ma chag ste khong lta bu'i mkhas pa chen po la de tsam gyi 'khrul ba ga la 'byung / zha lu'i gsung gi rjes blos mdzad par rlom mkhan phyis kyi 'grel byed cig gis ni de tsam la'ang rtob dpyod ma zhugs par tshig de nyid bshus shing ming gi nges tshig tsā ma'i sgra 'a sa drangs te legs par bshad pa ma rtogs nas gzhan du drangs pa dang / smra bar byed pa'i dus can gyi bdab nyid ces pa'i 'bru don ma go bar spru bar byed pa'i 203
