'dus byas kyi bdag nyid ces 'don pa dang / tha snyad kyi don la 'gal ba mang po spros pa sogs rjes zlos byed phyin rjes zlos gyur mo lugs de legs pa la de'ang min pa'i mkhas khyad 'dod pas rjes zlos kyang ma 'byor ba der gda'o/ /gnyis pa zhar byung yi ge'i 'jug pa spyi'i dgos pa bshad pa la/ yi ge'i 'jug pa rnams kyi rang bzhin gyi dgos pa bshad pa dang / yi ge'i 'jug pa ji ltar sbyor ba'i tshul gyi bstan bcos 'di nyid brtsams pa'i dgos pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la dgos pa ldog phyogs nas bstan pa dang /nying dgos ldog phyogs nas bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mo yi yi ge med pa na/ /pho yig brjod pa med par 'gyur/ /pho yig de dag rnams la yang / /'jug par bcas pa med na ni/ /ming dang tshig kyang gsal mi nus/ /ming tshig gsal ba med na ni/ /don noms brjod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas bstan te/ mo yi yi ge gi gu sogs ā li bzhi po med na pho yig ka li rnams kho nas brjod pa med par 'gyur te ā li rnams la ltos pa'i brjod pa de snyed mi tshang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / pho yig kā li de dag noms la'ang ā li dang ldan mi ldan ji ltar yang 'jug par bcas pa ste 'jug pa'i yi ge bcu med par gyur na ni don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming dang don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig kyang gsal bar mi nus te/ yi ge'i khongs nas ming phyung ste/ /zhes sogs bshad ma thag pa lha du'i rgyu mtshan gyi phyir dang / ming dang tshig gsal bar gyur pa med na ni don gyi rnam pa rang dang gzhan la mtshon zhing go bar byed pa'i brjod pa rnams kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /des na ā li rnams ni shā li'i 2yi

yi ge rnams kyi brjod pa'i yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / 'jug pa'i yi ge rnams ni ming tshig gsal bar bya ba'i phyir dang / yi ge'i 'jug pa mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i ming tshig rnams ni don ji snyed pa dag mtshon cing brjod pa'i phyir 'jug par mkhas pa rnams la rab tu grags shing grub pa'ang yin pas/ yi ge dang yi ge'i tshogs dang sbyor ba de rnams di rang gi ngang gis don nam dgos pa dang bcas pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /'dir 'grel byed kha cig gis mo yig ces pa ming gzhi la pho mo ma ning gsum du dbye ba'i mo yig rnams la ngos bzung nas de nas phyung ba'i 'jug pa'i yi ge rnams med na ming gzhi'i nang tshan pho yig rnams kyi brjod pa don med par 'gyur zhes bkral mod/ shin tu mi 'thad de/ spyir mo yig noms zhes zer yang yang tig 'jug pa'i yi ge bcur dmigs rtse gtad pas de dag med na/ pho yig ka ca ta pa tsa lnga po'i brjod don med par 'gyur zhes 'jug pa'i yi ge rnams med pa'i nyes pa de 'jug yul gyi yi ge thams cad dang sbyar rigs pa la pho yig nyi tshe ba de rnams kho na dang sbyar ba la dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa ci'ang med pa'i phyir dang / mo yig 'jug pa bcur khas blangs nas pho yig ka li thams cad la 'dod na'ang mi rung ste 'chad 'gyur/ 'jug par bcas pa med na ni/ /ming dang tshig kyang gsal mi nus/ /zhes pa dang zlos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar 'chad mkhan phyi ma zhig gis zha lu pa'i gsung rgyab skyor du drangs mod kyi/ zha lu pas ni 'dir bstan gyi pho mo so sor gang yin ngos bzung ba mi 'dug kyang kho rang gis blo ka snga phyi'i 'grel pa'i mtshams ma byed pas nongs par snang ngo / /rgyas 'grel de tsam gyi thugs khur 206

bzhes pa la khungs su mdzad rgyu'i phyag dpe der thugs rtog zhib mo tsam yang mi mdzad pa ni ya mtshan pa'i gnas so/ /'grel byed 'dis mo yig 'dir bstan gyi ā li bzhi la ngos 'dzin mkhan tshor dgag pa mang du mdzad mod/phyogs snga de rnams kyis dbyangs yig srog zhugs kyi tha snyad bod yig la sbyar ba yod na ni skyon de dag 'gro bar snang yang phal cher gyis ā li zhes pa gi gu sogs la bsams pa 'dra bas/ de lta na phyogs lnga'i nam ma langs par dgag gzhag gi nyi ma shar zer ba de byung snang ngo / /gnyis pa nying dgos ldog phyogs nas bstan pa ni/ de ltar gyur na 'jig rten du/ /don mtshon brjod pa kun kyang med/ /rig byed spru ba'ang yod mi 'gyur/ /nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas kyi/ /bsrab pa rnams kyang med par 'byur/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de lhar ming tshig brjod pa thams cad med par gyur na 'jig rten 'dir don mtshon par byed pa'i brjod pa ste lung du ston pa'i sgra ska da thams cad mi 'byung bab// de 'a blto sa pa'i 'jig rten pa dang thun mong ba'i bzo gnas dang rtsis dang snyan ngag sogs rig byed smra ba rnams kyang yod par mi 'gyur zhing / 'jig rten las 'das par 'jug pa'i shes bya thun mong min pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa rnams ston zhing smra ba'ang med par 'gyur ba de'i phyir/ ming tshig brjod pa thams cad legs par sbyar ba 'jig rten du yod pa'i rang bzhin gyi dgos pa ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes bya dang bslab bya mtha' dag ci ribs par ston cing smra ba 'byung ba dang / de dag la zhugs shing blang dor phyin ci ma 'o ga par byas pa la brten 206

nas 'di dang gtan gyi bde ba dam pa phun sum tshogs pa ra 'byung ba rnams yin no/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /'dir rig byed ces pa mchod sbyin sogs rig byed bzhi po kho na la 'dod pa ni khyab chung bas mi legs te bod brda sor gzhag gis thud mong ba'i shes bya rig gnas thams cad la'ang rig byed ces pa'i sgra 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na/ mo yi yi ge med na ni/ /sogs nas/bslab pa rnams kyang med par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung 'dis gong smos lhar rjes 'jug kho nar ma zad yi ge'i 'jug pa spyi'i dgos pa bstan pa yin mod kyi/ yi ge'ang bod yul kho na'i dbang du ma byas par spyi khyab la spyar du rung ba'i dbyangs sam nga ro tsam la mo yig dang / gsal byed dam nga ros 'dren pa'i yi ge'i rnam pa tha dad pa rnams la pho yig dang yi ge de dmas don mtshon pa'i brjod pa la ji lhar 'jug pa de ltar sbyor ba la 'jug par bcas pa zhes dgongs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ tshig don lhag ma rnams dang prel te bshad na'ang dpyod ldan dag gi blo la 'jibs par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa yi ke'i 'jug pa ston pa'i bstan brtsas 'di'i dgos pa bstan pa la dngos dang / dgos pa de 'grub par smon pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ji ltar 'jig rten sems can rnams/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /grub mtha' gzhan yang yod na yang / /rang nyid kyis ni mi shes bzhin/ /de bzhin yi ge'i 'jug tshul rnams/ /spra ba kun la gnas gyur kyang / /rang tshul de nyid mi shes pas/ /don la sbyor ba ga la shes/ /de phyir smra ba'i dbang phyug gi/ rjes smras/ zhes gsungs te/ dpe ji lhar na 'jig rten gyi sems can rnams la/ gzugs phung la sogs pa'i phung po dang / mig gi khams la sogs207

pa'i khams dang / mig gi snyemached la sogs pa'i skye mched rnams rang rang la yod par ma zad/ grub pa'i mthas bzhag pa gzhan yang grangs can pa'i de nyid nyer lnga dang / nang pa'i theg chen lugs rnam shes tshogs brgyad sogs gzhan dang gzhan yang yod cing / thog ma med pa'i dus nas lhan cig tu 'grogs pa yin yang thog ma nas de lta bu'i nom gzhag rang nyid kyis shes pa med pa de bzhin du/ rang rang gi yi ge rnams ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul yang yul so so'i lung ston pa'i sgra skad kyi smra ba thams cad la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa ste med pa mi srid kyang gzhan gyis brda sprad pa la sogs pa'i rkyen med par thog ma nas yi ge rnams ming tshig sogs la ji lhar 'jug pa'i rang tshul de nyid kyang mi shes na ming tshig la sogs pa de rnams bye brag bye nas don la ji lta bar sbyor ba'i tshul ga la shes te mi shes so/ /de bas na thu mi bdag gis gangs can pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i blos 'di dang gtan gyi bde ba spub pa'i thabs/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i rig byed dang bstan bcos dang bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum sogs legs par slob cing shes su rung ba brda ji ltar sbyor ba'i tshul/ yi ge dang ming dang tshig gi 'jug pa rnams tshul bzhin tu rtogs pa la rag las par mthong nas dgos pa khyad par can de lha bu'i ched du yul 'di nyid kyi skad dang rjes su 'tsham pa'i/ yi ge'i 'jug pa gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos 'di 'phags yul la sogs pa'i smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhas pa rnams kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos 'chad ba'i tshul gyi rjes su 'brangs nas spras pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /208

gnyis pa di/ 'di kun rtogs gyur cig /ces pa ste/ de lhar yi ge'i 'jug pa legs par sbyar ba'i tshul 'di gangs can gyi skye bo kun gyis rtogs nas ming tshig brjod pa thams cad la rmongs pa med par smra ba'i dbang phyug chen por gyur cig /ces pa ste/ zhar la sngar smos pa'i nying dgos de rnams kyang 'grub pa'i smon lam mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar rtags kyi 'jug pa'i gzhung gi tshig don gyi cha rnams ji ltar dpog pa re zhig bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ gang dag thar mchog bde chen dpyig thob phyir/ /nges don snying po'i rgya mtshor 'jug 'dod na/ /ming tshig brjod gzhi yi ge'i spyor ba'i gru/ /blo ldan ded dpon tshogs kyis bsten bya yin/ /grags pa'i gter gyur yon tan bye ba'i mdzod/ /mkhas pa'i khang bzang rtse mor 'dzeg 'dod na1brda dang tha snyad rnam par spyor ba yi/ /'dzeg skas 'di la mi brten thabs gzhan ci/ /lha dang mi mchog rnams kyi dpal gang yin/ /dpag bsam zla ba bdud rtsi'i rjes 'gro ba/ /de dag legs byas chu gter las 'byung mod/ /de yang rig lam ri dbang 'dir ltos so/ /deng dus cher snyems spyi brtol can 'ga' zhig /yig sdeb tsam la'ang blo mig ldong bzhin du/ /'chad nyan byis pa'i zlos gar sgyur ba la/ /mkhas rlom de dag gyi nar ma gyur tam/ /brda sprod shes pas don la mi chongs dang / /tha snyad la brten don dam rtogs pa dang / /rtogs pa'i bstan pa lung la rag las zhes/ /rigs par smra ba'i brag ca klo bzhin du/ /gtsug lag dang 'gal lung don 'chad rlom dang / /lung dang 'gal ba'i sgom spub byed pa rnams/ /bsams kyin khong nas gad mo 'cho na yang / /snyigs ma'i rang mdangs bcos su ci zhig yod/ /de phyir dam bshad 209

myu tig phreng mdzes 'di'ang / /mkhas mchog thu mi'i dgongs pa gsal byed pa'i/ /rgyan du snga 'grel gzhan gyis bsgrun min par/ /grub pa gzur gnas rnams kyis mkhyen 'gyur mod/ /phal cher blun pas don du mi gnyer zhing / /blo ldan 'ga' yang phyogs lhung zug rngu ldang / /de 'dras gzhad la phan par mi 'gyur yang / /rang nyid lhag bsam dkar ba'i rgyan byed do/ /'di na mkhas pa dag gis rnam bshad par/ /rigs dang mi rigs cung zad dpyad pa yang //sdang dang phrag dog dbang gis ma lags te/ /blo ldan rnams kyi blo gros 'phel slad du'o/ /de phyir ji lhar dpyod pa'i tshul 'di las/ /brtsams te gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /rigs pa'i snang byed 'bum phrag sgar spros nas/ /mkhan po'i dgongs don pad+ma 'byed par mdzod/ /gang 'dir bdag blo dman pa'i dbang gyur pas/ /ma bshad pa dang log par ba bshad pa sogs/ /mkhyen spyan yangs pa rnams kyis bzod mdzod la/ /nongs pa'i dri ma rnam par sbyang du gsol/ /gzhan gyi lad mo min par rang stobs kyis/ /legs pa ra bshad pa puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i phreng / /'ga' zhig bdog par rlom pa'ang mkhas rnams kyi/ /mgul dang snyan gyi rgyan du mdzes byur cig /ces sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i gzhung gi rgyas 'grel mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan mu tig phreng mdzes 'di ni don gnyer can du mas sngon du yang yang bskul ba la brten nas ldom bu pa gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba zhes bya bas rang 'o sum cu pa la gzhung snga ma'i 'gre' pa brtsams pa g.yeng ba'i rkyen du mas 'phror lus shing / slar rang lo sum cu rtsa bdun du son pa me 'brug lor/ grub pa'i rigs su 'khrungs shing gtsub 'a ga mang por gzigs pa'i spyan ras pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar yangs 210

pa gangs can gyi sa'i dbang phyug dam pa'i bka'i mdun na 'don chen po'i chen por gyur pa zhabs drung mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal gyi zhal snga nas me tog dang bcas te dngos su skul bar mdzad pa dang / slar yang bka' drin gyi sgo nas yang yang skul bar mdzad pas bka'aXbazhin bgyid par yid la brnag kyang skabs 'gar bsnyen sgrub sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba dang phal cher bzlog tu med pa'i gzhan dbang gi kho' bo nyid du 'phyan pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba bar med du gnyibs pas re zhig 'gyang yang / rang lo bzhi bcu rtsa lnga par son pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa mig dmar shing pho byi ba'i lor sngar brtsams zin pa dmas la dag ther dang / snga ma'i 'phros dang rtags 'jug gi 'grel pa bcas sbo zla ba'i dbang phyogs zla ba gro zhun gyi 'grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba'i tshes kyi nam langs 'khrul med bdud rtsi thun mtshams dang ldan pa'i dus dge bar thub bstan chos 'khor gyi gtsug lag kang du yongs su grub pa 'di'i dge bas bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang lus can mtha' dag smra ba'i dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /sarba kā le the yo bha ba tu/211
bsha /bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal khab lo tsā bas brtsams/

zag /na mo bud ya/ bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ yang dag par gsung ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo//mtshan dpe'i gziXbyin gser gyi ri 'dra'i sku/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnga chen po'i gsung / /ye shes rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa'i thugs/ /thub chen 'gro ba'i bla ma phyag gi gnas/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i phung po cig car du/ /skal bzang yid ma bar 'gog pa med pa'i gzugs/ /phan bde'i 'od dkar legs bshad bsi' zer can/ /'jam mgon smra ba'i zla ba mchog der 'dud/ /ye shes sgyu 'phrul mdzes sku'i 'jo sgeg dang / /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rgyud mang snyan 'gyur gyis/ /snying la zag med bde ster lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyangs can lha mos blo yi mchog sbyin mdzod / /sngon med yi ge'i ngo mtshar snang ba sogs/ /legs bshad 'od brgyas byang phyogs mun gling 'dir/ /thub bstan gsal mdzad ba ṭa la sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros rtul zhing sbyangs pa'i mthu chung yang / /tshad ldan mkhas pa'i legs bshad la brten nas/ /'khrul ba'i lhan chen drungs 'byin brda sprod kyi//bstan bcos mkhas pa'i ngag sgron rab gsal bya/ /brjod don ka li sum cu 'a / /rkyang pa 'phul dang ma bo cad dang / /dbyangs lnga ya ra la wa'i 'dogs/ 1rjes 'jug dpe sogs rim pas bstan//spyod kun mkhyen shākya ka mo pa/ /ka ra ka tan ka shi ka /nags klung chu klung dba' klong klu/ /ka dag klong yangs klong du gyur/ /ka ku bha ya ka dka/ /ka sha ku sha ka ma la/ /kun ku mud ke du ka /ka ra dī ra ke ta ka /216

shing kun ma krong dar ya kan/ /ka ped ku ba kem pa'i 'bras/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri g.ya' kyi ma/ /na rī ke la ka ko la/ /ke la sha dang ka lid/ /ko ba ko sa la/ /ka ma ta dang ko'u shi ka /ka sgyu ya na ba zu/ /ke'u tshang du ko krad dang //yungs kar ka ru thod le kor/ /ku shu gur kum ka ca kun/ /bsags kyang 'thab krol phung krol rgyu/ /kye ma kyi hud kye ho kwa /kye kye kyong kyong kong kong du/krog krog krab krab mgo kyog kyog /krong krong kog gis ker langs nas/ /ku res do ker ko sko 'degs/ /ku co kyang ka klan ka'i rgyu/ /'on kyang lan kan nyen kor du/ /ka lan ta ka co ka dang / /ka la bka'i kyur kyur skad/ /ke'u kun dong kag ki kang / /stod kor klad kor klad don dang / /ke sha zhabs kyu lcags kyus btab/ /kar kar zug langs bad kan chu'i/ /ku ya kan 'og rtsa kyal kyal/ /rus krang krang nge skyil krung bcas/ /'byams klas mtha' klas klog kyang klag /ston ka dpyid ka gnyis ma'i dus/ /glang chen thal kar ber kas brdungs/ /ka lā pa yis kla klo bcom/ /ka ba ka tsa libs klubs/ /kar+ṣa pa ṇa ke ke ru/ /kang ka 'di ko klag cor che/ /keng rus ka li'i klad pa za/ /kun nas kun tu pags kab kob/ /ku hu'i mgrin sogs ka rkyang ngo / /dkar chag ma dkrugs dkor mdzod dkrogs/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil du dkrong bskyed dka'/ /dka' thub dka' spyad dkon cog dkon/ /mdog dkar dkyel che spyan dkyus ring / /dkyus ma'i dkor zas dri ma dku/ /dkos thag kun dkris gos kyis dkris/ /dku skabs dku klum dku ma rtongs//sprin dkrigs zho dkrogs rol mo dkrol/ /dkar yol chag dkrum dkyu sar da~X/ /dka' 'grel dkrigs phrag dkun gzar po/ /phan tshun dkrugs

sogs das 'phul ka'o/ /bkra shis bkrag mdangs chod bkra bkram/ /bka' bsgos khral khal srad bu bag / /pho nya ston mo 'od sprul bkye/ /dgongs pa khral bkra dgongs bcings bkrol/ /dri ma bkru bkrus bkren cing bkres/ /bkar nas bkyigs te srog bkums bkrongs/ /bkad sar snod bkang thugs dam bkang / /bsnyen bkur bkur stes gong du bkur/ /bkod legs bder bkod zur bkol dang / /shing bkug bkas shing g.yog tu bkol/ /gnang bkag man bku bkus te bor/ /gos bdab gzhu bdang rtsa ba bkog /bka' drin bka' btags bka' blo bde/ /bka' bkyon brgyad bkag 'khon du bkon/ /lam bkag spa bkong rgyal pos bkrabs/ /lus bkan lag bkan bkros nas bkri/ /mdo bklags mgo bkad thags kyi bkad/ /bkyang ba'i ngag sogs bas 'phul dka/ /rkang lag rka zhing rkang rkan rkub/ /chom rkun rkyan dang zu rkyal rku/ /rkong pa chig rkyang sa rko rkos/ /gan rkyal rked rkyong rkon pa 'dzugs/ /rka mgo'i rkyal rtsed ri dwags rkyang / /rgyu rkyen la sogs rar btags ka'o/ /skog gyur lkog ma lkog shag dang / /ngag skugs la sogs lar btags ka'o/ /ska cog skal ldan skar ma skag /sku skem sgyum skud skud pa skyob/ /skyo ma'i skyag pa sgyung kas sgyud/ /ska rags skyer skya sgyu ru ra/ /skyes bu skyems kyi skom sgyur skol/ /gos skon skyed yang sgyur bas skyo /skom byed skul byed skor ba byed/ /sgyu rum sgyu gang sgyugs pas skyengs/ /skran dang skyigs bu skya sbab skrangs/ /ri skyegs chu skyar skya ga'i skad/ /skun bu skam pa skya ba skyogs/ /dge skos bro skab ḍa ru skyog /skud po skyo sngogs snyan skyos skrag /rgya skye sa skyed tshal skyer ba'i skas/ /ske dang yog skor chu skyegs skyes/ /skyi g.ya'i skyon skyob skyaba~X 1༵gro

skyor/ /'tsho skyong re skong dzin gor skogs/ /srab skyogs skyes bzang rgyal gyi skugs/ /bya skyibs skar khung skor tsher skyid/ /skyel ma skyes chen skyos ma sgrod/ /chu skyom zho skyog rtsis kyi skyeg /ji skad 'di skad kha skong skabs/ /sa skyong skyang nul skam re skan/ /ska cig skra skyes shing skrus pa/ /sbas skungs mtha' skor skobs su chud/ /rang skal skye mched thugs dam skong / /bya skon skyi dkar skye tshe'i 'bru/ /skyo ma snga btsan skyil krung skyod/ /skya rengs zhal skyin sar btags ka'o/ /'dod la brkam pas brku bya brkus/ /sra brkyang lag brkyang brko bya brkos/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ka'o/ /byug pa bsku bskus lag bskum bskums/ /'phrin 'gan dbang bskur chos la bskul/ /nor bskyi bskyis dang bskyin pa bskyal/ /gos bskon rtar bskyon bskyar nas ba'i da/ /gcom bsgyungs zas bskru bskyed cing bskrun/ /bskal mes mtsho bskams chu bskyil bskyams/ /bskal don bskungs shing 'jigs bskyabs bskyangs/ /'pho bskyas rgyang bskyur bya ba bskyungs/ /mi bskyod bskor ba rgyal sar bskos/ /ro bska kha bskang thugs dam bskangs/ /sems bskyed rgya bskyed brjed pa'i bsgyud/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ka'o/ /spyod go khrab khri phrag khrab khrig khur/ /khong khro khon 'dzin khro bo khros/khro dang khrol tshags khrud khus khrus/ /khong khrag khrag khrug khrung khrung khyu/ /tshul khrims khris 'jags khrims kyi khra' / /khru gang khrun ring khram kha khra/ /khrom khrod khri steng khang khyim khyams/ /bya khra khyis khyer khyor ba'i khre/ /kho ra khor yug khron chu khrems/ /sil khrol khams gsum khram pas khrel/ /dur khrod sna khrid khrums stod smad/ /khro gnyer khu da kha rkyang ngo / /mkhan pos sa mkhar mkhrang mkhregs 218

bka/ /mchen spyad dpe ma khyud zhumakhan pa kho/zhi/ma mkhal mkhal ma mkhris 'dzum mkhas//mkhan khrod mkhos phab snga ma ban//mkha' mnyam mas nad med par ba / /chu mkhris mkhrig ma mas 'phul kha'o/zhi/blo 'khums zhe 'khon 'khang zhing 'khu/ /tsogs nas mtha' 'khob tsor nga ba/ /rgas 'khogs 'khos chung rkang 'khum ba /'khyor 'ab 'khar bar 'khril khyud 'khri //'khrig tshig ngag gaX'athabaka'akhrul//ba ba sems 'khol shing 'a ngas//gdugs 'ar bro 'khrab 'khar rnga 'a/la//mas 'khol sems 'khrugs 'a por 'jis/ /khur 'khur khral khyi 'od ba 'a༅/ /'khor bar yon pa da 'khrims 'a/ /ma 'ag ma 'kho snum 'khur 'khur/ /ma sa bred 'ams 'khas shing 'khun/ /'khor lo 'khod kyang 'khor ba 'khobs/ /g.yog tu 'khu~X 'al srad bu 'khal/ /'khra sar ma ba da par 'bams/ /rus 'khod sogs 'as 'phug bka'i 'o//grub mtha' grub thob grangs med grol/ /ral gri gro gas gril zhes grags/ ba/la bum rim ༵ grum bus grongs/ /snan gru 'i smo gru gre gro bzhin/chos grwa' gral du ma grabs//yul gru gru ba gru kha grong //gra ma spu gri gru 'dzin ri/ /mon lug gla sgang gro'i sbang glum/ /gra phub gro ma mon sran gre'u/ /grod pa grod can grung zhing grims/ /gram pa'i chu grog gre ba'i grogs/ /grib mar gros gleng re gron med/ /gla rtsi gla rngad glud lhar glen/ //khri /gli pa'i pa'i'adzam nga glegs bam nga bu glu/ /pho glang glang shu glog pa nad/ /glo ba'i glo dgos leb mor glebs/ /glang r+ṣa glos phab glod nas glal/29/glo

'bur glo bur glo rdog glog /glags rnyed lan glan lhan pa glan/ /sgo glegs chos gos glegs bu'i grwa/ /gla gor zho sha mdun ma gleng / /bya glag grog ma grib grib gnon/ /grog por gru mo chag grum grubs/ /dngos grub gru char 'bebs par grags/ /sha ba'i ga dor ga rkyang ngo / /dge bsnyen dge tshul dga' dgyes dgod/ /dgung sngon dgu tshigs dgye zhing dgu/ /nyin dgung dge bshes yod dgu dgug /dge sbyong dge slong dge 'dun dgus/ /dgra bcom dgong dgrol yi ger dgod/ /dgag sgrub snod dgang dgon par dgar/ /dgo bas pha ba dgo dgo dgas/ /kha dgal lhan pa dgab dang dgog /skye dgus dge legs dge sgrub dgos/ /dgongs mo zong dgram me tog dgram/ /dgun dung can du dgun ka sdod/ /dgung lo la sogs das 'phul ga'o/ /bka' bgro bgro gleng bgyi bgyid bgyis/ /go bgos bgegs kyis bgrod lam bgags/ /dus bgyangs tshod bgam bgo ba bgos/ /bgres pos mig bgrad bgrang phreng bgrangs/ /bgrus pa'i 'bras bgos gad mo bgad/ /gom pa bgoms shing rnyog ma bgrungs/ /bgo skal la sogs bas 'phul ga'o/ /mgo mgur mgul mgrin mgar mgon mgu/ /mgal dum mgal me gtor mgron mgyogs/ /ya mgal ma mgal mas 'phul ga'o/ /'gro 'greng 'grim 'grul 'gying 'gros 'gran/ /'grangs 'gengs 'gag 'gog 'gags 'gas 'grib//'gyangs 'gor 'gyes 'grogs dgongs 'grel 'grol/ /'gyel 'gril 'grongs 'gums 'gal 'gras 'gyod/ /'gol sar 'gram 'gul nor 'gye 'gyed/ /'gan 'khur 'gong po'i 'go nad 'gos/ /'phel 'grib 'gyur 'byus mi 'gong dang / /lam 'gron 'ga' 'gugs rtsig 'gram 'god/ /220

brtson 'grus 'go ma'i chu 'grems 'grub/ /mgo 'gems rigs 'gre tshos kyi 'grib/ /'thab mo 'gyed sogs 'as 'phul ga'o/ /rgod po rgya mtshor rgal phyir rgyu/ /gtam rgyud phreng rgyud rgyud mang rgyan/ /bya rgod rgan po rga shi'i rgud/ /phas rgol rgyang 'phen mgo la spyob/ /rgod ma'i rgyab rgyas rgyang ring rgyug /rgya bo dmu rgod phyag rgyar rgyo/ /rgya tsha rgyam tsha rgyags phye'i rgyugs/ /rgyu mtshan lo rgyus bying rgod rgyu/ /rgyal ba'i rgyud rgyal rgyu skar rgyal/ /shes rgyud rgyas btab nga rgyal rgyags/ /rgya gram rgyan po rgyan dang rgyal/ /gron 'thum rgya shug nya rgyar rgyu/ /rgyus pa rgyu ma lu gu rgyud/ /gru rgyongs rgyangs shing smig rgyu'i rgyun/ /rgyu yul rgya che sto rgyab skyid/ /rgyal mtshan rgyal sogs rar btags ga'o/ /la sga sgang ba gcig pur nges/ /sgom chen blo sgam sgrin por spun/ /lcags sgrog sgor mor sgrom zhing sgril/ /skyid sgyur skyid lug snyed pu snyel/ /sgyu rtsal g.yo sgyu sgyu ma spung / /snam sgrom sgro ba skye snye'u/ /sgyug mos sgo nga sgog zos sgrogs/ /sdig sgrib chu sgrol chos sgra sgrogs/ /bya sgro bshad sgros mchu sgros sgrigs/ /sgal tshigs sgul skyod sga sge'u gsher/ /sgren mor sgo drung sgeg mo skug /sbyid par gos sgab sgro gus sgrog /dbang sgyur 'khor lo sgyur sgyur byed/ /lag sgrong zas sgong bu ram sgor/ /sgar du rta sgas sgron me sgrib/ /srid sgrub klu sgrub sgrol ma sgrub/ /mna' sgog skyogs rdos sgru do gcog /da sgos sgos su rtsig pa sgron/ /sgu stegs sgang gshongs tsha sgo can/ /sgrob dang sgrom sogs sar btags ga'o/ /brgal brtag brgal lan brgyad cu brgyad/ /phreng ba brgya phrag brgyus pas brgyan/ /chu brgal 'o brgyal dran med brgyal/ /brgyud pa lam brgyags spyo ba'i brgyad/ /le brgan gad brgyangs smra ba'i brgya/ /brgyugs shing brgyungs par brgyud mar brgyab/22/rdos

'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ga'o/ /bu ram bsgar zhing bsgrangs nas bsgongs/ /chos bsgyur mdog bsgyur bka' bsgo bsgos/ /chu bsgral chos bsgrags ting 'dzin bsgoms/ /mgo bsgres rigs bsgris rgyal mtshan bsgrings/ /mna' bsgags lam bsgugs seng ge bgyings/ /bag chags bsgo bsgos phyogs gcig bsgrigs/ /'od bsgribs blo bsgrims srad bu bsgrims/ /bsgrub pa bsgrub bya ba mi nus/ /bsgrin mi phod dang bya ba'i sgang / /bsnyel zhing sgra bsgrags rtsis kyi bsgyur/ /gzhan gyis mi bsgul nor gyis bsgang / /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ga'o/ /dzod snyan dngags zil dngar tshar du dngar/ /gser dngul dngom che dngos dngos med/ /dngos grub dngos gzhi dngos bshams dngos/ /dngangs skrag dngan 'then 'bab chu'i dngo / /gre yi dngo sogs das 'phul nga'o/ /mnga' ris mnga' zhabs mnga' thang mnga'/ /mnga' mdzad mnga' bdag mngag gzhug mngags/ /mngod sum mngon byur mngon mtshan mngal/ /mngon spyod mnga' brnyes mngan mi bgrang / /chos mngod mngon shes mngar ba'i ro/ /thugs la mnga' sogs mas 'phul nga'o/ /rngon pa'i rnga yab rnga rngo'u chung / /rngam pa'i bkres rngab rnga mo je'u/ /rngom brjid rngam 'jigs rngo bag can/ /dbugs rdub zug rngus rngod mkhan rngul/ /rngos khyer dre'u rngog gla rngan dang / /rnga rngog mthug rngam rngo mi thogs/ /rngan chan rtswa rnga rngu ma dang / /rus kyi rngog sogs rar btags nga'o/ /zhal snga spyan snga snga sor sngon/ gsang sngags sngags pa mdog sngon sngo/ /snga dro sngas la sdur ba che/ /snga dus skyo sngogs mon sran sngo'u/ /snga phyi spud du sngo bar byed/ /mtshang nas sngog sogs sar btags 222

nga'o/ /brngan yang brngams nas btsas ma brngas/ /bud med brngod dang rngon pas brngod/ /chang brngubs bas 'phul rar btags nga'o/ /sdug bsnga' bstod bsngags bsngo bas bsngos/ /rnam par bsngos dang bsngog pa sogs/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nga'o//dzad ci slad ci phyir ldan pa'i can/ /bdag cag spyi cer sum cu dang / /drug cu bdun cu brgyad cu noms/ /lhand cig thabs cig skad cig tsam/ /khyed cag sems can yod do cog /can cer cab cob chang co re/ /ha cang cas cus bab co' mang / /ci ste cung zad phyin ci log /cang shes cig shos ci nas kyang / /co to'i thor cog cod pan dang/ /rgya cang be con lta ci smos/ /ca co'i cal col lha cor dang / /co 'dri cig car cam gyis 'jog /cog pur car re mig ce re/ /lan cig cis kyang cir mi rtog /kha cig cang mi shes kyang cong / /cang dang cang te'u ci yang brdung / /cu gang cung zhi cur nis za/ /ce spyang brag cas ci zhig bya/ /cog tser tho cos cung peng za ci ga la sogs ca rkyang ngo / /gros gcom gcong nad gcad bya gcod/ /khon gcugs yid gcugs gcen dang gcung / /gcud bor lag gcus gcur zhing gcun/ /rnam gcod yongs gcod zhal lce gcod/ /gcong rong gcong skad gcin gci ba/ /gcod bzhin gces med gcig gis gcig /gcam bu kha gcang gcugs med gces/ /tshar gcod gcu gal yid la gcags/ /sgra gcan gcan gzan la gcad pa/ /gcig tu gcal bkram grangs kyi gcig /ro gcig rdzas gcig gcer bu gcog /gce'u'i sman sogs gas 'phul ca'o//brtsam ldan dgra bcom bcas pas bcags/ /dam bca' khrims bca' bcing 223

bas bcings/ /shing bcad rlan bcir bca' yos bcem/ /tshigs bcad bca' gzhi bstan bcos bcang / /logs bcar bca' sga bza' bca'i bcud/ /mig bcar phyir bcil chu bcur bcug /nor bcal lag bcangs chags bcag bcol/ /bcar ba'i rtar bcibs zhal lce bcad/ /tshar bcad blos bcal bcas rang bcabs/ /rdo bcag shing bcer gros bcam bcum/ /bcu dang bzhi bcu lnga bcu dang / /dgu bcu bco lnga bco brgyad bcos/ /bcos bu'i ras sogs bas 'phul ca'o/ /mnyen rdzug rdzug phran lcang ma'i lcag/mgo lhogs ches lci blo yis lhogs/ /gnam lcags lce 'bab me lcer lceb/ /lcang lo can gyi lcags ri'i lhog /nya lcibs sbal rtsong lhang ka'i lce/ /re'u lcag lca ba lcam pa lhum/ /lag lcibs tsha lcibs sgo lcibs dang / /spyan lcibs lcam dral skra'i lcang lo/ /lci ba lcag pod srus lcag rtsig /tshig 'bru lcibs sogs lar btags ca'o/ /lha'i chem che chal chi chos chu'i char/ /chags bral chog shes cho ga'i ched/ /go cha mtshon cha'i cha lugs chos/ /byang chub bar chad cham la phob /rin chen chud po chabs cig chur/ /chu zheng cha mnyam che me ba/ /chibs pa cha de chibs la chogs/ /srog chags chag chag cha mar brdal/ /cho los che ge'i cha rkyen chad/ /chad pas chod la chung ma chol/ /chang chems che chung thugs su chud/ /mthar chags chags chogs chir gyis chir/ /chab 'og chos rkun ches cher chun/ /choms shig chings shig chab sgo chog /tshar chod thag chod chab 'og chug /cha cho ma chod cha med chas/ /zan chang 'bras chan chab nas chus/ /cha lang mal cha che zhe'i chas/ /cho rigs chud zos cha pa'i nad/ /chab shog kha 224

che sa chig rkyang chong / /bag zags cho 'phrul cho nge 'don/ /cha ga pa sogs cha rkyang ngo / /mchog tu skyabs mchi dkon mchog mchod/ /mchis mal mchil lham mchig mchig gu/ /sku mched mchan gyi mchis brang mchor/ /mchi ma mchi ma mcher pa mchin/ /zhal mchur kha mchu'i bka' mchid mchis/ /skye mched mching bu rgya mtsho'i mching / /rtswa mchog me mched mchi pa'i mchongs/ /gzhu mchog sgyu ma'i mchan du mchan/ /mchi pa mchi sa sogs mas 'phul za'1 /chos 'chad khrims 'cha' 'chag sar 'chag /tshul 'chos gar 'chams srog 'chad 'chi/ /'chums pa'i gnas 'cha' 'chel bar 'chur/ /'chal ba'i 'char sgo mi 'chags 'chab/ /nyi 'char chu 'cho las 'chol 'chun/ /gros 'choms khas 'che 'ching zhags 'chang / 'chol dang 'chus sogs 'as 'phul cha'o /dzad ji lta ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs/ /ji ltar ji srid ji skad smra/ /jo jo'i jo mo jo bo'i ja/ /nge zhig jag pa ju bo 'phangs/ /ja hong ja ril ji mthor song / /nge dang je sogs ja rkyang ngo / /mjal 'phrad mjing pa mjug ma mnge/ /mi mjed zhing sogs mas 'phul ja'o/ /'jag ma 'ji ba 'jim pa 'jags/ /'jig rten 'jig pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms/ /'jus nas sha 'jog 'jar nas 'jabs/ /'ja' zhing 'jungs pa'i skyon 'jil 'jem/ /'ju ba khrag 'jib zas 'ju 'jang / /'jud mthun 'jol 'jol 'jo sgeg 'jog /'jor bu dbyibs 'jong 'jur zhing 'jun/ /lus 'jam 'jog po mtsho 'jing 'jug 'jam dbyangs snyan 'jibs mnyam par 'jog /blos 'jal tshad 'jal 'dod pa 'jo/ /khrims 'jags 'ja' sa 'ja' mo dang / /226

'ja' bdeg 'ja' tshon srad bu'i 'jur/ /srod 'jing sha 'jums rtsa 'jing gnyen/ /thob kyis 'jal sogs 'as 'phul ja'o/ /rje btsun rjes 'jug rdo rje'i rjes/ /rje dpon lha rje rjed pa'i 'os/ /sa rjen sha rjen rje ngar rdzud/ /rjod byed snying rje lag rjes dang / /thugs rjes rjes bskyangs rje'u'i rigs/ /til gye jing sogs rar btags ja'o/ /brjed ngas brjed byed gzi brjid brjid//brje brjes ma brjed brjod bya brjod/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ja'o /yul sngongs ljang bu'i ljan lngin khrod/ /sngon shing lngid lci sman sngongs ljang / /ro 'dzin ljags sogs lar btags ja'o//spyod nyams rtogs nying khu nyag gcig nyab/ /nya ma nyag mo nyes 'gyur nyung / /spu nyag nyal nyil nya lto pa/ /nyam nyes nyon mongs nyam ngar nye/ /nying sha'i nyod pa nyes 'byung nyen/ /nyam chung nyam thag nyin mtshan nyal/ /nyams dga'i nying dgos nye bar nyon/ /sgos nyug lag nyas nyan thos nyams/ —pho nya nyi ma'i nyen kor du/ /nya sha nya ga nyi shu nyos/ /nying tor chu nyog nye reg nyang / /nye gnas nyug rum nyan rna nyid/ /nyag phran nya rgyas nya rkyang ngo / /dpung gnyen bshes gnyen gnyis kyi gnyen/ /gnya' shing gnyer pa khro gnyer dang / /bka' gnyan gnyan nad dud 'gro gnyan/ /gnya' bo don gnyer gnyan gnyags gnyos/ /gnyid kyi gnyen por gnya' ltag gnyul/ /gnyigazer gnyig tu lus gnyong chung / /gnya' rengs gnye ma nyag por gnyegaganyus ma'i don sogs gas 'phul nya'o/ —mnyan pa thugs mnyes rna bas mnyan/ /mnyed mnyes shing mnyen mnyan yod gnas/ /mnyam gzhag mnyam med mtshungs pa'i mnyam/ /ra mnye mnyes gshin mas 'phul nya'o/ /'dam 226

rnyog rnyed bkur gsar rnying rnyed/ /so rnyil rnyang ma rtong dang rnyi/ /lcang rnyid ma hob yin rnyil/ /rkang pa rtong sogs rar btags nya'o/ /go stod snying po snyid mo'i snying / /spu stol chang snyol snye phung snyil/ /tha snyad ji snyed de snyed snyam/ /snyems dang snyud med snyan shal snyi/ /stom 'jug btang stoms snyom las dang / /bsod snyoms snyugs srings snyeg sar stogs/ /snying rje'i snyim pa stobs la snyes//ston mongs snyad 'dogs rgyal mtshan snyol/ /gtam snyan snyigs dus skud pa stod/ /snyang stogs sems snyoms sar btags nya'o/ /gzugs brnyan sgra brnyan gzhan la brnyas/ /mnga' brnyes phyag brnyan brnyan po'i brnyas/ /gos brnyings kha brnyogs snang brnyan brnyang / /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i nya'o/ /dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas bsnyen rdzogs bsnyen/ /bsnyon can bsnyon dor bsnyon tol dang / /bsnyen bsgrub bsnyen bkur phye mar bsnyil/ /gtam bsnyad bsnyams nas lag pa bsnyal/ /phyir bsnyi' mal bsnyal lhung bzed bsnyigs/ /lag bsnyabs bsnyung gzhis bsnyun pas bsnyengs/ /bsnyel med nas bsnyor yo byad bsnyungs/ /bsnyen sring zas bsnyod skyu gang bsnyug /bsnyems pas rjes bsnyegs khro gnyer bsnyer/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nya'o//spyod te por te ser tal mar song / /dzā ti tang kud tig ta til/ /tug tug tong tong tog tog sgra/ /tel pa tog rtse dbyug to dang / /gtsug tor thor tor spyi tog tog /mu tig me tog ba la/ /lo tog rtsi tog za ma tog /ting 'dzin dkon mchog ta 'a la/ /ting lo tal tsam teg tes med/ /yon tan zhabs tog nan tan dang / /nan tur gal te go'u ta ma/ /kha ton 'a 'a ta nad tar bzang / /ta zig ta ming ta'i si tu/ /te shri ta dben ta hung2 ḍi~X 1

kar ṇa dang te'u shang khri/ /tam bu ra dang ting nying shag /nyo ti ta la tres sam dang / /shang shang te'u te te brdung / /'on tang ling tog ta rkyang ngo / /gtan gyi bsam gtan gtan tshigs gtam/ /gtun bu lag gtad gtun shing gtubs/ /brdung gtag gtong dang gtang rag gtang / /gter mdzod yongs gtams gtor zan gtor/ /nor gyi gta' ma gteng pa gta'/ /gtan pa med pa'i sbyin gtong gtang / /gtum po'i zhabs gtugs zad pa'i gtugs/ /lha chen gtogs 'dod gzhan la gtod/ /'ben la gtod dang dmigs pa gtod/ /gti myug gtol med mtshang nas gtol/ /khrag gtar chu gtigs se gol gtogs/ /bcol ba'i gtams dang grangs kyi gtams/ /sgo gtan gnying zab nun pa gtibs/ /gtur bu spos gtul ri bo'i gtos/ /mgo gtums mtha' gtugs khongs su gtogs/ /gtan la 'bebs sogs gas 'phul ta'o/ /sgro btags ming btags kha btags btags/ /spyir btang blos btang sngags btu btus/ /srol gtod gdan bting sa bon btab/ /btang bzung klus bteg gsol btab btud/ /btags so rgyas btab bza' btung btub/ /spu btogs rtsa bton btags shing btul/ /mgrin pa bteg sogs bas 'phul ta'o/ /mi rtag rtab rtab dbang rtul rtags//mi rtog yid rton rtog ldan rtogs/ /rtag tu rta la rte'u skyes rting / /rtol gog rting pa rtod pas bcings/ /ru rtas nyams rtas gnas su rtol/ /mong rtul rtul phod rten rten 'brel/ /mchod rten rta babs bya ma rta/ /rta thul rta dbyangs rtog ge pa/ /mi gtsang rtug sogs rar btags ta'o/ /ltos 'gro'i lha~X ༵ de lha bu/ /lto 'bye'i lte bar lhad mo lta/ /lto ba lto yis snyir gyis bkang 1

dur ltang 'grang ltogs da lta stos/ /ltar snang lhag chod lha log gi /rtsang bas ltas ngan lta ci smos/ /lteng rgyas lteng ka ltem gyis gang / /re ltos lta zhog mda' yi ltong / /ltar lhar ltem rkyang lar btags ta'o/ /ston pa'i bzhugs stangs bkur ste stobs/ /stes dbang nu stegs byad stems kyis/ /mi sto lta stangs me stag stegs/ /sta gon stong grogs sha stag byed/ /gzhogs stegs stangs stabs sta zur ston/ /shing stags stug khrod stobs can stag /dgra sta sta re ste'u stor/ /star zhun star ga'i ston mo ster/ /stod la stan dang stu ma ston/ /ston dpyid gang stongs ya stags stong/ /stem byed so stor stor khung dang / /stang zil stabs gcig star brgyus steng / /stong pa stong nyid sar btags ta'o/ /brtag dpyad gnas brtan kun brtags brtags/ /yid brtan brtad pa brtul zhugs brtan/ /spubs brtol brtun pa spyi brtol brtabs/ /yongs 'du sa brtol brtag pa brtul/ /brten pa la brten phur bus brtod/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /bstos sa bltos chos bltar rung bltas/ /blta bya sku bltams gos bltab sogs/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /bste stang bstud pa'i bste gnas bstar/ /thub bstan dang bstun bstod 'os bsten/ /bstang bas ma bzung bstan bcos bstan/ /thag bstungs sna bstad 'gro chas bstad/ /bsteng tshig bstems pas mi bstongs kyang / /bster med mngon bstod byin len bstabs/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ta'o//dzad thun mong thu bo tha gru che/ /thu mi thor cog thor tshugs dang / /tha ma tha na thig thig sgra/ /thur dang tha mal tha rkyang ngo / /mtho ris mtha' dag 229

mtha' klas mthong / /mthar thug nus mthu mthun mi mthun/ /thag mthil mthe bong mthe'u chung / /mthon ga mthon mthing mthang gos mthug /mthar byis rta mthur mtho gang mthud/ /mtho 'tshams mthol bshags mtho yor mtho /mthon po'i rgya mthongs mtha' 'khob mtha'/ /mthing ril mthing kha mas 'phul tha'o/ /'thab mor 'thon yang grogs su 'thams/ /sprin 'jibs chu 'thor 'thor 'thung dang / /blo 'thums mgo 'thoms du ba 'thul/ /sra 'thas 'thems nan nan tan 'than/ /chu 'thungs sha nas 'then zhing 'thog /smod tshig 'thing slad 'then pa 'thad/ /zas 'a 'thu 'thus bye mar 'thag /zha 'theng mal gos 'theb kyis 'thum/ /dum bur 'thub sogs 'as 'phul tha'o//spyod gzhan dring mi 'jog bka' drin dran/ /dril bu dri mchog dra draphyed/ /snga dro phyi dro'i dri dris lan/ /drang don g.yung drung drang song drug /khrims dral lcam dral zas drangs drongs/ /drang po'i shing drung drel dre'u rngog /mon dre smin drug ma dros mtsho1 /dreg nad dreg pa dri ma dang / /kha drag drab shul sa la drud/ /drod dang dro ba zan dron dril/ /dred lhags dras drubs dres mas drags/ /dred po dru bu'i dra bar drangs/ /dril bsgrags dra ma'i gnas su drongs/ /dregs pa drug phyung la yi drog /nad drag dwa phrug dwa ba'i 'bru/ /thal ba'i drags sogs da rkyang ngo / /gdugs med gdong pa gdus sa kyis gdungs/ /gdon lhar gdug pa'i gdo' pa gdul/ /gdams ngag gsal gdab gding ba bdan/ /bdu du bdang dang gdung mar gdags/ /gdung rus skad gdangs ska sa kyi gdang / 1gdung brgyud gdung 'dzin bka' gdababa~X/ /gnyer gdams bco' gdams rnyed la gdu/ /ming gdags snyun

gdangs sa bon gdab/ /kha gdangs mtshon gdengs gdon mi za/ /da gdod sos gdal gdeng thob gda'/ /gdos pa thud gdar srang la gdeg /gdags pa'i bstan bcos gdam nga byed/ /gdengs can gdul bya dam la gdags/ /ba gdal gdod nas gdags gzhi bral/ /gdangs can kun ra gas 'phul da'o/ /bdag bden bdud bdun mdun du bdar/ /bde bdo zas bda' bdug spos bdug /bda' ded bdag pos bda' zhing bdas/ /bde gshegs bde legs bden pa bdar/ /gzhu bdungs bdog pa'i skyed bdar bdog /bden gnyis bdud rtsi bye mar bdar/ /phyag bdar phyi bdar bas 'phul da'o/ /mda' mdung mde'u lam mdo'i mdos/ /mdun mdongs mdog mdangs mdor bsdus mdo/ /mdangs sang mdong gsol ra mda' dang / mdud pa la sogs mas 'phul da'o/ /bya ngan 'da' 'das 'dun pas 'dud/ /'dam khrod 'dur 'dur 'dong zhing 'dug /'dom dus rjes 'ded gsol 'debs 'don/ /lha 'dre shing 'drud khung du 'dru/ /'du byed 'dus byas 'dres ma 'dra/ /'drul pa'i gtam 'dri yi ge 'dri/ /'drid cing khrims 'dral srog 'dor 'dar/ /'degs pa 'di 'dod 'dul bas 'dul/ /'dam bu'i 'dab mar 'dab chags 'du/ /ri 'dabs 'dol sar 'dag gu 'dag /blo 'drog zhabs 'dred 'drad cing 'drud/ /'dren pas chos 'doms dge 'dun 'dus/ /'do med 'dom sa su 'dom gang 'dogs/ /'dod chags 'du shes 'du 'dzir 'dris/ /'dreg mal na 'deng phyir 'do rta 'dam/ /'das po'i 'dad kyis 'khor 'dabs 'dums/ /ming 'dogs chu 'dal skyo ma 'ad— / /'dag chal go 'dun de ma 'drog /dri ma 'dag sogs 231

'as 'phul da'o/ /grong rdal thog rdib rdo rje'i rdul/ /rdo rde'u rdog po rdog kyang rdugs/ rdung 'tshog pheg rdob cha lang rdeb/ /glo deg rdab chal lus rdos che/ /lag rdum glo rdol dbu ba rdos/ /gri rdor rdol chos rar btags da'o/ /mkha' lding 'brug ldir ldab ldib skad/ /lda ldi lde mig yod pa'i ldan/ /mgo ldog sto ldir rtsar lhur spugs/ /seng ldeng ldem ldem lder bzo'i ldebs/ /ldong ros ngad ldang lde gu byug /'jug ldog ldobs skyen phyir mi ldog /skom sdud me lde ming gi lde/ /lhum ra'i lhum bu ldab ldob dang / /bcom ldan ldem dgongs dris lan ldon/ /bskyar ldab nyis ldab lhag ma ldas/ /ldan pa'i so ldeg mig kyang ldongs/ /ne'u ldang ldom bu stan las ldang / /ldang tshad la sogs lar btags da'o/ /zhe sdang sdang mig sdigs mdzub sdig /sdar ma bde sdug dge sdig sdom/ /sdings kyi sdong po sdong bu'i sde/ /srog dang sdo zhing sde tshan sdeb/ /srog chags sdom sdig sder mo no/ /sdom pa bsrung sdom sdod gnas sdod/ /sdeb sbyor mdzes sdug nor sogs sdud/ /sdum par mchod sdong sdom bus bskor/ /sder ma'i thug sdor lag pas sdom/ /bka' sdod sde snod sar btags da'o/ /gri brdar brdeg 'chos brdung bya brdungs/ /kha brdar bla brdol chal brdab brdabs/ /rnga brdung bro brdung go byed brda/ /chal mar brdal nas brdul zhing brdeg /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i da'o/ /bldabs nas bldag pa bldeg cing bldad/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i da'o/ /bsdu bya bsdu bsdus bsdur nas bsdad/ /nyes bsdams bsdoms nas srog dang bsdos/ /'og bsdogs nyer bsdogs gzhan la bsdigs/ /grogs dang bsdongs bsdebs sna thag bsdogs/ /'gal bsdum bas 'phul sar btags da'o/ /232

lha'i phan gnod gnas skabs gnang bkag gnad/ /gnod sbyin gnag phyugs gnam lhar gnag /gnas brtan nyer gnas gnas khang gnas/ /gnod byed zil gnon gna' mi gnubs/ /zhi gnas gnas 'gyur gnas lugs rtogs/ /gnangs gzhes gnam ru rkang pas gnon/ /zhe gnong gnad gcod gnas ngad len/ /gnod gnas la sogs gas 'phul na'o/ /mnal gzims mna' ma 'og tu mnan/ /mnab rtsal dri mnam mnar med mnar/ /mnar sems zas mnog mnog chung ba/ /mnol rigs mna' bskyal na bza' mnabs/ /mno bas mnos sogs mas 'phul na'o/ /rnam shes rdod po'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /rnam rtog dam grangs dam pa mang da gshog rtse rdo rnal ma'i don/ /khug rna dag khrag zhing rnang ma/ /tshig phrad rnam par rar btags na'o/ /snar ma smon sgyubs snag tsha rdzur/ /snang ba sna tshogs sna yi snabs/ /snam bu'i snam sbyar snal ma'i sne/ /bar snang snang gsal sgyum dri snom/ /lam snar sna bo'i snag dbon snang / /lhar snang sna mang snel zhi snod/ /yug snam snam phran sna ma sne'u/ /snad yang ser sna'i snod mar sgoms/ /rgyab kyi snam logs sar btags na'o/ /brnab sems lto la bdan yang brnangs/ /brnag dka'i brnag pas mdun du brdur/ /sbas pa'i brdogs dang nges bzung brnan/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i na'o/ /gnad brdzun mtshon bsnun nu ma bsnun/ /srog bsnubs gong 'og bsnor zhing bsnol/ /mtshon bsnams dus bsnur zhib mor brtsar/ /mjug bsnar dri bsnams nem nem bsnems/ /mang du bsnan nas 'dres par bsnos/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i na'o/ /233

de'i pang par par bu pi wang 'dzin/ /gcig pur bar gyis pa tra bris/ /pu shu'i pu shud pur gyis pur/ /puṇ+ḍa rī ka mi spu ling / /pa shi pad+ma pa la sha /pus btsugs pog por ga pur 'thul/ /par ma'i po nyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ /ze prog srog zhu 'og pag dang / /pur khang par tang po ṭa la/ /pu sa la dang pu shel tse/ /pa sangs pra phab pre ya sku/ /pags pa lag pod po zos kyang / /par gyis 'phar sogs pa rkyang ngo / /dpag tshad rjes dpag dpag bya dpog /rgyal po'i dpya khral dpyang thag dpyangs/ /dpag med dmag dpung dpung bu chung / /dper na dpe byad dpe cha dped/ /rnam dpyod rtog dpyod brtag dpyad dang / rje dpon slob dpon sems dpa' che/ /dpyid dus dpa ba dpyi mgo dpyongs/ /shing nga dpung bcad dpung rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dpangs mtho dpag bsam shing / /dpa' bo dpa' ba'i dpang pos dpod/ /gso dpyad dpyis phyin dpyas mi 'dogs/ /dpal ldan dpang lo das 'phul pa'o/ /pha spad spun zla spang bya spangs/ /sprang po'i spar mo spa dbyug sprad/ /spos srin spro spros longs spyod spyod/ /spang spos spar spor spen spyil spro/ /spen tog spug gis spud pas spa/ /gnas spar bya spur gzhan du spags/ /mgo spu sprug sprug thags kyi spun/ /spe'u'i gces spras rgyud dngos spel/ /spa ma spru ma spra ba spungs/ /spra chal spod dang zho smis spags/ /'thab mo sprad sprod spyos nas sgyugs/ /spri sgos spel mar 'phrin spring springs/ /nun sprul spong ba sbongs spyod pa/ /tshur spyon dka' spyad chos spyod spor/ /spros bral sprul pa gza' spen pa/ /gos spo chur spyings spra rgyu spyin/ /khe spogs spyang gi spra spre'u/ /spyang po'i spobs pa~X ༵ge mi spyoms/ /spyi blugs kha spub rgyan gyis spras/ /spyi bo rdul sprugs rdul

gyi spabs/ /spyod pa spa bkong ri yi spo/ /mig gi spyan sogs sar btags pa'o//stag kags la sogs lar btags pa'o/ /thob phang par phun tshogs phun tshugs shing / /phrug gu dang phrad rdul phran phra/ /brgya phrag phyang phrul phyal phyang nge / /phyug po'i phyir du phyogs bcur phyin/ /phyag dar phyi sa'i zu ma zu/ /phywa mkhan phongs pas phying rul phyar/ /phyi bdar gyis phyis phyags mas phyags/ /nam zud gyen gtong phyi rdo phang / /dbang phyug dbugs phyung sgo zu nas/ /phyags lham phran tshegs phreng ba blogs/ /phra men phrin las sa phyod che/ /phyugs kyi phru ma phye ma leb/ /phru ba'i phyir phyung phyag gis phyor/ /smin phrag phyag 'tshal nyin mtshan zud/ /phra ma phrag dog phrag pa phral/ /phyin chad yid byung sud ci phyin/ /phyi 'brang phyir phyogs phyin ci log /mi pham tshig phrad rnam dbye byed/ /phru ma phyar g.yeng pha rkyang ngo / /gzhan la 'phya 'phyas 'od 'phro 'phros/ /'phyi ba 'byu bo dus 'phyi 'phyis/ /rnam 'phrul sgyu 'phrul mda' 'phen 'phangs/ /nam 'phang khri 'phang go 'phang 'phrog /mtsho 'phyur dung phyur lam 'jig 'phyugs/ /snying 'phyo'i 'phyon mas zu 'phyar 'phangs/ /'phongs kyi 'phag 'phag mgo thum 'phur/ /'phong gis gzhan 'pham 'phal ka 'grig /'phyan zhing 'phyo lding dar 'phyar 'phral/ /'phrin 'phrod 'chi 'phras sems la 'phreng / /'phral ba skra 'phyings phyag dar 'thag /'phyang dang 'gye ba 'as 'phul pa'o/ /zhed bla ma'i bla na bla bre bres/ /byams pas byad byur byabs pas byer1bre yi bye mas brabs pas byang / /bran g.yog byes byon byug pa byin/ /byis pas bya ra'i bya ba byos/ /zam ze brag ri'i byang du byol/ /bya pyi'u byi ba byi la'i~X ༵da//

byol song brang 'gro'i brang byil byil/ /bla gab bla gos blus kyang bla/ /blun po 'dam bying blo blong blong / /bro nad thabs bral bro bor bros/ /byan mo'i byi bor rang byan chud/ /byag mkhan bro gar bye bas brel/ /sos blad chu blud zas brims brod/ /bya na'i yo byad byur dur zugs/ /da byid ro bro bra ba'i brun/ /dong brubs chu brug bru ba tsha/ /gos byed btso blag gos kyis byibs/ /bla tshe byang bur ba bla byugs/ /khas blangs bla thabs sa blas khyer/ /blo brid bla dwags yi ger bris/ /spu byi cha byad gzi byin bri/ /byi bzhin bra nyer bra phye byol/ /byug ris bya ba'i bye brag la/ /rgyal blon blo mig bde blag byed/ /blang dor blon 'debs bla bo la/ /rab byung skra bregs rna ba blags/ /sto gos brang breng bya dgar byin/ /sman bla byang chub bla na med/ /byin rlabs byu ru ba rkyang ngo / /dbyen dang dbye zal chos dbyings dbyibs/ /dbyer med dbu ma dbung dang dbus/ /dbyu gu dbyig pa dbyug pa dbyugs/ /jing dbol chu dbo skar ma dbo/ /phyir dbyung sun dbyung mtshon gyis dbug /dbul pos dbugs dbyung nor mi dbrog /tshon dbyi dbyig mor dbyig dbyig dbur/ /dbon pos dbyangs dbul sma mi dbab/ /dpyig gnyen dbu la gdugs kyang dbub//dbang bskur byin dbab gtan la dbab/ /lung dbog khur dbog dbed sar dbral/ /dbang phyug dbang ldan dbang thang dbyar/ /dbang po dbyig mang dpral dbyes che/ /dba' rlabs dbu ba skyon gyis dbags/ /dbre btsog kha dbri zhe sa'i dba'/ /dbal di sha nyam rtse drod tog /zha nye'i dbyar 'dab das 'phul ba'o/ /rab 'byams 'byams klas 'byung bzhi 'brug /'bral ba 3snyed 'brel 'bras bu 'bru/ /'jing po 'dam 'bying 'brum nad 'byang / /

'grog gi 'ji 'brong rus kyi 'grom/ /'byung 'gyur tshe 'byid 'drid pa'i 'byid/ /ka' ba la 'bel gtam sgo 'bye 'byud/ /'bras chan lces 'byog chang 'byo 'byang ga /'brom ston 'byon dus 'bros shing 'brang / /'brub khung kha 'byed 'byol zhing 'byer/ /mtshang 'bru'i tshig 'jin tshon 'byug 'byongs/ /kha 'ji chu 'brub sbyar ba'i 'grur/ /'byung po'i 'byor ba 'as 'phul ba'o/ /khyi rbad rbab sgril kha rbad che/ /nad kyi skya rbab skra zad rbod/ /rbod ma skyel sogs rar btags ba'o/ /spu ba lnga ba lar btags ba'o/ /nor sbyin gnod sbyin sbyin bdag sbon/ /spun pa sbangs dang sbang mas sbangs/ /spug tu nor sba sbas sbos sped/ /nyis sbrag ba 'bubs sprel nas spyar/ /sbyis nas spur mar me sbar sbor/ /chus sgrus zas sprus phyogs gcig sboms/ /sgrum ma lto sbos srog chags ste/ /phyag sbal grog spur sbal pa sprul/ /grogs spran spungs skyed spud pa'i sgrubs/ /sbyig mor sbyig cing spe ga sbyor/ /spyag tshe lus zid sba 'khar sbom//sha sprang sbrang ma srung dang jigs/ /sped byed gser spram sa le spram/ /sbyor ba sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs/ /dge sbyong gso sbyong gtsang spra sbyor/ /'doms kyi sba ba sar btags ba'o/ /dzad ro zugs skyag myog nags myu myur/ /nyams myong myu gu'i ro zung myos/ /spyang 'das zung zung myug myug dang / /chu ngan zu ngam ma rkyang ngo / /dmag gi nyes dmigs dmangs rigs dman/ /dme po da nus long dmigs bu med/ /da nu rgod dmu chu 'dre srin da su/ /blo dkun da nus byung bu ga'i dmig /gtsang dme 'dzum dmul dmigs pa gtod/ /lag dmar kha dmar kha dog dmar/ /nyams dmas dmod btsugs dmod pa 'dor/ /da~X ba

gnas dma' dmigs bas dang / /myug myug dmyugs sogs das 'phul ma'o/ /mod byung rmugs 'dzin mi lam mis/ /rmang nas rmo rmos rmon dor dang //rmongs zugs khyis rmur rmugs pa'i rma/ /chen pa rta mig sga yi med/ /zongs bu meg med sun pa'i rmus/ /ser me bsris che ngo mtshar rmad/ /rmo mo bal mel dris pa'i rmas/ /rma bya khams rmya bya rmyang byed/ /zog dang dbu rmog rar btags ma'o/ /sman dang sman pa'i gtam smra sgros/ /smig rgyu smag rum zong min smar/ /sman ljongs sug smel spyag shad dang / /sgyug ma snyi gu spyig ma smin/ /tshe smad sma phab smad ras smod/ /mgo sgyung smrang dang smre sngags smras/ /bu smad ming smos spyan ka byed/ /ngur smrig rnam smin smos ci dgos/ /sgyung gnas dus sgyur spyon pa smyo/ /smon 'drin dri med smon lam sman/ /smin drug smal po smin drug bu/ /sme ba sgrug rtsi kha dog sgrug /sma ra smin ma spe sha can/ /rtsis kyi spe ba sar btags ma'o//lha'i tsab tsub mi bya tsog tsog pu/ /tsan dan tsā ta tsam pa ka /tsa ko ra dang tsi ti mo/ /ne tso de tsam de tsug lags/ /tse ne tse re tsa ri ba tsā ru'i bza' ba tsa na ka /tsug tsug sgra sogs tsa rkyang ngo / /gtsug tor spyi gtsug gtsang khang gtsang / /mi gcigs spyod pa gtsug lag khang / /gtsod rus gtses shing gtser bas gtses/ /mche gcigs gtsub shing gtsub gtan gtsubs/ /gtso bo gcigs che gtsag bus gtsag /gtsang phyogs gtsang chu gas 'phul tsam/ /btsan po bka' btsan rdzong btsan dang / /btsun mor bu btsas gru btsas btsal/ /btsun pa mig btsums btson rar btsud/ btsong btsug btsags btsongs btsod btso btsos/ /gos btsems btsag dang btsod 238

kyis brtsos/ /btsan dug tshags kyis btsags shing bcir/ /btsas khyer 'bags btsog btso blag mkhan/ /mtho btsams rdeg btsog btsog po deg /btsan rgod btsan thabs gser btso ma/ /srol btsugs shing btsugs sgog btsong btsongs/ /btsad po btsas ma bas 'phul ma'o/ /rtsa lag rtsa rtse tshon rtsi rtsing / /rtsi mar rtsi shing rtsi thog rtswa/ /'thab rtsod rtsed mo rtse rtses rtsen/ /lngas rtsen sum rtsen rtsis rtsis mkhan/ /rtsib ma'i rtsa rgyus rtsid pa nub/ /kha rtsang rtse rgod rtsam rin rtseg /rtsabs gcod rtsad gcod tsher ma'i rtsang / /stobs rtsal 'bad rtsol rtsom pa rtsom/ /zho rtsabs rtsab mo ser rtsa'i gos/ /rtsig pa rtsig mkhan 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /rtsangs pa srog rtsol rar btags tsam/ /bka' stsol dngos grub bstsal dang sprul/ /sbyin pa stsal bgyi bgyid du stsal/ /stsal du gsol sogs sar btags tsam/ /brtson 'grus snying brtse brtse ba can/ /brtsad cing dris nas brtsam bya brtsams/ /khang brtsegs brtsigs shing brtsi bya brtsis/ /so brtse ha cang brtsengs pa'i gos/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i tsa'//lha'i nags tshal skyed tshal tshi gu'i tshigs/ /tshogs pa'i sde tshan lus lang tsho/ /tshon rtsi phra tshom tshar du dngar/ /the tshom tsham rngams 'ju byed tshwa/ /khang pa'i tshoms sogs tsha rkyang ngo / /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe mtsho dang mtshe'u/ /mtshe ma mtshams bcad mtshan gzhi dang / /mtshan nyid mtshon bya mtshan mas mtshan/ /phyogs mtshams skyon mtshang mtshan mo mtshon/ /mtshur ston kha mtshul mtshal dang mtshungs/ /rgyal mtshad mtsha' mes rta mtsha' lu/ /mtshar sdug khyim mtshes mtshe dang mtshan/ /mtshams med la mtsher dur mtshed mtshun/ /mchod 239

za'i phyag mtshan mtshog mar 'thar/ /ming gi mtshad sogs mas 'phul tshang/ /blo 'tshangs chu 'tshag nang du 'tshang ga /til 'tshir mes 'tshig du ba 'tshubs//zas 'tshed lus 'tsho 'tsho byed 'tshengs/ /'tshe med 'tshag bzang 'tshal ma 'tshal/ /nor 'tsho phyugs 'tsho 'tshog chas 'tshong / /bdeg 'tshog ngal 'tsho 'od 'tsher zhing / /blo dang 'tsham par skyid pa 'tshab/ /gdung 'tshob 'tshang rgya longs pa'i 'tshar/ /phyag 'tshal shes dang chog pa'i 'tshal 'dzom pa'i 'tshag sogs 'as 'phul tsham//tshod dza rag dza lang dza bo shing / /dza ya can sogs dza rkyang ngo / /dpa' mdzangs mdza' bo'i bang mdzod mdzes/ /gnod mdzes mdzub mo mdzod spu dkar/ /mdzo rta'i mdzer ba mdze nad dang / mdzol bu bsrung ba'i mdzad pa mdzod/ /ya rabs mdzangs sogs mas 'phul dzad/ /'dzings pas gos 'dzar lag pas 'dzin/ /'dzag dang 'dzir ba'i snod 'dzed 'dzem/ /'dzur zhing sgor 'dzul 'dzeg skas 'dzugs/ /bzhin 'dzum 'dzin pa snod du 'dzud//'dzam gling du 'dzom nor 'dzangs 'dzad/ /'dzab bzlas skad 'dzer nor ba'i 'dzol/ /'du 'dzi chud 'dza' rdo yi 'dzeng / /'khrugs pa'i 'dzag 'dzog 'as 'phul dzad/ /kun rdzob rdzun gyi rdzab rdzub dang / /phyugs ji'i rdzongs su ji'u byin/ /jing bur rdzus skyes 'dam rdzab rdzogs/ /ji phyogs rdza ma'i bu ji dang / /ji med ji ma zin pa'i rdzob/ /mkhar rdzong nor rdzas rdzu 'phrul dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs rar btags dza'/ /gzhan gyis mi ba ji khro bor bsdus/ /ral pa gyen ba)sa srog chags brdzis/ /zan ba jis yul gzhan brdzangs pa sogs/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i dzad//240

zhed ka skyes pha wang chu'i wa kha/ /'gi'u kang pe wang 'dzum wang wang / /yid la wal le kang long dang / /wa ta yug sogs wa rkyang ngo //snyed zha bo'i zhwa mo zha rkyang ngo / /mnyam gzhag gzhal bya gzhal med khang / /kun gzhi rnam gzhag nam gzhag gtan/ /gzhon nu gzhung bzang gzha' tsho'i gzhu/ /gzhogs slong bdud gzhom sbo gzhogs kyang / /gnas gzhi gzhong pa g.yang gzhi gzhan/ /mngag gzhug khu ba gzhib la gzhol/ /gzha' gsang gzhongs su lcag gis gzhu/ /gzhi grub gzhung lugs brtag gzhig gzhug /gzhogs kyi nad gzhi gzhang 'brum gzhil/ /gzhar yang gzhom med yid gzhungs gzhob/ /gzhis ka gru gzhas 'tsho zhing gzhes/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bsgrigs pa'i gzhibs/ /gzhen bskul nang gzhug gas 'phul zha'o/ /bzhag zin bzhad gad bzhad dkar bzhi/ /bzhabs nas skra bzhar bzhams bsgo byed/ /gsol bzhi'i dgongs bzhed de bzhin nyid/ /bzhengs bzhugs 'byon bzhud bzhon pa zhon/ /bzhon ma bzho bzhos brlan bzha' bzhogs/ /g.yog bzhun mar bzhu bzhur nas bzhes/ /bzhin ras me bzhi gro byi bzhin/ /'di bzhin khur bzhes dpang che bzhi/ /bzhi mnyam bzhag sogs bas 'phul zha'o//thob zwa tshod mi zad gzhan la klo/ /sngags zlos blos gar zla ba blum/ /zla gam zlas dbye blog pa dang / /zla grogs lo zla zu ngan klo/ /bskyar ba'i klos sogs za nyid do/ /gcan gzan gzig gi gzugs brnyan gzigs/ /gza' skar 'od gzer gzi brjid gzi/ /rdul gzan phrag par gzed cing gzar/ /gzong gi gzer la gzer du gzug ga /gzegs ma gzegs zan gzir bar pho1

gzas/ /da gzod drin gzo chud mi gzon/ /gzu lums gzung 'dzin gzeg cha chung / /zug gzer la gzem gzim mal gzud/ /gze ma tsher ma gzang ring gzan/ /gru gzings sha gzug zas kyi gzan/ /phying gzar gzar du dgang blugs gzar/ /gzengs bstod gzi mdangs gzod ma'i dus/ /ri gzar gzugs mo byi zur gzugs/ /gzar thag gzungs thag gzabs kyang gzags/ /gzungs spobs gzungs sngags thugs gzu bo/ /bsgo ba rnar gzon gas 'phul za'o/ /bza' ba bza' bzas bud med bza'/ /bza' mi bzi zhing ma bskugs kyang / /na bza' bzang po lag pas bzung / /bzo bos lhung bzed bzed zhal bzed/ /bze chung mi bzad las la bzur/ /bzod pa tshogs bskums sngags bzla bzlas/ /mi bzlog g.yul bzlog zu ngan bzla/ /gcig tu bskums sogs bas 'phul za'o//dzad yi rang yi chad yi dwags dang / /mda' yab rnga yab ya rkyang ngo //g.yor mo g.yo g.yos g.yab mo g.yabs/ /g.yor po g.yung za g.yan pa dgab//g.yang sa mi g.yo g.yung drung g.yang / /g.yel med g.yur za zas g.yo g.yos/ /g.yang gzhi g.yog g.yogs g.yer mas g.yigs/ /g.yi lhags g.yar nas g.yab g.yug g.yob/ /g.yon ma log g.yem g.yeng bas g.yengs/ /g.ya' sgog skyi g.ya' lcags g.ya' g.yu/ /g.yung mo g.yo sgyu g.yer bag g.yag /g.yas g.yon g.yul sprod g.yul las g.yog /mig g.yor kha g.yal g.yar ngo tsha/ /g.yar khral g.yar dam g.yar khams dang / /snang g.yel g.yer kha gas 'phul pa'o//zhed ra lug rwa co rdul du brlog /mngon rlom rlom sems byin 242

rlabs rlobs/ /rlon pa rlag byed 'doms kyi rmig /rlabs chen dba' rlabs rlangs pa rlung / /rlab khyer khrag rlabs zad rlon zang / /rlag mo rlugs pa khung bu'i rlubs/ /dud 'gro'i zad bu bas 'phul med/ /bcom brlag tshig brlang brlag bya brlag /brla sha chus brlan ya ma brla/ /blo brlug brtan bzang byin gyis brlabs/ /gdon gyis bzangs sogs bas 'phul rla'o//spyod lu ni gos kyi bye brag yin//zhed/shar gyi shing khar shang shang shi/ /shul du shid zan shel gyi shubs//shed bu shed bdag shed las skyes/ /shun pags shad zabs shur bus bcings//shes ldan shin tu shub bur sga /shan pa shā 'od sha rkyang ngo / /bde gshegs gshis lugs de bzhin gshegs/ /gshin po'i gshags 'byed gshin rje gshed/gshen rabs gshang dkrol dbu skra gshor/ /gshis ngan g.yul gshom gshung dang gshe /mo gsham gsha' ma yin du gsha'/ /gshor gyis chu gsho shing gshog gshags/ /thong gshol gsheg cing 'dab gshog gshibs/ /brlan gsher bres gshor 'phrang la gshor/ /gsham gyi spang gshongs zhing sa gshin/ /gshong bu la sogs gas 'phul sha'o/ /mdza' bshes dge bshes lha bshos bsham ga /sdig bshags phyi bshol bshul lam bshar/ /bshum bshums bshal drud bshud nas bshags/ /bsha' tshe bgo bshad ri dwags bshar/ /rgyab bshul pags bshus bshan pas bshas/ /mer bshur chus bshal bshang gci bsho /mkhar bshig zes bshar 'phrang la bshar/ /grubs bshangs dpe bshad bas 'phul sha'o//spyod sangs rgyas sor mo sen mo so/ /sil snyan mil sil se mo do/ /tshe srog sung zhing 'od srung sras/ /srid par drang srong srol tshugs srid/ma//da

dus sa sros gre nag srab/ /srin po lus srul sa srung bu/ /srubs kyi lam srang srid du srings/ /yid srubs kyis greg srid mor sred/ /sru mo'i sri zhu sri'u'i sri//sre mo sreg pa srin bya sram/ /srin bu sro ma srad bu spa /ji srid de srid sran ma srus/ /brnyen sring sreg byed sreg blugs dang / /rgyal srid nun sribs rta yi srab/ /srub shing srub thag 'jal byed srang / /slob dpon slob ma slob gnyer sla/ /slob pa slo mar slong mo slong / /spe ba gyen slong slog kyang sleb/ /sle tres slu gu'i chu sla mo/ /kun slong spe yon bsad pa'i slo/ /slar zhing slar yang slu med slad/ /sle'u slog pa phyi nang slog /sla nga'i slad rol phyogs su slon/ /slad mar slad nas dug ro slong / /sra brkyang bting sogs sa nyid do/ /gsar bu gsar nas 'khar gsil gsor/ /kha gsag gsog gsob gsad bya gsod/ /gsang sngags snyan gsan gsung rab gsungs/ /gsong po'i tshig gsol gsol 'debs gson/ /gser mdog ne'u gsing gseg ma'i gseb/ /gseb dang gsa' yis gsag gsir te/ /shing gsom gsor gyis gsem zhing gses/ /gsas mo gsog 'jog gsang gtam gsong / /gso ras spu gsed gseng gi gsur/ /gsus pa gso phyir gsol yang gsud/ /so gsod lus gsig dril gsil gsum/ /skad gsang gseg gshang gseg ka li/ /gson po snyan gsang chud ma gson/ /'od gsal nang gses dri chu gsil/ /gsal shing chud gsan gas 'phul sa'o/ /sngo bsangs 'bags bsangs tshogs bsag bsags/ /dmigs bsal skyon bsal bsam bya bsams/ /bse khrab bsod nams bsod snyoms bsogs/ /tshe bsring bsam blo drin bsab bsabs/ /yo bsrang nor bsri rgyang bsring bsrings/ /dri bsung gis bsus bse ru bsad/ /bsrungs pa 2yo

bsrung bya bsreg bya bsregs/ /bzod bsran bsro khang zho bsrubs bsres/ /bsod pa'i zas ba ring bsreg bsrings/ /bya ba'i bas dang sgrib pa bsrabs/ /bsel ba'i bso sgra ngal bsos du/ /kha bsum rjes bsubs bser bu bsil/ /lha bsangs me bsangs skyo bsangs dang / /blo bsrun bsam bse'u sba bsri med/ /bsang gtor zhabs bsil zhal bsil bsro/ /bslad bya bslad nas bslu bya bslus/ /bslad bya'i nor bslangs phyogs su bslad/ /bslab bya bslab pa byed du bslang ga /'dod pa'i bsod nyams bas 'gul sa'o//snyed da hral zug zug mig trig hrig /hwa shang hwags dang gos kyi hwa/ /rtsab tshal la sogs ga nyid do//dzad bka ru dang ma ru ra/ /nu duka ra ut+pa la/ /brgyan spu ma maṇ+ḍa rnyil/ /shing thog bza ba ba'i 'dab/ /me nu ya na a nyid do/ /bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las/ sngon 'jug sogs yi ge'i sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa ste le'u dang po'o/ /da ni rnam dbye phrad la sogs/ /gces bsdus sil bur bstan pa las//thog mar rnam dbye drug pa yi/ /kyi gi gyi 'i yi rnams ni/ /da ba sa dang da drag dag /thob mthar kyi dang ga nga gi /na ma ra la bzhi po gyi/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'i thob cing da rkang pa skong tshe yi ste dper/ /khyod kyi rgyab kyi g.yas kyi char/ /gyur gyi brag gi byang gi phyogs/ /dpon gyi lam gyi bar gyi sar/ /gzhol gyi sa gzhi'i bdag de ka /'o 'u 'am gyi tsheg khyim yang / /rkang pa skong mi skong gis dbye/ /bde 'o la sogs rdzogs tshig la/ /'o nyid spyi bo la sogs 246

pa'i/ /ming la ba phyed wa nyid do/ /mtha' rten can dang brtsegs pa dang / /gug kyed can mthar 'a mtha' spang / /tshig phrad ga da ba'i rjes su/ /cing ces ce'o ce na cig /nga na ma 'a ra la dang / /mtha' rten med pa'i rjes dag tu/ /zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig /sa mthar shing she'o she na shig /na ra la gsum rjes su ni/ /da drag thob phyir de gsum gyi/ /rjes su zhing sogs lnga thob kyang / /da drag nges par thob pa der/ /cing sogs lnga bo legs te dper/ /rtag cing rtog ces lhag ce'o/ /su 'dug ce na khyod 'dug cig /rgyad cing zad ces med ce'o/ /ci 'chad ce na chos shod cig /zab cing thob ces nub ce'o/ /gang rgyag ce na gri spyob cig /byang zhing drang zhes 'byung zhe'o/ /gang gzung zhe na sems gzung zhig /snyan zhing 'dzin zhes dkon zhe'o/ /lha yin zhe na don zhig gnyer/ /'jam zhing ngom zhes 'dzom zhe'o/ /dben nam zhe na nam zhig dben/ /dga' zhing bza' zhes gda' zhe'o/ /du gda' zhe na 'ga' zhig go /dar zhing 'phyur zhes 'gyur zhe'o/ /ci 'phyar zhe na dar phyor zhig /'chol zhing 'chal zhes 'khrul zhe'o/ /gang tsho zhe na chos chog zheg /za zhing bde zhes spro zhe'o/ /e spru zhe na ma bzhig /'dus shing 'bral bar nges she'o/ /ci nges she na gtam sgros shig /mkhyen cing 'phral ces brgyan ce'o/ /cis grol ce na grol gyur cig dri dang rdzogs tshig skabs su ni/ /mtha' rten med dang 'a mthar 'a/ /mtha' rten gzhan mthar rang rang la'o/ /da drag can mthar ta ste dper/ /bde 'am bde'o dga' 'am dga'o/ /gyurd tam gyurd to lta bu'o/ /lhag ma can gyi te ste de/ /na ra la sa da drag gi /rjes su te rkyang da ma~X de/ /ga nga ba ma 'a dang ni/ / tha' rten med mthar sa ste dper/ /byon

te bskor te nor btsal te/ /skyengs te gyur te don med de/ /rtog ste gtsang ste lhun grub tshe /'dzom ste dga' ste sems bde ste/ /rnam dbye bdun pa la don gyi/ /tu du ru su'i zhabs kyu ni/ /ga ba da drag can mthar tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /sa su mtha' rted med pa dang / /'a mtha' ru ste dpe rim bzhin/ /rtag tu rab tu shin tu dang / /steng du sgod du rgyun du zo/ /lam du myur du 'jal du song / /rjes su 'di ru dga' ru chug /mtshams sbyor kyang 'ang yang rnams ni/ /ga da ba sa nyid dang ni/ /da drag thob pa'i rjes su kyang / /nga na ma 'a ra la yang / /mtha' rten med mthar 'ang dang di/ /rkang pa skong tshe yang ste dper/ /bdag kyang 'bad kyang don grub kyang / /byas kyang 'on kyang ma byung yang / /byon yang nam yang 'ga' yang ni/ /slar yang mjal yang blo'ang bde'ang / /ming mtha'i pa ba'i dbye ba ni/ /ga da na ba ma sa dang / /da drag can mthar pa dang ni/ /nga 'a ra la mtha' med mtha'i/ /ba phyed war 'bod rnams la ba/ /gzhan la pa nyid sbyar te dper/ /zag pa med pa phan pa mchog/thob pa dam pa mkhas pa ru/ /gyur pa dang ba la dga' ba/ /myur bar mjal bar spro ba las/ /lung pa mda' pa'i 'byor pa yis/ /yul pa phu pa tshim sogs dpyad/ /gcod mtshams mtha' rten ga yi mthar/ /chig shad nga yig ma gtogs pa'i/ /shad gong rnams su phyi tsheg spang / /don mang bgrangs pa'i ming gi ni/ /mtshams dang don 'bring 'byed pa dang / don nyung rdzogs tshig mtshams chig shad/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang mtha' dang / /lhug pa'i sde tshan rdzogs mtshams kyi/ /sna ru can mthar nyis shad bya/ /sde tshan chen po rdzogs mtshams dang / /le'u mtshams lta dur bzhi shad thob/ /bod kyi brda'i 247

bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las/ rnam dbye dang phrad sogs gces pa sna tshogs thun mong du bshad pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o/ /da ni 'phul dang mtha' rten mgo /med la sbyor dang yod la spong / /gdam nga can la mtha' gcig tu/ /'dzin pa'i 'khrul spong cung zad bshad/ /ngo yab ge sar sil snyan dang / /mngon sum phud sum tshogs sogs la/ /gas 'phul nor ro gsha' ma dang / /gshags 'byed sogs la med na nor/ /sar pa lta bur gang yang rung / /skyil krung sogs la das 'phul med/ /dgung lo mtshan dgung long khrid kyi/ /dmigs bu sogs la med na nor/ /snyan dngags sogs la gang yang rung/ /phyag dar lag dar gad mo dang / /skra shad sogs la bas 'phul spang / /bser bu skyo bsangs rgya mo bza'/ /phyi bdar sogs la med na nor/ /sngo sangs lha bur gang yang rung / /tha gru tha ma tshar du dngar/ /tshon rtsi sogs la mas 'phul spang / /mthe bo mtshe ma sngo snan mtshe/ /khrim mtshes sogs la med na nor/ /thun mong sogs la gang yang rung / /tshong dus khams dang tshogs pa tshogs/ /phra ma khon 'dzin khro bo khros/ /rim gro phra mo phongs pa dang / /phyug po sogs la 'as 'phul spang / /mtha' 'khob 'khri shing 'khur ba dang / /tshul 'chos sogs la med na nor/ /phrin las phreng sogs gang yang rung / /yi ge myu gu lu gu rgyud/ /shākya sogs la ga mtha' spang / /phrag dog phrug gur med na nor/ /pus mo'i lha nga sla nga dang / /sgo nga sogs la nga mtha' nor//yi dam yi rang yi dwags dang / /sri zhu sogs la da mtha' nor/ /ska cig lta bur gang yang rung / /se mo do la na mtha' spang / /byan mo lta dur med na nor1248

lha btsun bza' btung gdu bu dang / /le brgan sogs la ba mtha' nor/ /rgya 'dre kha mchu ra mda' dang / /ra mnye na bza' rtswa mchog grong / /rgya mtsho sogs la ma mtha' nor/ /lha rje mdo rgyud nga rgyal can/ /bya rgod rdo rje mtha' rted dang / /lha rten sogs la ra mtha' med/ /dur khrod mdor bsdus la med nor/ /bder gshegs sogs la gang yang rung/ /skun gyi gsos sman khaXdro dang / /grwa lnga sogs la la mtha' nor/ /rig sngags gsung rab mkhyen rab dang / /nam mkha' go 'phang khri 'phang mchog /bskyed rim rdzogs rim 'du shes dang / /mkha' spyod sa spyod do shal 'phreng / /nyam chung nyam thag nyam nga ba/ /log rtog som nyi chom rkun dang / /cho ga sogs la sa mtha' nor/ /lhas byin klus pyin gdams ngag sogs/ /mang po zhig la med na nor/ /dri bzangs rgyud mangs go rims dang / /'khor los sgyur sogs gang yang rung / /klad kor stod kor gdub kor dang / /pad kor than kor 'od kor phreng / a spo sogs la sa mgo med/ /ngur smrib smig rgyur med na nor/ /yi ge zhal ta da lha dang / /la sogs za dad ces rnams la/ /bar tsheg mi byed blun po'i lugs1de ltar mdo tsam bshad pa 'dig /mtshon nas shin tu rgya che'i gnas/ /rang rang rnam dpyod rig pas dpyad/ /mtha' dag yi ger brjod mi lang / /bod kyi bda'i bye brag gas bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba lag /yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul pa spong ba bshad pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// //deng sang byis pa'i mi bo dmas/ /brda dag 'di ko lung rigs kyis/ /dpyad gzhi chung zhing tshegs med du/ /shes snyam 'khrul bas mgo bo rmo—19/ /

kye ma shes bya pha mtha' yas/ /de dag re re'i ming gi yang / /rgyu mtshan nges tshig mi shes na/ /brda dag spyor ba ji ltar 'byung / /so so rig bzhi sa dgu pa//ma thob de srid chos kun gyi/ /nges tshig shes min de yi gyir/ /mtha' dag sdeb sbyor su yis shes/ /'on kyang phyogs re'i brda dag kyang / /'bad pa du mas btsal bar bya/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul na/ /don rnams 'khrul ba smos ci dgos/ /'di ni gsung rab ma lus pa'i/ /phyi mor shes pas mkhas mang gi /gzhung la brten nas bdag gis kyang / /'di nyid kho dar nan tan byas/ /mkhas pa du mas mdzad pa yi/ /brda yi bstan bcos grangs mang yang / /'ga' zhig tshig rgyas dgos don nyung / /'ga' zhig gnyis ka ha cang bsdus/ /'ga' zhig yig rnying dang mi mthun/ /'ga' zhig sum rtags sogs dang 'gal/ /de phyir tshig nyung don rgyas pa'i/ /legs bshad 'di ni bdag gis byas/ /'di la rang bzo ma mchis te/ /tshad ldan gzhung la yang dag brten/ /gsar rnying brda dang rgya bod skad/ /la sogs zhib mor dpyad de bkod/ /snyigs ma'i mi rnams rnam dpyod mig /phyogs lhung ling tog gis bsgribs nas/ /gzu bo'i blo yis legs bshad la/ /mi rtog grags pa'i rjes su 'brang //mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma 'di ko legs bshad 'od zer stong ldan mod/ /blo nor ldan yang rigs gzugs longs spyod nyam chung bdag gis sbyar ba'i phyir//rab rib blo ngan rnams kyis spangs nas blun po 'khor mang 'byor ldan gyi/ /nyes bshad srin bu'i kha yi 'od la rmongs pa'i myun pa sel phyir rgyug /bdag gis 'dir 'bad bsod nams dang / /gzur gnas blo gsal don gnyer ba//'ga' la 'di yis phan srid na/ /de yi dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /260

bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di di/ sdom brtson mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag byang pa 'tsho mdzad karma 'od zer ba'i gsung gis bskul te/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde zhes bya bas/ rnam 'phyang gi lo tha skar zla ba'i gral tshes bco lnga la spyan ras gzigs karma pa'i sgar chen du grub par bgyis pa'o/ /mad//261
bsha /bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos dag yig ngag sgron gyi 'grel pa ba(1gas so//bstan 'jin rgyal mtshan kyis brtsams/

ra /chos don nges tshig spobs pa'i gter/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas la bcud nas/ /gsung rab 'jig rten tshul la yang / /yi ge'i spyod bas 'jug pyir dbye/ /'dir bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos ngag sgron bshad pa la 'jug go /na mo bu ya sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs bod kyi brda krod pa'i bye brag gsung rab las 'byung ba'i yi ge'i sbyor ba gsal zhing ko bar byed pa mkhas pa'i gsung gi bstan bcos tshigs su bcad nas tshig le'ur byas pa shes bya la mkhas pa'i ngag gi rang bzhid sgron ma lha bu zhes bya ba'am sgrog pa/ yang dag pa phyin ci ma log par gsung ba po gnyid sad pa ltar ma rig pa sangs shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma bye ba ltar shes bya ma lus par mkhyen pa'i ye shes khyab nas rgyas pa la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthong na skyes du dam par mchod pa mtshad bzang so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gzi byin gsal ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra ba'i sku dang /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong rtsol rtog med par 'doms pa chos kyi sdom bzhi sgrog byed lha'i rnga chen po lha bu'i gsung dang / ji lta ji snyed kyi ye shes rgya mtsho lha bu gnying dang mtha' med pa ldan pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ thub pa yin la chen po yang yin pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa ni tshangs pa la sogs pa'i yang phyag gi bya ba 'jug pa'i gnas yin no/ /dus gsu gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa kun gyi mkhyen pa dang thugs brtse ba chen po gcig tu spungs pa'i phung po cig car dus mnyam du/ skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa mtha' yas pa'i yid kyi nam mkhar 'gog pa'am sgrib pa med par gsal ba'i gzugs can sgyu ma lha bu/ 'jig rten gyi phan pa dang bde ba'i 'od dkar po kun tu smo ba legs par bshad ba'i bsil zer mnga' ba can/ 'jam dbyangs 'gro ba'i mgon po ma ba'i zla ba 266

mchog tu gyur pa der gus pas 'dud do/ /ye shes kyi bdag nyid sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul lha bu mdzes shing sdug pa'i sku la brten pa'i rnam 'gyur yid 'jo zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang / rna ba'i yul gyi sgra dang dbyangs dpag tu med pa rgya mtsho lha bu'i 'byung gnas rgyud mang bkun pa las byung ba'i sna snyan cing 'gyur bag dang ldan khyad par gyis/gdul bya'i snying la zag pa nyon mongs pa med pa'i bde ba ster ba mo lhag pa'i lhar gyur ba/ dbyangs las byung ba can ma lha'i bu mos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo yi mchog dam pa sbyin par mdzod cig srong btsan sgam po'i sngon du med pa bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs brtsams pa'i ngo mtshar du snang ba brda krod dam brgyad mdzad pa gsung rab bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i/ legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer brgya phrag gis rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs bod du grags pa chos med mun pa'i gling lha bu 'dir/shākya thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa po ba ṭa ste bod bzang po la sogs pa/ rgya dang bod kyi mkhas pa rnams la bka' drin dran nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal khang pa bdag ni skyes thob kyi blo gros mi rdo bar rtul zhing rig pa la spyangs pa'i mthu chung bas rtsom pa'i rgyu dman pa lhar snang yang / tshad ma dang ldan pa khungs ldan gyi mkhas pa thu mi la sogs pa'i legs bshad yi ge'i spyor ba la brten nas/ ngag gi 'khrul pa'i nun pa chen po drung rtsad nas 'byid pa go brda sprod byed kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma rab tu gsal bar byed pa brtsam par bya'o/ /'dir brjod par bya ba'i don sdom du byed na kā li ka phreng sum cu tham pa la/ rkyang pa 'phul dang mgo gsum med pa dang 'phul byed ga da ba ma 'a lnga gang rung can dang mgo la ra la sa gsum yod pa can dang / dbyangs nga ro'i rnam pa sa mi nub ma lnga can dang ya ra la ba bzhi'i snad 'dogs can dang / rjes su 266

'jug pa ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa bcu yang 'jug bcas ji ltar 'thob pa'i dpe —dang sogs pa phrad rnam dbye'i sbyor ba dang 'khrul ba smong tshul te rim pas bstan — par bya'o//rje'i shes bya'i rnam pa kun mkhyen pa thams cad mkhyen pa shākya shing shā kar gnas pa'am dzad pa nus ldan te ston pa'i rigs yin la mang bkun gyi sgyud kaza las sa 'phrin las pa/ ka ra mngar ba'i khyad par ka tan ras dkar zhig ka shi ka gsal ldan te yul dang de'i ras/ nags klung shing nags mthug po chu klung gtsang po dang rgyug chu dba' klong chu rlabs sa klong 'khor klu dud 'tsho bye brag ka gdod ma nas dag pa stong nyid klong yangs khong yangs pa'am rgya che ba klong du gyur par don rtogs pa dang dbang du gyur pa/ ka ku bha ya phyogs khyab ste shing zhig ka dasba tshogs can te chu skyar dang shing zhig ka sha gsal byed de sgyu zhig dang de ga pa ku sha sar nyal te sgyu mchog ka ma la chu'i rgyan te pad+ma/ kun kum zhig gi me tog dkar po ku nud sa mos sam sa dga' ste za bas kha zu ba'i me tog dkar po ki dru ka ke shu ka rgya skyegs shing yin ne rtso'am ci zhes pa'i don/ ka ra blo ra lag pa'am sor bzhad de re lcag dang zu ngan gyi me tog dmar po ke ta ka shing dang nor bu ste gnyis kas chu stog dngas nus/rlung snan shing kun dang ma krong sngo snan dar ya kan zhang nung gi skad de bdud rtsi'am sman yin so so'i gas snan dang grangs brtsi rgyu'ang yod/ ka ped ba lha pho ku ba bka mo sdong ring gzar bu sogs byed btub kem pa dug shing de'i 'bras bu mngar la zos na 'chi ba/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri tsher ma can stan stag tsher gsab kyi ma sngo stan 'khor lo rtseg pa 'dra ba yod/ na rī ke la mi mo rtsen te be ta'i 'bras du ka ko la po rog dang sman zla ba'i bye ma dang dug rigs dgu'i bye brag ke la sha gangs ri dang ka lid ka liṅka yul 267

gyi mtshan/ ko ba mdzod ldan nam tsā ku sha dang maka 'dus pa can te grong khyer zhig dang ko sa la yul dge ba can/ yul ka ma ta ste 'di bzhi rgya gar gyi yul ming dang ko'u shi ka rgya skad la ko shi ka yod pa sna zur phyin pa'i ched sna ru gcig gi dod 'u spyan ba sngags kyi klog thabs dang bod skad nyid la'ang mi chung la mi'u thung dang 'dab zags chung ba la byi'u sogs chung ba'i dod lha bu la 'jug pa yod pas khyad par shes par bya ste don/ dbang chen gu gul 'ug pa dang / /sprul 'dzin rnams la ka shi ka /zhes sogs la 'jug / ka tsā ya na ka ti'i bu ste 'phags pa ko ṇ+ḍi cu thab ldan ma'i bu ste lnga sde'i ya gyal/ ke'u tshang zag phug gi ming du go glang la sogs pa'i ko ba pags pa dang lham gyi krad pa rdog pa dang / yungs kar 'bru'i khyad par ka ru kha dog dkar po thod le kor ha shig ste ri mo dod pa'i rdo dkar/ ku shu shing tog gi khyad par gur kum ku dum kha che sha skam lha bu ka ca spyad dngos rgyu nor kun thams cad/ bsags mod kyang rgyan sdud kyi sgra 'thab krol 'thab mo phung krol phung byed rlag byed kyi rgyu/ kye ma num pa zu ngan snying rje'i brda kyi hud skya ngan gyi brda kye ho rab bam ngo mtshar bod pa'i brda kwa dang ka ye bod tshig /kye kye bod tshig lan gnyis smos pa kyong kyong dang kong kong gnyis gshong gshong du go sgra dang mi sogs krog krog mig sogs krab krab 'khrab tshul mgo kyog kyog kyog po 'khyog po/ krong krong tshog tsog kog gis myur bas ker ke re langs nas/ ku re rtsed mos do ker thor tshugs ko sko ma mchu'i 'og gi cha 'degs pa/ ku co skad che ba kyal ka rtsed mo klan ka rtsod pa'i rgyu/ 'on kyang yin na yang lan kan pu shu mda' yab chu skyor nyen kor nye 'khor du go /ka lan ta ka bya mchil ba co ka byi'u zhig dang / bya ka la bad la sogs pa'i kyur kyur ni skad 'byin tshul/ ke 'u sgog pa kun dong btsong kag lo'i bar chad ki kang sa bdag gi khyad par/268

sku stod thad kyi 'od kor dang yi ge'i steng rgad kyi jig kor ram rjes su nga ro klad gong ngam steng ngam thog mi'i don dang / ke sha 'greng budang rna ru nyis rtseg zhabs kyu sru yig lcags kyu mchi pa'am kyo bas btab pa / kar kar ni zug langs tshul bad kan nyes pa gsum gyi gcig ste jig po lha bu chu'i/ ku ya dzin 'dra ba sogs mthugs las tsha grang gi nad 'a kun gung mdzub kyi 'og tu rtsa kyal kyang 'phar tshul/ rus krang sha med rus rkyang krang nge krong nge do rje skyil krung 'dug tshul zhig bcas pa bzos pa/ 'byams klas dang mtha' klas gnyis bas gyis mi khyab mthas klas pa mthas gtugs pa yang yin klog 'don byed kyang yi ge klag pa klog pa'i ming tsam/ ston ka zla ba gsum dpyid ka zla gsum nyin mtshan gnyis ka gnyi ga'i dus/glang chen gnyis 'thung lag ldan thal kar mdog skya bo dkar shas che ba ber ka dbyug pas brdungs pa/ tshogs dang mdongs sgro gser ska dang / /rgyan dang dong bar ka lā pa sgra dang ba la'i pho zang yang yin pa yis kla klo ta zig sogs bcom pa/ ka ba gdung 'degs ka tsa li rdo lha'i gos kyis klubs g.yogs pa dang skul tshig kar+ṣa pa ṇa kar+ṣa pa ṇa zho yi dong rtse ke ke ru nor bu ser po/ dur bya kang ka ste rgyab dkar 'di ko 'di di'am 'di tsho klag cor ku co che ba/ keng rus sha med rus pa cha tshang ka pa li ka pā la ste bde skyong thod pa'i dang gi klad pa kha la za/ kun nas thams cad nas kun tu thams cad du'am yang dag par pags pa kab kob gyong po mkhyegs pa/ ku hu khu byug dpyid kyi pho nya'i mgrin pa la sogs pa kong bo pra ka ra ṇa ma thos ka med de ka shes na ka lha bu ka rkyang pa 'thob par snang ngo / /dkar chag tho yig 'chems byang gong 'og ma dkrugs pa ma 'khrugs pa dkor nor gyi spyi ming mdzod sgo zu da dkrogs pa mchod sbyin byed pa'am 'ju~X ༵/

lha'i dkyil snying po 'khor len pa zla dkyil sogs kyang dkyil dbus thad du lha dkrong skad cig gis bskyed pa dka' ba khag po dka' las/ chos sogs la dka' las thub pa dka' ba spyad pa dkon cog dkon mchog dkon pa dkon mo/ mdog kha dog dkar po dkyel che pa khong yangs pa spyan mig dkyus srid du ring ba/ dkyus ma phal ba'am rang bzhin pa'i ming dkor ni dad zas dang dor spyi dri ma dku dri nga ba mchi ma dku mami ma 'dzag pa/ dkos thag nyam thag pa kun nas dkris pa nyon mongs pa gos kyis lus dkris pa dkri ba/ dku gsus pa'i skabs mtshams te sta zur dku grod pa skum po ril ril dku dku ma rnyongs rked pa ring thung 'tsham pa/ /mkha' la smin dang rdul dkrigs pa 'khrigs pa zho dkrogs pa srub pa rol mo sil snyan lha bu dkrol ba 'khrol ba/ dkar po'i yol go ste btung snod dang gas chag dkrum pa bcag pa dkyu ba'i sar rta dkyus pa ste rgyug sar rgyug pa/ go dka' ba'i don 'grel pa 'grol ba dkrigs phrag grangs gnas shig dkan gyen gzar po/ phan tshun phra mas dkrugs pa mi mthun par byed pa dang dkyus mo dkre sogs sngon 'jug das 'phul ba'i ka'o/ /bkra shis dge legs bkrag ni mdangs yin tshon ji bkra ba khra bo ngo mtshar mdzes pa bas mi khyab bkram pa 'grems pa/ bka' gsung sogs bsgos pa gnang ba khral dpya bkal ba khal khur bkal ba srad bu skud pa ba mkha ba 'gel ba'am 'kha ba/ pho nya bang mi bkye ba ston mo zas sogs bkye ba 'od bkye ba sprul pa bkye ba gtong ba'am spro ba/ /dgongs pa bas pa'i don bkral ba 'grel pa dang dpya khral bkral ba so sor bgos pa'am zu ba dgongs pa bkrol ba dgrol ba bcings pa mdud pa sogs bkrol ba bshig pa/ dri ma chus bkru ba dang bkrus pa gnyis 'khrud pa bkren ser sna 2ma

dang dbul ba la 'jug cing pho ba bkres pa ltogs pa/ logs su bkar ba bton pa'am bko bdas thag pas bkyigs pa 'jig pa bcings te tshe srog bkums pa 'gums pa gsod pa bkrongs pa bsad pa'i zhe sa/ bkang sa g.yos khang gral zas za ba'i khang par go snod spyad bkang bdagang ba thugs dgongs dam pa bkang ba dgyes par byas pa/ bsnyen bkur zhabs tog bkur ste rim gro'am mchod pas gral gong du'am gtsug tu bkur ba 'khur ba rtsi ba/ khang pa sogs kyi bzo bkod dang bka' bkod legs pa bde ba'i sar bkod pa bzhag pa zur du bkol ba bton pa dang / shing sogs bkug pa 'gugs pa bkas pa dgas pa dum khur gses shing g.yog tu las su bkol ba spyod pa 'kho ba/ gnang ba bya rung ba bkag pa bya mi rung ba ste 'dul ba'i brda sman gyi khu ba bku ba 'jin pa bkus pa byung ba'am bton te bor ba dor ba sman snyegs kyang da gos dang thog sogs ba mkha pa g.yogs pa gzhu la mda' spyar nas bkang ba 'chen pa dang shing gi rtsa ba dang shog bu sogs bkog pa dgog pa bton pa/ bka' drin phan btags pa bka' btags pa khrims bkugs pa bka' la blo sems bde ba ste chos ston gyi tshig la dga' ba/ bka' bkyon dang brgyad bkag gnyis spyo ba khod du bkon pa 'khod pa 'dzin pa/ 'gro lam sogs bkag pa 'gegs pa spa bkong pha rol bo num par byas pa rgyal po sogs kyis bkrabs pa mang po'i dkyil nas gdams pa/ lus gan rkyal du bkan pa bstan pa lag pa bkan pa lag mjil gyen du bstan pa sogs bkros pa 'dams pa'am gdams pa nas bkri ba 'khrid pa/ mdo rdo bklags pa klog pa dang yi ge'i mgo bkad dam skra lhas ma yin snyam mgo 'dzugs zhes kyang snang dpyad zags kyi bkad sgyur ba dang 'ur rdo lhas pa'i bkad lta bu/ bkyal ba'i ngag ngag 'tsho dang bkyed pa 261
