bgrum pa sogs bas 'phul ka'o/ /mi sogs kyi rkang pa dang lag pa rka yur ba ldan pa'i zhing ngam rkang bzhi yod pa lhar na dud 'gro rkan dkan yang rung ste ya ken dang rkub tshos te 'phongs/ chom rkun rku mkhan dang zangs sogs kyi rkyan snod dang zu rkyal rtsam rkyal sman rkyal sogs rku ba ma byin par len pa/ rkong pa pags nad chig rkyang gcig rkyang pa sa dang par sogs rko pa dang rkos skul tshig gan rkyal gan kyang yang rung ste kha spub min pa rked pa nu ma dang dpyi gnyis kyi bar lha bu dang lag sogs rkyong ba brkyang ba rkon pa rnyi 'dzugs pa/ rka yur ba'am chu lam gyi mgo'i chu la rkyal rtsed pa rgyab pa ri dwags kyi bye brag rkyang drel 'dra ba/ nyer len gyi rgyu dang lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen dang rang rkya thub pa rkom la sogs pa rar btags pa'i ka'o/ /lkog phag tu gyur pa mngon gur min pa lkog ma sog ma lkog shal ske nas sha leb 'phyang ba dang / ngag skugs pa kha skugs pa la sogs pa lar btags pa'i ka'od//ska ba dpal brtsegs dang cog ro spu'i rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis skal ba dang ldan pa las 'phro can dang nam mkha'i skar ma spyi ming skag skar ma'i khyad par dang rgya tshos/ chos sogs kyi sku lus sam phung po skem pa skad pa snum rtsi lus la skud pa 'byug pa dang bal gyi skud pa srad bu skyob skyel ba'i skul tshig dang sgrim pa/ skyo ma lde gu mig skyag phra ma'i dod skyag pa phyi sa dang bya sgyung ka lhang kas sgyud pa mi dran par rjed pa/ska rags rted chings skyer kha ser po skya bo dkar shas che ba sogs sgyu ru ra snan/ 1skyes bu gang zag dang zhal sogs skyem rjem bkung ba nyid kyi don la 'jug skom rlan kun dang ro bro sgyur mo dang me la chu skol ba/ gos skon rgyan du bcug pa g.yog pa skyed 262

yang ldang ba yang ba'am rtsal che ba dang chu la sgyur ba 'phen pa 'dor bas sems skyo ba nges 'byung yid 'byung / skom byed skem pa po dang gdon zhig skul byed dge sogs la skul pa po skor ba byed pa gnas skor mtha' skor mgo skor sogs/ sgyu rum zas kyi ro gsal byed tshod ma sgyu mtshon nam zan gang dang kha nas mi gtsang ba'i zas sgyugs pas kha skyengs pa ngo tsha ba/ kun nad kyi khyad par dang skyigs bu g.yig pa'i ming tsam mam de'i nad dang bad kan skya rbab nad dang skrangs pa sbos pa/ ri skyegs ri skegs kyang rung ste bya dang glang chen chu skyar mjing ril skya ga mdog nag cing glo dkar po can gyi bya'i ming skad sgra/ skun bu kong bu dang slo ma skam pa 'dzin spyad dang gru'i skya ba lung rigs kyi skya bar nas bton zhes pa lta bu sogs dang snod skyogs nu skyogs sogs/dge skos sa yang da dge bar sko ba pos bro spob pa 'khrab pa ḍa ma ru skyog pa rdung ba/skud po chung ma'i ming po dang sring mo'i bdag po skyo sngogs 'khrug long rtsod pa zhi zin pa slar slong ba snyan skyo skyo ma phra mas sam yang na skyos pa nyams pa skrag pa 'jigs pa bred pa/ rgya skyegs rgya tshos skag skyed mos tshal kum shing ra ba skyer ba zhes pa'i shing zhig skas tha zem skas/ lus kyi ske mgul ba dang dag skor chog ma chu te/gas kha la sgyugs pa'i sngon du byung ba'i chu sgyur dang shing dang bu sogs skyes pa skyeb/ skyi g.ya'i don skrag pa skyon nyes pa mtshang dang ngan song las skyob pa srung ba dang rten nam skyabs su 'gro ba re ltos 'ab ba dang tshig yang yang skyor ba ldab pa/ mas bu 'tsho zheng skyong ba bskyang ba re ba skong ba bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa skyin gor da byid de stobs skyed sman gangs sbal sogs dang mar gyi skogs pa 'thums byed dam shun pa/ srab skyogs rta srab bam srab kyis skyogs shing sgyur ba skyes rten nam rigs bzang po rgyal gyi don la 'jug pa'i skugs rgyal 'gugs byed/ /bya skyibs bar mi 'bab pa'i brag skyibs 263

sogs skar ma mthong ba'i thog khung rab gas yang skor tsher skabs rer bde zhing skyid pa spro ba skyid po/ skyel ma skyel mkhan skyes bu chen po snyes mchog skyos ma rten nam skyes skyod pa gegs sogs mthar skyod btang ba snyil ba/ chu sogs skyob pa g.yo bar byed pa zho skyog pa srub pa rtsis kyi skyeg bar chad / ji skad ji lha ba lung 'dren pa'i tshig 'di skad 'di ltar dang yin skad zer skad sogs kha skong pa kha tshang bar byed pa tsho skabs go skabs skabs snyed gnas skabs sogs/ sa gzhi skyong ba sa skyong pa rgyal po skyang nul zhal ba skam pa rlon pa min pa re skan mna' skyel ba/ /yun thung ba'i ska cig ma skad cig ma mgo'i yumagor nyal skyes pa mib shing sogs spus pa kong kong 'dra ba'am gcod pa/ sbas pa'i don can gyi skungs shig dbus kyi mtha' nas skor ba khor yug skobs su chud pa gnas sa bar du tshud pa ste bya dka'i skabs su chud bya dka'i gnas su tshud lha bu/ rang gi skal ba bgo skal sogs dang shes pa skye zhing mched par byed pa ste mig sogs bcu gnyis thugs dam skong ba dgongs pa rdzogs par byed pa'am mnyes par byed pa/ bya 'dzin byed skon pa rnyi skyi ko ba'i phyi dkar po ko ba mnyes ma skye che'i don ni 'bru zhig skyo ma snga btsan phra ma bcug pa skyil krung 'dug stangs kyi khyad par skyod pa g.yo ba 'gro ba/ skya rengs skya mda' zhal skyin zhal ras dang skyes pa rtsig skyabs rtsig skyon sku pa mib mi bo skyas 'degs pa sgog skya re skon sogs sar btags ka'o//'dod pa'i yon tan la brkam pa brkams pa chags pas brku bya brku ba ma byin par blang bya gser sogs brkus pa ma byin par blangs pa ste brku rku brkus rkus lha bu byed 'brel bdag gzhan dus gsum dang ma 'brel ba'i dus gsum skul tshig dang bcas pa'ang rtags 'jug las shes dgos tshul 'di gong 'og gi bya tshig gzugs 'gyur 2tsho

mi 'gur ba sa cad bsgyur bar can /'dul ba'i gzhi bcu bdun las bag nga sa dang nga ba bas brkyang gi gzhi ste gtan pa yang zer lag pa brkyang ba spyong ba brko bya par dang sa sogs brkos pa rko ba/ brkyangs pa bkems pa sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i 'kho//byug pa sgrub sogs bsku bdang bskus pa kun pa 'jig pa lag pa sogs bskum pa dang bskums pa tshur nga pa sdud pa/'dzin cha bkun ba 'gan khag bskur ba dbang mnga' bskur ba kun ba cad pa chos sogs la bskul ba da ba zud du bcug pa/ nor gang sogs ba dang bskyis pa mib gang ba dang bskyon pa skyin tshab bang ba skyed ba 'phen pa/ gos la sogs pa bskon pa kun pa g.yogs pa rta dang thab la sogs par bskyon pa skyon pa 'jog pa'am la ga pa'am rgyab pa bskyar ba nga ba ldab pa bzlas nas mi bzad pa skod pa 'don pa/ gcom bsgyungs nga rgyal bcag pa'am spo chung ngur byas pa sgyung ba 'dor ba zas bskru ba ba ba bskyed pa rma pa ba ba'i don la nga ga cing dge rtsa dang par sogs bskrun pa ma pa mi pa gsog pa bzhengs pa bzo ba/ du kyi bskal pa bar bam sogs kyi mes mtsho dang shing sogs bskams pa skem pa chu sogs kyi snab btang bar bskyil ba mi ba 'kho ba bskyams pa skyo pa g.yo bar byed pa/ yul dus rang bzhin gyis bskal pa skog sgyur ram bar cad pa'i don dang bskungs pa skung ba sbas shing 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa skyong pa bskyangs pa skyod ba 'tsho ba/ gnas gzhan du 'pho zhing bskyas pa bskya ba spo ba rgyang ring du bsgyur ba sgyur ba 'dor ba bya ba bsgyungs pa sgyung ba bshol ba/ mi dgag tshig bskyod pa skyod pa g.yo ba bskos ba mtha' nas skor ba dang tshig skor ba rgyal po'i sar bskor pa bsko ba bzhag pa byed du bcug pa/ /zas kyi ro bska ༵༵ ru

ra'i ro lha khu dang bska ma'i bska ba ste gar ma kha bskang ba skong ba tshang bar gyed pa thugs dgongs dam pa bskangs pa skong ba rdzogs par byas pa/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa lta bu'i sems bskyed pa skyed pa rgya khyod bskyed pa cher btang ba dang dran pa med par brjed pa'i don can gyi bsgyud pa sgyud pa dang / bskyang ba bskyang ba sogs bas 'phul ba'i sa mgo ldan pa'i ka 'thob pa'o /dag go khrab go cha khri phrag stong phrag bcu khrag khrig grangs gdas shig gi ming khur ni 'khur ba ste 'das pa dang skul tshig yin/ khong nas khro ba zhe sdang khon du 'dzin pa gnod sems 'chang ba khro bo khro ba po khros pa khro ba'i 'das skul/ khro dang khrol ma'am tshags ma 'tshag byed khrud pa 'khrud pa'i ming khu bas khrus 'khru ba'i ming dang skul tshig dang 'das pa/ khong pa tsho dang khong du chud pa da khong nas sam zhe nas khro ba sdang ba khon du 'dzin pa mi mthun par 'dzin pa gnod sems mi gtong ba khro bo zhi ba min pa'i khro ba po khros shig pa'am 'das pa/ khong ba'i zungs khrag sogs khrag khrug khrag nad dam 'khrugs pa khrung khrung bya'i bye brag khyu rigs mthun pa'i tshogs/ nyes spyod sdom pa sogs kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i khrims bsi ba 'thob pa khris 'jags chings byas pa lhar gnas pa khrims lugs kyi ming khral dpya sogs/ 'jal byed khru gang sor nyer bzhi'i tshad sogs khrun dkyus ring po khram kha ri mo'i khyad par khra bo kha dog sna tshogs pa/ khrom tshogs pa khrod gseb bam dkyil gnad khri'i steng gtsug lag khang sogs mi khrim sgo dang 'khor gyi khyams/ phug ron sogs gsod byed bya'i khyad par khra dang khyi yis khyer zin dang khyer cig bsnyem pa gang la khyor ba do'i tshad byed pa lha bu khre 'bru'i bye brag kho ra khor yug mtha' skor khron pa'i chu khrems jim pa dang 'grems pa'i skul tshig sil khrol lcags kyi rol mo 'dod gzugs gzugs med kyi 266

khams rnam pa gsum po khram pa ham pas zhe khrel ba ga na la 'dzem pa/ dur khrod ro bzhi can skye sa lam gyi sna khrid pa nga mkhan khrums stod dang khrums snad gnyis rgyu skad zhig khong khro ba'i gnyer ma khu ta 'dab gas shig dang khams khong rnam pa bad khyod kun pa khong du chud kha khris ma khegs kha sogs kha rkyang ngo //rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang las kyi mkhan pos sa las byas pa'i mkhar rdzong mkhrang ba gyong bo grims pa mkhregs pa sra ba mkhyen pa shes pa/ mche pa'am snas nas spyad pa gsang ba'i man ngag dpe za mkhyed pa ser snas chos kyi gdad mi ston pa zhu mkhan 'dri mkhan nam tshos ga na nye bar mkho ba dgos pa/ ma mkha ma mgal mkhal ma nang khrol zhig bzhin gyi mkhur tshos 'dzum pa da dul ba shes bya la mkhas pa dran dbang / sngo mkhan pa'i khrod mkhos phab pa bde bar ga sa pa snga mkho jir bzhin sngar lhar nam mkha' rgyu skad gyi lam dang mnyam pa mkhris pa'i nad med par mkhyen pa shes pa/chu mkhris rta gdong mi me lag pa'i mkhrig ma dang mkhur ba spo ba sogs mas 'phul ba'i kha'o//blo 'khums pa nga sa num pa zhe nas 'khon pa bkon pa 'dzin pa 'khang ba sdang ba'i don kun zhing 'khu ba sdang ba dang ser sna/ 'gas pa da ga pa'am grang nas yul mtha' 'khob chos med pa'i gdas 'dzi ba 'tshos pa'am zhig pa'am 'chi zhing 'tshos pa 'phyan pa/rgas pa la go ba'i 'khogs pa lon song ba 'khos ka chung ba nus pa chung ba rkang pa 'khum rang bzhin gyis da pa 'du ba 'jig pa drang bo min pa/ gom pa 'khyor ba mi brtan pa 'khro pa g.yo ba 'khar ba lag rten dang chu btung so dang da kyi mjil du zas tshig pa lha bu go bar byed cing yab nga 'khril ba sbyor ba shing la 'khris pa spyor ba dang chags zin pa lus la 'a pa spyod ba/ ༵snyig

pa 'dod pa'i dga' ston gyi tshig smin 'khrig sogs ngag gam gtam 'tsho ba ba pa ba 'chal ba 'thab pa dang 'jig pa don bka cing gong 'og sa ga pa sogs kyang go 'jil ba nor ba g.yo ba/ shing sogs la ba'am chags zhen 'a ba bgru ba dang bshal ba chus 'jid pa gzhan la 'khri zhing spyor bar byed pa'i shing 'jings pa skyes pa/ nyi gdugs sogs 'khyir ba 'khor ba zhabs bro 'khrab pa rdung ba'am sku pa 'khar ba'i rnga 'grol ba dkrol ba/ sems chu ltar 'kho ba dal du mi gnas pa sems sogs 'jigs pa 'dzings pa 'a po mgyogs po dang mig sngar 'bab pa khri mthun par go 'jis pa 'a sa pa rgyug pa/ khur bo 'khur ba bkur ba dpya khral 'a ba phog pa nyi 'od 'khos pa 'od skor ba chu sogs 'khyil ba mi ba/'khor ba rang nyid skor mkhan med par 'khor ba ste srid pa sogs mang po la la ga par mthong zhing 'khren pa chags shing zhen pa 'khras pa chags shing 'khar ba zhen pa 'di gsu don 'dra/ thag pas ma 'khrig pa ma 'ching ba dang da tshig ma 'khyer ba ma 'khur ba sgrum du btsos pa'i 'khur ba bzhes spro 'khur ba 'khyer ba/ las sne sogs ma 'tsho ba ma bsgyur ba'am ma brjes pa bred pa'i 'khrims pa 'jigs pa 'khams pa brgyal bar go dkos shing nad sogs kyis ngag 'ban pa'am 'khun bu'i sgra thon pa/ gser sogs kyi 'khor lo 'khod pa bkod pa'am gnas kyang gtso bo g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa 'khobs pa khyab pa rgya che ba/ g.yog tu 'khul ba ma bskul bar g.yog las byed pa g.yog tu 'khol ba bkol bsad bu kun pa 'khal ba bkal ba/ 'ab ba chags pa'i sar ma yu ba ma bskya ba'am ma son pa 'khrid pa bkri bar 'jug 'khums pa go ba'am shes pa thos pa/ rus kyi bye zag sa skya'i gdung la 'khon ces pa'am mi mthun pa~X ma ga sa ba pa la gong du 'khur 'kho sa sogs 'as 'phul kha'o//

snyed grub pa'i mtha' dpyad pa'i mtha' ste chos lugs grub pa thob pa mthong la sogs la reg pa grangs ka med pa grangs gnas shig dang grangs su thebs mi nus pa grol ba thar ba mdud pa zhig pa yal ba/ ral gri mtshon ba'i kun par gro ga shing stag pa'i shun pas shog bu dang bab sogs rang bzhin gyis gril ba zhes grag lo grag zer gsum gyi grag grul bum gdon zhig grang ba'i nad bad kan sogs grum bu nad cig gis grongs shi bdang skul tshig mon gru dang dam gru dang gre dang gro bzhin 'di bzhi rgyu skar gyi bye brag chos kyi grwa chos ra bla'i grwa bzo grwa chos gos kyi grwa grwa pa'i gral rim du rim gro bkur ste dang zhabs brtad nam sku rim la sogs pa'i ming grabs sta gon/ yul gru yul khyod nam yul grubar bzhi gru gzings kyi kha na yod pa'i grong khang pa'am khang pa'i tshogs/ gra ma shing zhig spu gcod pa'i gri spu gri ltar yang 'dug gru 'dzin pa'i ri ste po ta la'i ri/ mon lug gla sgang sngo man zhig gro 'bru'i bye brag sbang ma'i grum grum sbang / snye ma'i gra ma dang sogs ma'i phub ma rgya gro ma sogs mon sun gre'u khri'u/ grod pa gsus pa gron 'gro can thugs gron snag shog gron du zad lha du 'gro song ngam chud zos grung bo snang po dang sa bon grung po'i don yin zhing sku dang rig pa sogs grims pa mi lhod pa'i don skul tshig rkyang yin/ gram pa zhes pa'i don chu sgyug shul gyi sa chu grog chu grang la bye btab pa'i snan gre ba mgur ram mid pa'i don grogs po rogs sa zla bo/ shing gi grib ma la sogs par bya ba legs nyes kyi gros byed pa gleng ba bshad pa re ba gron du med pa re ba chud mi za ba/ ri dwags gla ba'i ste bar yod pa'i rtsi snan gla las byas pa'i rngan pa grud tshab lhar glen pa blang dor mi shes pa/ dzasgyu zur ga pa'i 'dzam bu'i shing yod pa'i gling chu'i bar du chud pa'i gle bar glegs ma'i bam po ste po te gling bu rgya gling la sogs pa'i ming gru rdo rje'i gru 269

sogs/ nad pho ba glang thabs dang pags nad glang shu bas bldag glog pa zhes pa'i nad/ glo ba nang khrol zhig dang glo ba dga' zhes pa yid dga' ba'i don glo lud pa dgog pa bkog pa dbyibs lebs mor glebs leb leb byed pa mnan pa/ glang po chen po lag ldan glo yis phab pa gzhogs phab pa bde bar gnas pa kha glod pa lhod po byed pa bkrol ba'am btang nas seng ge glal ba seng ge rnam da dang kha g.yal ba/rtsig pa'i glo logs 'bur ba glo bur nges med dam 'phral du rung ba glo deg mgyogs pa glo bur nam mkha' glog rnam ga / glags mabs rnyed pa thob pa bzang ngan gyi lan glan pa 'jal ba gos kyi lhan pa glan pa dgab pa/ khang pa'i sgo glegs sgo 'phar chos gos kyi glegs du tshal bu dang pod chung dang khring yig la sogs pa'i don grwa zur dang sde sogs/ gla gor zho sha shing snan zhig gtan gyi mdun ma sogs gleng ba gros byed pa bshad pa/ bya'i khyad par glag ces pa lu gu sogs gsod mkhan grog ma srog chags mig med grib mi gtsang ba grib gnon gdon zhig grog po ri'i sul la sogs par ka lag pa'i gru mo dkar yol chag cing grum pa dgrum pa grubs zhes snang yang dpyad don grub yin nas med/ /thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub grub pa gru char char ba 'bebs par 'jig rten na grags pa/ ri dwags sha ba'i khrag rwa sogs la 'jug pa'i ga dor dang gru gu tha gru bya gag gya nom gyi na gang bu sogs ga rkyang ngo //sna gcig spyod pa sogs kyi dge bsnyen pha ma speng bya bcu spong ba'i dge tshul pha ma sems dga' ba thugs dgyes pa mnyes pa dgod pa gad mo shor ba/ dgung gnam sngon po dgu tshigs gdam gyi ska rags lus rgyab tu phyir dgye ba'i don yin zhing mdun du dgu ba gug pa/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i dgung dkyil lam zud dge ba ༵shes gnyen dge grogs yod dgu yod do cog gam yod tshad dgug pa bkug pa/

dge sbyong sangs rgyas lta bu dge slong pa ma jing bya thams cad spangs pa dge 'dun dge slong bzhi las mi nyung ba'i tshogs grangs dgu yis/ /nyon mongs sogs gnod byed kyi dgra bo bcom pa dang dgongs pa bzhed pa'am bas pa dgrol ba bkrol ba'am bkral ba yi ger dgod pa bkod pa/ mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa sun 'byin pa 'thad pa'i cha spub pa snad dgang ba bkang ba dgon pa dben par go dgar ba bkar ba/ri dwags dgo ba yis pha ba dgo dgo me med du ba ste khrag gcod kyi snan dgas pa bkas pa/ khal dgal ba bkal ba gos kyi lhan pa dgab pa bkab pa dang dgog pa bkog pa/ skye dgu ka bos dge ba legs pa'i don bde ba 'byid byed kyi dge sgrub pa dgos pa nyer mkho yod med sogs/ dgongs mo ji dro sogs zong btsong bya'i dngos po snar min dgram pa bkram pa me tog zang ga sogs dgram pa bkram pa/ dgun dung can chu med pa'i gnas nyid du dus dgun ka sdod/ dgung gnam lo dang dgam pa dgrung ba la sogs das 'phul ga'o//bka' bgro ba gros bya ba bgro bya'i gtam gleng ba 'chad pa bgyi ba bya ba bgyid pa byed pa bgyis pa byas pa gyis shig sgyus shig go cha lus la bgos pa gyon pa bgegs bar zad gegs kyis bgrod pa 'gro ba'i mas bgags pa bkag pa/ dus chod bgyangs pa phyis pa tshod bgam pa nyams chod len pa bgo bar bya ba'i rgas bgos pa gyon zin pa/ sku bgres po bgres pa rgan pas mig gnyis bgrad pa bsgrad pa gdangs pa bgrang bya brtsi bya'i phreng ba bgrangs pa brtsis pa/ bgrus pa shun pa'am spun pa phud pa'i ming 'bras sna lu bgos pa bgo bshar bas pa gad mo ga zha bgad pa dgod pa/ rkang pa'i gom pa bgoms pa 'gom pa gom pa spos pa dang steng nas bgoms shing chu rnyog ma bgrungs pa dngas par byas pa/ bgo bya'i skal ba rang skal 271

bgrod pa bgor ba la sogs bas 'phul ga'o//lus sogs kyi mgo bo yan lag mchog gzu bo mgur ba mgrin pa dang gsung mgur mgul ba sko mgrin pa gre ba mgar ba lcags brngo dang blon po mgar lta bu rus ming mgon po skyob byed sems mgu ba dga' ba/ /mgal dum shing tshig dum mgal me'i 'khor lo gtor ma sogs kyi mgron du bos pa mgron po'am gsar 'ongs kyang mgyogs pa myur ba/ ya mgal ya le ma mgal ma le sogs mas 'phul ga'o//gzhan du 'gro ba phyin pa 'greng ba langs pa rgyal khams 'grem pa 'gro ba myul ba 'grul ba 'gro ba 'grul pa yang 'gying ba skying ba 'gying bag rnam 'gyur 'gros 'gro tshul rta 'gros kyang 'gran pa bsdur ba/ zas kyis lto ba 'grangs pa gang ba 'gengs pa bkang ba 'gag pa bkag pa 'gog pa bkag pa 'gog bden nyan thos 'gog pa lha du 'gags pa bkag pa dum bur 'gas pa bkas pa'am yang na 'ga' zhig gis zhes pa'i don 'grib pa mi snang ba sgrib pa/ dus 'gyangs pa phyis pa 'gor ba yun ring thogs pa so sor 'gyes pa 'bral ba grol ba bshes gnyed dang lhan cig 'grogs pa sdeb pa sten pa dgongs pa 'grel pa bkral ba ste bstan bcos 'grol ba 'grol ba/'gyel ba snyel ba 'gril ba sgril ba 'grongs pa 'aci ba 'gum pa 'chi ba 'gal ba mi mthun pa zhe 'gras pa zhe sdang ba mi dga' ba sngar byas la 'gyod pa phyis gdung /'gol ba dben pa'i sar gdong gi 'gram pa ldan pa 'gul ba g.yo ba nor rdzas 'gye ba dang 'gyed pa bkye ba gtong ba/ 'gan khag 'khur ba 'gong po'i gdon gzhan la 'go ba'i nad cha pa sogs 'gos pa sbags pa'am 'byar ba lta bu/ gong du 'phel ba dang 'grib pa nyams pa kud pa 'gyur ba mi brtan pa dang skad 'gyur ba sogs 'byus pa rgyas pa dang sems 'gyu ba mi 'gong ba mi skug mi num zil gyis mi gnon pa 272

dang / lam gyi 'gron po 'grul pa 'ga' zhig kha cig 'gugs pa bkug pa rtsig pa'i 'grab ga 'am zang 'gram chu 'tham nye 'gram sogs kyang 'god pa bkod pa 'bri ba dang 'jog pa/ brtson cing 'grus pa 'bad pa 'go ma thog ma'i chu 'grems pa bkra pa don sogs 'grub pa grub pa/ mgo bo 'gems pa 'joms pa bkas pa gzhan la rigs 'gre ba kha sbo ba tshos kyi 'greb pa tshos nyes pa/ 'thab mo 'gyed pa 'khrug pa byed pa dang 'gel ba rigs 'gres pa 'gyu ba 'gang ba 'gums pa la sogs pa 'as 'phul ba'i ga'o//blo rgod po sna tshogs dran nus sa grung po sogs rgya zaba'i mtsho chu'i phung por go chu dang la sogs rgal ba'i phyir rgyu ba 'gro ba/ gna' gtam gcig nas gcig tu rgyud pa sngon gyi lo rgyus phreng ba'i rgyud phreng thag gam phreng ba rgyud pa yang rgyud mang po can sna snyan mdzes byed kyi rgyan sogs/ bya rgyal rgod po rgan po rgas pa dang bslab pa rgan pa rga ba na tshod yol ba sogs shi ba lha bu'i rgyad pa nyams pa/ phas kyi rgol ba pha rol gyi rgol ba gnod byed rgol phyir da sogs rtsod byed rgyang 'phen pa phyi rol pa thams cad dang chad tsho'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa mgo bo la spyob cig rdzun cig rgod ma rta mo'i ming rgyab lus kyi rgyab sogs rgyas ba rgya che ba 'phel ba bye ba sgros pa rgyas par bshad pa sogs rgyang thag ring po rgyug pa mgyogs bor 'gro ba dang rgyug che ba sogs/rgya bo gdong la rgya yod pa da nu rgod mi kun pa phyag rgya phyag da dang phyag rgya bzhir go rgyo 'khrig pa'i dngos ming / rgya tsha ba'i khyad par rgyam tsha ba'i khyad par rgyags sto phogs kyi phye'i rgyugs dpe rgyugs ja sgyugs sogag rgyu mtshan skub byed dam go byed rgyu lo rgyus gtam sgyus bying ba rig pa gas med pa rgod pa sems da gnas par 'phro ba rgyu skyed byed dang 'jog byed kyi rgyu/ bdud bzhi la4rgyal ba shad ba pa bcom ldan bla 273

ma'i rgyud rgyun chags te rgyud sde bzhi sogs rgyal po gtso bo mi bdag lha bu rgyu ba'i skar ma rgyal stod dang rgyal snad de skar ma'i bye brag shes pa sems kyi rgyud rgyud rgya yis btab pa mi 'da' ba'i rtags bkod pa nga rgyal dregs pa zas dang rigs sogs kyis rgyags pa mtho bar sems pa/ rdo rje rgya gram bsnol ba rgyan po sho sogs rgyan dang rgyal gnyis skugs/ rgun gyi 'brum pa rgun shing gi 'bras bu rgya shug shing gi khyad par nya rgya dol lam rkon par go rgyu ba 'gro ba/ lus kyi rgyus pa rtsa rgyus dang rgyus skud lta bu rgyu ma nang khrol lu gu rgyud bar ma chad pa1 ko gru rgyongs shig pa ste grur spyad dngos sogs bkang ba'am gru nyid cher btang ba'i skul tshig rgyang byed kyi shing cher gtong byed kyi shing yin la rgyang shing zhes pa ltar na rgyang bar byed pa'i don spig rgyu bye ma nyi 'od rlung gsum tshogs pa las chur snang yang don la ma grub pa chu la sogs pa'i rgyun bar ma chad pa/ rgya gar rgyan ga ji yul rgya khyod che ba lto rgyab zas gos skyid/ dgra las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma g.yul las rgyal ba rgyal kha thob pa dang rgya ma rgyang shel rgyus shig chu rgol cig rgyag pa gad rgyangs rgyab pa mi rgod rgod pa la sogs pa rar btags pa'i ga'o//la mgo can gyi lga ni ldang ba gcin snod la 'jug pa gcig pur nges so/ /sgom pa 'dris pa goms pa bsams don yang yang yid la byed pa chen po blo gros sgam po zab pa sgrin po mkhas pa dang 'gran por go spun pa sdur ba 'gran pa/lcags kyi sgrog chings lcags thag sgor mo dbyibs gor gor te phyi sgor rgya sgor lha bur go skud pa dang rig pa sogs sgrim pa mi lhod par byed pa'i don yin zhing rbab dang shog bu sogs sgril ba lta bu dril byed pa/ sgyid pa sgyur ba stom las byed pa sgyid pa lug pa don gyi le lo snye bya ba rlabs chen la zhum par byed pa dang rkang pa'i skyid khug sogs kyang snyed pu thab snyed sa la snyel ba snyol ba/ sgyu rtsal drug cu re bzhi g.yo slu ba sgyu sems gya 274

gyu'am thabs kyis rang yod sgrog pa sgyu ma mig 'phrul snang la rang bzhin med pa spung gna' gtam sogs/ sgam dang sgrom shing sogs kyi snod yin chung ba la sgam chung dang sgom bu zer sgro ba pags sdod ba lha du dang rmig pa snye mo ras sogs kyi snod snye'u snye mo chung ba/ sgyug mo chung ma'i ma'am zla bo'i mas sgo nga bya sgong ri'i sgog pa ke ru zos nas rgyags pas sgregs pa khanas gsung ba/ sdig pa mi dge ba de kho na nyid la sgrib par byed pa nyon shes kyi sgrib pa lha bu chu bo las sgrol ba rgal bar byed pa chos dang chu sogs kyi sgra rna yul sgrogs pa 'byin pa'am klog pa sgrogs shig pa yang / bya yi sgro gshog pa sogs la yod pa spu lta bu bshad pa'i sgros tshul mchu sgros kha mchu gral sogs sgrigs shig pa ste mthun par byed pa/ rgyab kyi sgal ba'i tshigs pa sgul ba ni skyod cing g.yo bar byed pa sga spug sga skya sga ser sge'u gsher snan sga rlon/ sgron mo gcer bur go khang pa'i sgo rnam thar sgo gsum rngo sgo thabs tshul sogs kyi drung du sgeg pa mdzes pa mo sgug pa ma yong bar du mi 'gro bar sdod pa phebs skug zhu lta bu/ keng pa'i gyid par gos sogs sgab pa 'gebs pa sgro gu dru bus sgrog pa 'ching ba/ dbang du sgyur ba gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi rgyal po dkar phyogs la dga' ba 'khor lo sgyur ba gling gcig gnyis sogs kyi rgyal dzadakar byed sgyur ba po/ lag pa rgyal mtshan sogs sgrong ba gyen du slong ba zas zan sgong ba ril mor byed pa bu ram dang bzhes sbo sogs sgor ba btsos pa'am bskol nas sra bar byed pa'i don yin nam snyam sgor cig pa yang / sgar gur tshogs stod sgar chos sgar dmag sgar sogs kyi nang du rta sogs la bstad sgyu'i gser dang ko ba sogs kyi sga yis sgron ma'i me snang byed sgrib pa mi mthong bar byed pa/srid sgrub skya bseng du lnga'i ya gyal brgya byin gyi bu 'a pags pa klu sgrub zab mo lha ba'i srol 'byed kyi slob dpon sgrol ba ma rje btsun ma sgrub pa sgrub byed kub thabs sogag276

mna' sgog pa mna' skye ba skyogs rdo 'phrul 'khor gyis 'phen pa'i do dang 'ur rdo me ‘gas sogs kyis sgu do lus snad 'ur do yod tshad gcog pa bcag pa/ da sgos da cha sgos su sger du rtsig pa sgron pa kha gso ba rgyan sgron zhib sgron sogs/ sku stegs stegs bu dang sgeg chos sgang pa mtho ba mdo khams snang drug rto bu gshongs sa dma' ba tsha sgo ba tsha can/ sgrob 'gying tshugs sam dregs pa'am mi chen gyi tshul byed pa dang sgrom gsob dang khog gam tshugs sgrog chen mgo sgron lta bu dang sgrog sgong sgrig sgrims thugs sgongs sgoms sgod sre bo sgro 'dogs sgros gtsang rigs sgri sgros la sogs pa sar btags ga'o//brgal ba rgol ba brtsad cing brtag pa dpyad pa brgal ba brtsad pa'i lan rtsod lan brgyad cu dang brgyad grangs ka /phreng ba grangs brgya phrag gam tham pa skud par brgyus pa brgyu bas brgyan pa spyas pa'am mtshan pa/ chu brgal ba rgal ba 'o brgyal ba dka' las sam ngal dub dran pa med par brgyal ba 'khams pa rtsongs pa/lung sogs brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'am gcig nas gcig tu 'brel ba lta bu lam gyi rgyags zu brgyags pa rgyags pa spyad pa spyo ba'i don gyi brgyad bkag ste brgyad pa dang rgyad pa'ang 'thad snyam/ le brgan dar dmar gur kun tshos gad mo brgyangs pa ngar skad bton pa smra ba'i gtam brgya ba nun spu ba zhal brgya byas zhal ba rgyas zhes zhal shob gsungs pa/ brgyugs pa chu sogs rgyug pa'i don yin par rtogs shing brgyungs pa gzhungs pa snal ba'i klad par go brgyud ma bar ma chad par tho brgyab pa rgyag pa/brgyag brgyags brgyang brgyugs brgyab sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ga'o//bu ram sogs bsgar ba sgor zhing bsgrangs pa grangs su bcug nas bsgongs pa sgong ba/ rgya chos bod du bsgyur ba sgyur ba mdog dkar po dmar por 276

bsgyur ba sgyur ba bkun gsung bsgo ba dang bsgos pa gnang ba bsnab ston byed pa/chu sogs las bsgra ba sgrol ba chos sogs bsgrags pa dag pa zhi lhag gi nying 'dzin sa gtan sogs bsgoms pa sgom pa/ mgo bsgros pa mgo mtshungs byas pa rigs bsgros pa rigs 'gres sa pa rgyal mtshan ba dad bsgrongs pa speng ba/ mna' bsgags pa sgog pa lam sogs su bskugs pa skug pa seng ge lus da pa 'gying tshugs bstan pa/ gnyis snang sogs kyi bag chags bsgo ba dang bsgos pa bzhag pa'am 'gos pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa sgrig pa/ sgron ma'i 'od sogs bsgribs pa sgrib pa blo rig sogs bsgrigs pa sgrib pas da bu skud pa bsgrigs pa sgrib pa/ sgrub pa dang bsgrub bya gnyis sgrub byed kyi yul bkun pa kun par mi nus/ bsgrin pa kun pa 'gran par mi pod pa dang bya ba la 'jug pa'i sgang bya ba'i dkyil lam byed bzhin pa/ bsnyel ba snyel zhing sgra skad bsgrags pa sgrog pa skar rtsis sogs su gnyis kyi gsum bsgyur bas drug lha bu sgyur ba/ gzhan nam pa rol gyis mi bskul ba mi g.yo ba mi skul ba mi ba'i ba nor gyis bsgang pa phyug pa'am 'gengs pa/ bsgro bsgring bskug bsgrag bzugs bsgangs la sogs bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ga'o/ /spyod snyan pa'i dngags ni snyan ngag ste dpag 'khri sogs dar tshig rgyan gyi bstan brtsos kyang zil dngar bdud rtsi'am sprung rtsi tshar du dngar ba gral du sgrig pa/ /gser rin chen dang po dang dngul rin chen gnyis pa dngom che rtsa chen rin thang che ba sogs dngos po 'dus byas sogs dngos po med pa 'dus byas su ma grub pa/ /mchog thun gyi dngos grub dngos gzhi ma gzhi'am rtsa ba mchod pa sogs dngos su bshams pa dngos ngom rgyu dngos dngos btags dngos shugs dngos ming sogs/dngangs pa sngangs pa sgrag pa dngan 'then gzhan gyi nor khyer ba phyir mi krod pa 277

'bab chu'i dngo chu ngogs sam chu kha/ gcod gyed gri yi dngo rdo so dang ro dngar dngang ba sogs das 'phul nga'o/ /mnga' ris mnga' ris skor gsum dang 'bangs mnga' zhabs mnga' 'og chab 'bangs mnga' thang dbang zang mnga' ba yod pa'am gsal ba/mnga' mdzad dang mnga' bdag dbang po'am gtso bo mngag gzhug bran g.yog gam pho nya 'phrin mngags pa btang ba sogs/ dbang po sogs kyi mngon sum tshad ma dang mngon sum du mthong dngos su mthong sogs mngon gyur rang mtshan dang yon tan sogs mngon du sgyur pa mngon mtshad mngon gsal che ba bun skyed sogs mngal bu snod/ mngon spyod drag las mnga' brnyes pa dbang thob pa mngan mi bgrang ba skyon mi brjod pa/ dam chos mngon pa'i sde snod lha'i mig sogs kyi mngon par shes pa lnga'am drug mngar ba'i ro dngar ba yang 'bad/ thugs la mnga' ba ldan pa yod pa gsal ba 'dzin pa mngar cha shing mngar yin par mngon mngag pa sogs mas 'phul nga'o/ /ri 5gas rngon pa po khye ra ba'i ming rnga ma las byas pa'i bsil yab brdung bya'i rnga chen sogs rnge'u rnga chung / rngam pa zhes pa'i don bkres pa chags pa rngab pa ltogs pa chags pa rnga mo tsher mar dga' ba'i dud 'gro zheg ji'u ngo mo chung ba'am rnga phrug rngom brjid gzi ba'i da che ba'am ngo mtshar rngam pa khro ba'am 'jigs tshul pags nad rngo bag can za 'phrug can/ da dugs dang chang sogs rngub pa 'then pa zug rngu zug gzer dang mde'u sa rngod mkhan sha sogs rngod pa po lus rngul ba dang rngul gzan zul nag sogs/ rngo yis khyer ba ham pas khyer ba dre'u rngog grum tse las kyi gla byis pa'i rngan pa gsol ras lha bu dang / rnga ma mjug ma rngog ma ze mthug po'i 278

dod cad gyi rngam ste rngams kyang snang rngo mi thogs pa mi nus pa mi phan pa ngo mi tsha ba/rngan chan brtas thabs sa mi rtsi ba rtswa sngon dang btsas ma rnga pa gcod pa rdu ma mig skyo 'ad mig skyag dang / rus kyi ste brag la 'jug pa'i rngog ste rngog lo chen po sogs dang rngom bag can rngos jab rwa jim po sogs rar btags ba'o/ /zhal snga spyan ji'am spu'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad ces sa zhal nyid kun snga mig snga'am drung snga so mdun nam ji mar snga sor yang snang sngon ma sam sngon dus sngon 'gro/ gsang ba'i sngags yid skyod pa'i don sngags pa jigs 'chang mdog mkha' ltar sngon po sngo ba sngon po'am sngon por byed pa/ snga dro nyin byed tshun sngas mgo gzhag sa la sdur ba gnyid sgra che ba/ snga ma'i dus sngon dus skyo sngogs 'khrug long mon gyi sran ma sngo'u kun chung zhig snga mdang phyi ma sngon rjes sdun sngon nam mdun du go sngo ba spel ba'am sbyid pa'am sgyur bar byed pa/ mtshang skyon nas sngog pa 'bru ba kha sngog pa dang gzungs sngags spre sngags rnam par sngos shig sngogs shig sogs sar btags nga'o//brngan pa mchod pa'am rngan pa ster yang brngams pa brngab pa ste ltogs pa'am chags nas btsas ma lo tog brngas pa ji ba/ bud med sogs brngod pa 'drid pa'am slu ba dang rngon pa gshor ba'am ri dgas gsod byed kyis brngon pa ri dwags bshar ba/ chang sogs brdubs pa rdub pa dang brngo brngos brnga brngam brdub sogs bas 'phul rar btags nga'o/ /lus sems kyi sdug bsngal ba mi bde ba bstod pa'i don can gyi bsngags pa yon tan brjod pa bsngo bya'i dge bas bsngos pa sngo ba/ rnam par bsngos pa sngon por gyur pa dang mtshang nas bsngog pa sngog pa dang bsdogs mdog bsngo sogs/ bas 279

'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nga'o//lha'i sgyu mtshan nam dgos pa ci'i slad dang ci'i phyir gnyis gang gi phyir ldan pa'i don ston byed kyi can te dag can rgyan can sgyu can lha budang khyed can khyod drung sogs/ bdag cag nga cag kho bo cag nga tshon ka rang cag 'o skol spyi cer thi med spyi ther sum cu dang / drug cu dang bdun cu dang brgyad cu rnams grangs kyi khyad par/ lhan cig dang thabs cig gnyis zabs cig mnyam po bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma sogs dus kyi tshad tsam/ khyed cag khyed tsho khyod cag sems can sems ldan yod do cog yod tshad shes so cog yin no cog sogs dang 'dra rtsog rkyang / can ce can no'am bor bar go cab cob za ba'i sgra chang sogs co re grub pa'i sgra'am grug pa'i sgra/ha cang shin tu'am thal che ba cas cus tshugs shor ba mi brtan pa mi drang ba bab col ma brtags pa'am byung rgyul mang / ci ste gal te'am ci phyir cung zad nyung zad phyin ci log pa yang dag min pa'am nor ba/ cang ci yang shes pa ste mngon shes cig shos gcig po'am ngos bzung ba'i ya ste mkhas pa'i cig shos mi mkhas pa legs pa'i cig shos mi legs pa lta bu ci nas kyang gang nas kyang ngam nges par/ co to dang co ni sku'i ming thor cog thor tshugs cod pan dbu rgyan dang / rgya cang ska rags kyi gye zag be con dbyug pa de lta ci smos ci bshad dam bshad ci dgog ca co sna'i tshogs sa ku co cal col bab col la mi brtan pa'am gtam nyog nu cor don dang mi 'brel ba'i gtam mam rgyu mtshan ltar snang dang / co 'dri ba gnod pa'am 'gran pa cig car dus mnyam cam dal gyis 'jog pa/ cog pu gur chung bar go car re bcar ba'i tshul mig ce re lha tshul dang ce re long lha bu/ lan cig lan ma gcig tshar cig cis kyang gang gis kyang ngam cinas kyang yul ci ru yang ma grub pas blos cir yang mi rtog gang 280

du yang mi zug kha cig 'ga' zheg cang gang yang mi shes kyang cong rol mo cang gshang dang cang te'u ḍaru byung ba ci yang gang yang brdung / sgyug cu gang sogs man zheg cung zhi cong nu ste rdo snad zhig cur nis zu ma ba zur chag yin snyam kha la za/ ce spyad gcan gzan ba brag ca sgra brtan gyis ci zhig bya gang zheg bya dgos med dam mi nug cog tse mdun cog la sogs par go tho co jing po ste tho co'i spyod pa spyod pa rtsing po lha bus cung peng ngas bu cung peng lhar na thug pa kha la za/ ci ga ci zhig ga ci yin nam ji ltar dang kag com ku co cag cag cing ces ce'o ce na cig 'dra cog la sogs pa ca rkyang ngo / /gros gcom pa gros byed pa gcong nad nad rnying gcad bya shing lha bu gcod pa 'thub pa 'dreg pa 'gog pa sel ba/ khon gcugs pa yid mi mthun pa yid gcugs pa mdza' ba yid mthun pa gcen spun che ba sngon skyes dang gcung spun chung ba rjes skyeg gcud la bor ba gtan la phab pa 'dul ba lag pa yon por gcus pa sgril ba lta bu gug tu gcur ba 'jur ba 'dul ba'i don yin zhing gcun pa 'jun pa 'dul ba/ mi ldan sogs rnam par gcod pa dgag pa yongs su gcod pa grub pa ste rnam gcod du sprul yin pa bkag na yongs gcod du thag khra sgrub pa lha bu zhal rtse khrims dang bad pa sogs gcod bzhin pa/ gcong rong bam sog gcong skad gcong nad can gyi skad dam gcom rong gi skad dam skad ngan gcin pa dri chu gci ba dri kar ma dri chu gtong ba lta bu/ the tshom sogs gcod bzhin pad lhab 'jal bzhin pa yang gces 'dzin med pa gces zas dang gal za'am dgos lha bur yang gces 'jug phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bshad sogag gcam du bcos ba'i ngag ga bcos bstod dam bcos ba kha gcang kha snyan nam kha gsag gcu sa pa mthun pa med pa gces 281

dgos/ tshar gcod pa 'pham par byed pa 'joms pa gcu gal do gal la khag yid la gcags pa yid la 'jags pa/ sgra gcan gza' zhig gcan gzan stag gzig sogs la gcan pa la tshugs pa'am la'i sho gam pa/ phyogs gcig mtha' gcig gam logs shig tu gcal du bkram pa ma mar brdal ba grangs kyi khyad par gcig gnyis/ bu ram dang snang sems sogs ro gcig pa khyad med pa rdzas dngos po'am rang bzhin gcig pa tha mi dad pa gcer bu sgron mo gcog pa bcag pa gci'u ni chu sogs 'then gtong byed pa'i sgyug spubs lha du yin la des bshang lam du gtong ba'i sman dang gcag gcom sgyung kha tshon gcod dad gcod thag gcod sogs gas 'phul ca'o//bdud bzhi bcom pa 'joms shing yon tan drug dang ldan pa sangs rgyas nyon mongs sogs kyi dgra bcom pa 'khor dang bcas pa yod pa'am ldan pas zhabs kyis 'chag sar bcags pa mnan pa'am phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas pa/ dam bca' ba khas len pa rje bya khrims bca' ba bzo ba bcas pa bcing ba 'ching bas bcings pa bkyigs pa/ shing sogs bcad pa gcod pa rlan gsher bcir ba bku ba bcar yang snang bca' bya'i nas kyi yos sogs sos bcem pa bcag pa'am blad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa tshig rkang bzhi sogs bca' ba bzo ba'i gzhi bka' yi zlas zu ba'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i gsung ngam 'chos skyob kyi cha nas bka' la'ang 'jug bcang ba lag tu 'chang ba/ logs sam zur du bcar ba nye bar phyin pa sku bcar ram bcar sogs bca' sga snan sga bza' ba lnga dang bca' ba lnga'i ro bcud bcud len dang bcud can lta bu/ mig dang sgong sogs bcar ba bkur ba lha bu phyir phyi rol tu bcil ba bton pa'am spangs pa'am bsal ba chu bcu ba chu 'dren pa'am len par go bcug pa las la sbyar ba nang du bcug pa'ang / nor dang bu lon sogs bcal ba 282

'jal ba lag pa bcangs pa bzung ba 'chang ba 'dod spyod kyi lag bcangs kyang chags bcag pa snam bu chu nang du mnyes pa las bcol ba las byed du bcug pa dang gtams pa'i bcol yang / bcar ba rta ra'i ming rtar bcibs pa 'chib pa zhon pa zhal rtse dang chad pa sogs bcad pa gcod pa/ rgol ba tshar bcad pa gcod pa blos bcal ba 'jil ba shes pa'am rtogs pa bslab pa bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba bcabs pa gsangs pa 'ab pa/ rdo sogs bcag pa gcog pa shing sogs bcer ba spungs pa gros bcam pa gros byas pa bcom yang snang bcum pa chung ngur btang ba/ bcu dang bzhi bcu dang lnga bcu dang / dgu bcu dang bco lnga dang bco brgyad rnams grangs kyi khyad par bcos pa bzos pa phyir bcos nad bcos sogs/ bcos bu bcos ma'i ras dang bcas bcos bcun bcur bcus bcab brtso bcib sogs bas 'phul ca'o/ /mnyen cing lhag pa mi rgyang ba myug phran yal ga gsar pa lcang ma shing rgya lcang la sogs pa ka lcag sku byed de thal lcag rta lcag skul lcag sogs/ /me tog sogs kyi mgo rtsogs dud pa dang dog pa yin nam dpyad ches cher lci ba yang ba min pa blo yis rtsogs pa khom pa'am nus pa/ gnam gyi lcags dang lce 'bab pa gnyis thog gam rdo rje'i me me'i lce gyen du g.yo ba lha bur lceb pa rang gis rang sog 'dor bar byed pa chu sogs su byung pa lha bu/ lcang lo can gsang bdag gi gnas khyad par can gyi ming lcags kyi ri bo rgya mtsho'i mtha' nas bskor ba ste khang pa'i lcags ri sogs kyang mtshon rtsog lcags ri sogs kyi steng du yod pa'i khang chung lta bu/ nya rtsibs nya phyis sam chu nang gi ral ba lha du'i sngo sbal ba rtse med lhong mo chu'i sog gas lhan ka bya sgyung ka'i ming rtse ro 'dzin sogs/ re'u lcag shog rgyu'i sngo lca ba stan rtsa ba lnga'i ya gyal lcam pa snan 283

nyi dga' lham pa snan zhig lag rtsibs lag pa'i dri ma gzhan la mi 'go bar byed pa'i lag phyis tsha lcibs snod sogs tsha bas mi 'tshig par byed pa'i ras sogs sgo rtsibs sgo yol la sgo yi ji sa phur sogs dang / sbyor lcibs mig smyogs sa mig shel lcam mo srid mo dral po ming po chos skyong lcam dral rtsa lcam dral ba zung skra lhas pa'i lcang lo ral ba lha bu dang lcang ma'i lo ma/ dud 'tsho lci ba ji bas 'byug snyi ba mer 'bud lta bu lcag pod ska rags shig sus lcag snye ma'i srus te srus cag kyang snang lcig pa rdung ba'am 'jal ba/ tshig gi 'bru ma rtsibs pa sgrig pa gshibs pa dang rtsigs rtsibs zhes pa 'dzin pa zu ba skyob pa sgrig pa'i dod yin snyam de lha bu sogs lar btags ca'o//dzad che che sgra sgrog tshul lam 'od chags tshul cha chi chu rlabs kyi sna lta bu chos 'dzin pa'i don te shes bya la sogs chu nyal 'gro ma'am dag byed nam mkha'i char ba smin gyis gtor ba'i chu sogs/ chags pa dang bral ba dgra bcom sogs rnyed pa ji yod kyis chog pa rung ba'am 'greg par shes pa sems pa ste byed chog mi chog sogs kyang cho ga sgrub pa'am bya ba byed tshul la sogs pa'i don ched dgos pa'am dmigs bsal te dgos ched dam ched du byas dang byang chub la ched du 'bad lta du/ go cha ya lad mtshon cha gri mdung la sogs pa'i ming cha lugs za byad chos shig pa ste bcos pa'i skul tshig yin/ byang ba dag pa'am spungs pa'am sangs pa chub pa rtogs pa'am rgyas pa byang chub gsum dang khog chud pa yang bar chad bya ba'i bar du gcod pa bgegs sogs ma la phob cig tshar chod cig gam gtan la dzab cig /rin pa'am gong chen po rin po che ste sna lhar na dga' rgyas sa rang rigs kyi gtso bo'i don chun po phreng ba'am bam po chabs cig thabs cig phyogs gcig chur cig ces 2tsho

gcur ba dang dul ba'i ma tshig ga nga ba dul ba nga ba shong ba/ chu srid dam da zhes zheng kha bzung sogs kyi cha mnyam pa za mthun pa'am cha mtshungs che me ba 'od 'bar tshul nga sgra sgrog tshul/ chibs pa bzhon pa cha zung de chibs shig ces pa zhon cig la 'jug ste bcibs pa'i da tshig tshogs shig bcags pa dang snam bu bcag pa'i dag tshig srog dbang chags pa gnas pa'am ldan pa chag chag btab pa ste la chu gtor nas rdul mi ldang bar byed pa cha ma thang mar brdal ba bkram pa/cho lo sho dang gos zhig dang sngo cho los che ge mo gang zag gi spyi ming la 'jug pa'i brda cha rkyen mthud rkyen chad pa bar ram rgyun chad pa/khrims kyi zad pa bka' nyes lus chad rgyu chad sogs kyis chod cig gcod pa'i da tshig yin la chung ma khrim 'dzin ma'am mdza' mo cho cig nor btso ba dang nga sa 'cho ba'i skul tshig chang che sa chang khang dang chang bzi rgya sogs che ba yangs pa chung ba nyung ba lha bu thugs su chud pa don rtogs pa bar du cad pa phrad pa gnas su cad pa shong ba/mthar chags rim pa snam bu chags su chogs shig bcag pa'i skul tshig chir gyis bcir tshul chir cig bcir ba'i skul tshig chab 'og mnga' 'og cho po jag pa'am rkun ma ches cher shin tu thal ches pa lha du yang chun cig gcun pa dang dul ba'i skul tshig chom ma shig bang pa'i skul tshig dgra choms pa dgra dul ba chings shig bcings pa'i skul tshig dang mdud chings chings sgrig chings ma 'ching byed kyi thag pa sta bu chab sgo khang ba'i sgo chog cig gcog pa'i skul tshig dang cho ga bsdus pa'i grong chog sngon chog da chog sogs dang ma chog pa ma tshang ba/rgol ba tshar chod cig gcod pa'i tshig tshig gros sogs kyi thag chod cig gcod pa'i skul tshig zag chod pa nges pa rnyed pa chab cad kyi 'og mnga' 'bangs chug cig bcug pa'i skul tshig dang yin du chug ga du rung / cha cho don rtsad ma chog ha

ma go ba cha rgyus med pa chas pa song ba cha ba 'gro ba rtsom pa/ zan la chang gi ro zo ba yod pa'i kha zas shig 'bras dang nas sogs kyi chan 'bras sogs ba'i sa pa chab chu chab gtor chab bran nas chus shig lag gcus dang chu bcu ba'i skul tshig cha lang rol mo mal cha nyal chas sogs che zhe sring mo che ba'am gu mo'i ming chas cha lugs/ cho 'brang ma'i rus te rigs kyi don chud zos pa chud gsan pa cha pa 'go ba'i nad cig chab shog bka' shog gam sming yig gam shog bu kha zhal che sa 'chi pos spus pa'i 'jid chig rkyang gcig pu chong zhig bcang ba'i skul tshig bag shul lam cung zad chags pa gnas pa'am nyal ba bod skad kyi nges tshig 'di ltar 'thad dam dpyad sgra ltar na rjes su nyal ba'am gnas pa'i don cho 'phrul rdzu 'phrul lta bu cho nge ngud mo 'don pa ngu ba/ /cha ga pa dbyar dus su sna dang bcas te cung zad 'phur nus pa'i srog zags phra mo zhig dang chab chog chen ma chud ma dgas chod cha shas go chod pa chag changs chub chungs la cha rgyan cha ches sogs cha rkyang ngo //mchog rmad byung ngam mtho ba'am rab tu go skyabs su mchi ba 'gro ba'am yong ba mchis pa dkon pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun gsum mchod pa bstod pa 'bul ba bzhes pa bkur ba/ mchis pa gnas pa'am 'dug pa'i mal gnas dug sprul gyi mchi ma rtsa sngon la gos pa las skyod pa'i rkang lham ste lham spyir yang go mchig rang 'thag sogs kyi mas gtun mchig gu yas gtun/ sku las mched pa skyes shing 'phel ba'i zla bo ste spun zla dang grogs mched rdo rje'i mched po sogs kyang mchan dpung 'og gam nye 'gram gyi don mchis brang chung ma rgyan gyis mchor pa mdzes pa gzabs mchor mchor po mchor zas/ mchi ma mig chu'am spyon ma mchil ma kha chu ma ljags mchil mcher pa sngon po dang mchin pa dmar po gnyis don 286

lnga'i khyad par/ zhal la kha' mchu sgros gnyis kar ka kha mchu kha' yas mas kyi mchu ma 'khrug pa'i don bka' mchid 'bel gtam mam sming yig mchid ces pa gtab ma bshad pa mchis pa yod pa'am songs ba/ rnam shes tshogs drug skye zhing mched par byed pa mig dang gzugs sogs bcu gnyis lha bu mching du mdog sna tshogs shing sdid med pa'i nor bu phal pa rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i mching dkyil lam dbus/ rtswa mchog ku sha'am sgyu yi rtse mo me mchen pa 'bar ba'am 'phel ba mchil pa byi'u nas zan nam 'dab chags bcu gcig pa'i don mchongs pa rtsal gyis 'phags pa'am 'phar te 'gro ba/ gzhu yi mchog ma ni rtse mo sgyu ma mkhan la sogs pa'i mchar bu slob bu mchan bu gnung gi dmyus dang nye bar don gsal byed kyi yig chung da mchil pa lcags kyu mchi sa rus kyi bye brag dang bsam yas mchi sa phu dang mche ba mchod bya'i mchu sogs mas 'phul cha'o//chos gzhan la 'chad pa bshad pa khrims sogs 'cha' ba bca' ba zhabs kyis sa rta sogs 'chag pa'i sa dar 'chag pa bcags pa/ snyed bkur gyi phyir tshul khrims ltar 'chos pa sogs 'chos pa bcos pa ste nyon mongs 'chos na da 'chos rgyud 'chos lta bu gar 'cha sa pa 'khyab zin pa srog dbang 'chad pa 'gag pa rgyud 'chad pa cha rkyen 'chad pa sogs kyang 'chi ba srog 'dor ba dang me mnal ba sogs/ 'dod pa la 'chums pa chags pa'i don gnas 'cha' ba 'dug sa bzo ba 'che ba zhen pa'i don yin par snang 'chur ba gnas su gcur ba/ 'chal ba gtad so med pa'am mi brtan pa'am khungs med pa'i don shes rab 'am ba tshul 'am 'ab bo sogs sems kyi 'char ba'i sgo 'a mtshul lam drad tshul mi 'chags pa sdig pa mi bshags pa 'chab pa bcabs pa'am sped pa/ nyi ma dang dus sogs 'char ba shar ba'am yod287

pa'am 'byung ba ste 'char ka 'char lo sogs chu sogs 'chor ba rtol ba'am shor ba las las ka ga na la 'cho ba brtsol ba'am byed du 'jug pa nor tshus 'chos ba yang 'chun pa stobs kyis gcun pa/ gros 'jom pa 'dun gros byed pa kha yis 'che ba khas len pa'am zhal bzhes 'ching ba bcings pa'am 'jig byed kyi zhags pa 'chang ba bcang ba'am 'dzin pa/ gtam 'chos ba 'khrul ba dang go rim 'khrug pa dang 'chus pa yo ba'am 'khyod pa yid ka 'chus sogs dang khas 'ches kha 'cha 'ab sa 'cham 'cha 'gro 'chag pa rus pa dang khyab mtha' dang dam 'ab gar gyi 'ab dang 'ab ba sogs 'as 'phul cha'o//spyod chos nyid dam gnas tshul ji lha ba phyin ci ma log pa'am dpe'i sgra yin chos can nam snang tshul ji snyed pa ji tsam mam thams cad ji lha ba bzhin yang dag par gzigs pa mig gis lha ba'am shes pa/ ji lhar gang lhar ram dpe sgra ji srid dus ji tsam mam dus tshad 'dri ba ji skad ji lta ba'am ji lhar 'di lhar smra/ jo jo jo lags sa phu bo'i don jo mo btsun mo'am gsang yul mam gtso mo jo bo gtso bo ste jo bo shākya nu rte lha bu dang rje'u rigs kyi rje bo'i don yang ja smon 'dab cig ste rgya ja bod ja lha bu/ je zhig re zhig gam ko rim ston pa'i sna jag pa chom rkun ju bo rdo ba 'phangs pa/ ja hong dmar ser ja ril thod pa zhig gas ja 'dab ril bur byas pa rje mthor song ba rim gyis mtho bar rtser pa nge rgyas ji rgyas nge bzang ji bzang sogs/ji di dang po'i don dang je dbyangs kyi don dang rje zhes pa ci gang sogs ltar spyi khyab kyi sgra ste ji yod ji legs ji ldan ji lta bu sogs dang ji ma sogs ja rkyang ngo //mjal ba thug pa'am 'phrad pa lus kyi mjing pa ske dang mjug ma rnga ma lus mjug las mjug mjug bsdu mji pho mtshan nam 'doms mjug mi mjed pa bzod 288

pa ste nyon mongs bzod pa'i sems can 'jing ba'i zhing dar mjal bgo ba'am mthong ba dang mjil kha sogs mas 'phul ja'o//'jag ma sgyu'i gye zag 'ji ba dang 'jim pa gnyis 'dam gyi ming 'jags —pa gnas pa'am gcags pa'am brtan pa yid la 'jags pa khris 'jags pa/ 'jig rten phung po lnga'am 'khor ba 'jig pa 'gag pa'am nyams pa'am bshig pa'am zhig pa'i don 'jigs pa skrag pa 'joms pa bcom pa'am nyams par byed pa/ 'jus pa 'dzin pa'am rgyab pa'am bkun nas sha dang shing sogs gris 'jog pa gnag pa phra mor byed pa 'jam ba bcar ba 'a nye bar phyin nas 'jabs pa gad pa'am gsab ba'am ba tshor ba/ 'ja' ba bka pa nyams pa zha ba keng lag sogs 'jas pa'i dod yin zhing 'jungs pa ser sna'i don skyon dang dri ma sogs 'jil ba bcil ba sel ba 'joms pa 'jim pa mkhas pa' legs pa'am 'thad pa/ 'a ba sgyu shig khrag sogs 'jib ba mchus 'then pa zas sogs 'ju ba nu ba'am ba'i ba 'jang ba 'khru ba'am yul zhig 'jud pa 'gro bar mthun pa ma snad 'tshong ma 'jol 'jol gos ring bo'i dbyibs sogs 'jol ba ring ba 'jol bo yid 'jo ba yid 'phrog gam 'dren cing sgeg pa dga' ba 'phel ba'i rnam 'gyur 'jog pa 'god pa sgrub byed gsal byed gtong ba sa la gzhag pa sogs/ /'jor bu tog rtse dbyibs 'jong mo 'jong 'jong sgo nga lta bu 'jur ba gcur ba'i don yin zhing 'jun pa gcun pa/ lus sogs 'jam pa mnyen pa nub min 'jog pa po spu rgyal zhig mtsho 'jing dkyil dbus 'jug pa 'gro ba zhugs pa bcug pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs ye shes me long snyan pa la 'jug pa'i 'jibs pa ste yid du 'ong ba dang mdzes pa dang legs pa yang snyeng 'dzin sogs la mnyam par 'jog pa gzhag pa/ mngon rjes kyi blo tshad mas 'jal ba bab ba 289

dpog pa ring thung sogs kyi tshad 'jal ba khru bre srang gis 'jal ba bcal ba 'dod pa 'jo ba ster ba'am 'byung ba 'o ma 'jo ba yang / khrims 'jags khrims ji lhar bsgrags pa lhar gnas pa 'ja' sa rgya nag gi go sa zhig 'ja' mo khral dang yul zhig dang / 'ja' brdog khang pa'i jig skyon ram 'degs byed kyi rten 'ja' tshon dbang po'i gzhu srad bu skud pa la sogs pa'i 'jur pa 'jur bu 'jur gong sgrig ches nas mdud pa ltar gyur pa dang 'jur mig kyang / srod dus kyi 'jing srod dkyil sha dang sems sogs 'jums pa sha rid pa'am zhum pa'am dman par byed pa rtsa 'jing di gnyen nam rtsa lag yin/ thob kyis 'jal ba rnyed phyir gzhan la mngod sum smod pa ste log 'tsho lnga'i gcig dang 'jab bu 'jibs pa 'ju 'jin sogs 'as 'phul ja'o//rje btsun gtso bo ste dad sgrol gyi don rjes su 'jug pa rjes su 'brang ba rdo rje phyag 'tshad dang pha lam sogs mi zud pa'i don rjes rtags sam shul lam mtshad ma rkang rjes sogs/ rje dpon gtso bo'am dpon po lha rje 'tsho byed sman pa rjed pa bkur ste'am mchod pa'i 'os/ sa rjen pa sa rlon nam sa sgrin sha rjen pa sha rlon nam sha sgron rjen pa sgrib byed sogs med pa'i don rjed ne yang rje ngar rkang pa'i ngar gdong rdud pa rid pa'am rgad pa/ brngod bya'i don rjod par byed pa ming tshig brjod pa snying zugs rje brtse ba duḥkha 'bral bar 'dod pa'i don lag pa'i rjes phyag rjes gzhan phan gyi lag rjes sogs dang / thugs rje snying rjes rjes su bskyangs pa yongs su skyong ba rje'u'i rigs rigs bzhi'i gcig til gyi dang nas sogs kyi jing pa bang ba'am 'khor dang rje bo rjes ma rjed byed rjen zu rje ba sogs rar btags ja'o//brjed ngas mi dran par brjed pa brjed byed gdon zhig gzi brjid gzi pyin nam 'od dam zil lam nus pa brjid pa 'bar ba'am mdzes pa1 brje ba dang 2mi

brjes pa bdag gzhan sogs rje ba ma brjed pa dran pas ma bsgyud pa brjod bya bshad bya'i don sogs brjod pa bshad pa'am gtam gyi ming dang / ba'i da gas rngom ba'i da sogs bas 'gul ra mgo ldan pa'i ja'o//yul gyi ljongs gnas sa yul sde ljang bu lngang pa myu gu'i don ljan sdin mi gtsang ba nyal nyil khrod/ sngon ba'i shing rkang 'byung kad ces pa lci ba'i don dang rtsi yang gi sdid lta bu snan mi ba'i ljongs yul lam gnas ljang gu kha dog gi khyad par/ro drug 'dzin pa rtse la 'jug pa'i ljags dang lngags mdud lngags rtsom snags lung ljon pa sogs lar btags ja'o//spyod nyams myong cha'am rngong ba'am nus pa'am rang bzhin nam ro ste sgom nyams rang nyams nyams can dag nyams sogs rtogs pa shes pa nying yang khu khu ba'i yang khu ba'am khu ba'i khu ba ste nying 'khrul nying lag sogs kyang sgra don stor nyag ma rkang ngam rdog ma zegs ma gcig pu nyab pa lag pas len pa'am reg pa'am 'dzin pa/ nya ma slob ma nyag mo ma phyi'am bud med nyis 'gyur nyis ldab nyis brgya nyis ldad sogs nyung ba nyung ngu nyung zad/ spu dang skra sogs nyag ma keng nga mdog ma nyal nyil lngan sprun nya yi lto za ba pa gnyi ba dang nya pa sogs/ nyam thag cing nyes par gyur pa ste nyes skyon kun nas nyon mongs pa ngal bar byed pa ste nyon mongs las snye ba'am tshe'i kun nyon gsum dang dka' las sam 'o brgyal nyam nga ba nyam thag par go nye ba thag ring min pa dang yod pa dang mtshungs pa/ nying sha bsad pa'i nyin gyi sha 'am nye du'i sha'i ming nyod pa zas sa kha nyod pa nyes pa skyon 'byung ba nyen rgyang ngam nye ba'am mnar ba/ nyam chung bdang nyam thag pa gnyis 'khos chung ngam stobs chung nyin mo nyi ldan gyi dus mtshan mo zla ldan gyi dus nyal ba gnyid log pa'am gnas pa/ nyams su 291

dga' ba yid dga' ba'i don nying dgos dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'am dgos pa'i dgos pa'am dgos pa'i gtso bo'am ched du bya ba ste gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nying dgos nye ba thag mi ring ba'am legs par go nyon cig ste rna bas nyon kha la nyon lta bu/ spos dri'i byug pa nyug pa 'byug pa lag nya ster mkhan med par len pas chos sangs rgyas las nyan cing gzhan la thos par byed pa nyams pa mi mthong ba kud pa lhung ba mnar ba mi nus pa/ dza nya bang chen nam pho mo'i bar du 'gro 'ong byed mkhan dza nya mo sogs nyi ma nyin byed dang nyi ma'i gnyen dang nyi 'od la sogs pa'i don nyen kor nye 'khor du go nya ser mig mi 'dzum pa'i sha shā sa nya ga 'jal byed dam tshad nyi shu grangs ka nyos pa rin gyis nyo ba dang nyos shig kyang / nying tor nges par mtha' gcig chu sogs nyog pa mi dwangs pa mi gsal ba nye bar reg pa ste khrus kyid par nyang rus shig dang yul zhig dang ro rtsong la yang bshad/ nye ba'am drung na gnas pa ste slob ma sogs nyug rum btsun mo'i 'khor rmig phyung nyan cing rna gtod pa pho nya sogs nyid kho na nges gzung gi sgra'am tshig phrad de gzhan ldan sogs gcod pa'i sgra/ nyag phran mda' nya rgyas zla ba nya gang ba dang nyar nyag phra bka' nyes byas nyes nyes cing bag nyal nyungs sogs nya rkyang ngo //rgyab dpung gi gnyen pa rtsa lag ste mgon skyabs dge ba'i bshes grogs kyi gnyen pa nye ba ste za ma sogs gnyis grangs kyi khyad par gnyen pa phan byed nye du rtsa lag gnya' bar dgal ba'i shing rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gnya' shing gang tsam lha bu gnyer pa don nam tshus gnyer mkhan khro ba'i gnyer ma dang rgas pa'i gnyer ma sogs dang / bka' gnyan pa'am po bka' btsan pa'am po gnyan bur sogs kyi ba ༵nga gnyan kha yang dud 'gro'i bye brag gnyan zhes pa ri dwags shig /gnya' bo

dpang po don du gnyer ba 'dun cing 'jug pa'am len pa gnyan dang gnyags dang gnyos 'di gsum rus ming ste gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab gnyags 4 na ku mā ra gnyos kha rag sgom chung lta bu/ gnyid dbang po nang du sdud pa gnyid mthug lta bu dang nyal ba gnyis kyi ming gnyen po spong zud dam 'joms byed zhi byed gnon byed la sogs par 'jug gnya' ba ka'i rgyab cha ltag pa rke rgyab kyi steng cha dang gri ltag ltag chu gnyul ba 'tshog ba'am so btsugs pa'am bya ra byed pa/ gnyi ma nyi ma'i gzer zer gnyig gcig tu lus sogs gnyong ka stobs sa sran chung / gnya' ba rengs pa lang shor ram dred pa'am rgyang ba gnye ma nang khrol sgyu ma zhig nyag po dma' mor gnyag pa dma' bar byed pa'am za ba'i don gnyeg ltar na dma' ba nyid/ gnyug ma ma bcos pa so ma rang bzhin rnal ma gnas lugs gnyug sems gnyug gnas la sogs pa'i don dang gnyig gnyis ka sogs gas 'phul nya'o//mnyan pa gru pa'am skya ba 'dzin pa thugs sems mnyes pa dgyes pa'am dga' ba rna bas sgra mnyan pa nyan pa/ mnyed parang mnyes pa gnyis 'phur ba 'joms pa rdung ba sprus pa mnyen par byed pa shing sogs mnyen pa snyi ba 'jam pa dul ba mnyan du yod pa gnas kyi khyad par zhig ste 'dir ston pa lo nyer bzhi bzhugs/ting 'dzin la mnyam pa mtshungs par gzhag pa 'jog pa mnyam pa 'dra ba'am zla med pa mtshungs pa'i don can gyi mnyam pa skyon yon ring thung ji yang sogs mnyam pa/ ra mnye snan rtsa ba lnga'i gcig yid mnyes pa'am snye zhing gshid pa ste mdza' ba'am grogs dang zhan pa'i mnyam pa mnyel ba sogs mas 'phul nya'o//'dam dang chu sogs kyi hog ma nyog ma mi dwangs pa mi gsal ba dang 'dam gyis rngog pa rnyed pa nor tshus dang 'thob pa bkur ste rjed pa'am mchod pa'am dam 293

par byed pa'i don gsar pa'am so ma rnying pa'am yun lon pa'i dngos po rnyed pa 'thob pa/ so yi rnyil so'i sha rnyang ma mi gtsang ba'am rlag mo hong 'khru ba dang gal dang rlag mo dang rnyi ri dgas 'dzid byed kyi rgya/ lcang lo sogs tsha bas rnyid pa rnyis pa rlon rkyang min par skam shas ldan pa ma rnyob pa lag pas ma stob pa yin rnyil rin chen dbang sngon te yin smi la'i zur chag /rkang pa dang lag pa rnyong pa rkyong ba dang dku ma hongs hogs sogs rar btags nya'o//go stod sngo sman zhig snying po sra ba brtan pa gtso bo sba ba rnam g.yeng rang bzhin snyid mo pha'i sring mo'am zhang po'i chung ma'i don snying nang khrol zhig gam sems/ spu stol ba khro ba sgyung ba chang myos 'grur snyol ba nyal du 'jug pa'am bsnyal ba dang stol cig snye ma 'bru dang 'bras bu'i dog pa 'bru phung dang ri rtse snyil ba 'joms pa bshig pa zhig pa skyod pa dang snyel cig tha snyad ming ngam shes brjod 'jug pa'i yul lam kun rdzob ji snyed ci tsam de snyed de tsam snyam pa sems pa'am rtog pa'am lhar/ snyems pa nga rgyal dang skul tshig dang snyun pa nad dman pa dang skul tshig med dgag tshig snyan shal rna rgyan nam rna shal la snyan dar snyi ba 'jam pa'am rgya'am dwags po'i rus/ cha stoms par 'jug pa dgu sogs mnyam par gzhol ba'o chags sdang bde sdug 'du byed mi byed btang ba spangs nas stoms pa mnyam par byed pa ste bar ma'am spang blang med pa'am nyon mongs med pa sogs snyom las le lo'i bye brag bde bar zhen nas brtson mi nus pa dang / mchog dman bar ma'i bsod nams snyoms pa mnyam par byed pa ldom bu'am slong mo snyugs yun nam rgyun srings ring ba'am byos shig dang lhags tsha skugs grang yang rjes su snyeg pa 'jug pa'am 'gro ba'am 'brang ba'i sar stogs shig snyeg pa'i skul tshig ga grub mtha' stogs pa yang / snying rje thugs rje'am cung zad dam snying 294

sdug lha bu'i ming snyim pa sgo ba do'i tshad dam thal mo snyobs shig lag pas stob pa'i sku tshig snyoms la 'jug min dpyad snyes pa sngas sogs la nyal 'gres gyed pa/ snyon mongs nyod mongs sa nyon mongs par byed pa snyad ka skyon nam khag 'dogs pa btags pa rgyal mtshad sogs stol ba bsnyal ba'am snyel ba/ gtam rna bar snyan pa 'jebs pa'am rna ba snyigs ma tshigs ma'am stog ma'i dus dang snyigs shig skud pa gtam zas snyod pa ring du gtong ba 'chad pa zas kha nas khar 'jug pa'am blud pa lta bu/ snyang snyogs byed pa nyag nyag byed pa'am zugs pa lta du yin nam sems snyoms pa mnyam par byid pa'am 'bring ngam bde bar gnas pa dang stom gcin snyi snal skung snyig stob snyen snyer skug stor sogs sar btags nya'o//me long gi gzugs brnyad pa'am po g.yar ba'am porang tshab sgra brnyan yang de bzhin te zag ca gzhan la brnyas pa rngan chad byas pa dang brtas thabs/ mnga' dbang brnyes pa thob pa phyag brnyan lag g.yar ram tshab ste g.yog 'khor brnyan po g.yar bo'i don brnyas pa g.yas pa'am g.yar ba/ gos sogs brnyings pa rnying ba kha bstogs pa kha 'dris pa'am lang shor dang chu hog snang brnyan sku 'dra'am 'dra cog brnyan pa g.yar ba bdang lhar na stong ba dang brnying bstog brta sogag bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i nya'o//dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas dang bsnyen rdzogs te spang bya lnga brgyad jims cad spong bar mnos pa'i so thar gyi sdom ba yin bsnyen pa nye ba phyi ma la rdzogs bsnyen du yang 'gyur bsnyen pa bsten pa nye bar bas pa 'grobs pa/ bston can bston mkhan bston dor ming tsam dang bston btsugs pa bsnyon tol ming tsam ste bston pa yin pa la min pa'am min pa la yin par brjod pa dang / bsnyen pa dang nye ba'i bsnyen pa 296

bsgrub pa dang sgyub pa chen po'i yan lag bzhi lta du bsnyen cing bkur ba zhabs tog sogs zu ma zhib mor bsnyil ba snyel ba 'thag pa/ gtam bsnyad pa stod pa bshad pa bsnyams pa stoms pa mnyam par byas nas lag pa bsnyal ba bskul yang snang ste bgrus pa'i don/ phyir phyi rol du bsnyil ba bzad pa'am bton pa mal du bu sogs bsnyal ba stol ba lhung bzed bsnyigs pa snyig pa snyegs mar byas pa'am lhung bzed gdams pa'i lhag mar byas pa/ lag pas bsnyabs pa stob pa reg pa bsnang ba na ba'am nad kyi gzhi yis bskun pa skun pa na bar 'gyur ba'am na zin pas bsnyengs pa 'jigs pa/ bsnyel pa brjed pa med pa nas dang nyes can bstor ba stor ba rdung ba'am bshig pa yo byad spyad dngos bsnyungs pa skung du btang ba/ bsnyen pa nye ba'am nye bar byed pa sring ba ring ba'am ring bar byed pa zas bsnyod pa stod pa kha nas khar 'jug pa'am blud pa lha bu dang byin pa'am gso ba sgyu gang mtshon gang bskug pa sgyugs pa'am 'byug pa/ /bsnyems pa snyems pas rjes su bsnyegs pa snyeg pa khro ba'i gnyer ma bsnyer ba bsdus pa'am bstan pa dang bsnyeg bsnyig pa bsnyang bsnyags bsnyam bsnyab rjes bsnyags kyang snang bsnyem sogs/ bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nya'o//spyod te por sra ba dam pa drag pa shin tu legs par te se gangs rir go tal ma de ma thag pa'am ma thogs par go song ba'i da/ dzā ti man gyid par sna ma tang kun sngo go stod 'dra zhing dri zhim can nyig ta tik+ta'i zur zag ste sum tig sogs tel dkar dag tel la snam lta bu/ tug tug dang tong tong dang tog tog ces pa'i sgra byung na de dang de zer/ tel pa ste'u dang me tel tog rtse 'jor bu dbyug to dbyug pa'am phyag mtshan zhig dang / dbu yi gtsug tor spyi tor thor to thor tshugs spyi tor ba/ rdor tog dpal te rtse mo phud mchog dang sgra zhig kyang / nu tig rin chen zhig

nuba'i sna nyams pa me tog pad+ma sogs sa bsod stoms sa zla mtshad ba la zas shig ga so rtsi/ lo tog lo thog rtsi tog sgyu thog za ma tog rin chen gyi snod dam mngar ba'i snod dam ga'u/ teng nge 'dzin pa mnyam par 'dzin pa rdo rje lta bu sogs mdo dkon mchog ta la la sgron me'i don yin/ teng lo zan kong tal cung zad dam yid tsam tig tig nges rjes med/ yon tan skyon min dge ba legs pa khe dang ji yang sogs zhabs tog bsnyen bkur ram drin can la pan pa nan tan do gal lam nad tar ram brtson pa dang / nan tur khrims kyi chad pa'am chad las gal te gal srid brtag pa mtha' gzung gal te da go'u ta ma rigs rgyud kyi khyad par ram thub pa/kha ton kha 'don gyi ming tsam zhal ta kha ta'am bran g.yog nan tar ni bzang po dang nan tan/ ta zig kla klo'i yul zhig ta ming rgya nag gong ma ta ming lha bu ta zhes pa rgya nag gi skad de chen po'i don te ka'ang snang ta'i si tu dang / ti zadang ta dben dang ta hung bzhi rgya nag gi go sa'i ming dang phyi ma dar dmar la'ang 'jug pa dang /tā ra ṇa rta babs te gzhal yas khang gi sgo'i phyi na yod pa'i ka ba rgyan can sogs dang te'u shang shang shang gis bteg pa'i khri/ tam bu ra sgra snyan nam khyud mang dang ting yon cha kyi sgod nying shag rol mo zhig teng shags kyang snang / nyo nyi dang ta la gnyis shing gi bye brag tres sam zu ma'i ming zhang zhung gi skad dang / shang shang te'u bya shang shang chung ngu'am zug gu te te brdung bya'i rnga brdung / 'on tang 'on kyang yin mod ling tog mig sgrib byed dang 'on te ta tsā ga ta gal ta su ga ta tur gyis dran lhag bcas kyi te sogs ta rkyang ngo //gtan nam gzhag rgyun gyi don bsam pa dmigs yul la gtan du bar gnas pa gtan du gnas pa las mi 'da' bar byed pa'i tshigs mtshams su gyur pa 297

sgrub byed dam rtags sogs gtam brjod pa gtam pa bshad pa/ gtun bu mas gtun lag pa la sogs par gtad pa gtod pa byin pa bkal ba rtsog pa gzir ba ce gtun shing yas gtun gtubs pa dum bur 'thub pa/ brdung gtag rdung 'tshog gtong ba rgyab pa'am sbyin pa dang gtang rag legs 'dul gtang ba sbyin pa/gter 'byung gnas sa nges par 'dzin pa mdzod nor khang yongs su gtams pa gang ba bcol ba gtad pa bshad pa gtor ma 'byung gtor sogs zan dang chu me tog gtor ba 'thor ba bkram pa kha 'thor du 'jug pa/ bu lon len pa'i nor gyi gta' ma dang gteng pa dang gta' gsum bu lon gyi tshab lha bur bzhag pa'i dngos po/ gtan pa sgo gtan nam sgo chegs kyis bkag pa med pa'i sbyin pa bar ma chad pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba dang gtang ba gnyis ster ba 'dor ba glod pa rgyag pa/gtum po khro rngam can nam gdol ba'i dod zhabs kang pa la spyi bos gtugs pa reg pa'am thug par byed pa'am bsten pa zad pa'i don can gyi gtugs pa 'dzangs pa kas pa thug pa yang / lha chen la go ba'i gtogs 'dod dbang jig gzhan la tshus sogs gtod pa gtad pa/ 'bem mda'i dmigs yul lha bu la gtod pa gtad pa gzir ba dang bsgom byar dmigs pa bsam pa gtod pa gtad pa rtse gcig tu sems pa dang gtod cig kyang / gte nug ma rig pa rngongs pa gtol rgyus gdeng nges pa thabs med mtshang skyon nas gtol ba 'bru ba/ khrag gtar ba gtsag pa 'don pa chu dang snam gnyigs pa jigs pa 'bab tu 'jug pa se gol gtogs pa rgyab pa/ nor bcol ba'i don la 'jug pa'i gtams pa gdams pa dang grangs kyi khyad par gtams dkrigs/ sgo'i gtan pa gdan du'am sgo 'phar gteng dbus kyi mtha' 'am dkyil zab mo dpag dka' ba nun pa dang smin sogs gtibs pa dkrigs pa tshogs 298

pa/ gtur bu snam spyan sogs kyi nod spos reng sogs gtul ba snar ba'am bdug pa ri bo la sogs pa'i gtog che chung gi tshad dam bong da mgo bo sogs gtums pa dgog pa mtha' la gtugs pa zad pa thug pa bkag pa bkar ba khongs phyogs su gtogs pa 'ji ba 'dus pa bzan pa/ gtan du gnas pa la 'bebs pa don gnas dang mthun par byed pa dang gtum mo gtar kha gnyi zug gtong ba sogs gas 'phul ta'o//bya sgro mda' la don du med kyang spyan ba lhar med pa la yod par btags pa spyan ba bzhag pa 'dogs pa ming btags pa bda'am tha snyad spyan ba 'dogs pa kha btags lha reg gam dar dang ma par bas pa btags pa g.yogs pa bcings pa brgyan pa 'dogs pa/ spyir btang ba dmigs kyis ma bsal ba'am thun mong du btang ba'am zun mong blo sogs kyis btang ba gtong ba dor ba sngags me tog btu ba dang tshad ma mngon pa bslab pa mdo kun las btus pa gnyis 'thu ba sdud pa/ srog btod pa lugs ka dod du 'jug pa'am 'dzugs pa gdan dang gzhi bting ba 'dings pa 'grems pa spyong ba 'dzugs pa sa bon skyed byed kyi sgyu btab pa 'debs pa rgyag pa/btang bzung ni klu zhig dang ri btang bzung gis don gnyis la go bteg pa 'degs pa gyen du slong ba 'jal ba 'gro ba gsol ba nu ba btab pa gul ba 'debs pa btud pa 'dud pa dgu ba'am phyag 'tshol ba/ btags so tha ga pa'i 'thag spyad kyi bye brag rgyas btab pa rtags kyis mtshan pa bza' bya'am bza' ba zas btung bya'am btung ba skom btub pa bla'am rung ba dang gtubs pa/ me tog dang spu btogs pa 'thog pa 'then nas tha dad du byed pa rtsa ba sogs bton pa 'don pa 'byin pa bkog pa bkol ba btags pa zu dang thag 'thag par shes dgos shing btul ba bkol ba'am las su 299

rung ba dang pham par byas pa 'dul ba/ mgrin pa gyen du bteg pa sgrong ba 'degs pa dang btog btag btang stoms sbyin btang bya btang sogs bas 'phul ta'o//mi dgag tshig rtag pa brtan pa 'gyur med rgyun pa mi nyams pa rang bzhin zad med rgyun mi 'chad mnyam nyid rtab rtab brel brel tshangs tshangs skrag tshul rtab rtab po yang sbyar dbang po rtul ba mi rdo ba brtul ba dang rtul po rtags skyos ma mtshan ma rgya sgrub byed mtshon byed shes byed/ mi rtog pa ye shes dang gnyid kyi shes pa dang dbang shes sogs te mi sems pa'i don yid rton pa cha 'jog pa'am yid ches pa yid brtan pa rtog pa dpyod pa dang ldan pa rtogs pa shes pa dang nges pa/ dus rtag tu rtag par rta mgyogs 'gro la rte'u rta zug gam chung ngu skyes pa rteng ma rjes ma phyi ma/ rtol gog glang dang mdzo mo 'dus pa'i bu rtol pho'am mo rteng pa rkang ba'i pyi rteng rtod pa 'ching bas bcings pa rtod thag rtod phur sogs kyang / ru rta zhes pas snan bye brag pa zhig go bar byed nyams shed mo rtas pa rgyas pa gnas su rtol ba slob pa'am 'byor ba dang rnag rtol ba/ mong nul blun po rtul phod snyeng stobs che ba'am pha rol gnon pa rten gzhi yan lag can gnas pa skyos ma skyabs sogs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba stong nyid yod pa dngos po lhas/ mchod pa'i rten brgyad lta bu rta babs tsā ra ṇa bya ma rta bya rta min pa'i myur 'gro ste pho nya'am bang chen/ rta thul lnga sde'i gcig rta dbyangs slob dpon dpa' bo rtog ge pa rtog pa po'am dpyod mkhan te so skye lta bu dang rtog ge sde lnga'am 'bar ba yang / mi gtsang ba la grags pa'i rtug pa skyag pa dar rtug dri dang rton pa bzhi lha rten rnam rtog so sor rtog pa rtogs pa brtan pa'am dbang du bya ba nul ba sdud pa 'jam pa 'dul ba dpa' ba zhan pa mi no ba rtul cig rten cig sogs rar btags ta'o// 3kyi

lto bas 'gro ba brang 'gro sgrul lto 'tsho sgra yang 'jid lhag pa ske rgyab kyi steng cha de lha bu mtshungs pa/ lto bas 'bye ba 'gro ba sa bdag gi khyad par la go ba'i sgra lte ba lus kyi dbus cha sa sogs kyi dkyil ma gzhi ngo mar go lhad mo gzigs mo lha ba blta ba'am grub mtha'i lta ba/ lto ba grod pa pho ba mngal dkyil lto zas sam bza' bya yis lter gyis snyem gyis te bkang ba'i tshul/ bur du ram mar tshos sogs kyi ltang tshe rkyal ba'am snod 'grang pa rgyags pa stogs pa bkres pa da lha dus kyi khyad par ram myur ba ltos shig lha bar byos dang ltos pa nu ba dang gcig la gcig stos pa/ dngos ltar du snang ba mngon pa yang dag min pa ltag chod sun 'jin lhar snang grub mtha'i lha ba phyin ci log gi rtsang ba lhung bar byed pa ste kung ba sde lnga sogs kyis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa mi legs pa lta chos lta zhog srid kyang mi shes zhes pa'i lha lta bu ci smos/ lteng rgyas 'od srungs kyi bye zag gam lteng ka rgyas pa lteng ka char chu 'khyil ba'i gshong bu ltem gyis lter gyis gang ba/ re ba'am ltos pa blo gtad byed pa dang ming tsam ja lta phar zhog chu yang med mda' yi ltong ka gzhu rgyud dang spyan rgyu'i kha/ lhar lhar dbyibs sam mngal gyi gnas skabs shig ltem rkyang ngam snyem kyang mi brtan pa'am mtho dma' dang lteb lhab ltos grub ltar da lhar ltag gong steng yan la 'jug pa sogs lar btags ta'o//bstan bya ston pa bstan pa dang ston po'i don bzhugs pa'i stangs ka 'dug tshul bkur ba'i yul du ste ba gnas par byed pa ste mchod pa stobs shig byin cig rol cig sgyus shig stes sam stes dbang stabs legs nu stegs byed dam pa phyi rol pa —byad stems mthu gtad kyis/ mi sto mi skyon lta stangs lta tshul me stag me'i tsha tsha'am lo stegs bu gtor stegs so sa/ sta gon 'og grabs stong ba phan pa'i grogs rogs sha stag 'ba' zhig gam kho na byed/ gzhogs stegs zur mig 'jo sgeg mdzes pa'i 301

dam 'gyur stangs stabs gom pa 'dor tshul sta zur dku'am dpyi ston pa bstan pa/shing stag bka ga'i shun can gyi shing stug po mthug pos ba gar ma'i khrod stobs nus pa'am ye shes can stag gcan gzan zhig dgra bo 'joms byed kyi sta re mtshon sta re shing gcod byed ste'u ste sta re chung ba'am tel pa stor ba 'bor ba'am rlag pa/ shing star bu'i zhun ma man star thog gi khaṇ+ḍa star ga'am ka kham bu zheg la go ba'i ming ston mo dga' stod shid ston sogs ster ba sbyin pa/ lus sogs kyi stod dkyil yan chad la grags stan gdan dang stu mo mtshan ma dgag tshig sten pa bsten pa'i rten pa'i bye brag gan 'grogs pa dang sten cig ston yang snang / ston ka dang dpyid ka dus kyis da par gang ba 'phel ba'am gtams pa dang stongs pa 'grib pa'am 'bri ba ya stags mdos yas dang stags grong tshig stong phrag brgya tsho bcu/ stem pa thim du 'jug par byed pa so sto so zing so thags mi bzang bar go stor khung mi gtsang ba khrus chu sogs 'bab pa'i khung bu dang / stang zil dngul rdo stabs gcig gom 'gros gcig lhan cig gi stabs cig la yang 'thad snyam stabs 'bul stabs ka sogs star phreng brgyus pa brgyu ba steng ma thog ka gong bla/ stong pa zom stong khang stong lha bu snod nang du dngos po gzhan med pa'i don sogs stong pa nyid rang bzhin med pa rten 'byung sogs dang star ba sgrig pa rgyud pa phyi dor byed pa nyas ma su len pa gzabs pa dang cha sta steg chos 'phang stod stongs stangs ka sgyud stebs sogs sar btags ta'o//brtag pa dang dpyad pa gnyis rtog dpyod de 'jal ba'i don yul dang bslab pa'i gnas su brtan pa gnas pa mi ldog pa kun tu brtags pa blos bzhag pa gnyis snang lha du ngo bo nyid gsum gyi gcig brtags pa rtog pa dpyad pa/ yid brtan yid rton nam yid brtan po brtad pa glo dur ba brtul ba bsdus pa spungs pa zhugs pa 302

'jug pa len pa ste spyod pa brtan pa'am po rtag pa byang chems sam 'gyur ldog med pa/sgo nga'i spubs sogs brtol ba rtol ba bshangs pa ba'i na pa brtson pa rtun pa spyi brtol dzad pa'am ngo tsha med pa brtabs pa 'jigs pas ba ba/ yongs 'du sa brtol dpag bsam shing sa brtol sa gug ste shing brtag pa sgyud kyi dum bu brtag pa gnyis pa dang so gnyis pa sogs dang brtag pa brgyad brtul ba rtul ba/ brten pa rten gyi cig shos la go brten pa rten pa gnas pa stos pa 'grogs pa sogs phur bu phur bas brtod pa rtod pa bcings pa/ brtas brta brtab rtog byed kyi brtag bya sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldad pa'i ta'o//bstos pa stos pa'i sa zub dbang dang pa sogs bstos pa ltos pa'i chos slob ma dang bu sogs blta bar rung ba 'os pa mig gis bltas pa lha ba/ blta bya mig yul sogs sku dang jing du ba lhams pa skyes pa dang gang ba gos gdan gzan bltab pa lteb pa lhab pa nyis lha sum ltar byed pa dang blta sa ba lha mtshan ma de 'di la bltas zhes sogs/ bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /bste stang mchod pa dang gnas bstud pa mthud pa'am 'dud du 'jug pa'am brgyud pa bar chad du ma bcug pa bkun ma bsgyud ma zhes pa'i don bste ba ngal gso ba'i gnas gnas chen sogs bstar ba star ba/ thub dbang gi bstan pa chos dang bstun pa stun pa mthun par byed pa bstod pa bsngags pa dang 'phang stod pa la 'jug par 'os bsten pa sten pa/ bstang ba pan pa'am mgon sogs dang bcas pas ma bzung ba don med kyi bstan bcos sogs dgu lha bu bstan pa ston pa bshad pa/thag dang gos sogs kyi ring bo bstungs pa nye ba'am thung du btang ba blo'am gdong sna bstad pa kha phyogs pa'am gtad pa sogs 'gro chas 'gro ba'i grabs bstad pa gshom 303

pa sga bstad pa sga rgyag pa/ bsteng ba'i tshig 'phya tshig bstem pa stem pas mi bstongs pa mi phan mi stong mod kyang / bste ba ngal gsor med pa mnar med mngon par bstod pa bsngags pa'am mngon par dga' ba byin len dang yo byad bstabs pa stob pa dang bstes pa bstab pa bste sa pa bsnang ba sogs/ bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ta'o//lha'i thun mong spyi thun thu bo rgan pa'am gtso bo phu bo tha gru yul gru'am rgya khyod che ba/ thu mi ba ṭa'i rus thon mi zhes pa thon yul gyi thu mi bsdus pa 'dra thor cog dang thor tshugs gnyis do ker dang / tha ma dman pa phyi ma chung ngu tha na chung ngu na thig thig lham gyi sgra/ thur gyen min pa'am thur ma dang tha mal phal ba rang bzhin dang thul thar thang theg thogs thum po jig le thug thugs thon thub pa thu ba thal 'gyur thod pa thal ba sogs tha rkyang ngo //mtho ba mthon po'i ris phyogs sam rigs mtha' dag pa thams cad mtha' klas pa mtha' yas sam mtha' gtugs pa ba mthong mig gis rig pa mthong lam sogs/mtha'i char thug pa mtha' la reg pa nus pa'i don can gyi mthu ste stobs dang ngan sngags mthun pa mtshungs pa gcugs pa 'byor ba mi mthun pa snga ma'i ldog phyogs/lag pa snod sogs kyi mthil lto ba'am 'og gi cha'am dkyil lam gzhi lha bu mthe bong ngam sor mo sbom shos mthe'u chung sor mo phra shos/ mthon ga dang mthon ka dang mthing ga sngon po'am sngo ba ste ming mtha' ci rigs drang zhing mjing kha lha bu la mthing gi kha dog bsdus kyang 'gal ba med la tshul 'di rigs mthun kun la sbyor mthang smad gos gyon pa mthug pa'am po stug po srab min/ mthar gyis rim gyis te mthar gyis pa'i spyor ba lha bu rta'i mthur mgo mthur thag mtho sor bcu gnyi'i tshad sogs gang ba 304

kha tshang ba mthud ba bar sprul ba mi 'chad par byed pa/ mtho 'tshangs pa 'gran pa'am gnod pa byed pa mtho btsams pa mthol ba mi gsang bar spya ba ste sdig pa bshags pa mtho yor mi bgreng lha bu'i do rtseg sogs mtho ba mi dma' ba mchog mthon po mtho ba'i ming tsam la go ba'i sna rgya mthongs rgya cher mthong ba'i gnas sa dkyil khang pa'i rgya mthongs sogs yul dbus kyi mtha' la 'khob pa khyab pa'am gnas pa mtha' don drug la 'jug rtag chad kyi mtha' sogs/ mthing ril chu bya zhig mthing kha sngon po dang mthon ka chen po mthos mthong ga mthas klas pa mthu bo che mtheb mthar chags sogs mas 'phul tha'o//'thab mo 'khrug par go zhing 'thab pa yang 'thon pa bton pa'am 'gro ba mgo 'jon 'thon phyag lha bu dang 'byung pa'i don yang yin grogs dang rta sogs su 'thams pa 'tsho pa 'dzin pa bdag byed pa spyo ba shi spar 'thams pa lta bu/ smin dang rig pa 'thibs pa 'khrigs pa mi gsal ba chu dang nor 'thor pa gtor ba 'bor ba kha 'thor ba 'thor zhing 'thung ba khrus shig dang / blo dang lus 'thums pa gtums pa mi gsal ba mgo 'thoms pa 'khor ba mi shes pa du ba dud pa 'thul ba 'gyur ba gtul ba tshos pa/ sra ba'i don can gyi 'thas pa mkhregs pa shin tu zhen pa 'thems nan zhes pa nan tan gyi don 'thems pa mi 'phyug pa chad lhag spong ba kha tshang ba mnan pa 'than po brtan po nan po/ chu kar lha ja 'thungs pa btung ba 'thung yang 'thad sha spu nas 'then pa tshur 'dren pa tshan gyis 'khrid pa lha bu'i don yin zhing me tog spu 'thog pa gtogs pa/ smod pa'i tshig dang 'thing snad gnyis don gcig 'then pa rdub pa 'thung ba 'jog pa phyir 'ben pa 'thad pa rigs pa 'os pa rung ba 'dod pa/ skyid zas sogs la 'thu ba dang 'thus pa 'du rgyab pa btu ba 'greg pa 305

tshogs pa 'the ba phye ma zhib mor 'thag pa btags pa 'joms pa thag 'thag rang 'thag zha ba yan lag nyams pa 'theng po rgyal bo kang pa ring thung mi mnyam pas 'theng nas 'gro mkhan te zha zhing 'theng ba yang mal gos nyal chas 'theb pa lhag po lhag pa nyid kyis 'thum pa gtums pa g.yogs pa/ dum bu tshal bar 'thub pa gtubs pa dang 'a bas pa nan chags 'thems 'jid pa nan tan byed pa'am brtan pa sogs 'as 'phul tha'o//zhes gang zag gzhan gyi dring zhes pa tshul lam 'dren pa'am lugs la re ltos mi 'jog pa ste ga na la rag ma las pa bka' drin sku drin zhes pa phan btags pa'am byas pa dran pa mi brjed pa'i sems pa/ dril bu dril chen dril chung dri sna'i yul mchog bzang po ste kha che skyes lta bu dra ba dra zud mchod rdzas kyi khyad par/ snga dro zhogs pa phyi dro dgong ka'i don dri ba zhu ba gtam 'dri ba'i ming tsam dris pa'i lan nus lan dri ba byas pa'i lan/ gdul bya 'ga' zheg zab don nam bstan pa la kha drang bar bya ba'i don can gyi gsung ste nges don min pa g.yung drung 'gyur med rtag pa dang bkra shis pa'i mtshan ris drang por srong ba thub pa sogs drug grangs ka zhig khrims ngo tsha chu dral ba 'jig pa 'joms ba ral ba lcam mo dang dral po ming sring zas thug sogs drangs pa drang ba 'brim pa drongs shig ces pa drang ba'i skul tshig nges pa drongs pa nges pa rnyed pa/ drang po bshan po mi 'phyog pa bden pa'i don shing dang zhabs kyi drung rtsa ba nye ba zhe sa'i brda drung 'khor drung yig spun drung drel dud 'gro dre'am dre'u dre'u rngog stan khra bo par tang grum tse don gcig mon dre dang smin drug gnyis rgyu skar gyi bye brag ma dros pa mi dro ba'am bsil ba ste klu rgyal zhig yin de gnas pa'i mtsho/ dreg ni nad kyi khyad par dreg pa nag po chags pa'i dri ma'am lngan sdin dri ma dreg pa dri nag 306

dang nyon mongs sa skyon dang / kha drag pa kha mkhas pa'am kha btsan pa drag zhan sku drag drag po'i shul ldan pa khro ba'i rnam 'gyur lus ngag tu dod pa sa dang mo mtshan sogs la gzan dang dza mtshan drud pa 'dud pa spyan nas 'then pa'am 'phul ba lta du drud cig kyang 1 drod dron mo bskul drod dang dro ba tsha ba dros pa zan zas dron mo dro po g.yos zan dril ba sgong ba sgrig ba sdeb pa ltab pa/ dred mo gcan gzan zhig lhags pa pags pa gos ming dras pa gri sog gis 'dra ba'am gshags 'dra ba drubs pa 'tshe pa'am mi kha gso ba dres ma thag pa sog bya rung ba'i tsā zhig thag pas drags pa sdom pa drogs shig sdoms shig /dred po rgyang po ma dul ba chos dred zhabs dred dru bu sgro gu'i don dra ba skud pa 'brel ba'i spyod nya rgya lta bu dra bad sgyu dra dra mig rtog pa'i dra bar go drangs pa 'dred pa/ dril chen bsgrags pa khrims bzags pa sogs dra ma mkhas pa ya rabs gul phyin legs pa'i don gnas su drongs 'dren pa'i skul tshig gam tshogs pa/ dregs pa rgyags pa khengs pa drung pa rtsa ba'am rtsa danas phyung ba bton pa sun jing yid zung kha yi drog kha skyid pa 'tshe sa pa tshim pa/ nad drag nad las grol ba dwa phrug pha ma med pa'i bu dwa ba snan dang rgya gro ma lha bu zhig la go ba'i 'bru 'bras du/ thal cha che ba'i don can gyi drags pa ste bshad drags pa che drags pa chung drags pa dang dred drus tshe zub dor do gal drang ba drag pa mkhas pa btsan pa shugs che ba mtho ba mchog 'grig pa dris shig sogs da rkyang ngo //gdugs nyi char sgrib byed med pa gdong pa bzhin ras dam dun gdugs nyin par ram nyi ma'am nyin byed kyis gdungs pa gdung ba tsha bar zud pa'am mnar ba/ gdon mi min gyi gnod byed ltar dpe sgra gdug pa ma rungs pa mi bzad pa'i don gdol pa dmangs rigs kyi zu brag gdul ba btul ga gdams bya'i ngag phan 307

pa'i ngag gsal gdab pa btab pa brjed du mi 'jug pa gding ba dge tshul slong gi yo byad cis dang mal gding dang bting ba gdan stan gdan bu gdan 'dren gdan sa/lag rkang dpung pa'i gdu bu mjos rgyan gdang gos sogs 'gel sa dpyang thag dang dre gdang sogs dang gdung ma ka ba'i gdeg byar go gdags pa btags pa/ gdung ni rus sam 'phel gdung skad sna'i gdangs dbyangs 'dzeg pa'i skas kyi gdang bu skas rim mam skas them/ gdung rus pa'i zhe sa brgyud pa bar ma zad pa gdung rus sam rigs 'dzin pa po 'tsho pa po gsol ba gdab pa bdag cag la dgongs su gsol bar zhu ba gdon pa bton pa/ gnyer ba dang gdams pa gnyis gnyer gtad byed pa yang na gnyer bar gdams pa bcol ba dang gdams pa gnyis gtams pa rnyed pa nor la gdu ba zhen cing chags pa thug pa gdu ba gar po byed pa/ ming tha snyad gdags pa btags pa sbyar ba snyun nad gdangs pa drag pa sa bon skyed byed gdab pa btab pa/ kha sogs gdangs pa zu ba bgrad pa mtshon cha gdengs pa 'phyar ba gzas pa gdon mi za ba che tshom med pa nges pa/ da gdod da gzod de da lha lta bu'i rjes kyi dus sos gdal bde bar gnas pa'am snyom las gdeng nges pa spobs pa tshad yid brtan rgyu mtshan rtsis thob pa rted pa gda' 'dug gam mngon/ gdos pa gru'i rna ba'am rlung g.yor te gru'i dar po che thud gdar mar chung bsres pa'i zud gru bzhi lha bu mar gdar yang srang 'jal byed la go gdeg pa bteg pa 'jal/ gdags pa'i bstan bcos mngon pa sde bdun gyi gcig ste mo'u gal gyi bus brtsams pa'am bsdus pa gdam nga 'dam ka byed pa/ gdengs ka yod pa can klu rgyal sogs gdul bya sems can nam rta lha bu dam la gdags pa btags pa gzhag pa/ khrul gdal gnas lugs dang yongs grags gdod ma thog ma nas ming gdags bya'i gzhi gnas te 308
