bdag gi gung lnga sta bu bral med pa/ khrim bdag gdangs can thub pa'i sbyin bdag yin la des phul ba'i kun dga' ra ba dang lag gdub sor gdub gdub kor gdab pa gdal ba gdas pa sogs gas 'phul da'o//bdag nga'am nged tha mi dad kyi gcig rang bzhin dbang ba bden pa rnal ma ngo ma mi spu ba drang po bdud 'chi byed gnod byed bar chad bdun grangs shig mdun gyi phyogs nyid du bdar ba gral sgrig pa/ bde ba skyid pa dga' ba sim pa bdo ba dar ba 'phel ba zas thug sogs bda' ba ro zhim pa me la bdug rgyu'i spos bdug pa bdug bya dang bdug byed pa/ bda' ba dang ded pa gnyis rjes su 'ded pa'am ming tsam bdag pa po dbang ba po gzu bos bu lon zugs sogs bda' ba 'ded pa'am dbang med pa'i don yin zhing bdas pa ded zin pa/ bde ba legs pa'am bzang bar gshegs pa song ba'am rtogs pa ste rnam pa zams cad mkhyen pa bde zhing legs pa dge legs bden pa mi slu ba bdar ba bshad pa/ gzhu mda' stan bdungs pa bkug pa'am bkang ba bdog pa yod pa dang nor rdzas la sogs pa'i ming skyed bdar skye gla phebs skye byas pa'i jan pa bdar ba sbyin pa bdog pa yod pa'am 'dug pa/kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa yod pa gnyis dang bden bzhi sogs bdud 'chi ba rtsi 'joms byed kyi tshus te mi 'ami ba'am 'chi med kyang zer phye ma zhib mor tsardo na sogs bdar ba brdar nas zu mar byed pa/ phyag bdar 'thag pa'i ming ngam phyag cing bdar ba phyi bdar phyi ba'i ming ngam phyi zhing bdar ba dang bdugs bdag nyid bdag gi ba bdag lha sogs bas 'phul da'o//mda' nyag phran nam lung pa'i mtha' me mda' mda' tshad ma skar mda' mdung mtsho'i cha zhig 'phang mdung sogs mde'u mda' chung ba me mda' sogs kyi 309

mdel lam la bzhi dang sum mdo 'dzoms 'gag gnad ka'i don mdos yas stags/mdun drung rdzun nye ba mdongs sgro jig gam dpral ba'i cheg le mdog kha dog gam bkrag mdangs chod sogs kyi bkrag ga gzi byin mdo nyung ngur bsdus sdud pa mdo sdom pa dkri ba mdo sde mdo phyogs mdo sngags/ mdangs kha sang mdangs dgong dang mdang zhes kyang 'thad sang nyin mdong gsol ngo dga' bstod pa 'dun pa ra mda' rogs sam dpung dang / mdud pa bcings pa gos mdud mdud pa bor ba dang mdag ma mig mdongs mdan pa la sogs mas 'phul da'o//zu ngan sgyug bsngal 'da' ba dang 'das pa gnyis rgal ba 'chi ba zad pa dang phyi ma 'di dus gsum gyi gcig 'dun pa don gnyer 'dod pa gus pas 'dud pa btud pa/ 'dam pa 'jim pa 'dam skyes khrod nang 'dur 'dur 'gro tshul 'dong ba 'gro ba'i ming yin zhing 'dug pa sdod pa gnas pa yod pa mngon pa/ sgra dang bya ba sogs nang 'dom pa dus sam phyogs gcig tu tshogs pa 'dzom pa rjes su 'ded pa bda' ba skul ba gsol ba 'debs pa gdab pa nu 'dul byed pa 'don pa bton pa lag nas 'don pa sogs/ lha 'dre mi ma yin 'byung po shing 'drud pa drud pa khung du bu ga 'dru ba drus pa rko ba sngog pa rtol ba/ 'du byed las sa rtsol ba dang dngos po sogs 'dus shing byas pa mi rtag pa dngos po rgyu 'bras 'dres ma 'dres pa'i ming tsam 'dre ba chu 'o mnyam du 'dus pa 'dra snyam pa mtshungs pa dras pa/ 'drul pa rul ba'i don gtam gleng mo 'dri ba dris pa dri ba byed pa yi ge 'dri ba 'ji ba/ 'drid pa spu ba mgo skor ba'i don la 'jug cing khrims dang chu ngo tsha 'dral ba dral ba srog sogs 'dor ba gtong ba spong ba 'bor ba dor ba 'dar ba 'gul ba 'phrig pa/ 'degs pa bteg pa 'di thag nye ba dang da lha ba chos 'di pa 'dod pa khas len pa chags pa 310

dga' ba mos pa 'dul ba 'dul byed dam 'dul po dang sde snod gsum gyi gcig dang 'dul spyod gis 'dul ba btul ba gdul ba/ 'dam bu 'dam rtswa'i ming 'dab ma lo ma gsog par ka 'dab ma gsog pa chags pa ldan pa ste bya 'du ba 'dus pa tshogs pa nor/ ri bo'i 'dabs ri ngogs sa logs 'dabs kyang 'thad 'dol sa sa gshin po'am legs par go 'dag gu skyo ma'am spags 'dag pa rtses ldag pa dang 'dam/ blo dang rta sogs 'drog pa dogs nas 'dzur ba dkrogs pa khur drags pa zhabs rkang pa 'dred pa dred pa rdog stabs shor ba lta bu 'drad pa drad pa brdar ba sen mos 'dud pa la thob cing 'drud pa drud pa/ 'dren pa po thub pa lha dus drang bya drangs chos bslab bya 'doms pa gdams pa ston pa 'chad pa slob pa dge ba la 'dun pa don du gnyer ba'am tshogs pa yang na dge ba'i tshogs 'dus pa 'du ba'am tshogs pa/ 'do med bzo med dam gnad mi shes pa chen pa lta bu 'doms gsang gnas su go 'dom pa khru bzhi'i tshad gnu 'dom gang ba kha tshang ba 'dogs pa btags pa gdags pa/'dod pa chags pa'i yul dang yul can 'du shes bas pa'am mtshan mar 'dzin pa 'du 'dzi g.yeng yul lam chung ma la sogs par go 'dris pa goms pa rgyun du 'grogs pa/ skra 'dreg pa gcod pa bzhar ba'i mkhan po'am byed po 'deng ba 'gro ba'am gzhan du gtong ba'i phyir ched 'do ba rta'i 'dam pa 'dam ka byed pa/ 'di las 'das pa po gshin po 'chi po'i don 'dad pa sems la 'greng ba'am chags sems sogs kyis 'khor 'dabs 'khor nye du bcas 'dums pa mthun pa tshogs pa 'grig pa sdom pa 'dun yang snang / ming bla dwags 'dogs pa btags pa chu sogs 'dal ba dal ba dal po'i bya tshig skyo ma dang snag tsha 'dal ba khyab pa dal gyis 'gro ba/ 'dag chal khrus tshus sam 'dag byed kyi rdzas ba byung go 'dun sna tshogs pa de ma 'drog de ma 311

thag gam de blo 'drog ma song / dri ma sogs 'dag pa dag pa sbyong ba dang 'dun sa 'dren ma 'dri ba 'dum pa sogs 'as 'phul da'o/ /grong rdal grong gis khyab pa'am grong khyer mthar grong thar thor ram sngongs thog dang mthil dib pa phyi nas nang du 'bur ba'am kung ba lta bu rdo ba'i rje bo pha lam la sogs pa'i ming rdul spabs zla mtshan skyon grangs cad pa'i yon tan gsum gyi gcig rdo rje'i rdul gnam lcags/ rdo ba sped byed rdo'u rdol rdo chung ngu dang nad kyi khyad par dang cis rdel rdog po rdog ma ril bu'am gong bu nyag ma 'bru rdog po gcig lha du rdeg pa rdung ba bcug pa 'dres pa sogs kyang go rdugs po thogs pa thabs rdugs po lta bu/rdung 'tshog rdung deg dang rdung ba dkrol ba rdun pa gtubs pa 'khrab pa mnyed pa rgyag pa pheg rdob rol mo zhig dang lag pa rdob pa'i ming tsam pheb rdob kyang snang cha lang rol mo zhig rdob pa brdab pa dkrol ba spug pa rgyag pa/ glo deg mgyogs pa sogs rdab cing chal ba gtad med du 'gyel ba'am 'gag rdab pa lus po rdos gtos sa bongs chod che ba/ lag pa dang mjug ma sogs rdum pa med pa'am chad pa glo lto ba rdol ba rtol ba 'thon pa brdol ba dbu ba spu ba rdos pa thon pa thogs pa/ gri sogs rdor ba rdo 'don pa bkan nas 'drad pa brdar ba rdor cig kyang rdol chos rtsing chos sa spyod rtsing dang rdab pa rdul phra rab rdul phran rdal ba rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje lha bu'i ting 'dzin sogs rar btags da'o//nam mkha' la lding ba 'phyo ba g.yo ba bya spyi dang khyung 'khrug sgra brgya ldir ba sgra 'byin pa ldir skad sgrog pa ldab ldib mi gsal ba gsang po med pa'i skad/ lda ldi mchod rdzas shig lde mig sgo lcags 'byed byed yod pa'i don can gyi ldan pa bcas pa mthun pa 'grogs pa/ mgo ldog mgo 'jug log pa'am phyin ci log pa lto ba grod pa312

ldir ba 'bur ba rtsag pa rgya che ba rtsar rtsar shin tu tshos pa sil dur gyur pa rdzugs pa spug pa bcug pa/ seng ldeng shing ngam sman zhig ldem ldem mnyen lhag gam g.yo tshul lder bzo 'jim bzo'i don ldebs logs pa leb ma shog ldebs sogs/ ldong ros tsho'i nam man zhig ngad dri sogs kyi shugs sam nus pa ldang ba 'thul ba lang ba lde gu snan sogs ldir ba'i skyo ma'am bag zan sla ba lha bu byug pa 'byug pa/ rjes su 'jug pa 'gro ba'am len pa ldog pa 'dor ba mi mthun pa log pa'am med pa ldobs pa'am ldob pa 'i slob pa skyen pa myur ba ste shes par sla ba phyir blar mi ldog pa mi log pa brtan pa/skom btung lhud pa spud pa sbyin pa me dang nyi ma lde ba sro ba'am tsha bar byed pa ming gi don can gyi lde dpal lde skyid lde 'od lde khri srong lde'u btsan sogs/ lhum bu sngo'am tshal gyi ra ba tshal zhing dang skyed po lta bu'i ming kum bu tsā sngon nam sne'u ldab ldob mnyen pa'am snye ba dang / bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas ldem po 'khyog por dgongs pa bas pa mtha' drug gi gcig dris pa'i lan ldon pa 'jal ba 'debs pa/ bskyar ba dang ldab pa gnyis yang yang dang blos pa nyis ldab nyis 'gyur sum ldab ldab log sogs lhag ma lhag po ldas pa las pa'am lus pa/ ldan pa kha' 'tham pa mdan pa'i sdeb kyang rung so tshems ldeg pa g.yo ba blad pa za ba mig lta byed kyang ldongs pa long ba mdongs kyang rung / ne'u na chod chung ngu'am na chod ldang mnyam pa sten mnyam na zla ldom bu bsod stoms ldom bu ba bsod stoms pa stan gdan las ldang ba lang ba/bstan bcos dang gos sogs kyi ldang ba kha tshang ba'i tshad dang ldag pa ldem pa lding thag ldad pa lde'u mig ldeg so rjes su 'gro ldog gzhan sem gyi ldog pa la sogs lar btags da'o//zhe gting nas sdang ba khro ba gnod pa sdang ba'i mig mig log sdigs mo byed 313

pa'i mdzub mo sor mo zhig sdig pa gshe ba 'jigs su 'jug pa 'ben la gzir ba/sdar ma dpa' min nam snying stobs chung ba bde ba dge 'bras sdug bsngal mi dge ba'i 'bras bu dang skyid sgyug dge ba legs spyad bcu lha bu sdig pa mi dge ba bcu sogs dang ngan pa sdom pa spong ba rtsad pa sre ba 'ching ba rdom tshig lha bu1 sdings gteng ngam zhe dang dkyil dbus sogs kyi don sdong po yal ga gyes pa'i rten nam smon pa'am rtsa ba sdong bu sdong po chung ba'i don sde mang po'i tshogs sa tshoms rang sde gzhan sde sde bzhi lta bu/ tshe srog dang sdo ba brje bsdur ba srog gtong ba'i don yin zhing sde tshan dum bu bam po tsho sdeb pa spyod ba sdom pa 'grogs pa sgrig pa/ srog chags sems ldan chung ba'i bye brag sdom pa'am ba rgya byed mkhan sdig pa dngos dang sdig srid sder mo gcan gzan sogs kyi chen mo rdo ba rdon po/ so byang sngags kyi sdom pa spong ba spyod pa mi 'da' ba bsrung bya'i sdom pa dge bsnyen sogs sdod gnas 'dug gnas sdod pa bsdad pa gnas pa sdod cig /sdeb sbyor rig gnas chung ba lnga'i gcig dang rig byed kyi yan lag drug gi sdeb spyod rnam dbye dang yi ge'i sbyor ba sogs mdzes pa'i don can gyi sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sdug gu yang nor dang chos sogs phyogs gcig tu sdud pa bsdu ba gsog pa sdom pa tshogs par byed pa/ sdum pa khyim mam khang par 'jug mchod sdong mchod pa'i rten dang mchod sbyin gyi phyugs 'dogs pa'i ka ba sdom bu khang chung gis bskor ba/sder ma snod spyad kyi khyad par rag sder la sogs pa'i sgra thug pa skyo tsha la gdab rgyu'i sdor sha tshil sogs lag pa sor mo lnga bas sdom pa 'dzin pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' gsung la sdod pa gnas pa chos skyong sogs sde snod gsum ste bro bo che'i don rtor bshad dgos sdong ba sdos sdum pa sdus sdur ba sdoms sdug po sdigs sdig to can sdang po sogs sar btags da'o//314

gri mtshon brdar bdor ba brdog cing 'chos pa brdung zhing bcos pa sogs brdung bya nyes can lha bu brdungs pa rdung ba/ kha brdar ba gtam mang bshad pa bla bo gtam brdol ba byung rgyal du thon pa ste bab col lam nyid gtam ma mar ram cha lang brdab pa dang brdabs pa gnyis dab pa'am rdab pa/ rnga brdung ba rdung ba snan pa bro brdung ba rdung ba 'khyab pa go byed la 'dug pa'i brda lag bad go brda/ cha ma thang mar brdal ba dal ba bkra pad nas g.yab mo sogs brdul ba g.yob pa dang btul ba'i don yin zhing bdeg pa rdog pa/ chu brdol snod brdol brdung ba sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i da'o//bldabs pa bskyar ba ldab pa bzas nas bldag pa ldag pa rtses 'byog pa bldeg pa ldeg pa la thob cing bldad pa ldad pa zhib mor zad pa'am kur ba/ bldab pa sogs bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i da'o//bsdu bya nor sogs bsdu ba btu ba bsdus pa btus pa sdud pa bsdur ba sdur ba mnyam par byed pa 'gran pa bkun nas bsdad pa sdod pa 'dug pa/ nyes spyod sogs bsdams pa sdom pa spangs pa bsdoms pa sdom pa bsdus nas srog dang bsdos pa sdo ba/ 'og bsdogs 'og grabs sa sta gon nye bar bsdogs pa nye bar brtsams pa sta gon bas gzugs kyi sngon 'gro gzhan nyes can dang 'phen lta bu bsdigs pa sdig pa gshe ba sogs/ /grogs rogs dang bsdongs pa 'grogs pa mnyam du 'gro ba sdong ba bsdebs pa sdeb pa spyod ba sogs sna la btags pa'i thag pa dang gru gu bsdogs pa bsdus pa dril ba brtsams pa sdog pa/ 'gal ba mi mthun pa bsdum pa sdum pa mthun par byed pa chings sgrig pa gros byed pa dang bsdig pa bsdeb pa mdor bsdus sogs bas 'phul sar btags da'o//316

dmi phan pa bde bar byed pa gnod pa mi bde bar byed pa mnar ba gnas pa yod pa 'dug pa'i skabs go'am tshul la thabs sa dus te gnas tshul dang 'phral ma'am mthar thug min pa dang gnas thabs gnas dus gnang ba ster ba'am grub pa'am byed du rung ba bkag pa dgag pa byed du mi rung ba ste 'di gnyis 'dul ba'i brda gnad gsang ngam mdog gam rtsa ba gnad ka don gnad lus gnad sogs/ gnod sbyin gdon nam lha'i bye brag gnag nor ram 'bri g.yag sogs phyugs dud 'gro rta lug sogs kyang go gnam rgyu skar gyi la lhar dpe sgra gnag pa nag po'am nag po'i bya ba/ gnas brtan bcu drug gam 'od srungs chen po sogs nye bar gnas pa gam du sdod pa thag nyer yod pa gnas kyi slob ma gnas pa 'dus sa'i khang pa khyim gnas pa sdod pa yod pa brten pa mi 'gyur ba 'os pa/ gnod byed 'tshe byed rlag byed zil gzi brjid kyis 'og tu gnon pa mnan pa num par byed pa gna' sngon nam snga ma'i mi spru zhing don go ba'i gang zag gnubs rus shig ste sangs rgyas ye shes sogs/bying rgod zhi nas dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa ste bsam gtan sogs sngar gyi gnas skabs dor nas gzhan du 'gyur ba ste chu rtog ma dwangs pa lta bu yin la gnas yongs gyur pa yang zer don la gnas pa'i lugs ka gshis lugs ngo ma gnas tshul stong nyid rtogs pa shes pa/ gnangs sang gi phyi nyin gzhes gnangs kyi phyi nyin gnam ru gzhu mda' stan rkang pa zhabs kyis gnon pa mnan pa kha gnon log gnon rnam gnon/ zhe gting gnong ba nongs pa ste skyon gyis num pa'am 'gyod pa'am nongs 'khur ba gnad gcod 'chi nad lta bu gnas ngan pa len pa skye gnas mi legs par skye ba'am yang na sgo gsum byi gnas ngan len las su mi rung ba'am bag chags lta bu/ gnod pa'i gnas yul lam ba la dang gnas gnas min gnos shig 316

bka' gnang gna' bo gnod bya la sogs pa gas 'phul na'o//mnal gnyid log pa gnyid 'chi ba gdams pa gnyid log pa mna' ma bu'i chung ma bag ma 'og tu mnan pa gnon pa mi mtho bar byed pa/ mnab rtsal kha za dri sna'i yul mnam pa sdom pa'am bro ba dang dku ba mnar ba gzir ba de las lhag po med pa ste dmal ba zhig mnar ba gzir ba gnod pa nyen pa/ kun nas mnar ba 'tshe ba gnod pa'i sems bsam pa zas sogs mnog pa zhim pa mang ba gya nom pa mnog khe ma spogs dang phan chung ba phran bu/ mnol ba grib bam mi gtsang ba'i rigs rgyud dam gras mnol ri ltar na ri rtseg mna' bro bskyal ba bor ba'am sgog pa na bza' gos mnabs pa mnab pa rgyan pa gon pa gsol ba/ mno ba dang bsam pa gnyis bsam blo gtong ba'am bsam blo mnos pa mno ba bas sa pa thob pa len pa dang mna' chu gnol cig sogs mas 'phul na'o//rnam par shes pa sems sa shes pa rdon po rtul min nam mchog gam rdo ba'i ming tsam nol ma gnyug mar 'byor ba spyor ba sgom pa ting nge 'dzin thabs shes zung 'jug rnams mang tshig ste sangs rgyas dmas lta bu/ rnam par rtog pa kun rtog sems kyi 'char tshul rnam dbye rtog pa nyon mongs rnam grangs dbye ba'am rnam pa ming don gyi rnam grangs sogs rnam pa rnam grangs mdzes pa dam 'gyur rang bzhin mi rtag pa'i rnam pa sogs mang bas nyung min/ rna ba za 'dzin nam nyan byed kyi gshog pa 'dab ma ste 'bag sogs kyi rna chas gshog pa lta bu'am snyan gshog rtse mo dang po rdo ba non po'i bya ba rnal ma gnyug ma bden pa ngo ma'i don brjod bya sogs/ rdul dang khug sna lho bur ram du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu zhig rnag ces pa khrag rul nas dkar bor song ba zhing lo tog skye ba'i sa gzhi'i rnang ma chus khyab pa'i ched du nu'am sa sgang 'then pa ste don zhing 317

chu ma/ tshig phrad kyi bye brag rnam par di yongs su zhes pa 1 bu ste rnam par dag rnam par bshad pa sogs ra la don dang rnam mkhyen rnam 'grel rnam pa'i phra mo rnam kun rna dbang rna chas rna shal rna rgyan sogs rar btag na'o/ /snar ma dang smon dang snabs gsum sgyu skar gyi bye brag snag tsha yi ge 'ji byed kyi sdas dang snag gi tsha bo ste gnyen zhig snur ba 'dul ba rdzur kur byed pa zhib mor 'thag pa/ snang ba gsal ba sgrub pa mngon pa yum mthong ba tsha sna kha tha dad dam dbye ba'am du ma tshogs pa 'dus pa sna sgom byed thog ma rtse mo yi don snabs sna'i lud pa'am zag chu/ snam bu zheng chung la chu ring ba bal gyi gos sogs dang 'dod pa'i snam bu'i don snam phran sbyar ba'i gos te chos gos gsum gyi gcig snal ma gos rgyu'am snam bu'i spun nam skud pa'i don sne mo rtse mo 'go ma thog mas ra/ gnam sa'i bar gyi snang ba mthong ba bar snang du 'phur ba lha bu snang bdang gsal ba gnyis nun pa med pa'am 'od chags pa sgron ma snam 'bru mar rtsi mar sogs dang kum pa snam po mdog mi skya ba'am sang seng med pa dri dang mtshon dgo pa tshor ba dang thogs pa/ lam sna lam ston nam sna 'khrid par go sna bo gtso bo thog mar dpon po'i don snag nye du zhig dbon po spun nam tsha bo snang yod dam mngon/ yang dag pa lha bur snang ba mthong ba ste dngos min pa yang dag min pa mngon rjes skub pa sun 'byin ltar snang lha bu sna kha rigs mi 'dra ba mang po snal zhi 'chol ba'am go rims su mi gnas pa dang 'gred snod snod spyad dang snod du rung mi rung sogs/ yug snam btsag ga rdo zhig dang yug tshang ba'i snam du snam phran snam spyar gyi snam phran nam snam bu chung ba sna ma tsā ti'am tsā snye'i me tog dang srid shing sne'u sngo'am sngo dri 'gags sel ba dang rtse chung / snad yar zas pa'am skyod ka 8 pa snad pa'i ming tsam ser sna dam du 'dzin pa'am 'jungs pa'i don sgon

ma kha skor ldan khar go snoms shig dam pa'i skul tshig rol ltar na ba rol ba/ rgyab kyi don la go ba'i snam logs rgyab bam ngos sa zur dang kun pa ldan pa snar ba snar ba kun ba kun cig snang byed grub pa snad pa sogs sar btags na'o//brnab pa zags ba'am gzhan nor bdag gir 'dod pa'i sems bas pa sto zas sogs la brnan pa nan tan byed pa'am do ga la byed pa'i don yang yin brnangs pa chu rtsam sogs gre bar 'gags pa/ brnag pa bzod pa'am bas par dka' ba mi nus pa'i don brnag pa bzod pa'i bas pas mdun ga du bzur ba 'chen pa'am tshur 'dren pa/ sa la sbas pa'i don can gyi brdogs pa gab pa dang nges gzung la 'jug pa'i brnan pa dmigs su bzung ba'am bkar ba di spo'i 'jug yul lta du/brnang brdog sogs bas 'gul ra mgo ldan pa'i na'o//gnad gsang du bsnan pa kun pa rdog pa mtshon cha lag bsnun pa kun pa rgyag pa nu ma 'o 'dzin nam nu zho bsnun pa kun pa nu ru 'jug pa'am zud pa/ srog ka bsnubs pa snub pa nyams pa'am nub par byas pa gong 'og ltag 'og bsnor ba snar ba nor du 'jug pa dgrugs pa brje ba lta bu'i don yin zhing bsnol ba rol ba brje ba dang phan tshun nam bla 'og rim min du sbyor ba'am rtseg pa seng ge mjing bsgom dang do rje rgya gram lha bu snol mar byas pa/ mtshon cha bsnams pa thogs pa khyer ba bzung ba sgom pa dus phyi brdur phyi bshol rdur ba 'chen pa'am nye ru btang ba zhib mo zhib par bsnur ba snag tsha sogs rdur ba/ mjug ma rnga ma bsnar ba snar ba brkyang ba dri sna'i gzung bya bsnams pa sgom pa bro bar byas pa bsgoms kyang mthong nom nom snel pa'i tshul bsnems pa snem pa mnan pa'am dam dmabs pa/ mang po dang yang yang du kha bsnan pa ldan pa ldan ma bcug nas 'dres pa bsres pa'am legs par go bsnos pa 319

sgo ba ba jis pa mnyed pa 'phur ba sprus pa/ bsnam bsgo bsgo bsnad pa sogs bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i na'o//dzod par pa pang pa'am thu ba ma pang bu 'jug lha bur go par bu sdod kyi bye brag mar par zhag par sogs pi wang sna snyan nam sgyud mangs 'dzin pa 'chang ba/gcig pu grogs med pa rkyang pa reng dur go spur ri mo 'bri byed dam tshon 'byug byed la go ba'i don can gyis ngos la pa tra shing lo'am ri mo bris pa 'bri ba/ pu shu mda' yab lan kan spen rgya'i don pu shud 'dab chags shig pur gyis 'phur tshul pur ba 'phur ba mkha' la 'gro ba/ puṇ+ḍa rī ka gdugs dkar chu skyes dkar po stag dang phyogs kyi glang po dang bur shing gsum gyi bye brag spu spu ling spu sga lī zur chag pa ste grog ma dang dpyibs mdog 'dra ba'i sman zhig yin pas grog snan yang grags/ pa shi bod kyi btsun pa rgya nag tu phyin pa'i ming pad+ma 'phyo ba 'dam skyes pa la sha rgya skyegs kyi shing bal sha yang zer/ pus mo sbyid khug gi mdun cha pus tshigs pus lhang btsugs pa 'dzugs pa pog spos por pa phor pa blug snad ga pur ka zur zur chag pa ste nus can yin ga pur yang zer ba sman zhig 'thul ba dri ngad ldang ba du ba 'phyur ba/ par ma spar zin pa'i dngos po dang par zhes pa 'dra ba dang spar ba'i ming tsam mtshon pa'i sgra po ti glegs bam ste pu sta ka zur chags pa paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros dang 'grogs pa mkhas pa lnga rig pa/ ze prog sgo lcags kyi ze ma'i rtse dang ze ba'i rtse yin snyam srog zhu dbu rgyan dang rtse zhwa sbog ces pa rtse la grags 'og pag ska rags kyi rgyan nam rked pa la 'phyang ba'i tshar tshar dang / pur ro'am gdung de'i khang pa ro khang gdung khang sreg khang par tang dre'u rngog gam stan khra po ṭa la gru 'dzin te sgra nyams nas po ta la sgrol ma'i gnas ri zhig dang dmar po ri/ pu sa la sman 'o su dang pu shel tse sman zhig ste bya zas dang khru nga 320

yang byed rung ba'i rtswa/ pa sangs pa la sangs gza' bdun gyi gcig pra phab pa za se na 'bebs pa sngags sogs la brted nas skog gyur gsal bar ston pa mo btab pa bri la du sngo gling 'bru gsum gyi bye brag la 'jug /pags pa shun pa skogs pa gzig gi pags pa sogs lag pod lag tshang lag pa g.yar ba phan tshud las ka'i rogs re mos byed pa'i ming tsam po zos pa ji lhar thogs pa re ltar thogs pa ji tsam 'gor bar gyur kyang ni sdud sgra ste re lhar thogs kyang lan bdun pa lta du/ par gyis 'dir tshul 'phar ba 'phag pa dang cod pan pa na sa ut+pal te por pupe sku par sogs pa rkyang ngo //dpag pa 'jal ba'i tshad de rgyang grags brgyad sogs dang rtags mthong 'brel ba nges pa'i rjes su skog snar dpag pa 'jal ba nges pa rtogs par byed pa dpag bya lkog gyur gyi gzhal bya dam bca' rtags kyi yul bsgrub bya rtogs bya dang gzhal bya tsam dpog pa 'jal ba nges pa rtogs par byed pa/ rgyal po sa gzhi skyod ba la sogs pa'i ming dpya zhes pa khral yin la lag dpyar yang 'gur snang dpyang pa 'phyang ba thur du da sbyongs byed kyi thag pa gdang thag sogs dpyangs pa 'phyang ba thur du btang ba/ dpag pa tshad dam gzhal du med pa ma mchis pa dmag g.yul gyi dpung tshogs sam rgyal byed dpung bu chung rkang thang gi dmag rkang dmag don nam dpe can gyi dpe'am dper brjod dam bkod na nges bzung ngam dmigs kyis 'byed pa dpe dang phal cher 'brel ba'i byad gzugs yin nam snyam ste dpyad don chen mo zangs mdog sogs brgyad cu dpe cha chegs bam yig cha dpen pa mkho ba yid du 'ong ba phangs pa/ rnam par dpyod pa khyad 'phags kyi shes rab dang dam par dpyad pa rtog pa dang dpyod pa gnyis blos 'jal ba tsam mam rtsing zhib kyi khyad kyang yod brtag pa 321

dang dpyad pa gnyis gzhal ba dang rtog dpyod kyi yul lam bya las dang gcig tu smol na ming tsam yin pa 'de gong 'og la bsgri dgos pa dang / rje bo gtso bo gnan nu gdong drug dpon po dbang byed po slob pa'am klog pa'i dpon po bla ma sems pa bsam pa dpa' ba mi ldog pa snying stobs brtan pa che ba chen po rgyal sras sogs/ dbyed jig le'am dpal dang dus kyi dbye ba dpyid ka da dra ba zin ma'i steng gi ngos sa thod par go dpyi mgo stabar ram dkun snyi dang nu ma'i bar zer ba lha du dpyongs pa dpyang ba dang da sbyongs shig kyang / shing nga dpung bcad dge slong ma'i nu sgrib kyi gos phu bcad lus kyi dpung pa mdzes byed kyi rgyan dpung gdub dang / dar gos thur du dpyangs pa rgyan zhig dpangs zhes pa mtho dman gyi tshad dam 'phang ngam mtho tshad dpag bsam gyi shing lha'i smon shing sogs/ dpa' bo snying stobs can sdar ma min pa dpa' ba spro ba 'phel ba snying stobs brtan pa'i don dpang po che bzhi'am gnya' bos yi ge sogs dpod pa gzhan la 'jir bcu gnas rang gis smos pa lha bu/ snan khong du btang nas nad gso bar byed pa dang dpyad thur ma sogs kyis nad ji nas 'dren pa'am phyir 'don pa'am 'byin par byed pa ste gso rig dpyis mtha'am gting phyin pa son pa thon pa dpyas pa 'phya ba'am dpya ba'am skyon mi 'dogs pa spyod ba/ dpal ji skad du/ dpal mo dbyangs can blo dang sde gsum mi /phun sum tshogs dang 'byor pa mdzes pa dang / /'tshog chas 'jigs med tshal dang 'phags pa dang / /bdud rtsi dmas la dpal zhes rab tu grags/ /zhes pa'i don dang ldan pa bcas pa dpang rus shig lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa dang dpyal dpung gnyin dpag yas dpag gzhi dpags dpa' mo sogs das 'phul pa'o//pha spad pha du'am pha khu spun zla sku mchen nye du spang bya dor bya gnam bya sbyang bya 322

spong byed kyi yul spangs pa dor ba sogs 'das pa/ sprad po dbul po med po'i ming spar mo bag pa'i sper ba ngas pa lta du dang sprur mo'i don spa shing gi ste brag sba yang zer spa dbyug spu 'khar sprad pa sgrod pa ste gtad pa 'phrod pa/ bdug pa jig pa sogs kyi spos lta bu spren pa chu 'dzin spro ba da lta ma 'ongs dang spros 'das skul te don 'od sogs 'phro ba gtong ba rgyas par byed pa longs pa tshang bar spyod pa kun pa 'dod yon nam 'byor ba'i ming yang yin spyod pa spyad pa 'jug pa nyams su rngong ba ba'i ba'i gas bya ba byed tshul ba'i ba pa ya rabs kyi spyod pa sogs/ spang spos bdug spos ral ba can zhig spar ba dang spor ba me sogs 'bar du 'jug snga ma 'das ma 'ongs phyi ma da lta ba skul tshig ste 'di rigs la rtags 'jug nas dus gsum 'byed tshul dngos su ma bstan kyang 'di lhar lag len nyer spyod dang bsgyun nas rigs ba spen ma shing zhig spyil bo tsā sogs kyi khang pa spyil bu khang chung spro ba dga' ba skyid pa dro ba'am tsha ba brtson pa/spen tog rgyan zhig spug rin chen zhig ste chab rom lo stong tshan na spug tu 'gyur bar bshad snyam rin chen mchog gis spud pa brgyan pa sprus pas spa ba mdzes pa ba'i da chags pa/ go gnas dang gong sogs mtho bar spar ba sgor ba 'phar du 'jug pa bteg pa 'dren pa par rgyag pa spel ba bya 'dab chags dang shog bu spur ba 'dur du 'jug pa sding bar byed pa spur bya spur byed spur zin spur cig ces pa rto bu bya tshig dus gsum gzugs mi 'gyur ba kun la sbyar gnas gzhan du spags pa 'phag tu 'jug pa btang ba song ba 'dur ba/ mgo las skyes pa'i spu tho dang ba spu sogs spug sprug rdul sogs sprug tshul lam ming tsam thag pa'i thags su bran pa nyid kyi rgyu la spyan rgyu'i spun snal ma/ spe'u mkhar ram khang chung ngam rdong po'i ming gces spras gces po jis chen snying sdug spyad bya'i dngos po ka ca nor gyi spyi ming spel ba 'phel du 'jug pa skyed pa 323

sbyar ba sre ba/ spa ma shug pa lha bu'i shing zhig spru nag ma sngo snan zhig spra ba me len gyi rdzas mgo spra ba'i me tog lhar dkar zer ba lha bu spungs pa spung ba du ma gcig tu phung por byas pa sdom pa bcer ba1 spra cha 'do med dam gtad med lang shor rgan po spu ma lang ba lta bu spod zas kyi bro ba skyed byed sga pe sogs dang zho 'o ma chu sogs kyi spris ma kha' zhag lha bu spags pa bsres pa bsgos pa spags ma dang spags gnyis spags nas za lha bu/ phan tshun 'thab mo 'khrug 'dzing sprad pa dang sprod pa gnyis sbyor ba thug pa'am rgyag tu 'jug pa spyos pa spyo ba gshe ba bsdigs nas sgyugs pa gzhan du brdzangs pa'am bskad pa/ spyi thun mong gtso bo ldog pa rigs sgos bye brag gam sger spel ma re mos sam 'dres ma lha bur go 'phrin za spring ba dang smings pa gnyis skur ba sring ba 'bri ba 'gro ba/ zongs nun gyis sprul pa bskyed pa ste rang bzo lha bu spong ba pa sbong ba po'am sgom pa po spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo lta bu spongs shig spong ba'i skul tshig spyod pa ba nu stegs kyi bye brag tshur spyon byon nam 'byon dus gsum gzugs gcig snyam dka' ba'i las spyad pa spyod pa chos spyod yi ge 'dzi ba dang sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang sems bskyed sogs bcu tshan gsum lta bu spor ba mang du spel ba/ spros pa 'gag pa sogs dang mtshan ma dang rtog pa sogs dang bral ba spangs pa sprul pa sbyid pa'am stob pa bskyed pa 'phrul du 'jug pa mchog sprul sogs gza' bdun gyi gcig la spen pa zer/ gos rgyan pa gnas rigs pa spo ba spos pa brje ba sgyur ba bsgro ba chu bor gru shan sogs spyings pa spying ba bying du bcug pa spra tshil sbrang rtsi'i ro ma'am snyigs ma lhung bzed glon byed dang lhags g.ya' len byed spyin 'byor byed kyi rdzas shig kha spyin lha bu/khe la 'jug pa'i spogs rgyal kha skyed bogs 'don pa spyang ki gcan gzan zhig spra sprel che spre'u spre g.yo byed/ spyang po grung po sgrin po'i ming sgobs pa gdeng mi 'jigs pa 324

sngon ma thos pa'i chos don rtogs nas bskal par bshad kyang mi zad par byed pas dge ba legs spyad mi dgag tshig spyom pa ngom pa'am bdag nyid sgrog pa spyoms pa/ spyi blugs chab bum ril ba kha spub kha 'og tu bstan pa lhang bzed kha spub pa rgyan dang dpal gyis lus la spras pa mtshan pa brgyan pa spud pa/ spyi bo spyi gtsug mgo bo rtse mo rdul can gyi gos sprugs pa sprug sprug byas pa rdul gyi don la thob pa'i spabs rdul chags pa rna spabs sogs/ sgo gsu gyi spyod pa byed lugs spa bkong ba zhum par byas pa ri bo yi spo rtse mo'am mtho ba'am rtse'i thang ngam rmang 'gram yang yin snyam/ mig gi don la 'jug pa'i spyan 'dren byed spyan pa lta rtog mkhan nam gnyer pa lha bu dang spos pa spong ba spu la bab pa sprug pa spyi mtshad spang sbongs spun pa bsres pa'am thung ba sogs sar btags pa'o//stag lhags stag gi pags pa ste 'dir gzhi dang ma 'brel ba dang drug sgra yod na pa rkyang dang drug sgra med na la mgo can te ma 'brel ba ni pags pa lta bu dang mi lhags snying lngags la sogs lar btags pa'o///dge phang pa pang ba'am ngos dang thu bar go phun sum tshogs pa dpal legs pa dge tshogs phun tshogs kyi gzhi tshugs zug pa'am chags shing tshig phrad dam rkang 'thung phun zhes pa tshad kyi khyad par te phud gang phun re sdud lta bu/ phrug gu na phra ba'i pyis pa dang phrad pa mjal ba thug pa sprud pa 'phrad pa rdul phran rdul phra rab bdun lha bu phran bu chung ba gyin cung zad phra ba zab pa zhib pa phra mo chung ngu / brgya stong khri phrag tsho phyang ba 'phyang ba'i ming phrul ba 'phrul ba'i ming ngam yang na thur du phyang zhing zul ba'i rgyan phyal grod pa'i zhe sa phyang nge ba 'phyang tshul 'jol le ba/ phyug pa po rdor can 'byor ldan 'byor pa yod pa'i don phyir ched don slad du phyogs chos dang 326

chos can dang de tshogs pa'i bsgrub bya'am dam bca' dang rgya brten dang ris dang mthun dang shar sogs mtshams bcas bcur go phyin pa 'gro ba son pa song ba thob pa/phyag dar phyags snyegs phyag dar khrod sogs phyi sa dri chen bshang ba'i ming zu ma zhib tu btags pa'i snan sogs zu rtsam pa zu ma/ phywa gtso bo mo dpal la g.yang mkhan po byed po phongs pa dbul ba nyam thag pa des phying ba ma btags pa'i gos phying zhwa jing dmar rul pa 'dral ba'am rnying ba phyar ba gdengs pa gzas pa brtsams pa 'phyar ba/phyi bdar phyi zhing phan tshun bdar ba'am ming tsam mam phyi ba'i ras dum gyis cog tse dang ri mo phyis pa dag par byas pa dbyi ba jis shig kyang phyags ma rdul 'phyag byed kyis phyags pa 'phyag pa gad rgyag pa/ nam mtshan phyed dgung zud ka zud ma zun 'og rlung rtug dri gtong ba btang ba phyi rdo 'phongs phyi ba'i do dang phyi brgyab kyi rdo phang ba 'phed pa'i ming / dbang gis phyug pa lha chen rgyal po gtso bo mgon po dbugs phyung ba sems gso btang ba gnas spar ba dbugs bton pa tsam phyung ba 'jin pa bton pa sgo la srol phye ba 'byed pa btod pa brtsams pa phral ba bkrol nas/ phyags lham rkang pa la gyon rgyu'i lham mchil lham sogs phran tshegs chung ngu'am nyung ngu dang 'dul lung sde bzhe'i gcig phreng ba go rims su bstar ba'i gral lha bu phrogs pa 'phrog pa len pa tshar gcod pa phrogs shig /phra men lha'i g.yog 'khor ram gdod phrin las las ka mdzad pa bya ba bya byed kyi las sa thos bas sogs phyod che ba tshegs chung gis don chen sgrub pa'i ming ngam speb che ba/ phyugs dud 'gro'i bye brag da sogs kyi ming phru ma mngal gyi du snod dam sha ma bye ma leb me rtser rtsebs pa'i srog chags shig phru ba snod ngo ma'am rje'u khog ma'i ming phyir phyi ru'am phyi rol tu phyung ba 'jin pa bton pa bkar ba bkol ba bskyed pa phyag lag pa'am sor mo lnga pa dag gis dar sogs phyor 326

cig 'phyar ba'i skul tshig smin ma mche ba'i phrag bar mtshams phyag 'tshal ba 'dud pa phyag byed pa nyin mo dang mtshan ba'i dus phyad pa rgyud pa rtag pa phyad par kun du 'ams ga tu/ phra ma dgyen nam skyo ma mi mthun par byed pa'i tshig phrag dog gzhan gyi gun tshogs la mi dga' ba'i sems phrag pa dpung mtshams kyi cha phrag par khur longs phrag gong lta bu phral ba zu ba bral ba tha dad du byed pa/ phyin chad phan chad tshod kyi cha yid sems phyung ba mi dga' ba'am skyo ba bskyed pa yid byung ba sun ci phyin pa rang gis rang sun 'jin pa dang gzhan la sun ci nus 'jin pa/ phyi rjes 'brang ba snyeg pa phyir phyi ru'am rgyab tu dang yang ngam blar phyogs pa kha bstan pa gzhol ba 'jug pa phyin ci log pa nor ba go log pa mi bden pa/ mi pham pa ma ba pa rgyal ba rgyal tshab byams pa tshig pad tshun phrad pa spyod ba ste blar bsgyu sogs yin tshig dang don rnam par dbye ba 'byed pa tha dad par byed pa dang po sogs zud pa'i da par shes pa ma 'dres par rtogs pa ngos 'dzin pa/ phru ma dmag snar dang dza zang phyar ba 'phyar ba rgod cing g.yeng ba ste dam g.ye rang phru dang zhabs phyi zhe sa'i spyag ji phyi phyi nang gyi mig rgyu mtshan gyi phyir pha bu pha lam gu nu ra phyin dza ba dza long sogs pha rkyang ngo //gzhan skyon can la 'tha bdang 'phyas pa gnyis tsho'i pa skyon brjod pa dpya ba 'od dang sems 'phro ba dang 'phros pa 'gyed pa 'tsher ba g.yeng ba zo ba/ 'phyi ba sa khung gi sog gas shig 'bye bo rkang med sto ba sogs kyis 'gro mkhan dus chod 'phyi dang 'phyis pa 'grungs pa 'gor ba/ rnam par 'phrul ba sprul pa g.yo ba 'gyur ba sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul rnam 'gyar snang cha spul pa sgyu dra sogs mda' sgro ldan 'phen pa dang 'phangs pa skyel ba sgyur ba deg pa brgyab pa 'phang ba rlag pa/ nam mkha' 'phang mthon po khri gdan 'phang mthon po'am steng go 'phang go gnas sa go sa mthon po 327

'phrog pa phrogs pa dang 'phrog byed/ mtsho dang dud pa'am du ba spu ba 'phyur ba blud pa 'thul ba thon pa 'tshubs pa dung phyur grangs gnas shig lam 'jug ngogs 'phyug pa dang 'phyugs pa gnyis nor ba 'dzol ba 'chugs kyang 'thad/ snying don gyi rgyal po'am sems 'phyo ba g.yo ba mi bde ba'i don 'phyon ma snad 'tshong ma 'jud mthun mas phye rtsam sogs spun pa 'phyar ba phyar ba rlung la bstan pa bkag pa'am brkyang ba lta bu 'phangs pa 'phen pa chud zos pa 'phangs bstod snad kyang / 'phongs tshos rkub tshos tshang ra rkub kyi ming 'phag 'phag gyen du 'phag tshul lam yang yang 'phag pa mgo bo dang thum po 'phur ba mnyed pa dang mkha' la 'gro ba/ 'phong mda'am mda' rig 'phong dpyad 'phong skyed sna lnga dag gis gzhan pha rol 'pham pa bam pa glags rnyed pa thub pa 'phal ka ri mo'am shing sogs sbyor mtshangs kyi kha 'grig pa sgrig pa/ brtsan pa dbang med du 'tsho pa'am yan pa'i don yin zhing 'phyo ba g.yo ba'am lding ba lding lding byed pa dar bo che sogs 'phyar ba phyar ba slong ba 'phral ma myur ba de ma thag glo bur te 'phral du song lta bu/ 'phrin gzhan la bskur ba'i gtam mam lon te 'phrin yig 'phrid pa lta bu 'phrod pa zod pa mthun pa phan pa'ang 'phyod pa 'chi 'phras shi sdug gam skya ngan sems snying la 'phreng ba ni 'dzin pa ma brjed par dran pa mags pa dang bgrang 'phreng / 'phral ba gdong sga dpral ba dang so sor phral ba skra dang bal 'phyings pa dam du 'brel ba'am phying pa lhar gyur pa phyag dar phyags snyigs 'phyag pa phyags pa byi dor byas pa/ 'phyang ba thur du dpyang ba mchu 'phyang rna 'phyang lta bu dang 'bye ba 'gro ba'am brang sogs kyis 'gro ba dang bgrad kyang yin snyam 'phang 'phres 'phral 'phags 'phul rdu 'phrul cho 'phrul 'phar 'thangs 'pho 'phos 'phan 'phel sogs 'as ༷'phul pha'o//328

lha'i bla mad gong ma steng ma phyi ma dam pa slob dpon rtsi ba'i don bla na gong na'am gong man sogs bla bre mchod tshus sa thog yol bre ba dang bres pa phan tshun ze ba spyas pa/ byams pa bde ba dang ldan 'dod phan 'dod mdza' ba ma pham pas byad mthu gnod pa zu ngan byur zu ngan lhas ngan gang tshul byabs pa zur du 'then pa'am 'og tu 'dren pa dang sel ba dor bas byer ba bros pa 'thor ba song ba khyab pa/ sbo 'jil byed bre bo che ze kha la sogs pa yi don bye ma zu ma gaṅgā'i bye ma sogs kyis brabs pa 'brab pa gtor ba kun pa rgyag pa 'ju bas byang ba speng ba sbyangs pa mkhas pa 'byongs pa dag pa/ bran rtso mob/mog rtso mo byes gzhis min pa phyogs byes pa sogs byon pa 'byon pa phebs pa byung ba byug pa sgrub sogs 'byug tshus byin pa sbyin pa ster ba gnang ba/ byis pa shed ba bye ba ka'aphags mkhas thun rgan gnan gyi zlas zu ba'i pyis pas bya ra lta rtog spyan pa mel tshe'i ming bya ba dgos pa las ka mdzad pa bya ba'i las byos shig gyis shig grugs shig /bram ze zad ṇa zur chag pa ste tshangs pa'i bu rgyud rigs bzhi'i gcig brag 'i ri bo dang brag nun brag skyibs lta bu'i don byang phyogs bzhi'i ya gyal du grags byol ba 'dzur ba'am yol ba 'byor ba byol cig kyang / bya 'dab chags dang rus shig dang bgyi byi'u bya chung ngam bya zug gyi ba lo skor bcu gnyis kyi dang po byi la byi ba'i dgra byad bzhin dbyibs tshugs dgra/ byol song dud 'gro dang thogs med du 'gro ba brang gis 'gro ba sprul la sogs pa'i ming brang lus kyi mthong ga dang bla brang pho brang byil byil bshud pa'am bshad pa'i tshul lam dbyibs lha bu/ bla gab steng ngam thog g.yogs bla gos steng ngam stod gos grus pa spu ba rin gyis nyos pa blus shig kyang go bla rung bzod chog blun pa sems med lha bu'am rmongs pa po can nam bdag sgra yin snyam 'dam dang chub bying ba nub pa spyings pa blo gros rig pa shes 329

rab blong blong po rtab rtab po tshabs tshabs po mi bde ba rig pa mi gsal ba/ bro nad kyi ming bro 'tshal ba na ba thabs nub byed dang bral ba zhes pa 'bral ba 'phral ba spangs pa bro bor ba mna' bskyal ba'am sgog pa bros pa 'bros pa 'a sa pa bros shig /byan mo g.yog mo'am thug 'chod ma'i don byi bo gyi byed po gzhan gyi chung ma spyod mkhan nam 'chal po dang pyi mo gyi zug kyang mtshon par byed rang byan chud pa rang dbang thob pa'am gyur pa/ byag mkhan mda' mkhan nam gar mkhan bro zhabs bro gar rngos gar lta khu bye ba grangs shig dang rgyas pa dang zal bas brel ba dal khor med pa/ kha' so yis blad pa ldad pa 'ba' ba bce pa chu zang blud pa kud pa ster ba zas thug brims pa 'jim pa ster ba 'dren pa brims shig zod par ga' bdang rtse ba zod po rtsed mo'am dga' po/ bya na bya kun zur ga thug pa'am chod ma ste spags ma'am ro gsal ba'i don yo byad spyod dngos byur bu gang tshul lam zur bur go blugs pa blug pa bcug pa rtsags pa blugs shig kyang / da byid stobs skyed stan skyid gror ro rgod dri zo ba myong ba tshor ba bra ba byi ba lha bu'i sems can zun lud skyag bya zun lha bu/ dong khung sogs su brubs pa 'brub pa nang du bcug pa mi thar bar byed pas bas shig chu bo brug pa rgyas pa gang ba bru ba tsha bdang zu ba di ltogs pa bkres pa/ gos spyon gos sogs byer ba dman pa zhan pa ngan pa yin snyam gos zud lhar da tshem bu pa btso blag tshos sam khrus tso blag mkhan lta bu gos sogs kyis byibs pa g.yogs pa bkab pa/bla gnyan po gnad rten rtsa ba yin snyam tsho po'i don nam srog byang bu brjed byang chung ba kha ming mdzad 'gyur shing byang lha bur go ba bla tshon ser po zhig byugs pa bskus pa 'byug pa byugs shig kha dang lag pa yis blangs pa len pa blang ba sgrub pa 'jug pa bla thabs brngod bde'am rung thabs bde blag bla ba glo bur sa bla sa steng ngam sa las 330

'phags pa'i snyeng gis khyer ba khur ba/ blo rig brid pa 'jid pa ba nus pa bla dwags ming gi rnam grangs sa ming btags pa'am thogs pa yi ge ri mor bris pa bkod pa ji ba bris shig kyang / spu bla byi ba ma btogs kyang med par sgyur pa dang ri mo byi ba yang cha byad cha lugs gzi byin gzi ba'i dad la nus pa bri ba 'ji ba nyams pa 'greb pa 'jid pa/ byi bzhin dang bra nye gnyis skad ma jird par go bra bo 'byu'i khyad par rgya za sogs zu rtsam chang sgyu ba btsa ba grug pa/ byug ris gral la go rims bya ba bgyi ba'am zer ba'i ming bye brag nang gzhes da par gas ba la/ rgyal po sa skyod gi blon po sos byed po mdun na 'don blo gros kyi mig spyan bde blag bya bla bdaka' tshogs med par sa par byed pa bgyid bsnyed las/ blang ba len pa dor dor ba blon 'debs bkar nas sos 'debs pa'am ston pa bla bo gtam mam brngod pa ga khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba 'byung ba zung ba'am phul byung mkha spu bregs pa 'breg pa gcod pa rna ba nyan byed blags pa rna ba gtod pa nyan pa blogs shig nyon cig /lto gos zas gos brang breng ngan ngon nam snyen bya dga' gnang sbyin nam zho shar go byin pa ster ba sbyin pa/ snan gyi bla ma snan rgyal byang ba spang ba chub pa rtogs pa'am byang nas shes pa'am goms cha che ba bla na gong na med pa ma mchis pa/ gzi byin gyis rlabs pa slob pa'i ming tsam nus pa'i don 'dra byu ru dang pyi ru rin chen dmar po dang brang snyes kha brag byings gtong za ba byung ba pyin rten bong bab po bul ba babs pa bu gzus zang ra sogs pa ba rkyang ngo //dbyen pa mi mthun pa phra ma dbye ba'i ming dang dbye ba zu ba bye zag bad par bral ba spangs pa chos rnams kyi dbyings rang bzhin khams 'dzin byed 'byung gnas sgra'i skabs pyings kyang zer dbyibs gzugs kyi khyad par ring zung sogs/ dbye ba 331

byar med pa tha mi dad pa gcig pa dbu ma dang dbung dang dbus ma gsum dkyil ma bar pa mab 'a bral gyi don gcig kyang tshig sbyor legs tshul grags pa bzhin gyed dbus na mo yang / dbyu gu chu chod dang shing tsu dang dbyug pa chung ba dbyig pa dang dbyug pa gnyis ber ka'i ming snga ma brda rnying dbyugs pa dbyug pa sgyur ba 'phen pa kun pa dor ba yang 'jug med pa 'di da lta ba dang ma 'ongs par 'thad dbyugs shig kyang / jing bu'i chu dbol pa btang ba 'chor ba rtol ba chu dang 'bru dbo ba pho ba 'bo ba bshos pa skar ma'i khyad par la 'jug pa'i dbo dang dbo zla/ phyir dbyung ba phyir sgyung ba 'byin pa bton pa sun dbyung ba 'byin pa sgyung ba bton pa mtsho'i dang lcags gzer gyis dgug pa phug pa 'bugs pa rtol ba/ dbul ba po bkron po med po spyang pos dbugs kha sna'i rlung lha bu dbyung ba jing ba 'byid pa bton pa nor spyad dngos mi dgag tshig dbrog pa 'phrog pa 'joms pa/ tshon rtsi yi ge dbyi ba 'byid pa phyis pa 'dag par byed pa'am sub pa dbyig mo 'jam po la sogs par go dbyig dbyig dbur tshul 'jam 'jam byil byil sgra'i khyad par yang yin snyam dbur ba 'jam por byed pa 'khrud pa/ dbon po tsha bo sku mched rtsis pas dbyangs gdangs nga ro 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can ma dbul ba 'dul ba phul ba skur ba sbyin pa mchod pa sna dma' ba'i don yin 'dra mi dgag tshig dbab pa 'bebs pa 'bab tu 'jug pa bab pa sprel na sna 'bebs mi byed pa'i don/ dbyig gnyen kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbu mgo rtse mo gong ma gtso bo gzhung bya ba lus kyi dbu zhabs lta bu la go gdugs gur thog kyang dbub pa 'bubs pa phub pa bkab pa lha bu/ dbang bskur ba byed rung ba'i dbang sprad pa gtor ba dang blug pa'i don byin rlabs sogs dbab pa 'bebs pa phab pa gtan la dbab pa don la gnas par byed pa 'bebs pa phab pa/ bar ma chad pa'i 332

lung dbog pa 'bogs pa phog pa mnod pa len pa sbyin pa nor khur dbog pa 'bogs pa dzag pa bzhag pa gtad ka pa dben pa bas mtha' mi g.yo ba stong pa ste dben sar dben gnas su dkal ba 'phral ba phral ba ral du 'jug pa yang / dbang phyug spu ma'i bdag po sogs dbang ba mnga' ba dang ldan pa byang shar ram dbang can dbang thang mnga' thang kha rje dbyar ka dus shig dbyar gdas dbyar rnga/ dbang bya la dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis sam mi'i dbang po sogs dbyig nor ram rin po che mang po dpral ba sogs dbyes khyod na rgya che ba/ dba' rlabs ba rlabs dbu ba spu ba skyon dang mar gyis dbags pa 'bags pa bsgos pa bsres pa 'das pa la dbags 'thad dam dpyad/ dbre ba dang bzug pa gnyis dme ba mi gtsang ba ngan pa gyong po kha dbri ba 'brid pa phri ba dma' bar byed pa zhe sa gus pa'i dod can gyi dba' ste lags so lta bu/ dbal zhes pa ni sha nyams shed mo dang rtse mo'am zur dang drod dang tog la 'jug ste rim bzhin rta'i dbal phur ba'i dbal me'i dbal rgyal mtshan gyi dbal lta du dang shugs kyang yin snyam/ zha nye las byas pa'i dbyar 'dab rod stegs sa dge slong ma'i lhung bzed kyi stegs bu dang dgyig dug dpyig 'dzin yid dbyung phongs pa'i dbul ba dbad pa dgyibs mnga' sogs das 'phul ba'o//rab tu 'byams pa dang 'tshos klas pa gnyis mtha' klas pa'am mang po snga ma brdus na lha rams lta bu 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung bzhi grangs 'brug dbyar rnga'am srin sna/ 'bral ba bral ba med pa dgag tshig dang 'brel ba'am pa zel ba phan tshun spyor ba mthun pa nye 'brel 'ag 'brel 'bras bu bskyed bya gzhag bya don dgos pa dngos po 'bru das so sogs dang 'bru bdag ba dang tshugag 'bring po bar ma dkyil 'dam chub 'bying ba pying ba nub pa 'brum pa3 nad kyis da par 'brum 333

dkar nag 'byang ba byang ba spyong ba lto ba sa bdag pa/ 'brog dben pa dgon pa yul 'a ga gi ming 'dzi mo gnag gi khyad par 'bong ri dgas g.yag rgod rus kyi zu brag gcig la 'grom du grags/ /'byung bar 'ab ba ma 'ongs pa'am ka'agyur tshe 'byid pa phyid pa 'tsho ba tshe mgo 'thon pa'am tsho ba 'drid pa'i don la 'byid pa 'thob cing dpyi ba'i don yang kun/skra sogs 'bal ba 'dzings pa gcad pa bshig pa 'bel ba legs pa yang dag pa chos mthun gyi gtam mchen sgo srog me tog 'bye ba bye ba rgyas pa zal ba 'byed pa zu ba dbye ba 'joms pa 'phral ba rgyas pa/ 'bras na bzus pa'i 'a sa rtse ro 'dzin pa yis 'byog pa ldag pa 'dag pa chang zu 'byo ba byo ba snod gcig nas gcig tu grug pa rtsos pa 'jangs pa dag pa lto ba 'ji ba chu la sprungs pa'ang yin snyam/ 'brom gyi rus 'dzin dge bshes ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'byon pa byon pa phebs pa 'byung ba'i dus tshe ma sa 'gros pa bros pa da sa shing — —rjes su 'brang ba 'brangs pa 'gro ba snyeg pa 'dzug pa/ 'brub pa zubs pa bcug pa'i khung bu kha 'byed pa kha dbye ba zu ba 'byol ba rtsol ba la ra zhing 'byer ba byer ba nyams pa 'a sa pa 'gro ba/ mtshang skyon 'thu ba 'a ba sngog pa zus pa'i ming tshig drungs 'byin pa 'don pa zung ba tshon mi 'byug pa cad pa byugs pa 'byongs pa byang ba 'byang ba 'byangs pa spyong ba spengs pa goms par ga pa 'ji ba 'byongs shig kyang /mtsho kha 'bri ba bri ba 'a ba pa dman pa dang yi ge 'dri ba chu 'brub pa 'phel ba rgyas pa 'ad ba zubs kyang 'jid nga sbyar ba'i don can pa la 'byar ba 'a ga mod byed po dang dngos su 'a la ma 'a la gyi khyad par yod tshul 'di kho bos kyang bsres na bkod pa dmas zud dgos rtags 'byar 'byar ma lha bu dang 'byor ba'i spyor yang /'ang ba po sems yod dang ya par gdon gyi rigs dang mib po'i don 'byor pa

snyed /mchag 11 /zhengs pa 'a rdo bab pa mthun pa dang 'byung 'gyur 'byung ba rus 'bal zhabs chud waṃ 'a pand kyis za 'bags pa bangs sogs 'as 'phul ba'o//khyi sogs rbad pa bod pa ⑫da pa long ba tsho ba mngag ba zab rinas bal ba'i da sgril ba yol ba kha rbad kha bas ba kha bab dam kha che ba/ za dba' zas klong 'a skya bab bad ka gyi dbye ba zhig mdang bal rbad rngod —'angs pa'i tso ba phying bab yo pa dang / bod ma mthub da dam zan rma ba gtong ba yan ma dgag ratsār+ṣa zur bka 'dra ba bya bod byed bad ra cig dang lo gtong bad gar sogs rar btags ba'o//spu ba bar du ba lnga ba zhe sogs kyi sha lhag ga za byur ka sogs lar btags ba'o//nor sogs sbyin pa pyin ba snyer ba gnod pa tsho pa gdon zhig tsho pa'i bdag bo yon bdag zon pa grogs 'bod pa bcol ba 'gugs ba sgron cig dang /spun pa ba sogs kyi shun pa'am skogs dang po med pa yos rta ma tsho lo dang sbang ma kang ma mam tsho gyi da jing ba'i snyegs bas sbangs pa sbang ba ba byabapa/ spug spug gam dang spug mnang ma khang pa sogs kyi nge go nor gter sba bya snas zin pa sbos shig sped bde bzhi ba don tsha ba gsang ba srung ba/ nyis sprug nyis sbyil 4 sprug rkyang pa dang ga ma sta du sbra nag tshangs ma gur 'bubs pa gub la sbyil ba ba ba sdeb pa bal bye ba spyor ba rdob pa/sgros pa nyags pa'am grang nas spur ma ji shing chung chung ngam rdul lha dur go me za sbar bdang sbor ba gnyis spor ba 'bar ba spor cig kyang / chu sogs kyis sgyus pa brdos pa bkrus pa zas zan zus pa ba'i sa pa g.yos pa phyogs gcig logs shig tu sboms zhes pa ba dnga~X ༵sa

'byung ba lhar na skul tshig tu gzung ba la don sdom pa sdud pa sre ba/ spum ma mngal ldan ma she spyor ma sto ba mgo sbos pa zangs pa gang ba srog chags kyid par zhig la ste zer/ phyag sbal bkun khang ngam bkun dong grog ma dang spur ba 'du zhig sgal ba rtse med sprul mig jog grogs ra mda' spran pa zon pa spungs pa grim pa stobs 'bad pa skyed pa spel ba spud pa 'bud byed me chas la sogs pa'i ming spubs nang ngam khog stong rgya du ga pad spubs sgyug grub ga sbyig mo sgrin mo'am gcer bur go sbyig pa 'dred pa 'byin pa la 'jug cing spe ga shed tshad pa'am dbyug res byed pa'i ming sbyong ba snang ba sbyor lhar na sbyar ba/ sbyag pa sha skam pa'am rid pa rtsad pa'i tshe dus kyi don yin snyam ste dpyad lus keng sbrid pa ste rkang pa zid na 'ja' zhing 'gro mi nus pa lta bu sba shing gi 'khar ba sba dbyug ste lcag sbom pa phra min rags pa sdom pa/ sha la 'khor ba'i sprang bu dang sprang ma ra yig gnyis pa sprang ma'i rtsi me tog bcud dang sprags pa sbrag pa sbyil ba/ sped byed rdo ba gor ma gser sogs kyi spram bu gru bzhi lta du'am lhad med dang rtsi ba'am ba'i nga ba sa le spram gser rin chen dang po dang zangs sa le sprum yang /sbyor ba sngon 'gro rigs pa zabs rnal 'byor spyan ba sgom pa sdeb pa 'khrig pa sbyang bya spang bya 'dag bya bsnab bya sbyong byed sbong byed 'dag byed slob zud sbyangs pa spangs dag bslabs pa/ dge sbyong sangs rgyas sogs gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa sogs gtsang spra gtsang ma dag pa sbyor ba sbyar ba sbyor cig kyang / 'doms gsang gnas kyi sba ba sba bya ste pho rtags dang zib sbyibs zug sbyibs g.yal ba'i zid speg sbad sbyang sbags sgams sbyong spyongs chu la spengs byed sbongs shig kyang 'thad snyam lus kyi sbo sogs sar btags ba'o//ka'i ro dus mtshan srog bral ba'i lus zugs pa rul ba ro zugs 'dam 336

sogs zug myog ldan smin nam mi gas ba nags tshal sogs su myul ba gnyul ba 'tsho ba rgyu ba myur ba mgyogs pa ga nyams ro myong ba rtsang ba tshor ba myong cha myu gu gsar zug lngang pa'i ming nas myug sogs ro mngar ba sogs myang ba smong ba bro ba myos pa bab ba'am dga' ba/ zung 'das zu ngan las 'das pa thar pa nges par song ba zung zung gug gug gam 'gro tshul myug myug khyag khyug ga 'tsho tshul la dmyugs tshul dang / zu ngan sems kyi rtsag bsngal lam mi bde ba zu ngam dgun dung ngam chu med pa skya ngam thang lha bu dang myos 'gyur skyangs myongs shig mog mog mad pa mal nul mes po ma rkyang ngo //dmag g.yul la tshogs dag gi ming nyes dmigs nyes pa'am mi dge ba'i 'bras bu dmangs ni rigs bzhi'i ya gyal dman pa tha ma tha shal dma' ba phri ba'am med pa/ dme po rus gcig pa gsod mkhan da nus long mig med pa ldongs pa dmigs bu long khrid pa long sna 'khrid mkhan med pa/ dmu rgod gyong po gtum pa da su chu da nu jing ste chu nad 'dre srin gyis da par la 'jug pa'i da nu gdon zhig chu nad kyi bdag po/ blo rig dkun pa blun pa mi gas ba da nus byung tshi chad pa smo shi ba yi chad pa bu ga'i don can gyi dmig khung bu/ /gtsang ma dag pa dme ba dbre ba bzug pa 'dzum da sul ba cung zad rgod pa rgod pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dzum das la dmul yang dmigs pa dmigs bya dmigs byed mthong ba bas pa sgom pa gnad rtsong ba gtod pa gtad pa/ lag dmar lag pas khag khur ba dang bshad pa kha dmar khas khag khur ba 'gan dang kha gas dang kha dmar gdags pa thag gcad pa lha bu kha dog mdog dmar ba'am po mtshal mdog sta bu//nyams shing dmas pa rgyad pa 'grib pa nyag phra ba dmod pa btsugs pa dang dmod pa 'dor ba gnyis smon lam ngad pa 'debs 337

pa dmod mo byed pa bden pa bdar ba lha bu/ dbyal ba chags pa'am dga' ba med pa tsha ba sogs gnas go sa dma' ba dmas pa dma' mo'i bya ba dman pa dmigs — kyis bsal ba spyir btang ma yin pa logs su bkar bar sa gzung dmigs kyis zu ba dang / myug myug byas te dmyugs pa bcug pa 'dzul ba 'thon pa 'tshul ba myug myug gi bya ba yin 'dra dmar khrid dmar ser mod mi dam 'damigs bcas dmigs med dmigs rnam dmag dpon mi dpung lha min da rgyal theg blo spyod man sogs das 'phul ma'o//zad du byung ba phul byung ngo mtshar 'phel ba dam pa rmugs 'dzin zugs ldan gnod sbyin gyi bye brag dzad la mi lam gnyid kyi 'khrul snang ste gnas skadas bzhi'i gcig rmang lam yang zer mis pa mi ba gzim lam 'byung ba mi lam mthong ba/ /rmang rtsa ba'am 'gram gzhi nas rmo ba dang rtsos pa gnyis rngod pa zhing gi zu slog pa'am rngon pa brgyab pa rmon pa rmo ba'i ming dor zung 'dra ba dang / rmongs pa gnyi nug ma rig pa bdag lha mi shes pa nugs pa gdon zhig dang rig pa mi gsal ba bying ba'i rnam grangs kyang yin khyi yis rus pa ril bu rkur ba sos bcem pa'am bcag nas bldad pa 'am ba nur ba skugs pa gso 'debs pa'am brgyab pa dang gnod pa'i ming za lhan skyes dang gsar byung gi za dang du ga dang skyon dang rus shig men pa tshil la yod pa'i sha nag dang rma shul chen bu yang zer rta mig rta sogs kyi rkang lag gi rwa rmig pa dang rgya dngul rta jig ma sga yi chas med rnga mar bskon bya/ rmongs bu grun po gsang gnas kyi spu cheg med gtan nas med pa gtan med ming med sun pa'i don can gyi rmus pa skyo ba mtsher ba yi chad pa/ ser me ser sna 'jungs pa bsris che sri ba phri ba ser sna byed pa lha bu ngo mtshar la go ba'i zad rmad byung mad po che lha bu/ rtso mo ma phyi dang ma phyi dang rgan cig

mo bal sog mel ba gzud pa dang 'kha ba yang yin snyam dris pa'i don can gyi zas pa rjed pa rmad pa gtab 'dri ba nu ba/ za bya mdongs mtha' can khams skya ba khams nyog pa rid pa nyams pa bya zung gar ram rkyong shad byed pa bgyid pa/ zog mgo chog dang go spyi mtshon las skyob gyed dang dbu rmog mgo rngog dang dbu 'phang dang ya bad kyang mas pa zas ma rngod pa ched pa za dang mig du sogs rar btags ma'o//sman nad gso zud kyi tshus dang spod sogs dang snan pa lha rje 'tsho byed gso ba po'i ming gtam mched spu ba rje bshad pa smos shig rje skul tshig zig rgyu ri dwags sred chu lhar snang ba snag rum nun rum snag nun pa dang man zhig zong ma min —pa la go ba'i snar gces pa gser dngul lha bu/ snan skye ba'i krongs yul sug spel dgel zur chag pa ma phra mo snyed na zheb spyag shad shig gi khyad par dang / sgyug ma shing zhig sgyug rtsi cu gang dong lha sbyi gu sgyu gu ste 'bri byed dam sgyug chung snyeg ma shing sgyug ma smin pa tshos pa thul bsad rung gzabs rung / tshe khog sku lam grong snad snad stod min pa sna phab pa sna 'bebs pa'am skyon brjod pa snad ra bstod ra min pa'am smod pa'i ming tsam dang brtas thabs kyis smod pa snad pa 'phya ba dma' bar byed pa/mgo sogs sgyung ba ring po'am dbyibs 'jong mo zad ba mab 'am gsang ba dang smo sngags sgyug skad dam 'o dod smras pa smra ba bshad pa/ du smad ma du gnyis ba'i sbyi ming ming mtshan nas smos pa brngod pa bshad pa spyan ka gnyen ka bag ma gtong len gyi thabs byed pa bgyid pa lhag rtsang zhig kyang / ngur thig za hong dang dmar ser rnam par smin pa 'bras bu spyi tsam dang 'brab lnga'i gcig dang gyed par yang go smos pa ci zhig dgos te bshad mi dgos/ sgyung bar gnas pa chos kyi dka' thub zud pa'am ltogs skom du gnas pa dus chod sgyur myur ba'am myur bcug pa spyon pa spyo ba 1 —

ba smyos pa sems rnal du ma gnas pa'am 'khrul ba/ smon 'drin grogs po blo brlug dri med dag pa dri smod lhar na gtam 'dri ba'i don du bshad kyang de la dri rmid 'thad snyam ste dpyad smon lam 'dod don la smon cing 'dun pa'i ming tsam sman pa phan pa sman gyur cig phan gyur cig lta bu/ smin drug dang smal po dang smin drug gi bu gsum skar ma'i khyad par/ lus kyi smi ba sha jig sgrog po'i rtsi 'ji mog ga ri tshos kha dog mdog sgrug po rgya spug lha bu/ sma ra kha spu smin ma mig spu smin 'khyod lta du spe sha can spe can nam rigs ngan/ nag rtsis kyi spe ba gcig dkar sogs dgu dang smon pa snad pa ‘sa pa smin byed sgyung zad pa smad 'tshong snas pa thig ze pa sogs sar btags ma'o//lha'i tsab tsub tshang tshul mi brtan pa mi bya mi bgyi tsog tsog pu tsog pu 'dug stangs shig tsan dan tsardo na zur chag pa tshim byid dam 'bar byed de shing zhig tsu ta ma za'i khyad par ro sgyur shas can gyi shing tsam pa ka me tog dang grong khyer zhig tsam ka zur chag tsa ko ra bya gong ma sreg gam mib mdzes shing zla ba'i bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bya dang tsi ti mo byi'u 'am bya chung zhig ne tsa 'dab chags rtse gnyis pa de tsam pa de snyed pa tsam zhes pa tshad 'dzin dang nges gzung mi sgra de tsug de 'dra'am de ci 'dra lags yin nam red 'di tsug sogs/ tse ne ce re'am 'dug tshul tse re skad tser tser tsa ri ba gnas tsa rir sdod mkhan/ tsā ru zhes pa'i don bza' ba'am lha bshos dang mdzes pa tsa na ka sran chung zhig tsug tsug kha nas tsug tsug zer ba'i sgra dang tsan+d+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsog pu ni tsu la sogs tsa rkyang ngo /gtsug tor spyi tor spyi bo dang gtsug gnyis mgo bo'am rtse mo gtsang khang dri gtsang khang ngam 'du khang gi spug khang gtsang ba dab pa btsog pa med pa/ mi gcigs pa mi rigs pa'am ma 'os pa'i spyod pa byed tshul gtsug lag sde sna dam gsung rab 340

kyi khang pa gnag gtsod rin gas shig rus rus pa'am ru'am rwas gtses pa 'tshe ba gzir bar byas shing gtser ba mi rigs byed pa'am 'tshe byed kyis gtses pa sun par byas pa'am gtses shig mche ba gcigs pa sgrig pa spyod ba rtseg pa gtsub byed kyi shing dang gtsub bya'i gtan gyi shing gtsubs pa gtsub ba brdar ba 'dud pa skyod pa/gtsa bo rang bzhen spyi khyab rje bo gnad mgon po snyeng po gcigs gces zas sa rtsa ba che ba chen po gtsag bu gtsag byed kyi mtshon chung ngam gtar kun kyis gtsags pa gshags pa gtar ba bkas pa bton pa gtsag pa/ gtsang chu chen nam dbus kyi cig shos sa dag pa'i phyogs ngos kyi don gtsang chu yang da bzhid du spyan gzu ba gtsu ba gtsang ma mi gtsang ba gtsub pa gtsag pa sogs gas 'phul tsam//btsan pa ldog pa med pa 'da' bar mi byed pa 'gyur mi nus pa dbang ba gnyan pa btsan po btsan pa po'am btsan pa'i ming gnya' khri btsan po srong btsan sogs bka' gsung btsan po 'da' mi nus pa'am gnyan pa rdzong mkhar btsan po bgrod dka'am 'gyur mi nus pa dang / btsun mo rje mo rgyal po'i chung mar go bu zug btsas pa btsa' ba skyes pa 'khrungs pa gru gzings ko btsas gla ste gru phud pa'i rngan pa'am yon btsal ba 'tsho ba gnyul ba brtag pa/ btsun pa gas bo khrims ldan grwa pa spyi dang bye brag la zhe sa'i brda mig kha btsums pa 'dzums pa zum du 'jug pa btson gyi ra ba bkun khang la sogs par go btsud pa 'dzud pa nang du bcug pa/ gos lhon pa btsems pa 'tshe pad+ma bas pa btsem pa btsag sa tshos sa sa tshon dmar po sogs dang btsod dmar tshos shing tshos kyis snam bu sha gser btsos pa mdog sgyur ba smin pa bzhus pa 'tshe'i pa/ /btsan dug bong nag sogs tshags 'tshag byed kyis btsags pa 'tshag pa dwangs snyigs zu bar shes dgos shing btsir ba 'tshir ba phyung ba bar du tsho1

bcing ba/ lcags btsa' g.ya' yis khyer ba ste g.ya' brgyab pa 'bags pa la go ba'i btsog pa mi gtsang bdabye ba btso blag tshos sa khrus mkhan byed po/ mtho btsams pa mtho 'tshams pa rtso 'dri ba 'gran pa gnod pa deg pa la go ba'i btsog pa 'tshog pa rdung ba btsog po rdo ba sgyug bro bo ngan pa'am mi legs pa po bkug pho rgod rdog pa rdung ba/ btsan 'dre'i bad par rgod po btsan thabs thabs btsan pa glo bur gser rin chen dang po btso ma ba'i btul byas pa'am lhad med kyi nun ma ste btsa ma'i gser sogs/ srol ka btsugs ba 'dzugs pa btod pa zu ba shing rkang 'thung btsugs pa 'dzugs pa bskyed pa btab pa bkun pa slong ba btod pa sgog pa ke'u btsong kun dong ngam 'tshong ba bzungs pa btsang ba 'tshong ba tshus brje ba/ btsad po rgyal po btsas ma lo tog bad bya ste 'tsho skyong byas pa'i don 'dra btsa' ba btso ba la btsas btsun ma btsem pa mtho btsam pa sogs bas 'phul tsam//rtsa lag gnyen nam nye 'brel rtsa ba gzhi ma drung sdong po'i 'og cha shod skyed byed gcigs gnad sdom rtse mo mchog ma mgo steng ma gong ma phul byung rab chod rtsi mdog sgyur byed dam ri mo 'ji zud kyi rdzas rtsing ba zhib min rags pa sbom pa rtsing po jing nge /rtsi mar 'o zho rtsi tog gi mar rtsi shing gzhe mthun gyi za'am rtsi dang shing rtsi thog ka'am ba'i 'bras bu rtswa sngo gzan pa sogs/ 'thab rtsod 'khrug rtsod rtsod pa 'thab pa mi mthun par pab da ba rtsed mo rtsed 'jo rol rtsed rtse ba dang rtses pa'am rtses shig dang rtsen pa rnams rol ba rtsed mo rtse ba/ lngas rtsen pa mi spyi'am lha'i dbye ba sum rtsen pa skabs gsum pa lha rtsis grangs sa rtsis rig rtsis mkhan rtsis pa ji po/ rtsib ma glo g.yas g.yon gyi rus thur lha bu'i ming rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum sogs spubs can rgyus pa chu ba rtsid pa g.yag gi spu lha bu nub pa mi 'jim pa gdung ba skya ba gyong ba yid du mi 342

'ong ba nub mo kha rtsang grong tshig ba kha lo ngam nga sangs da rtse rgod rtse zhing rgod pa lha 'bangs g.yog bo rtsam pa mi rin pa gong rtseg pa can ba rtseg rtseg byed pa/ rtsabs ni gcod pa'am cog rtse sogs mi nga la bar cad pa'i shing lta bu ba snyam rtsad gcod rtsad rtsa ba nas gab parang rtsa ba'am rjes gas pa tsher ma la ka ba'i rtsang snye mdos ma rtsang gur nga / stobs la go ba'i rtsal rol gnon pa'i ba ba 'bad pa dang rtsol ba brtson pa dang 'du ba dang brtsal brtsom ba bya ba'am mgo nga gas pa'am gsung rtsom rtsom pa brtsam pa sbyor ga zho sogs kyi rtsabs ji'am ru ji rtsab mo chang 'dra ba'i nga mam btung ba zhig ser po'i mdog 'dzin gyi rtsa ba lha lta bus btsos pa'i gos gyon pa sogs/rtsig pa rtsig sku rgang rtsig bzhin pa rtsig mkhan jig pa po rdo bzo lta bu 'khor lo gdugs ba so sa pa'i rtsibs keng ngam thur ma 1 du snye rtsibs ba khyad/ rtsangs pa mi gor gyi byedag mig pa'am can lag gi da lnga'i gcig srog rtsol rlung ste tha dad du zal ba yang snang rtsoms shig rtseg rtsegs shig rtseg rtseg bdud ma gla zhag rtsi gzhi rtsa ma rtsa cad cad sogs rar btags tsam//bka' gsung sprul ba ga nga ba dngos grub thunas chog gi grub pa sprul pa sbyin pa'am gnang ba dang sgo byin cig ga sbyin pa/ sbyin pa gru ba sbyin pa'am gtang bar bgyi bya bgyid du lha ba byed du bcug pa la la spyan ba/ma du gsol ga nga ba'am sbyin par mdzod dam nu zhes pa la don ba la dus gsu gyi tshe phal che ma zhes 'byung zhing can nga ga nga na 'das ma 'ongs go bar zad bsal ba'i don yang nga bya bar ma ba sogs sar btags tsam1 brtson pa rte 'grus pa 'bad pa snying brtse ba snyeng po ltar brtse ba ste snying rje brtse ba can brtse ldan snying rje sa/brtsad ba rtsod pa ba ba rtsad bcad pa lang ga

cing dris pa rmed nas brtsam bya bstan bcos sa bya ba lha bu brtsams pa rtsom pa sbyar ba byas pa/ khang bu yi ge brtsegs pa rtseg pa gcig steng du gcig bzhag pa lta du brtsigs pa rtsig pa steng nas steng du sgrig pa lta bur go dgos shing brtsi bya bgrang bya bkur bya yon tan sogs brtsis pa rtsi ba bgrangs pa rtsis pa skor ba bkur ba/ kha' so sogs brtse ba mi bzod pa snye lcags drad drad byas pa las so brtse ba lha bu ha cang shin tu brtsengs pa bsgyungs pa'am 'jol ba min pa'i don gos bgo bya/ brtsig brtseg brtsal ba sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i tsam//lha'i shing nags kyi tshal nags ma skyed mos tshal dga' tshal lam rdzum dang 'bras shing gi ra ba dang shing dgas tsam yang tshi gu 'bras bu'i dang gi rus pa kham bu'i tshi gu lta bu'i ming tshigs di mtshams sam bar mtshams gcod zud dang / snyigs ma ste tshigs pa tshigs ma lta bu/ tshogs pa 'dus pa phung po sde ba'i don sde le don chos las tshan dum bu tsho khag tshan pa drod kyi tshan dang shed kyi tshan dang yang lus kyi lang tsho na tshod lon/ tshon rtsi tshon nam mdog sgyur byed kyi rdzas rin po che'i phra 'bru lha'i tshom bu tshogs chung ngam tshan pa tshar gral du dngar ba 'greg pa/ the chos blo rtse gnyis som nyi tsham rngams 'jigs tshul lam 'jigs pa 'ju byed la go ba'i tshwa zas kyi ro bro byed sogs te tshu zhes tshig sogs med pa'i rkyang pa la smad 'dogs yod cing rgya tsha zhes pa lta bu'i tshig grogs sbyar na med par phyag len mdzad la 'on kyang lan tsā la yod pa mang ngo /khang pa spyi dang bye brag la go ba'i tshoms te sde tshan la yang 'jug ched du brjod pa'i tshogs sogs dang tsha tsho tshe tshe sa tshus tshir tshig tshogs tshes tshar tshal tshul tshig tshi tshong ba sogs tsha rkyang ngo //ngo mtshar tshud byung bad mtshar mtshan ma mtshon byed so gnyis dpe byad 344

brgyad cu༄tsho chu gter rgya mtsho sogs dang mtshe'u mtsho chung ba jing bu lta bu/ mtshe ma mngal gcig nas dus mnyam du skyes pa'i bu mtsham rjem tshigs 'brel lam bar bcad pa zu ba gcod pa mtshams che chung sbyor lta bu mtshan nyid rten pa'am 'brel ba'i gzhi ste mtshan nyid kyi zu brag gam mtshon bya'i bad par ram dpe dang mtshon byar yang 'jug pa dang / mtshan nyid mtshon byed go byed mtshan ma rtags rgyu ston byed mtshon bya go bya rtogs bya bstad bya mtshan ma mi nor ba'i rtags rgyu rang bzhin lhas smos pas mtshan byed rtogs byed stod byed dam dpe'am cung zad mtshan lhar na spras pa/ phyogs dus kyi mtshams shar lhodang nyin mtshan gyi bar rto du skyon la go ba'i mtshang nyes pa bcab bya nongs pa mtshad mo mtshan ba zal lam mtshar ba mdzes pa ya mtshan rtsed mo/ mtshur rus kyi khyad par te mar ba'i slob ma mtshur ston dbang dor lha du kha sna'i mtshul pa kha sna'i nang ngos mtshal tshon dmar zhig ste rgya mtshal sogs dang mtshungs pa 'dra ba — mnyam pa/ rgyal mtshan ba dan mchod ngos mtsha' mes gcan gzan 'phar ba mtsha' rta nag dmar mtsha' lu rteng pa dkar po dang khyim bya dang dmar po'i don yang yin 'dra/ mtshar ba mdzes pa dang skyes ched ma 'dres par gas ba mtshar po mdzes po'i da mtshar po sdug pa mdzes pa yid 'ong khyim mtshos khyim rogs shag mtshes sgyum mtshes mtshe snan zhig ste ra mtshe lug mtshe lha bu dang mtshan sngo man zhig ste mtshan dmar lta bu gso gzhung du tshan yang snang / skyeb gzhan gyis bar mtshams gcad du med par dmal ba mnar med du skyoba'i las te pha bsad pa sogs lnga dang nye ba lnga dang sa mtshams med pa la yang go mtsher ba sun pa las byed par mi spro ba skyo ba 'tsher yang 'thad dur mtshed dur gnas sa dur du bcug ba mtshun pa mes sam de'i bla'am lha/mtshon cha gri la sogs pa'i ming phyag na bsnam bya'i mtshan ma ral gri pad+ma lta bu dang 346

mtshan ma mchod cha mtshog ma ma mtshams nas gyen du sor bzhi'i thad dang spyi bor yang go 'thar ba gdengs pa/ ming gi don ston pa'i mtshan mngon brjod dang zas pa'i mtshan mtshar po khyad mtshar ya mtshan mtshal kha dge mtshan sogs mas 'phul tshar//blo sems 'tshabs pa rtab pa brel ba 'jigs pa chu ja 'tshag pa btsags pa dngas snyigs zu ba nang du ma bos par 'tshangs pa btsangs pa dbang shed lha dus 'dzul ba 'jug pa bdams pa/ til sgrub 'tshir ba ba mi ba bkar ba num par byed pa 'don pa me yis 'tshig pa tshig pa sreg pa du ba dud pa 'tshubs pa 'jir ba tshang tshub byed pa/ zas gos gser 'tshed pa btso ba zin pa mdog sgyur ba 'ju bar zud pa lus srog 'tsho ba gso ba gson pa 'tsho byed gso byed snan pa skyong byed 'tshengs pa tshim pa dga' ba rgyal ba/ 'tshe ba gnod pa gtse ba nye zho med pa dgag tshig 'tshag pa sha nyams rgyas pa'am bzang legs pa 'tshal ma zas sa za ma 'tshal ba za ba'am bzhes pa dang 'tshal cig dang shes ma shes sogs/ nor sems pa dag 'tsho ba btsal ba gnyul ba rtsad gcod pa brtag pa phyugs dud 'gro 'tsho ba btso ba skyong ba 'tshog chas yo byad dam nyer mkho 'tshong ba bkung ba tshong rgyag pa/ brdeg pa la go ba'i 'tshog pa btsag pa'am rdung ba ngal dub 'tsho ba gso ba mnyel gso ba 'od sogs 'tsher ba 'bar ba'am bkrag thon pa rta skad sgrog pa las la sun pa'i don yin zhing /blo yid dang 'tsham pa mthun pa 'tshams pa ran par go skyin pa tshab ma 'tshab pa bsab pa 'jal ba ldan pa/ gdung rigs rus 'tshob pa 'dzin pa 'tshang rgya ba sangs rgyas pa byang chub pa longs pa'i don can gyi 'tshar ba cher skye ba'am 'phel ba dang skyed 'thon pa/ phyag 'tshal ba btsal ba gus pas 'dud pa shes pa go ba dang chog pa 'greg pa la go ba'i 'tshal ba 'dod pa dang dgos par yang 'jug 'dzom pa'i don 346

la 'tshag 'jug ste gsog pa dang 'dzom pa dang gnyer ba dang rgyas par yang go 'tshog pa 'tshul pa 'tshams pa spyan gyis 'tsho ba sems 'tshig pa 'tsho mdzad nyer 'tshe sogs 'as 'phul tsham//dab dza rag tshu bum sogs snod chung dza lang gtum po'am dred po dza bo di shing gi byi brag dza ya rgyal ba'am mi phan pa can ldan pa dang ldan dze ta'i tshal dza ba sogs dza rkyang ngo //dpa' ba'i don can gyi mdzangs pa snying stobs che ba mdza' bo mdza' ba po grogs po zla bo'i ming bang mtshod mdzod khang dkor mdzod mdzes pa mtshar ba legs pa mthun pa spud pa/ gnod pa la go ba'i mdzis pa ste khro bo gnod mdzis kyang mdzub mo sor mo dang sdigs mdzub mdzod spu sangs rgyas kyi smin phrag na yod pa'i spu dkar po/ mdzo po mo ba mo dang g.yag 'dus pa'i bu rta mgyogs 'gro'i ming mdzer ba sha 'bur ram sha'i gzer bu mdze da klu nad dam tsi ti dz+wa la dang / mdzol bu ri dgas sogs 'dzin byed kyi rgya dang snad 'tshong gi bu bsrung ba srung ba'i don mdzad pa bya ba'am 'ja las mtshad cig byos shig gyis shig ya rabs la go ba'i mdzangs pa ma rabs min pa kun spyod legs pa dang mkhas pa'i mdzangs pa byams pa'am mthun pa'i mdza' ba mdza' mo sogs mas 'phul dzad//'dzings pa 'dzing ba 'khrugs pa rtsod pa 'dres pas gos gzan 'dzar ba thur du 'phyang ba ring ba 'jol ba lha du lag ba sug pas 'dzin pa gzung ba zhen pa gces pa yul can/ 'dzag pa zag pa 'bab pa lhung ba 'thon pa dang 'dzir ba bkur ba 'dzag pa'i don sdod spyad 'dzed pa bzed pa kha gyed bstan pa 'dzem pa mi 'jug pa ngo tsha ba bag med mi byed pa ba dogs pa/ 'dzur ba bzur ba 'byol ba mi 347

'jug pa'i don yin zhing khang pa'i sgo dang khung bur 'dzul ba 'jug pa zul ba 'dzeg pa 'dzegs pa gyen du 'gro ba 'dzeg skas them skas ya gad 'dzugs pa btsugs pa gzugs pa/ bzhin ras 'dzum pa dmul ba ngo dkar ston pa cung zad dgod pa 'dzin pa dbang lag dang sngo 'dzin snod nang du 'dzud pa btsud pa grug pa bcug pa/'dzam bu'i shing gis mtshan pa'i gling ste ba zur chag pa'i don du gzung 'dzom pa tshogs pa 'dus pa kha tshang ba 'dzom po 'dzoms pa nor tshus 'dzangs pa dang 'dzad pa gnyis zad pa god pa gtugs pa/ 'dzab ni dza pa zur chag pa ste bzlas pa'am brjod pa sngags bzlas lta bu skad 'dzer ba skad 'dzer 'dzer ram tser tser byed pa dang zer ba'am spu ba nor ba'i don can gyi 'dzol ba 'khrul ba/ 'du 'dzi g.yeng yul lam rnam g.yeng chud 'dza' ba chud za ba'am zos pa rdo yi 'dzeng rdo'i tshigs sam zu braga'akhrugs pa'i don can gyi 'dzag 'dzog 'dzings pa 'dres pa sna tshogs dang 'dzing pa 'dzegs pa 'dzums pa 'dzoms pa sogs 'as 'phul dzad//kun tu rdzob pa yang dag par sgrib pa nun pa snang ba tha snyad rdzun pa mi bden pa log pa'i tshig spu ba can gyi don rdzab rdzub tsab tsub g.yo zol dang / phyugs gnag gi ji bo skyong byed 'tsho byed lha khu'i ming rdzongs skyes sa skal ba'am rngan pa 'bul ba sogs su go ji'u rdza ma chung ba ji bo chung ba byin pa ster ba/ jing bu phal cher bcos pa'i mtshe'u da go rdzus te skyes pa pad+ma sogs su skyes pa ste skye gnas bzhi'i gcig 'dam pa rdzab rdzob ljan sdin lha bu/ ji rlung phyogs ngos te rlung rgyu ba'i phyogs rdza ma sa snod tshu khog la sogs pa'i ming bu rdzi bu 'tsho mkhan dam byis pa'i g.yog byed dang / rdzi ring ba'i dri tshong byed med pa dgag tshig khyi lta bu la yod ji ma mig lhags kyi mtha' na yod pa'i spu zin pa'i don can gyi rdzogs pa tshar ba dang zad pa/ mkhar la go ba'i rdzong ste 348

bgrod dka'i khang pa dang zag rdzong sogs nor rdzas ka ca spyad dngos tshus zhes pa dngos bo rang bzhin bye brag kho na tshus cha me mda'i ros sogs rdzu zhing 'phrul ba snad nas me 'bar stod nas chu 'bab pa sogs dang / rdzogs pa gang ba tshang ba yang dag par sangs rgyas pa shākya thub pa lha burang ma ga gi nu ba phrag rdzong ) ba nu ba ji ba nu ji rdzong ba sogs rar btags dza'//gzhan pha rol gyis mi dgag ku ba ji ba ji ba thub pa tshugs pa gnod pa khro bo la sogs par brdzus pa dzu bsgyur ba ma yin pa la yin pa lhar byas pa/ ral pa skra ring gyen du brjes pa rdzob slong ba sgrong ba srog chags 'bu ba jis pa mnan pa ji ba chebs pa/ zan spags ba jis pa bsnas pa mnyes pa ji ba yul gzhan sogs su brdzangs pa mngag pa btang ba bskur ba bcug pa rdzong ba dang bzu ba ba) ba ba'i ba bdang ba sogs/ bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i dngo//spyod wa skyes sems can pha pha phang bya ma byi'am so gshog gnyis ldan gyi sems can zhig chu 'gro ba'i wa chu 'khrid nus kyi brus pa lha bu'i shing sogs te ka kha yang / 'gi'u lang glang chen sogs las 'byung ba'i snan tshus brgyad kyi gcig pi wang sgra snyan tathu ra 'dzum wang lngang 'dzum da sul da dul rgod pa'i dam 'gyur/ yid sems la kal le gsal ba'i tshul lam rnam 'gyur wang long rna rgyan nam rna long dang / za ta ras dang snan zhig dang gru gu yang yin snyam yug ras yug lha bu dang sa snan zhi la nyam la chung wa sogs lnga rkyang ngo //spyod zha bo yan lag nyams pa'am zha pa po'i don zhwa mo mgo'i zhwa ste nu yang zer zhum zhom zhen zhugs zhu nus zhag zhog zhing zhes zhe'o zhed da zhig zhang zhung bag la zha ba zhun ma zheng zho zhib zho sha sogs zha rkyang ngo //349

/nying 'dzin sogs la mnyam pa mtshungs par gzhag pa 'jog pa rjes thob kyi cig shos dang bsal gzhag gzhal bya shes bya'am 'jal zud kyi yul tshad dam rin gyis gzhal du med pa'i khang pa gzhal yas khang kun gyi gzhi ma rtsa ba rten sa bon gnas rgyud khams kun gzhi'i rnam shes sogs rnam par gzhag pa tshul la lugs dgag sgrub kyi rnam gzhag sogs te 'jog pa'i don nam yang gzhag pa dus gtan nam sgyun pa/gzhon nu na phra'am gzhon pa gzhung khog ga zo bzang po legs pa gzha' tshon 'ja' tshon gyi brda rnying gzhu gnam ru mda' stan te gzung bya'i don 'dra/ gzhogs zur gyis slong ba ste gzhan gyi rdzas 'thob par bya ba'i phyir de la bsngags pa gyed pa log 'tsho lnga'i gcig bdud dgra nad gzhom pa 'joms pa tshar gcod pa sel ba sbo lus kyi brang dang lto ba'i ngos gzhogs glo'am ngos sa zur sogs kyang go gnas la go ba'i gzhi rten bslab gzhi gzhi bcu bdun gzhong pa snod spyad ka to ra g.yang gzhi yan lag tshang ba'i pags pa gzhan pha rol lam tha dad dam bdag min pa'am bya las/mngag tu gzhug bya ste pho nya dang bran g.yog khu ba dang nu ma gzhib pa 'jib pa'i don yin la gzhol ba 'bab pa 'jug pa 'du ba zug pa/ gzha' gsang g.yung drung ngam rtag pa mi 'grur ba 'phrin las gzhongs yul smongs su go lcag spu lcag gis gzhu ba snan pa rgyag pa gzung ba/ gzhi grub pa yod pa gzhal bya smos ma dgos pa don la grub pa gzhung bstan bcos sogs kyi lugs ka brtag pa la 'jug pa'i gzhig pa dpyad pa bshig pa bcom pa rjes gzhig lta bu gzhug pa bcug pa byed du 'jug pa/ lus kyi ngos sam gzhogs zud sogs kyi don nad kyi gzhi ma bskung gzhi gzhang mad dam 'doms dang bshang lam la go zhing bshang la gyi dang sor bzhi tsam na yod pa'i bur nad la gzhang 'brum zer gzhil ba bcil ba 'jil ba/ gzhar yang nam yang ngam slar yang 360

gzhur ba 'jur ba ga pa med pa dgag tshig yid gzhungs blo gas lam 'dzin rtsal che ba mkhas pa gzhob pa 'tshig pa ste bal rwa thab ga ba lha du/ gzhis ka sa zhing sgos gzhis pha gzhes sogs spu dang gzhas gnyis don gcig gzhas gtong ba spu len pa 'tsho gson zhing gzhes pa rdod pha'am ba'i gas pa/ dran pa mi brjed pa nye bar gzhag pa 'jog pa bzhag pa bsgrigs pa'i don la go ba'i gzhibs pa gshibs pa sdeb pa/ gzhen pa legs pa'am phan pa la bsku ba stog 'debs sa dran bskul sogs nang du gzhug pa bcug pa 'jug pa dang dus kyi ga sa gzhungs pa gnung bgres gzhon gzhi la ma gzhi gzhal ba sogs gas 'phul zha'o/ /gnas su bzhag pa 'jog pa zin pa tshar ba bzhad pa bgad pa'am dgod pa bzhad mo ni gad mo'am bzhad gad dam ga zha bzhad bya'i bad par te ngang pa yin nam dpyad dkar po bzhi grangs ka bzhabs pa 'jabs pa gab nas sgra spu bzhar ba zegs pa bcad pa bzhams pa 'jam por byas rte bsgo ba bslab bya byed pa ste 'dul ba'i brda dran bskul/ las brgyanas gsol ba dang bzhi'i las sum cu tsam yod de 'di yang 'dul ba'i brda dgongs pa la go ba'i bzhed pa bsam pa 'dod pa 'thad pa de bzhin nyid chos nyid yang dag mtha'/ bzhengs pa langs pa ldang ba bkun pa bzhugs pa bsdad pa yod pa gnas pa 'byon pa la go ba'i bzhud pa 'jud pa phebs pa song ba nyi ma ba'i da pa bzhon pa theg pa rta sogs zhod pa 'chib pa/ bzhon ma 'o ma bzho sgyu yod pa'i 'dzo mo sogs bzho ba dang bzhos pa gnyis 'jo ba brlan pa la go ba'i bzha' ba gsher ba bzher ba bzhogs pa shib sogs 'jog pa/ g.yog dang nor bzhun pa legs pa bad du 'ong ba mar shā ba'i ba ba nus pa skol ba'am 'ju ba bzhur ba dngas snyigs zu ba'am gud du bton pa sog nas lhag bzas bzhes pa za ba rgyan 351

pa led pa 'thung ba sogs don mang / bzhin ras zhal ras gdong me bzhi dang gro bzhin dang byi bzhin gsum skar ma'i khyad par/ /'di ji de bzhin lha bu 'dra ba dpe sgra khur 'gan bzhes pa len pa sgom pa 'khyer ba dpang po la 'jug pa'i che bzhi gnya' bo ste grangs kyi bzhi min par bshad/ bzhi mnyam bshang ba'i ming sogs bzhag nang khrol rgyu ma zhig dang bzhus pa ba'i na po bzhibs pa tshul bzhin skye bzhin shes bzhin bzher ba sogs bas 'phul zha'o//ma dang zu tshod 'i sngo tshod tsher ldan mi zad pa mi 'dzad pa zad mi shes pa gzhan mchog dman kun la klo ba bzla ba 'ad pa snab/ rig sngags sogs zlos pa bzla ba skor ba yang yang brjod pa rngos shig kyang glos pa'i gar rig gnas chung ba lnga'i gcig gar 'khrab pa'i ming zla ba ku nud gnyen sogs skum po dbyibs kyi khyad par gor gor dang ril ril skum pa/ zla gam zla zud kyi dpyibs dang gos shig zla yis dbye ba grogs kyis bye ba bsdu ba drug gi gcig zlas drangs pa klog pa bzlog pa log tu 'jug pa dang / zla bo grogs po mched po spun zla lo dus shig zla ba zhag sum cu'i ming zu ngan sems sdug las zlo ba bzla ba 'da' ru 'jug pa sgrol ba/ bskyar ba'i don can gyi smos pa don gcig yang yang 'chad pa ldab pa rngos skyon lta bu dang zum pa la rngo ba zla bral za ma chud za zing zing bos la ba zag pa zab pa zug pa zer ba zol sbyor zong zum pa zil ba sogs za rkyang nyid do//gcan gzan stag sogs gzig gcan gzan zhig gi ming gzugs brnyan 'dra cog snang brnyan gzigs pa lha ba shes pa 'tsho ba dgongs pa/ gza' nyi ma sogs skar ma bra nye sogs 'od gzer 'od zer snang ba gsal ba gzi brjid gzi byin bkrag zil gzi nor bu khri bo zhig dang nus pa'am zil lam 'od/0rngul len pa'i 352

gzan yo byad bcu gsum gyi gcig sogs phrag pa dang snod lha bur gzed pa 'dzed pa bzed cing gzar ba bka ba dpyang ba/ gzong shing sogs rko byed kyi spyad cig gi ming gzeb gur dang sgyug gzeb sogs la go gzer bu lcags gzer chung ba sogs gzugs pa btsugs pa 'dzugs pa/ gzegs ma zegs ma nyar ma zer ma nyag ma phra ba'i dngos po gzegs zan zab kyi zegs ma za zhing 'tsho ba ste bye brag pa'i ston pa sogs gzir ba mnar ba gtod pa kun pa skyed par go gzas pa bdeg par brtsams pa chas pa gtad pa/ da gzod da gdod da tsam drin byas pa gzo ba byed pa rtsi ba 'jal ba rtsol ba'am 'bad pa chud mi gzon pa chud mi za ba'am chab mi 'tshal ba/gzu lums rang bzo bab col gzung ba yul lam gzhal bya dang bcang bya 'dzin pa yul can nam 'jal byed dang 'chang ba gzeg cha gnyod ka'am za dngos chung ba/zug gzer zug cing na ba'am na zug dang gzer bu brgyab pa lha du la go gzem pa 'dzem pa ba'i ma pa mnal ba gnyid dam gnyid log pa gzim la nyal sa'am gnas mal gzim shag lha bu zhe sa'i brda yang yin gzud pa btsud pa bcug pa/ gze ma gze ma ra mgo zer ba'i tsher ma rtsa ba lnga'i nang tshan gzang ring rtse rdo zheng ring ba gzan pa gnod pa gtses pa zad pa gzan po/ gru la go ba'i gzings chu sogs las sgrol zud dang 'dzings pa dang gru gzings ma sha khog gi cha zhig la gzug zer te gzug gcig gnyis lha bu zas kyi don la go ba'i gzan zan gyi ming / phying srin gzar stan nam gdan gzar bu skyogs sam spug byed dgang ba'i gzar bu dang grugs pa'i gzar bu gnyis sbyin sreg gi snod spyad sogs dang bsnam shing zhig kyang / gzengs bstod pa 'dun sar bstod pa'am mtho bar byed pa gzi ni mdangs sam stobs sogs gzod ma gdod ma thog ma'i ming dus chod/ ri gyed gzar po dam po bgrod༄ka' ba 3du

gzugs mo ni byi thur can te snang gzugs sgang zur dang lus sogs/ gzar ba dpyang ba'i thag pa gos kyi gdang bu gzungs chem bu'i gzungs dang bum pa'i gzungs thag sogs gzabs pa gzob pa bkar na byed pa sgrig pa bstar ba gzabs sprod dang gzabs gzabs kyang go gzags pa 'dzag pa lhung ba/ gzungs sngar thos pa'i chos don mi brjed par 'dzin pa spobs pa zad mi shes par 'chad nus pa gzungs sngags yi ge drug ma sogs thugs blo gzu bo drang po ris su mi lhung ba/ bsgo ba bslab bya rna bar chud gzon pa mi nyan pa dang gzengs pa gzings pa gzims pa gza' gtad gzu gzugs su rung ba gas 'phul za'o//bza' ba bza' bya spyad ba zas bza' ba dang bzas pa gnyis za ba bzhes pa spyod pa gnod pa bud med la go ba'i bza' ni mo'i don rte rgya bza' bal bza' lha bu/bza' chung ma'am mo mi sgo ma snyes pa ste don khyo shug bzi ba ra ro ba'am nus pa'i don yin zhing phrad ma dgag sgra bskugs pa dris pa zas pa nus pa blugs kyang go snyam/na bza' gos sam bgo ba bzang po legs pa dge ba phan pa bzang ba lag pa sug pas bzung ba 'dzin pa 'chang ba/ bzo bo bzo rig shes mkhan nam bzo byed dam bzo pas lhung bzed yo byad bcu gsum gyi gcig slong por yang zer bzed zhal zhag grug gam ba snod bzed pa 'dzid pa gzed pa/ bze re mi bzod pa' mas na med pa chung ba ste bzod sran che ba dang gnyod chung yang mi bzad pa ma rungs pa ha cang drag yul tshabs che ba'i las bya ba la bzur ba 'dzur ba gzur ba/ bzod pa bsran pa nus pa khro ba spong ba tshogs gnyis bskums pa bsdus pa 'dums pa dril ba mthun par byas pa ldang bar byas pa ston pas skar rgyal la tshigs bcad kyis bstod pas bskad pa mang po'i tshogs ba'i mas pa lha du sngags gzungs bzla ba dang bzlas pa gnyis 364

bskyar ba tsho pa rje mi dgag tshig bzlog pa sgyur ba phyir ldog tu 'a ga pa krog pa g.yul dmag bzog pa rngog pa bkag pa rdog tu 'jug pa'am log par byas pa zu ngan las bzla ba rngo ba bzlas pa/ phyogs gcig tu du ma bskums pa bsdoms pa bsdus pa dar bskum pa lad mo dang la bzla bzlas bzo bzos bgrug pa bzabs pa bzang ba sogs bas 'du pa bka 'o//'ongs 'ong 'o skol 'on pa 'ug pa 'on cig 'os pa 'ol kha 'ud po che 'og ma 'on tang 'o ma 'obs 'od zer 'o dod sogs 'a nyid do//ge yi rang ga na gyis byas pa la dga' ba'am dga' ba tsam yi chad pa tshi cad pa yi nug pa yi dwags ngan song gsum gyi gcig dang /mda' yab khang pa'i pu shu rnga ma'i yab ste rlung yab bsil yab sogs dang ya masang ya med yur ba yungs kar yol go ga mo yan pa yar ba yang ba yu ba yol ba yos sogs ya rkyang ngo //g.yor mo gdos pa gru ga ngas kyi dar po che rlung g.yor g.yo ba dang g.yos pa gnyis 'grul bskyon pa 'ab ba 'khyog pa ba ba phyi ma g.yos shig kyang g.yab mo g.yab g.yug ga g.yob pa'i ming tsam ga pa sa pa g.yob pa g.yab pa bskyod pa 'gugs pa'i brda sogs byas pa/ g.yor po yul gyi bye brag g.yung ba 'dris pa'am mi 'drog pa'am ba'i ba ba dang zhan pa dman pa za ba 'a ga pa longs spyod pa sogs g.yan pa gang nad dam za 'phrug gi nad dgab pa 'ge sa pa'i gos lta bu ste yos da bcu ga gyi ga dgab sogag g.yang sa lhang sa'am sa gzar po mi g.yo ba mi dzin pa mi ba'i ba g.yung drung rtag pa 'gyur med dang bkra shis pa'i ri mo zhig g.yang dpal nga phun tshogs nga sgyu/ g.ye ba bsnye bstom las brtson med brjed pa g.yeng ba med pa dgag tshig g.yur du za ba—bas rgyas nas zur du ba nga ba3 du du
